title: Accelerating Distributed Deep Learning using Multi-Path RDMA in Data Center Networks
authors: Feng Tian; Yang Zhang; Wei Ye; Cheng Jin; Ziyan Wu; Zhi-Li Zhang
venue_full: ACM SIGCOMM Symposium on Software Defined Networking Research
research_focus: Datacenter networking, RDMA / Transport, Routing / Load balancing, Network topology

problem_statement.en: Standard RDMA is a point-to-point transport mechanism that cannot utilize the rich multi-path topology of modern data center networks, leading to congestion and sub-optimal performance for distributed deep learning workloads.
problem_statement.zh: 標準 RDMA 屬於點對點傳輸機制，無法利用現代資料中心網路豐富的多路徑拓撲，導致分散式深度學習工作負載面臨壅塞與效能不佳的問題。

key_innovation.en: Maestro, a purely software-based multi-path RDMA middleware that uses virtual NICs (vNICs) to enable path control, message decomposition into chunks, and flexible, application-aware load balancing without modifying existing RDMA hardware.
key_innovation.zh: Maestro 是一套純軟體的多路徑 RDMA 中介層，藉由虛擬 NIC（vNICs）實現路徑控制、訊息分塊，以及彈性的應用感知負載均衡，無需修改現有 RDMA 硬體。

key_improvements.en: Up to 66.7% reduction in transport time for DDL applications and effective bandwidth aggregation with negligible CPU overhead.
key_improvements.zh: 分散式深度學習應用的傳輸時間最高降低 66.7%，並在幾乎不增加 CPU 額外負擔的情況下實現有效頻寬聚合。

ai_task: Distributed Deep Learning, Model Synchronization, Collective Communication
traffic_pattern: All-to-All, Elephant flows, Mice flows, Ring-AllReduce
compute_memory_hw: Xeon E5-2620v3, DDR4, Mellanox ConnectX-5, Mellanox ConnectX-3 Pro

title: Automated Design of Agentic Systems
authors: Shengran Hu; Cong Lu; Jeff Clune
research_focus: Agentic / Workflow serving

problem_statement.en: Building blocks of agentic systems (chain-of-thought, self-reflection, tool use, memory) and their combination into effective compound workflows are still hand-designed, requiring substantial domain-specific manual tuning by researchers and engineers. The paper introduces and formalizes the problem of Automated Design of Agentic Systems (ADAS): whether the design of agentic systems — inventing novel building blocks and combining them — can itself be automated.
problem_statement.zh: agentic 系統的基本構件(chain-of-thought、self-reflection、tool use、memory)及其組合為有效複合 workflow 的方式,目前仍仰賴人工設計,需要研究人員與工程師投入大量特定領域的手動調校。本文提出並形式化 Automated Design of Agentic Systems(ADAS)問題:agentic 系統的設計——包含發明新的基本構件並加以組合——本身是否能夠被自動化。

key_innovation.en: Meta Agent Search: a frozen "meta" LLM agent (GPT-4) iteratively programs new agentic systems as executable Python code (a `forward` function within a ~100-line framework), each new design conditioned on an ever-growing archive of previously discovered agents and their measured validation performance. Because programming languages are Turing-complete, searching the code space can in principle express any agent — arbitrary prompts, tool use, control flow, and their combinations — going beyond prior prompt-only or fixed-graph search spaces.
key_innovation.zh: Meta Agent Search:採用一個凍結參數的「meta」LLM agent(GPT-4),迭代地將新的 agentic 系統編寫為可執行的 Python 程式碼(於約 100 行框架內的 `forward` 函式),每一個新設計皆以持續擴增的歷史檔案為條件,該檔案記錄先前發現的 agent 及其在驗證集上實測的效能表現。由於程式語言具備 Turing-complete 特性,搜尋程式碼空間原則上可表達任意 agent——任意 prompt、tool use、控制流程及其組合——從而超越先前僅限 prompt 或固定 graph 的搜尋空間。

baselines_compared: Chain-of-Thought, Self-Consistency with CoT, Self-Refine, LLM-Debate, Quality-Diversity, Step-back Abstraction, Role Assignment, Prompt Optimization

key_improvements.en: DROP F1 79.4 vs 65.8 best hand-designed; MGSM +14.4%; MGSM-searched agents transfer +25.9% to GSM8K.
key_improvements.zh: DROP F1 79.4 對最佳人工設計 65.8;MGSM +14.4%;MGSM 搜出的 agent 遷移到 GSM8K +25.9%。

structure_space: Workflow code, Prompts (joint)
decision_mechanism: Evolutionary / swarm search, Textual gradient (LLM feedback)
optimization_signal: Validation-set score, Task utility (accuracy), Textual feedback
backbone_models: GPT-4 (meta agent that programs new agents)
GPT-3.5 (execution of discovered agents and baselines / evaluation)
benchmarks_used: ARC, DROP, MGSM, MMLU, GPQA, GSM8K, GSM-Hard

agent_scenario.en: Two roles. (1) A single meta agent (GPT-4) that, during an offline search, writes the code for new candidate agentic systems and self-reflects to debug/ensure novelty. (2) The discovered agentic systems themselves, which are compound multi-call workflows executed with GPT-3.5 — e.g., a "Multi-step Peer Review Agent," a "Divide and Conquer Agent," and the best ARC agent, a "Structured Feedback and Ensemble Agent" that runs 5 chain-of-thoughts, routes answers through specialized expert roles (Efficiency Expert, Readability Expert, Simplicity Expert) plus a human-like critic, iterates a refinement loop 3 times, and finally ensembles the top-3 answers. Tools include code execution (for ARC the agent writes and runs the transformation rule rather than answering directly). Search is single-domain (run independently per domain); the framework itself (~100 lines) exposes FM-query and prompt-formatting primitives.
agent_scenario.zh: 兩種角色。(1)單一 meta agent(GPT-4),於離線搜尋過程中為新的候選 agentic 系統編寫程式碼,並透過 self-reflection 進行除錯與確保新穎性。(2)被發現的 agentic 系統本身,為以 GPT-3.5 執行的複合多次呼叫 workflow——例如「Multi-step Peer Review Agent」、「Divide and Conquer Agent」,以及最佳 ARC agent「Structured Feedback and Ensemble Agent」,後者執行 5 條 chain-of-thought,將答案經由專門的專家角色(Efficiency Expert、Readability Expert、Simplicity Expert)及一位擬人化評論者進行路由,將 refinement 迴圈迭代 3 次,最終集成前 3 名答案。工具包含程式碼執行(於 ARC 中,agent 編寫並執行轉換規則,而非直接作答)。搜尋為單一領域(各領域獨立執行);框架本身(約 100 行)提供 FM-query 與 prompt 格式化的基本原語。

title: AFlow: Automating Agentic Workflow Generation
authors: Jiayi Zhang; Jinyu Xiang; Zhaoyang Yu; Fengwei Teng; Xiong-Hui Chen; Jiaqi Chen; Mingchen Zhuge; Xin Cheng; Sirui Hong; Jinlin Wang; Bingnan Zheng; Bang Liu; et al.
research_focus: Agentic / Workflow serving

problem_statement.en: Building effective agentic workflows (structured sequences of LLM invocations with control logic) still requires heavy manual design, and prior automation methods rely on manual initial setup and search over overly narrow representations, so they fail to fully automate discovery of effective, diverse workflows. The goal is to automatically generate optimized workflows per task/domain with minimal human intervention.
problem_statement.zh: 建構有效的 agentic workflow(具控制邏輯的結構化 LLM 呼叫序列)仍需大量人工設計,而既有的自動化方法依賴人工初始設定,並在過度狹隘的表示空間中搜尋,因而無法完全自動化地探索出有效且多樣的 workflow。其目標在於以最少的人為介入,針對各任務/領域自動生成經最佳化的 workflow。

key_innovation.en: Reformulates workflow optimization as a search over code-represented workflows (LLM-invoking nodes connected by code edges, plus reusable Operators) navigated by a Monte Carlo Tree Search variant, where an LLM acts as optimizer to expand/revise workflow code and execution accuracy is the reward, with a soft mixed-probability node-selection rule and tree-structured experience backpropagation.
key_innovation.zh: 將 workflow 最佳化重新表述為對「以程式碼表示的 workflow」之搜尋(由呼叫 LLM 的節點透過程式碼邊連接,並輔以可重用的 Operators),以一種 Monte Carlo Tree Search(MCTS)變體導航;其中 LLM 扮演 optimizer 的角色,用以擴展或修訂 workflow 程式碼,並以執行準確率作為獎勵,同時採用軟性混合機率的節點選擇規則與樹狀結構的經驗反向傳播。

baselines_compared: IO, Chain-of-Thought, Self-Consistency CoT, MultiPersona Debate, Self-Refine, MedPrompt, ADAS

key_improvements.en: Avg 80.3 vs best manual 76.0 (6 benchmarks); smaller models exceed GPT-4o at 4.55% of its inference cost.
key_improvements.zh: 六評測平均 80.3 對最佳人工方法 76.0;較小模型以 GPT-4o 推理成本的 4.55% 超越 GPT-4o。

structure_space: Workflow code, Operator / node graph, Prompts (joint)
decision_mechanism: MCTS / tree search, Textual gradient (LLM feedback)
optimization_signal: Task utility (accuracy), Validation-set score, Textual feedback
benchmarks_used: GSM8K, MATH, HumanEval, MBPP, HotpotQA, DROP

agent_scenario.en: One LLM optimizer (Claude-3.5-sonnet) searches, offline, over code-represented workflows executed by a single executor LLM (GPT-4o-mini in the main table; also DeepSeek-V2.5, GPT-4o, Claude-3.5-sonnet in Table 2). A workflow is a DAG-like sequence of LLM-invoking nodes wired by edge code, built from operators (Generate, Format, Review & Revise, Ensemble, Test, Programmer, Custom); Figure 2 further depicts operator structures such as Self-Consistency Ensemble, Multi-Agent Debate, and Self-Refine. It is a single-domain, offline workflow-generation setting (per benchmark: QA, code generation, math) rather than a live multi-agent runtime; the searched workflow may itself embed multi-agent/test-time-scaling operators. Protocol detail: each candidate workflow is executed 5x on validation for a robust reward, and experience (modification + outcome logs) is backpropagated up the MCTS tree.
agent_scenario.zh: 單一 LLM optimizer(Claude-3.5-sonnet)以離線方式,對由單一 executor LLM(主表中為 GPT-4o-mini;Table 2 另含 DeepSeek-V2.5、GPT-4o、Claude-3.5-sonnet)所執行、以程式碼表示的 workflow 進行搜尋。一個 workflow 為由邊程式碼串接、呼叫 LLM 之節點所構成的類 DAG 序列,並由 operators(Generate、Format、Review & Revise、Ensemble、Test、Programmer、Custom)組建;Figure 2 進一步描繪如 Self-Consistency Ensemble、Multi-Agent Debate 與 Self-Refine 等 operator 結構。此為單一領域、離線的 workflow 生成情境(依 benchmark 分為:QA、程式碼生成、數學),而非即時運行的 multi-agent runtime;所搜尋出的 workflow 本身則可能內嵌 multi-agent/test-time-scaling operator。協定細節:每個候選 workflow 於驗證集上執行 5 次以取得穩健的獎勵,並將經驗(修改與結果日誌)沿 MCTS 樹反向傳播。

title: Agent.xpu: Efficient Scheduling of Agentic LLM Workloads on Heterogeneous SoC
authors: Xinming Wei; Jiahao Zhang; Haoran Li; Jiayu Chen; Haoning Guan; Rui Qu; Maoliang Li; Xiang Chen; Guojie Luo
affiliations: Peking University, The University of Hong Kong
research_focus: Agentic / Workflow serving, LLM serving, Hardware co-design, PD disaggregation, Multi-tenant scheduling

problem_statement.en: Personal LLM agents combine foreground reactive interactions with background proactive monitoring, forming long-lived stateful LLM flows that interleave prefill and decode with unpredictable concurrency. Commodity heterogeneous SoCs integrate CPU, iGPU, and NPU with shared DDR memory, but existing on-device engines assume static, single-shot inference and lack flow-level concurrency, prioritization, and accelerator coordination, leading to shared-memory contention, NPU/iGPU interference, and starving reactive flows.
problem_statement.zh: 個人 LLM agent 同時處理前景 reactive 互動與背景 proactive 監測，形成長時間有狀態的 LLM flow，prefill 與 decode 以不可預測的並發交錯。商用異質 SoC 整合 CPU、iGPU 與 NPU 並共用 DDR 記憶體，但現有 on-device 推論引擎假設靜態單次推論，缺乏 flow 層級的並發、優先級與加速器協調，導致共享記憶體競爭、NPU 與 iGPU 互相干擾，以及 reactive flow 被餓死。

key_innovation.en: Agent.xpu introduces five techniques on shared-memory hetero-SoCs: (i) a Heterogeneous Execution Graph (HEG) abstraction with profiling-guided latency/bandwidth annotations and elastic operator binding; (ii) flow-aware NPU/iGPU coordination with stage elasticity that decouples prefill (NPU) from decode (iGPU); (iii) fine-grained kernel- and iteration-level preemption with copy-free context switching via a double activation buffer; (iv) slack-aware piggybacking that opportunistically fills compute/bandwidth slack with proactive work; (v) reactive-first adaptive decode batching that admits all reactive requests unconditionally and piggybacks proactive ones up to a cap.
key_innovation.zh: Agent.xpu 在共享記憶體的異質 SoC 上提出五項技術：(i) Heterogeneous Execution Graph（HEG）抽象，攜帶 profiling-guided 的延遲與頻寬註解與彈性運算子綁定；(ii) flow-aware 的 NPU 與 iGPU 協同，採 stage elasticity 將 prefill 由 NPU 主導、decode 由 iGPU 主導；(iii) 細粒度 kernel 與 iteration 層級搶占，透過雙 activation buffer 實現 copy-free 上下文切換；(iv) slack-aware piggybacking，趁運算與頻寬閒置時段以 proactive 工作填充；(v) reactive-first 自適應 decode batching，無條件納入 reactive request 並以上限機制 piggyback proactive request。

key_improvements.en: 1.2-4.9x higher proactive throughput while reducing reactive latency by at least 91% (up to 97%); 0.3-58% throughput gain over OpenVINO (iGPU) with even larger gains over other baselines; energy consumption reduced 26.8% and iGPU utilization reduced 32.5% versus iGPU serving and serial NPU-iGPU baselines respectively.
key_improvements.zh: Proactive throughput 提升 1.2-4.9x，同時將 reactive 延遲降低至少 91%（最高 97%）；相較 OpenVINO（iGPU）throughput 提升 0.3-58%，相較其他 baseline 增益更大；相較 iGPU serving 與 serial NPU-iGPU 基線，能耗降低 26.8%、iGPU 利用率降低 32.5%。

ai_task: LLM Serving, Multi-agent Systems, Disaggregated Prefill/Decoding
gpu_count: 1x Intel Arc iGPU + 1x Intel AI Boost NPU (single SoC)
reported_accuracy: Not Reported (predictive kernel annotation uses roofline + analytical model with stable per-kernel times across invocations; accuracy not quantified)
validation_workloads: ProactiveBench, SAMSum, CNN/DailyMail (proactive); LMSys-Chat-1M, MTRAG, Berkeley Function Call Leaderboard (reactive); Proactive-Mixed and Reactive-Mixed composites with Poisson arrivals 1-30 req/min

scope_assumptions.en: Targets shared-memory hetero-SoCs (CPU+iGPU+NPU) with unified DDR; evaluation on a single Intel Core Ultra 5 125H NUC. Uses W8A16 channel-wise quantization with negligible accuracy loss assumed. NPU kernels are AOT-compiled (cold-start JIT prohibitive); dynamic NPU kernels amortize JIT cost across layers and during slack. CPU is reserved for control flow, sampling, and kernel compilation only. Memory-overflow conditions are deferred to orthogonal offload techniques and not handled by Agent.xpu. Scope is on-device personal agents (1-30 req/min), not datacenter LLM serving.
scope_assumptions.zh: 目標為共享記憶體異質 SoC（CPU+iGPU+NPU）且使用統一 DDR；評估僅在單台 Intel Core Ultra 5 125H NUC 上進行。採用 W8A16 channel-wise 量化並假設精度損失可忽略。NPU kernel 採 AOT 編譯（冷啟動 JIT 不可行）；動態 NPU kernel 將 JIT 成本攤提到各層與閒置時段。CPU 僅保留給控制流、取樣與 kernel 編譯。記憶體溢位情境委由正交的 offload 技術處理，不在 Agent.xpu 範疇內。研究範圍限於 on-device 個人 agent（1-30 req/min），非資料中心 LLM serving。

title: AgentDropout: Dynamic Agent Elimination for Token-Efficient and High-Performance LLM-Based Multi-Agent Collaboration
authors: Zhexuan Wang; Yutong Wang; Xuebo Liu; Liang Ding; Miao Zhang; Jie Liu; Min Zhang
venue_full: Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics 2025
affiliations: Institute of Computing and Intelligence, Harbin Institute of Technology, Shenzhen (Zhexuan Wang, Yutong Wang, Xuebo Liu, Min Zhang);
research_focus: Agentic / Workflow serving

problem_statement.en: LLM-based multi-agent systems suffer from low communication efficiency (redundant agents and messages inflate token cost) and suboptimal task performance because their communication topology is designed statically. The paper asks how to dynamically eliminate redundant agents and edges across communication rounds to improve both token efficiency and accuracy.
problem_statement.zh: 基於 LLM 的 multi-agent 系統存在通訊效率低落的問題(冗餘的 agent 與訊息會膨脹 token 成本),且因其通訊拓撲採用靜態設計而導致任務表現次佳。本文探討如何在跨通訊回合的過程中動態剔除冗餘的 agent 與邊,以同時提升 token 效率與準確率。

key_innovation.en: AgentDropout makes the per-round intra-round and inter-round adjacency matrices of the communication graph learnable (edges initialized at 0.5) and optimizes them offline via REINFORCE on 40 samples, then performs a two-stage pruning: NODE dropout removes agents with the smallest weighted in/out-degree sum per round (rate alpha), followed by EDGE dropout that keeps only the highest-weight (1-beta) fraction of edges under a nuclear-norm-regularized objective.
key_innovation.zh: AgentDropout 將通訊圖的各回合內(intra-round)與跨回合(inter-round)鄰接矩陣設為可學習(邊初始化為 0.5),並在 40 個樣本上以 REINFORCE 進行離線最佳化,隨後執行兩階段剪枝:NODE dropout 依比率 alpha 移除每回合中加權出入度總和最小的 agent,接著 EDGE dropout 在核範數(nuclear-norm)正則化的目標函數下僅保留權重最高的 (1-beta) 比例邊。

baselines_compared: Vanilla, Chain-of-Thought, MAS round=1, MAS round=T, AgentPrune

key_improvements.en: Avg 68.70 vs AgentPrune 66.51 (Llama-3-8B); −21.6% prompt / −18.4% completion tokens vs SOTA.
key_improvements.zh: 平均 68.70 對 AgentPrune 66.51(Llama-3-8B);prompt token −21.6%、completion token −18.4%。

structure_space: Edge topology (spatial), Temporal / cross-round edges, Team composition (agent set)
decision_mechanism: Policy gradient / REINFORCE, Heuristic scoring / ranking
optimization_signal: Task utility (accuracy), Cost-aware utility, Validation-set score
benchmarks_used: MMLU, GSM8K, MultiArith, AQuA, SVAMP, HumanEval

agent_scenario.en: A single-domain LLM multi-agent collaboration: N homogeneous LLM agents arranged in a directed communication graph run for T rounds (T=2 for reasoning/math, T=4 for code). Agents exchange textual messages along graph edges; a final aggregation/decision produces the answer. AgentDropout modifies which agents participate and which edges carry messages in each round. No external tools are described beyond the LLM agents themselves; the graph optimization is offline and then fixed for inference.
agent_scenario.zh: 單一領域的 LLM multi-agent 協作情境:N 個同質的 LLM agent 排列於一個有向通訊圖中,執行 T 個回合(推理/數學任務 T=2,程式碼任務 T=4)。各 agent 沿圖的邊交換文字訊息;最終經由聚合/決策產生答案。AgentDropout 修改每個回合中參與的 agent 以及承載訊息的邊。除 LLM agent 本身外未描述任何外部工具;圖的最佳化為離線進行,並於推論階段固定。

title: Cut the Crap: An Economical Communication Pipeline for LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems
authors: Guibin Zhang; Yanwei Yue; Zhixun Li; Sukwon Yun; Guancheng Wan; Kun Wang; Dawei Cheng; Jeffrey Xu Yu; Tianlong Chen
research_focus: Agentic / Workflow serving

problem_statement.en: LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) built on dense communication topologies (e.g. complete graphs, multi-round debate) exchange large volumes of redundant messages, inflating token/API cost with little accuracy benefit. The paper asks how to identify and remove this redundant agent-to-agent message passing to obtain a cheaper, more robust communication structure.
problem_statement.zh: 建立於稠密通訊拓撲(例如完全圖、多輪辯論)之上的 LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS),會交換大量冗餘訊息,使 token/API 成本膨脹,卻僅帶來有限的準確度提升。本文探討如何辨識並移除此類冗餘的 agent 對 agent 訊息傳遞,以獲得成本更低且更穩健的通訊結構。

key_innovation.en: AgentPrune models the MAS as a spatial-temporal message-passing graph and trains a low-rank-regularized differentiable mask over its edges, then performs one-shot magnitude pruning of the redundant edges to yield a sparse, token-economical topology that is fixed and reused for the remaining rounds/queries at inference.
key_innovation.zh: AgentPrune 將 MAS 建模為時空訊息傳遞圖,並在其邊上訓練一個具低秩正則化的可微分遮罩 (differentiable mask),隨後對冗餘邊執行一次性 (one-shot) 幅值剪枝 (magnitude pruning),以產生稀疏且 token 節約的拓撲;該拓撲在推論階段固定不變,並於其餘輪次/查詢中重複使用。

baselines_compared: CoT, ComplexCoT, Self-Consistency, Chain, Star, Tree, Complete Graph, Layered Graph, Random Graph, LLM-Blender

key_improvements.en: GSM8K 95.83% vs debate 90.23%; 28.1–72.8% prompt-token cut; MMLU at $5.6 vs $43.7; +0.84 pts on GPTSwarm while cutting 60.6% tokens.
key_improvements.zh: GSM8K 95.83% 對辯論 90.23%;prompt token 減 28.1–72.8%;MMLU 成本 $5.6 對 $43.7;疊加 GPTSwarm 減 60.6% token 且 +0.84 分。

structure_space: Edge topology (spatial), Temporal / cross-round edges
decision_mechanism: Differentiable mask / pruning, Policy gradient / REINFORCE
benchmarks_used: MMLU, GSM8K, MultiArith, SVAMP, AQuA, HumanEval

agent_scenario.en: Multi-agent debate/collaboration over a communication graph. Main configuration = 5 gpt-4 agents (some experiments use gpt-3.5-turbo agents), each defined by Base LLM + Role + State + Plugins, communicating over spatial edges within a round and temporal edges across rounds. Dialogue depth K=2 rounds for math/general reasoning and K=4 for code; generation temperature = 1.0. AgentPrune spatial variants are denoted -C (complete-graph base), -L (layered) and -R (random). General-purpose (not single-domain): evaluated across general reasoning, math, and code. AgentPrune is both a standalone pipeline and a plug-in that sparsifies existing frameworks (AutoGen, GPTSwarm). Notable protocol detail: agents exchange messages only along edges retained after one-shot pruning, so pruned edges eliminate the corresponding prompt tokens.
agent_scenario.zh: 於通訊圖上進行的 multi-agent 辯論/協作。主要設定為 5 個 gpt-4 agent(部分實驗使用 gpt-3.5-turbo agent),每個 agent 由 Base LLM + Role + State + Plugins 定義,並在單一輪次內經由空間邊 (spatial edges) 通訊、跨輪次經由時間邊 (temporal edges) 通訊。對話深度在數學/一般推理任務中為 K=2 輪,在程式碼任務中為 K=4 輪;生成 temperature = 1.0。AgentPrune 的空間變體分別記為 -C(完全圖基底)、-L(分層)與 -R(隨機)。此方法為通用型(非單一領域):於一般推理、數學與程式碼任務上進行評估。AgentPrune 既是獨立的 pipeline,亦是可稀疏化既有框架(AutoGen、GPTSwarm)的 plug-in。值得注意的協定細節:agent 僅沿一次性剪枝後保留的邊交換訊息,因此被剪除的邊即消除對應的 prompt token。

title: AgentServeSim: A Hardware-aware Simulator for Multi-Turn LLM Agent Serving
authors: Rakibul Hasan Rajib; Mengxin Zheng; Qian Lou
research_focus: LLM serving, Agentic / Workflow serving, Long-context / Prefix cache, Continuous batching, KV cache offloading, GPU memory tiering, Multi-tenant scheduling, Routing / Load balancing, Performance modeling

problem_statement.en: Multi-turn LLM agents interleave model calls with external tool invocations, shifting serving from stateless request processing to stateful program execution. Evaluating scheduling, KV-cache management, and routing policies on real systems is costly, and existing LLM serving simulators target stateless request-level workloads, omitting multi-turn program execution, cross-turn cache locality, and KV-cache residency during tool gaps.
problem_statement.zh: 多輪 LLM agent 將 model call 與外部 tool 呼叫交錯執行，使 serving 從無狀態的請求處理轉為有狀態的程式執行。在真實系統上評估 scheduling、KV cache 管理與 routing 政策成本高昂，而既有 LLM serving 模擬器僅針對無狀態的 request 級工作負載，未涵蓋多輪程式執行、跨輪 cache 局部性，以及 tool gap 期間的 KV cache 駐留。

key_innovation.en: A program-centric, hardware-aware simulator with four composable modules: a Program Orchestrator preserving program identity and turn order, a Tool Simulator materializing tool-induced gaps (replay and generative modes), a Session-Aware Router maintaining program-to-instance affinity for cache-aware dispatch, and a KV Residency Model tracking policy-defined KV placement across HBM, host DRAM/CXL, and eviction — layered on an operator-graph back-end (LLMServingSim 2.0 operator scheduling + modified ASTRA-sim/Chakra).
key_innovation.zh: 以程式（program）為中心的硬體感知模擬器，由四個可組合模組構成：Program Orchestrator 保存程式身分與 turn 順序；Tool Simulator 具體化 tool 造成的間隙（支援 replay 與 generative 兩種模式）；Session-Aware Router 維護 program 到 instance 的親和性以實現 cache 感知派送；KV Residency Model 追蹤政策定義的 KV 在 HBM、host DRAM/CXL 之間的放置與逐出——並疊加於 operator graph 後端（LLMServingSim 2.0 operator 排程 + 修改版 ASTRA-sim/Chakra）之上。

key_improvements.en: Reproduces real-system behavior within 6% error across key performance metrics while running entirely on commodity CPUs; per-cell mean JCT error stays below 5% across the 80-cell validation grid, and aggregated throughput error stays below 2%.
key_improvements.zh: 在關鍵效能指標上以 6% 以內的誤差重現真實系統行為，且完全在一般 CPU 上執行；在 80 個 (configuration, policy) 驗證單元中，每單元平均 JCT 誤差低於 5%，聚合吞吐量誤差低於 2%。

ai_task: LLM Serving
compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA RTX 3090, NVIDIA H100-SXM, NVIDIA B200, HBM, DRAM, CXL (simulated)
reported_accuracy: Within 6% on key metrics; per-cell mean JCT error <5%; aggregated throughput error <2%
validation_workloads: SWE-Bench Verified trace (captured via mini-swe-agent with Qwen3.6-plus; 50 programs, Poisson arrivals at JPS 0.02-0.1)

scope_assumptions.en: Inherits the analytical-network and profile-based-operator assumptions of prior LLM serving simulators; tool gaps are replayed from real traces, so agent-side non-determinism is not modeled (a generative tool-distribution mode exists but its predictive validity is not evaluated); host-DRAM and CXL bandwidths are treated as static cluster-configuration parameters; validation covers only two model sizes (8B, 70B) and three NVIDIA GPU platforms, with TPUs and MoE agents left to future work.
scope_assumptions.zh: 繼承既有 LLM serving 模擬器的解析式網路與 profile 式 operator 假設；tool gap 由真實 trace 重播，因此不建模 agent 端的非確定性（雖提供 generative tool 分佈模式，但其預測效度未在本文評估）；host DRAM 與 CXL 頻寬視為靜態的叢集組態參數；驗證僅涵蓋兩種模型規模（8B、70B）與三種 NVIDIA GPU 平台，TPU 與 MoE agent 留待未來工作。

title: AgentSquare: Automatic LLM Agent Search in Modular Design Space
authors: Yu Shang; Yu Li; Keyu Zhao; Likai Ma; Jiahe Liu; Fengli Xu; Yong Li
affiliations: Department of Electronic Engineering, Tsinghua University (Yu Shang, Keyu Zhao, Likai Ma, Jiahe Liu, Fengli Xu, Yong Li);
research_focus: Agentic / Workflow serving

problem_statement.en: LLM agent designs are hand-crafted and task-specific, which limits their adaptability to novel tasks and leaves the combinatorial space of agent architectures unexplored automatically. The paper introduces "Modularized LLM Agent Search" (MoLAS): given a standardized modular design space, automatically search for a high-performing agent architecture for a target task.
problem_statement.zh: LLM agent 的設計往往仰賴人工手工打造且針對特定任務,此舉限制了其對新任務的適應能力,並使 agent 架構龐大的組合空間無法被自動探索。本文提出「Modularized LLM Agent Search」(MoLAS):在給定一個標準化的模組化設計空間下,自動為目標任務搜尋出一個高效能的 agent 架構。

key_innovation.en: A modular agent design space of four standardized modules with a uniform IO interface (Planning, Reasoning, Tool-Use, Memory), searched offline by two LLM-driven operators — module recombination (an LLM proposer swaps in existing modules) and module evolution (an LLM evolutionary meta-prompt writes brand-new module code) — and accelerated by an in-context LLM surrogate "performance predictor" that scores/ranks recombined candidates to prune (skip) unpromising designs before costly real evaluation.
key_innovation.zh: 本文構建一個模組化的 agent 設計空間,包含四種具統一 IO 介面的標準化模組(Planning、Reasoning、Tool-Use、Memory),並透過兩個由 LLM 驅動的運算子進行離線搜尋:模組重組(由一個 LLM proposer 替換既有模組)與模組演化(由一個 LLM 演化式 meta-prompt 撰寫全新的模組程式碼)。此外,本文以一個 in-context 的 LLM 代理模型「performance predictor」加速搜尋,對重組後的候選架構進行評分與排序,以在耗費成本的真實評測之前剪除(跳過)不具潛力的設計。

baselines_compared: CoT, CoT-SC, Self-refine, ToT, Step Back, Thought Propagation, HuggingGPT, Voyager, Generative Agents, DEPS

key_improvements.en: +17.2% avg over best human designs on 6 agentic benchmarks; surrogate predictor evaluates at ~0.025% of full cost.
key_improvements.zh: 六個 agentic 評測平均較最佳人工設計 +17.2%;代理預測器評估成本僅約完整評估的 0.025%。

structure_space: Operator / node graph, Workflow code
decision_mechanism: Evolutionary / swarm search, Heuristic scoring / ranking
benchmarks_used: AlfWorld, ScienceWorld, PDDL, WebShop, TravelPlanner, M3ToolEval

agent_scenario.en: The "agents" being searched are single modular LLM agents whose internal architecture is composed of four functional module types (Planning, Reasoning, Tool-Use, Memory) rather than a team of collaborating agents — this is agent-architecture search over one agent's internal module composition, not a multi-agent topology. The searched agent solves single tasks in embodied (ALFWorld, ScienceWorld), game (PDDL), web (WebShop), and tool-use (TravelPlanner, M3ToolEval) benchmarks, drawing tools from a tool pool via its Tool-Use module. The search process itself is LLM-driven: an LLM proposer (π_θ) performs module recombination, an LLM evolver (π_ξ) writes new module code, and an LLM surrogate (π_p) predicts performance to prune candidates, all instantiated with GPT-3.5-turbo-0125 or GPT-4o. Search is offline and per-domain.
agent_scenario.zh: 被搜尋的「agent」為單一的模組化 LLM agent,其內部架構由四種功能模組類型(Planning、Reasoning、Tool-Use、Memory)組成,而非由多個協作 agent 構成的團隊;此處為針對單一 agent 內部模組組成的 agent 架構搜尋,並非 multi-agent 拓撲。所搜尋出的 agent 在具身(ALFWorld、ScienceWorld)、遊戲(PDDL)、網頁(WebShop)與工具使用(TravelPlanner、M3ToolEval)等 benchmark 上求解單一任務,並透過其 Tool-Use 模組自工具池中取用工具。搜尋過程本身由 LLM 驅動:一個 LLM proposer(π_θ)執行模組重組,一個 LLM evolver(π_ξ)撰寫新的模組程式碼,一個 LLM 代理模型(π_p)預測效能以剪除候選架構,三者皆以 GPT-3.5-turbo-0125 或 GPT-4o 實例化。搜尋為離線且按領域分別進行。

title: Alibaba HPN: A Data Center Network for Large Language Model Training
authors: Kun Qian; Yongqing Xi; Jiamin Cao; Jiaqi Gao; Yichi Xu; Yu Guan; Binzhang Fu; Xuemei Shi; Fangbo Zhu; Rui Miao; Chao Wang; Peng Wang; Pengcheng Zhang; Xianlong Zeng; Eddie Ruan; Zhiping Yao; Ennan Zhai; Dennis Cai
venue_full: Conference on Applications, Technologies, Architectures, and Protocols for Computer Communication
research_focus: Datacenter networking

problem_statement.en: Traditional 3-tier Clos data center networks suffer from hash polarization and single-point failures (ToR) when handling the bursty, low-entropy traffic patterns of large-scale LLM training. This leads to uneven traffic distribution and significant performance degradation during synchronous training iterations.
problem_statement.zh: 傳統三層 Clos 資料中心網路在處理大規模 LLM 訓練的突發性低熵流量時，容易出現雜湊極化與 ToR 單點故障，進而導致流量分配不均，並在同步訓練迭代期間造成顯著的效能下滑。

key_innovation.en: HPN introduces a 2-tier, dual-plane architecture with non-stacked dual-ToR switches and a rail-optimized network design to eliminate hash polarization, improve fault tolerance, and support 15K GPUs within a single Pod.
key_innovation.zh: HPN 採用兩層雙平面架構，配合非堆疊式雙 ToR 交換器與 rail 優化的網路設計，以消除雜湊極化、提升容錯能力，並在單一 Pod 內支援 15K GPU。

baselines_compared: DCN+, traditional 3-tier Clos Data Center Network

key_improvements.en: 14.9% higher end-to-end LLM training throughput, 59.3% AllReduce performance increase, 91.8% reduction in ToR downstream port queue length, and zero ToR-related single-node failures in 8 months.
key_improvements.zh: 端到端 LLM 訓練吞吐量提升 14.9%、AllReduce 效能提升 59.3%、ToR 下游埠佇列長度減少 91.8%，且在 8 個月內 ToR 相關的單節點故障次數為零。

ai_task: LLM Serving, LLM Training, Inference
traffic_pattern: AllReduce, AllGather, Send/Recv, Elephant flows, Periodic bursty flows
compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA H800, BlueField-3 DPU, NVLink, HBM3E

title: Alto: Orchestrating Distributed Compound AI Systems with Nested Ancestry
authors: Deepti Raghavan; Keshav Santhanam; Muhammad Shahir Rahman; Nayani Modugula; Luis Gaspar Schroeder; Maximilien Cura; Houjun Liu; Pratiksha Thaker; Philip Levis; Matei Zaharia
affiliations: Brown University, Nvidia, Stanford University, UC Berkeley, Carnegie Mellon University
research_focus: Datacenter networking

problem_statement.en: Existing compound AI systems fail to fully leverage parallelism and pipelining because they rely on blocking input-output relationships and struggle to manage the heterogeneous data granularities produced by intermediate computations.
problem_statement.zh: 現有的複合 AI 系統由於依賴阻塞式輸入輸出關係，且難以管理中間計算所產生的異質資料粒度，因此無法充分發揮平行處理與 pipeline 的潛力。

key_innovation.en: Alto introduces 'nested ancestry', a metadata hierarchy that automatically tracks data provenance through a computation graph, enabling the system to correctly route, stream, parallelize, and aggregate partial outputs across distributed components.
key_innovation.zh: Alto 引入「巢狀溯源」（nested ancestry）機制——一套自動追蹤計算圖中資料來源的元資料層級結構，使系統得以正確地跨分散式元件進行路由、串流、平行化與部分輸出的聚合。

key_improvements.en: 2.3x higher throughput at the same median latency SLO of 6 seconds for FacTool; 10-30% latency improvement across evaluated applications.
key_improvements.zh: 在 FacTool 中間延遲 SLO 同為 6 秒的條件下，吞吐量提升 2.3x；跨評估應用的延遲改善幅度為 10–30%。

ai_task: LLM Serving, Compound AI Systems, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Multi-hop Question Answering, Agents, Data Querying AIs
traffic_pattern: Streaming, Pipeline Parallelism, Data-parallel operations, Fan-out/Fan-in
compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA A100-SXM (80 GB), Quadro RTX 6000 (24 GB), AMD EPYC 7763, Intel Xeon Platinum 8268
routing_and_congestion_control: ECMP-like routing based on ancestry tags

title: AMAS: Adaptively Determining Communication Topology for LLM-based Multi-Agent System
authors: Hui Yi Leong; Yuheng Li; Yuqing Wu; Wenwen Ouyang; Wei Zhu; Jiechao Gao; Wei Han
venue_full: Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing 2025 (Industry Track)
affiliations: Per-author mapping confirmed via ar5iv rendering: Hui Yi Leong (University of Chicago);
research_focus: Agentic / Workflow serving

problem_statement.en: Conventional LLM multi-agent systems rely on fixed, hand-crafted communication graph topologies that do not adapt to the individual input, which hurts performance across heterogeneous tasks. AMAS aims to pick an input-conditioned, task-optimal communication topology per query rather than applying one universal template.
problem_statement.zh: 傳統 LLM multi-agent 系統仰賴固定且人工設計的通訊圖拓撲,無法針對個別輸入進行調整,導致在異質任務上的效能受損。AMAS 旨在為每一則 query 選取以輸入為條件、任務最適的通訊拓撲,而非套用單一通用範本。

key_innovation.en: A "dynamic graph designer": a LoRA-adapted (rank 16) backbone LLM that, per query, scores a small bank of K=4 candidate communication topologies (generated offline via REINFORCE over a learnable edge-parameter vector) with a pairwise margin ranking loss and instantiates the highest-scoring topology for that input.
key_innovation.zh: 提出「dynamic graph designer」:一個經 LoRA 調適(rank 16)的 backbone LLM,針對每一則 query,對一組 K=4 個候選通訊拓撲(離線透過 REINFORCE 於可學習的邊參數向量上生成)進行評分,採用 pairwise margin ranking loss,並為該輸入實例化評分最高的拓撲。

baselines_compared: IO, Chain-of-Thought, Self-Consistency, Tree-of-Thought, Graph-of-Thought, AutoGPT, AgentVerse, GPTSwarm

key_improvements.en: Exceeds GPTSwarm on all 5 tasks (e.g. Crossword 0.485 vs 0.447, Llama-3-8B); selector adds ~0.5% memory, ~1% latency.
key_improvements.zh: 五任務全數優於 GPTSwarm(如 Crossword 0.485 對 0.447,Llama-3-8B);選擇器僅增約 0.5% 記憶體、約 1% 延遲。

structure_space: Edge topology (spatial)
decision_mechanism: Policy gradient / REINFORCE, Heuristic scoring / ranking
benchmarks_used: Game of 24, Crossword, MMLU, LLM-Eval-P, HumanEval

agent_scenario.en: Single-domain-per-task multi-agent pipeline over a fixed 12-node composite graph: a Tree-of-Thoughts reasoning agent (depth 4, branch 2), a Reflection agent (one reflection step, two iterative passes), and a dedicated output/aggregation node, wired together by the query-selected communication topology. A separate LoRA-adapted LLM ("dynamic graph designer") routes each input to one of K=4 candidate edge topologies. Agents solve QA, math-deduction, and code-generation tasks; the graph designer is trained per task/domain rather than being a single general router.
agent_scenario.zh: 在固定的 12-node 複合圖上,對每一任務採單一領域的 multi-agent pipeline:包含一個 Tree-of-Thoughts 推理 agent(depth 4,branch 2)、一個 Reflection agent(一次 reflection 步驟,兩輪迭代)、以及一個專責的輸出/聚合節點,由 query 選取的通訊拓撲串接。另有一個經 LoRA 調適的 LLM(「dynamic graph designer」)將每一則輸入路由至 K=4 個候選邊拓撲之一。這些 agent 求解 QA、數學推導與程式碼生成任務;該 graph designer 係針對各任務/領域分別訓練,而非單一通用 router。

title: Amplifying Effective CXL Memory Bandwidth for LLM Inference via Transparent Near-Data Processing
authors: Rui Xie; Asad Ul Haq; Linsen Ma; Yunhua Fang; Zirak Burzin Engineer; Liu Liu; Tong Zhang
affiliations: Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute, Wiseburn Da Vinci Science
research_focus: Datacenter networking, GPU memory tiering

problem_statement.en: LLM inference is bottlenecked by the limited effective bandwidth and capacity of CXL-based memory pools, which struggle to keep up with the high demands of model weights and expanding KV caches.
problem_statement.zh: LLM inference 受限於 CXL 記憶體池有效頻寬與容量不足，難以應對模型權重與持續擴張的 KV cache 所帶來的高需求。

key_innovation.en: CXL-NDP, a transparent near-data processing architecture for CXL memory devices that uses a precision-scalable bit-plane layout and transparent lossless compression to amplify effective bandwidth without modifying the CXL.mem interface.
key_innovation.zh: CXL-NDP 是針對 CXL 記憶體裝置的透明近資料處理架構，採用精度可調的 bit-plane 佈局與透明無損壓縮，在不修改 CXL.mem 介面的前提下放大有效頻寬。

key_improvements.en: 43% inference throughput increase, 87% context length extension, 40.3% lower DRAM access energy, 42.1% lower model-load latency, 25.2% weight footprint reduction, 46.9% KV cache footprint reduction.
key_improvements.zh: inference 吞吐量提升 43%、context 長度延伸 87%、DRAM 存取能耗降低 40.3%、模型載入延遲降低 42.1%、權重記憶體占用減少 25.2%、KV cache 記憶體占用減少 46.9%。

ai_task: LLM Serving, LLM Inference, KV Cache offloading
traffic_pattern: CXL.mem load/store, Sequential read, DRAM burst
compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA H100, DDR5-6400, CXL Type-3 Memory Expander

title: An Extensible Software Transport Layer for GPU Networking
authors: Yang Zhou; Zhongjie Chen; Ziming Mao; ChonLam Lao; Shuo Yang; Pravein Govindan Kannan; Jiaqi Gao; Yilong Zhao; Yongji Wu; Kaichao You; Fengyuan Ren; Zhiying Xu; Costin Raiciu; Ion Stoica
affiliations: UC Berkeley, UC Davis, Tsinghua University, Harvard University, IBM Research, Amazon Web Services, University Pollitehnica of Bucharest, Broadcom
research_focus: Datacenter networking, RDMA / Transport, Congestion control

problem_statement.en: Existing RDMA NIC hardware transport layers are difficult to evolve, leading to performance bottlenecks such as flow collisions, poor congestion control for ML workloads, and inefficient loss recovery.
problem_statement.zh: 現有 RDMA NIC 硬體傳輸層難以演進，導致流量碰撞、ML 工作負載的壅塞控制不佳，以及低效率的封包遺失恢復等效能瓶頸。

key_innovation.en: UCCL, an extensible software transport layer that decouples the data and control paths of RDMA NICs, allowing transport logic (congestion control, multipathing, loss recovery) to be implemented and updated in user-space CPU code.
key_innovation.zh: UCCL 是一套可擴展的軟體傳輸層，將 RDMA NIC 的資料路徑與控制路徑解耦，使壅塞控制、多路徑、封包遺失恢復等傳輸邏輯得以在使用者空間的 CPU 程式碼中實作與更新。

baselines_compared: NVIDIA NCCL built-in RDMA, AWS NCCL-EFA plugin, Broadcom Thor-2 RDMA transport

key_improvements.en: Up to 4.5x higher throughput for ML collectives, 4.9x better message tail latency for network incast, and significant performance gains in distributed training and MoE serving.
key_improvements.zh: ML 集合通訊吞吐量最高提升 4.5x，網路 incast 下訊息尾端延遲改善 4.9x，並在分散式訓練與 MoE serving 中取得顯著效能提升。

ai_task: LLM Serving, AI Model Training, MoE Serving, Allreduce, Allgather, Reduce-Scatter
compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA H100-80G, NVIDIA A100-40G, AMD MI300X-192G
network_hw: NVIDIA ConnectX-7 400G, Broadcom Thor-2 400G, AWS EFA 100G
transport_and_interconnect: RDMA, RoCEv2, InfiniBand, UC, RC, UD, SRD, AF_XDP

title: An Introduction to the Compute Express Link (CXL) Interconnect
authors: Debendra Das Sharma; Robert Blankenship; Daniel Berger
affiliations: Intel Corporation, University of Washington, Microsoft
research_focus: PD disaggregation, Datacenter networking

problem_statement.en: The paper addresses the limitations of traditional PCIe and DDR interfaces, specifically the lack of coherent access to system/device memory, memory scalability bottlenecks, resource stranding in datacenters, and high communication latency for fine-grained data sharing in distributed systems.
problem_statement.zh: 本文探討傳統 PCIe 與 DDR 介面的局限性，包括缺乏對系統/裝置記憶體的一致性存取、記憶體擴展性瓶頸、資料中心的資源閒置，以及分散式系統中細粒度資料共享的高通訊延遲。

key_innovation.en: The Compute Express Link (CXL) is an open industry-standard interconnect that multiplexes coherency, memory, and I/O protocols (CXL.cache, CXL.mem, CXL.io) over the PCIe physical layer to enable memory disaggregation, pooling, and coherent shared memory.
key_innovation.zh: CXL（Compute Express Link）是一種開放的業界標準互連技術，透過在 PCIe 實體層上多工 CXL.cache、CXL.mem 與 CXL.io 等協定，實現記憶體解耦、池化與一致性共享記憶體。

key_improvements.en: CXL 3.0 enables scaling to 4,096 endpoints, doubles per-pin bandwidth to 64 GT/s, and provides sub-microsecond communication latency for fine-grained data sharing compared to traditional network-based approaches.
key_improvements.zh: CXL 3.0 可擴展至 4,096 個端點、每 pin 頻寬倍增至 64 GT/s，並相較於傳統網路方案提供次微秒級的通訊延遲，以支援細粒度的資料共享。

ai_task: AI, Machine Learning, Smart NICs, Processing-in-Memory (PIM), In-memory analytics, Large-scale databases
traffic_pattern: Load-store, Coherent shared memory, Producer-consumer, Fine-grained synchronization, Peer-to-peer
compute_memory_hw: Intel Sapphire Rapids (SPR), AMD Genoa, AMD Bergamo, ARM V2/N2/E2, Agilex7 FPGAs, DDR5, HBM
routing_and_congestion_control: Port Based Routing (PBR), Hierarchical routing, Source throttling, QoS

title: AnyMAC: Cascading Flexible Multi-Agent Collaboration via Next-Agent Prediction
authors: Song Wang; Zhen Tan; Zihan Chen; Shuang Zhou; Tianlong Chen; Jundong Li
venue_full: Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing 2025
affiliations: University of Virginia (Song Wang, Zihan Chen, Jundong Li);
research_focus: Agentic / Workflow serving, Reasoning / Test-time scaling

problem_statement.en: Existing LLM multi-agent collaboration relies on static or graph-based inter-agent topologies, which limit adaptability/flexibility and confine communication to a comparatively small topology space. The paper asks how to build task-adaptive agent communication pipelines that flexibly choose which role acts next and which prior context each step reads, while reducing communication overhead.
problem_statement.zh: 現有的 LLM 多 agent 協作依賴靜態或以圖為基礎的 agent 間 topology,這類設計限制了適應性與彈性,並將通訊侷限於相對狹小的 topology 空間。本文探討如何建構任務自適應的 agent 通訊管線,使其能彈性地選擇下一步由哪個角色行動,以及每一步應讀取哪些先前的 context,同時降低通訊開銷。

key_innovation.en: Reframes multi-agent coordination as a SEQUENTIAL cascade (not a graph): a learned routing model performs Next-Agent Prediction (pick the best role at each step) and Next-Context Selection (each step selectively reads outputs from any previous step), building a per-query task-adaptive linear pipeline trained by reinforcement learning with an efficiency-aware, length-decayed reward.
key_innovation.zh: 本文將多 agent 協調重新表述為一種循序 (sequential) 級聯結構,而非圖結構:由一個學習得到的路由模型執行 Next-Agent Prediction (在每一步選出最佳角色) 與 Next-Context Selection (每一步選擇性地讀取任意先前步驟的輸出),藉此為每一個 query 建構任務自適應的線性管線,並以具效率感知、長度衰減 (length-decayed) 獎勵的 reinforcement learning 進行訓練。

baselines_compared: CoT, ComplexCoT, Self-Consistency, PHP, Chain, Star, Tree, Complete Graph, Random Graph, AutoGen

key_improvements.en: Best avg 90.62% on the 6-benchmark harness (+0.78 vs G-Designer); efficiency variant cuts prompt tokens ~5x on GSM8K.
key_improvements.zh: 六評測組平均最佳 90.62%(較 G-Designer +0.78);效率版在 GSM8K 將 prompt token 減至約 1/5。

structure_space: Roles / profiles, Temporal / cross-round edges, Team composition (agent set), Termination / depth
decision_mechanism: Policy gradient / REINFORCE
benchmarks_used: MMLU, GSM8K, MultiArith, SVAMP, AQuA, HumanEval

agent_scenario.en: A single-domain reasoning/coding MAS where all executing agents are LLM instances (gpt-4-1106-preview) instantiated with dynamically chosen role profiles (e.g., "Knowledgeable Expert", "Lawyer") drawn from a candidate role set R. Instead of a fixed graph, a small learned router (GPT-2 Small) sequentially assembles a linear pipeline of up to 5 role-playing agents; each agent may selectively read any subset of earlier agents' outputs (NCS), giving global information flow along the cascade. No external tools are described; the protocol is text-message passing along the learned sequence.
agent_scenario.zh: 此為單一領域的推理/程式撰寫 MAS,所有執行的 agent 皆為以動態選定角色設定 (例如「Knowledgeable Expert」、「Lawyer」) 實例化的 LLM (gpt-4-1106-preview),角色取自候選角色集合 R。有別於固定的圖結構,一個小型的學習路由器 (GPT-2 Small) 循序組裝出最多 5 個角色扮演 agent 的線性管線;每個 agent 可選擇性地讀取任意先前 agent 輸出的子集 (NCS),使資訊得以沿級聯結構全域流動。文中未描述任何外部工具;其協定為沿學習得到的序列傳遞的 text-message passing。

title: Optimizing LLM Inference: Fluid-Guided Online Scheduling with Memory Constraints
authors: Ruicheng Ao; Gan Luo; David Simchi-Levi; Xinshang Wang
affiliations: MIT Institute for Data, Systems, and Society, Peking University School of Mathematical Sciences, Alibaba Group
research_focus: Multi-tenant scheduling, PD disaggregation, Continuous batching, Length prediction, Capacity planning, Performance modeling

problem_statement.en: LLM inference suffers endogenous KV-cache memory growth during decode: overflow forces costly prompt evictions and recomputation, and a workload theoretically inside the fluid stability region can still destabilize under naive FCFS due to cascading evictions.
problem_statement.zh: LLM 推理在 decode 階段 KV cache 內生成長，記憶體溢位將觸發代價昂貴的提示驅逐與重新計算；即使工作負載理論上落在 fluid stability region 內，FCFS 仍可能因驅逐連鎖反應而失穩。

key_innovation.en: A fluid-limit approximation that characterizes the equilibrium batch composition and KV-cache memory requirement M*, plus two threshold-based admission policies, WAIT (Waiting for Accumulated Inference Threshold) for known output lengths and Nested WAIT for unknown output lengths via nested decode-segment thresholds. Both policies asymptotically approximate the fluid benchmark under the stated memory conditions.
key_innovation.zh: 提出 fluid-limit 近似，刻畫均衡批次組成與 KV cache 記憶體需求 M*，並設計兩種閾值型 admission policy：WAIT（已知輸出長度）與 Nested WAIT（未知輸出長度，透過 decode 段嵌套閾值）。兩者在所述記憶體條件下，皆漸近逼近 fluid benchmark。

key_improvements.en: In Vidur simulations of Llama-2-7B on a single A100 80GB, WAIT and Nested WAIT enlarge the empirically observed stable operating range relative to vLLM and Sarathi-Serve and reduce mean end-to-end latency most clearly near capacity and under overload; appendix reports real-GPU validation.
key_improvements.zh: 在 Vidur 模擬 Llama-2-7B 於單一 A100 80GB 設定下，WAIT 與 Nested WAIT 相對 vLLM 與 Sarathi-Serve 擴大實測穩定運作區間，並在接近容量與過載時最明顯地降低端到端平均延遲；附錄補充真實 GPU 驗證。

reported_accuracy: Linear iteration-time fit reported on A100 80GB; quantitative R^2 not specified in main text
validation_workloads: Synthetic (Poisson arrivals), Vidur simulator workloads, Real-GPU end-to-end traces

scope_assumptions.en: Models iteration time as affine in resident KV-cache size (tau(B) = d0 + d1 * sum of cached tokens) under Llama-2-7B on A100. Assumes single-GPU scheduling unit; multi-GPU deployments apply same admission logic per partition. Evicted prompts restart from prefill (LIFO). Nested WAIT uses an additional moderate-scale safety buffer to hedge against eviction under unknown output lengths.
scope_assumptions.zh: 在 Llama-2-7B 於 A100 上將 iteration 時間建模為 KV cache 駐留量的仿射函式 tau(B) = d0 + d1 * 累計 cached tokens；以單 GPU 為 scheduling 單位，多 GPU 部署在每個分區套用相同 admission 邏輯。被驅逐的提示自 prefill 重啟（LIFO）。Nested WAIT 在輸出長度未知時，額外採用中等規模 safety buffer 以對抗驅逐風險。

title: APEX: An Extensible and Dynamism-Aware Simulator for Automated Parallel Execution in LLM Serving
authors: Yi-Chien Lin; Woosuk Kwon; Ronald Pineda; Fanny Nina Paravecino
affiliations: University of Southern California, UC Berkeley, UCLA, Microsoft
research_focus: MoE serving, Multi-tenant scheduling, Continuous batching, Quantization, Capacity planning, Performance modeling, Energy / Carbon

problem_statement.en: Selecting an optimal parallel execution plan for LLM serving is non-trivial because of the many factors involved (workload, parallelism, quantization, devices) and the dynamism of iteration-level batching; brute-force evaluation on real hardware is prohibitively expensive and prior simulators built for DNN training cannot capture LLM serving dynamics.
problem_statement.zh: 為 LLM 服務挑選最佳的平行執行計畫並不容易，因為涉及工作負載、平行策略、量化與裝置等眾多因素，並受 iteration-level batching 的動態性影響；於真實硬體進行窮舉評估的成本極高，而既有為 DNN 訓練設計的模擬器亦無法刻畫 LLM 服務的動態行為。

key_innovation.en: APEX, a dynamism-aware simulator that abstracts an LLM as Transformer IR composed of cells/blocks, generates parallel execution plans via Parallel Templates, uses operation-level offline profiling to estimate execution time, and simulates iteration-level batching to evaluate latency, TTFT, TPOT and energy across heterogeneous clusters.
key_innovation.zh: APEX 為一具有動態感知的模擬器：將 LLM 抽象為由 cell 與 block 構成的 Transformer IR；藉由 Parallel Templates 產生多種平行執行計畫；以 operation-level 離線 profiling 估計執行時間；並透過模擬 iteration-level batching 以評估異質叢集下的 latency、TTFT、TPOT 與能耗。

baselines_compared: Heuristic plans (TP within node + PP across nodes), vLLM, SGLang

key_improvements.en: Identifies execution plans up to 3.37x faster than heuristic baselines and up to 45% lower energy consumption versus latency-optimal plans; 71x faster than real GPU deployment and 1234x more cost-effective; average relative error of 10.7% on speedup prediction.
key_improvements.zh: 找出較啟發式基線最高快 3.37x 的執行計畫，並較 latency-optimal 計畫降低最多 45% 能耗；相較真實 GPU 部署快 71x，成本效益達 1234x；加速比預測的平均相對誤差為 10.7%。

compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA H100 SXM (80GB), NVIDIA H200 SXM (141GB), Intel Xeon 6530 CPU (for simulation)
gpu_count: 8x H100 (single node), 16x H100 (multi-node, 2 nodes), 8x H200 (single node)
reported_accuracy: MAPE 10.7% (average relative error on speedup prediction)
validation_workloads: Azure LLM Inference traces (Summarization, Creation, Chat derived from paper-summarization, news-abstract and LMSYS-Chat-1M datasets)

scope_assumptions.en: Profiling focuses on key operators (attention, GEMM) while omitting minor operations, leading to slightly higher predicted TPOT than measured; assumes Poisson arrival; energy modeling does not explain operator-level variance; single Transformer block is simulated and extrapolated to the full model.
scope_assumptions.zh: Profiling 著重於 attention、GEMM 等關鍵運算子，省略次要運算，造成預測 TPOT 略高於實測；假設請求到達為 Poisson 分布；能耗建模無法解釋 operator 層級的變異；以單一 Transformer block 模擬並外推至完整模型。

title: Assemble Your Crew: Automatic Multi-agent Communication Topology Design via Autoregressive Graph Generation
authors: Shiyuan Li; Yixin Liu; Qingsong Wen; Chengqi Zhang; Shirui Pan
affiliations: Griffith University (Shiyuan Li, Yixin Liu, Shirui Pan [corresponding]);
research_focus: Agentic / Workflow serving

problem_statement.en: The effectiveness of LLM-based multi-agent systems hinges on the communication topology, yet prior methods either use fixed hand-crafted topologies or only prune/edit a pre-defined fully-connected graph, which fixes the agent count and roles up front and constrains the design space. The paper asks how to build the collaboration graph — number of agents, their roles, and their communication links — entirely from scratch and adapt it to each individual natural-language task query.
problem_statement.zh: 基於 LLM 的 multi-agent 系統其效能取決於通訊拓撲,然而既有方法或採用固定的手工設計拓撲,或僅對預先定義的全連接圖進行剪枝與編輯,此類做法在事前即固定了 agent 數量與角色,並限縮了設計空間。本文探討如何從零開始建構協作圖——即 agent 數量、各自角色及其通訊連結——並使其能針對每一項個別的自然語言任務 query 進行調適。

key_innovation.en: It reframes MAS topology design as conditional autoregressive graph generation: a generative model conditioned on the task query builds the graph node-by-node (selecting each agent's role from an extensible embedding pool and emitting an END token to decide the agent count) and edge-by-edge, trained end-to-end with a dense-to-sparse (exploration then efficiency) curriculum so topologies are both correct and token-efficient.
key_innovation.zh: 本文將 MAS 拓撲設計重新表述為條件式自回歸圖生成:一個以任務 query 為條件的生成模型逐節點建構圖(自可擴充的 embedding pool 中為各 agent 選取角色,並發出 END token 以決定 agent 數量),再逐邊建構連結,並以 dense-to-sparse(先探索後追求效率)的 curriculum 進行端到端訓練,使生成的拓撲兼具正確性與 token 效率。

baselines_compared: Single-agent CoT, Self-Consistency, Chain, Tree, Complete graph, Random graph, LLM-Debate, AgentPrune, AgentDropout, G-Designer

key_improvements.en: SOTA on all 6 harness benchmarks with GPT-4o (MMLU 89.54%, AQuA 86.45%); ~50% fewer tokens than G-Designer on GSM8K.
key_improvements.zh: GPT-4o 下六評測全數最佳(MMLU 89.54%、AQuA 86.45%);GSM8K token 較 G-Designer 約少 50%。

structure_space: Edge topology (spatial), Team composition (agent set), Roles / profiles
decision_mechanism: Trained generator (SFT), Graph neural generator (GNN/VAE)
benchmarks_used: MMLU, GSM8K, MultiArith, SVAMP, AQuA, HumanEval

agent_scenario.en: General-domain LLM MAS (not single-domain): six reasoning/math/knowledge/code benchmarks. Agents are GPT-4o instances, each assigned a role from an extensible role pool; the agent count is dynamic (decided by the END token during generation) rather than fixed. Agents communicate over the generated directed acyclic graph for K=3 rounds. External tools are not central — the contribution is the who-talks-to-whom spatial topology plus team composition. New roles can be injected at inference via metric-learning retrieval without retraining the generator.
agent_scenario.zh: 通用領域的 LLM MAS(非單一領域):涵蓋推理、數學、知識與程式碼共六項 benchmark。各 agent 為 GPT-4o 實例,並自可擴充的角色池中被指派角色;agent 數量為動態決定(於生成過程中由 END token 決定),而非固定。各 agent 於生成的有向無環圖上進行 K=3 輪通訊。外部工具並非核心——其貢獻在於「誰與誰對話」的空間拓撲以及團隊組成。新角色可於推論時透過 metric-learning 檢索注入,無須重新訓練生成器。

title: Asynchronous Verified Semantic Caching for Tiered LLM Architectures
authors: Asmit Kumar Singh; Haozhe Wang; Laxmi Naga Santosh Attaluri; Tak Chiam; Weihua Zhu
research_focus: Datacenter networking

problem_statement.en: Production tiered LLM caches use a single static similarity threshold that forces a trade-off between conservative thresholds that miss reuse opportunities and aggressive thresholds that risk serving incorrect responses.
problem_statement.zh: 生產環境的階層式 LLM 快取依賴單一靜態相似度閾值，在保守閾值（錯失重用機會）與激進閾值（可能回傳不正確回應）之間強制取捨。

key_innovation.en: Krites, an asynchronous, LLM-judged caching policy that verifies static cache misses in the similarity grey zone off-path and promotes approved matches into the dynamic cache via an auxiliary overwrite.
key_innovation.zh: Krites 是一種非同步、由 LLM 判斷的快取策略：對靜態快取未命中但落在相似度灰色地帶的查詢進行離線驗證，並將通過審核的匹配項目透過輔助覆寫提升至動態快取。

key_improvements.en: Up to 3.9x increase in static-origin served fraction (136% for conversational, 290% for search) with unchanged critical path latency.
key_improvements.zh: 靜態快取命中比例最高提升 3.9x（對話場景提升 136%，搜尋場景提升 290%），且關鍵路徑延遲維持不變。

ai_task: LLM Serving, Semantic Caching

title: Auditing Prompt Caching in Language Model APIs
authors: Chenchen Gu; Xiang Lisa Li; Rohith Kuditipudi; Percy Liang; Tatsunori Hashimoto
venue_full: Proceedings of the 42nd International Conference on Machine Learning (PMLR 267, 2025)
research_focus: Long-context / Prefix cache, Performance modeling

problem_statement.en: Prompt caching in LLM APIs reuses attention KV cache across requests and produces data-dependent TTFT variations: cached prompts respond faster than non-cached ones. When the cache is shared across users, this timing side channel can leak information about other users' prompts, and detection of prefix caching also leaks model architecture (e.g. decoder-only Transformer). Whether real LLM providers cache, and at what sharing level (per-user, per-organization, global), is largely undisclosed.
problem_statement.zh: LLM API 中的 prompt caching 透過跨請求重用 attention KV cache 而產生資料相依的 TTFT 變異：cached prompt 比未 cached 的回應更快。當 cache 跨使用者共享，此 timing side channel 可能洩漏他人 prompt 的資訊；偵測 prefix caching 也會洩漏模型架構 (如 decoder-only Transformer)。實際 LLM provider 是否快取、共享層級為何 (per-user / per-organization / global)，多半並未公開。

key_innovation.en: A statistical audit that frames prompt-cache detection as a two-sample hypothesis test on TTFT distributions. The attacker collects TTFT samples from a cache-hit procedure (send prompt twice, then prefix-matched probe) and a cache-miss procedure (random prompt), then applies a one-sided Kolmogorov-Smirnov test under H0 (no caching), yielding valid p-values for false-positive control at significance alpha=1e-8 with Bonferroni correction. Tests three sharing levels (per-user, per-org, global) and varies PROMPTLENGTH, PREFIXFRACTION, NUMVICTIMREQUESTS to characterize precision.
key_innovation.zh: 提出統計式 audit，將 prompt cache 偵測形式化為對 TTFT 分布的雙樣本假設檢定。攻擊者收集 cache-hit 程序 (連送兩次 prompt 後以 prefix-matched probe 測試) 與 cache-miss 程序 (隨機 prompt) 的 TTFT 樣本，於 H0 (無快取) 下以單側 Kolmogorov-Smirnov 檢定產生具有效 false-positive control 的 p-value，顯著水準為 alpha=1e-8 並做 Bonferroni 校正。測試三種共享層級 (per-user、per-org、global)，並調整 PROMPTLENGTH、PREFIXFRACTION、NUMVICTIMREQUESTS 描述精度。

key_improvements.en: Detected prompt caching in 8 of 17 API providers; global cache sharing detected in 7 providers (Azure, Deep Infra, Fireworks, Lepton, OpenAI text-embedding-3-small, Perplexity, Replicate). Average precision across audits ~0.8 (range 0.70-1.00). Provides new evidence that OpenAI text-embedding-3-small is a decoder-only Transformer (previously undisclosed). At least five providers responded to disclosure by changing caching policies (e.g. disabling global cache sharing).
key_improvements.zh: 於 17 家 API provider 中偵測到 8 家有 prompt caching；其中 7 家 (Azure, Deep Infra, Fireworks, Lepton, OpenAI text-embedding-3-small, Perplexity, Replicate) 為 global cache sharing。Audit 平均精度約 0.8 (範圍 0.70-1.00)。提供新證據顯示 OpenAI text-embedding-3-small 為 decoder-only Transformer (先前未公開)。至少 5 家 provider 在收到 responsible disclosure 後修改快取政策 (如關閉跨組織 cache sharing)。

reported_accuracy: Average precision of cache-hit classification 0.70-1.00 across detected APIs (mean ~0.8); p-values reported at alpha=1e-8 with Bonferroni correction.
models_validated: Llama 3.1 8B Instruct, Claude 3 Haiku, GPT-4o mini, Gemini 1.5 Flash, DeepSeek Chat, Command R, Mistral Nemo, text-embedding-3-small, text-embedding-004, embed-english-v3.0, Mistral Embed
validation_workloads: Synthetic (uniform random PROMPTLENGTH=5000 BPE-tokenizable strings; NUMSAMPLES=250)

scope_assumptions.en: Audits cache existence and sharing level but does not implement practical prompt-extraction attacks; preliminary breadth-first search for token-by-token extraction failed due to noise. Requires that the API expose TTFT (max_tokens=1) and either client-side or server-side timing. Floating-point precision discrepancies between cache hit and miss embeddings (1e-4 to 1e-5) are observed and hypothesized to come from lower-precision KV storage. Audit run from clients in California in Sep-Oct 2024; results may not generalize over time as providers patch.
scope_assumptions.zh: Audit 偵測 cache 是否存在與共享層級，但不實作實際的 prompt extraction 攻擊；token-by-token breadth-first search 因雜訊而失敗。需要 API 暴露 TTFT (max_tokens=1)，並具備 client-side 或 server-side timing。Cache hit 與 miss 之間觀察到 1e-4 至 1e-5 等級的浮點精度差異，推測來自較低精度的 KV 儲存。實驗於 2024 年 9-10 月在加州 client 進行，provider 後續可能 patch，結果未必可外推。

title: Autellix: An Efficient Serving Engine for LLM Agents as General Programs
authors: Michael Luo; Xiaoxiang Shi; Colin Cai; Tianjun Zhang; Justin Wong; Yichuan Wang; Chi Wang; Yanping Huang; Zhifeng Chen; Joseph E. Gonzalez; Ion Stoica
affiliations: UC Berkeley, Google DeepMind, Shanghai Jiao Tong University
research_focus: Agentic / Workflow serving, Multi-tenant scheduling, Datacenter networking, Routing / Load balancing

problem_statement.en: Existing LLM serving systems treat LLM calls as independent requests, ignoring program-level dependencies and context, which leads to head-of-line blocking and suboptimal end-to-end latency for agentic programs. This results in significant waiting times for programs as they scale their inference computation.
problem_statement.zh: 現有 LLM 服務系統將每次 LLM 呼叫視為獨立請求，忽略程式層級的依賴關係與上下文，導致 agentic 程式出現隊頭阻塞（head-of-line blocking）與次優的端到端延遲；隨著 inference 計算規模擴大，程式等待時間也隨之顯著增加。

key_innovation.en: Autellix introduces a stateful serving engine that treats agentic programs as first-class citizens, utilizing program-level statistics (cumulative service time) to inform scheduling and load balancing. It proposes two non-clairvoyant scheduling algorithms, PLAS (for single-threaded) and ATLAS (for multi-threaded DAGs), to prioritize calls based on program progress.
key_innovation.zh: Autellix 引入一套有狀態的 serving 引擎，將 agentic 程式作為一等公民，利用程式層級統計資訊（累計服務時間）指導 scheduling 與負載均衡。其提出兩種非預知型 scheduling 演算法：PLAS（針對單執行緒）與 ATLAS（針對多執行緒 DAG），依據程式進度對呼叫進行優先排序。

key_improvements.en: 4-15x throughput increase at the same latency compared to vLLM; up to 1.5x throughput improvement over standard load-balancers across engines.
key_improvements.zh: 在相同延遲條件下，吞吐量相較於 vLLM 提升 4–15x；跨引擎場景中相較於標準負載均衡器吞吐量最高提升 1.5x。

ai_task: LLM Serving, Agentic Programs, Multi-agent Systems, ReAct, MCTS, Chatbot

title: Beluga: A CXL-Based Memory Architecture for Scalable and Efficient LLM KVCache Management
authors: Xinjun Yang; Qingda Hu; Junru Li; Feifei Li; Yuqi Zhou; Yicong Zhu; Qiuru Lin; Jian Dai; Yang Kong; Jiayu Zhang; Guoqiang Xu; Qiang Liu
research_focus: PD disaggregation, KV cache offloading, Datacenter networking, RDMA / Transport, GPU memory tiering

problem_statement.en: The limited capacity of GPU HBM necessitates offloading KVCache to host memory or remote pools, but existing RDMA-based disaggregated memory solutions suffer from high access latency, complex communication protocols, and significant synchronization overhead.
problem_statement.zh: GPU HBM 容量有限，迫使系統將 KV cache 卸載至主機記憶體或遠端記憶體池；然而現有基於 RDMA 的解耦記憶體方案存在存取延遲高、通訊協定複雜，以及同步開銷顯著等問題。

key_innovation.en: Beluga, a CXL 2.0-based memory architecture that enables GPUs and CPUs to access a shared, large-scale memory pool via CXL switches using native load/store semantics, eliminating the need for complex network stacks and bounce buffers.
key_innovation.zh: Beluga 是基於 CXL 2.0 的記憶體架構，允許 GPU 與 CPU 透過 CXL 交換器以原生 load/store 語義存取共享的大規模記憶體池，從而消除複雜網路協定棧與中繼緩衝區的需求。

key_improvements.en: 89.6% reduction in Time-To-First-Token (TTFT) and 7.35x throughput improvement in vLLM compared to RDMA-based solutions.
key_improvements.zh: 相較於 RDMA 方案，TTFT 降低 89.6%，vLLM 吞吐量提升 7.35x。

ai_task: LLM Serving, LLM Inference, KVCache Management, RAG
compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA H20, Intel Xeon Platinum 8575C, DDR5 4800 MT/s, CXL-based memory expander
network_hw: XConn XC50256 CXL 2.0 switch, ConnectX-7, PCIe 5.0 switches

title: Beyond Greedy Chunking: SLO-Aware Sliding-Window Scheduling for LLM Inference
authors: Yuansheng Chen; Yue Zhang; Xuan Mo; Weigang Wu; Jialun Li
affiliations: Sun Yat-sen University, Guangdong Polytechnic Normal University
research_focus: LLM serving, Multi-tenant scheduling, Continuous batching, Performance modeling

problem_statement.en: Online LLM serving must sustain high throughput while meeting per-request TTFT/TBT SLOs, but existing systems rely on coarse-grained output constraints and greedy single-step chunk-size decisions. This handles resource contention among concurrent requests poorly, yielding low resource utilization and limited support for fine-grained QoS differentiation.
problem_statement.zh: 線上 LLM serving 需在滿足各請求 TTFT/TBT SLO 的同時維持高吞吐量，然而既有系統依賴粗粒度的輸出約束與貪婪的單步 chunk size 決策，難以妥善處理多請求間的資源競爭，導致資源利用率偏低，對細粒度 QoS 差異化的支援亦有限。

key_innovation.en: SlidingServe, an SLO-aware scheduler built on vLLM that couples a lightweight per-scene linear Batch Latency Predictor with: (1) SlidingChunker, which jointly optimizes chunk size over a sliding window of the current and next iterations via ternary search; (2) a Multi-Level Priority Sorter using a lexicographic key (SLO-safeguard flag, urgency, shortest remaining prefill); (3) BatchConstructor, which uses dynamic programming (0/1 knapsack anchored on SLO-risky requests) for in-batch request selection and token allocation.
key_innovation.zh: SlidingServe：建構於 vLLM 之上的 SLO-aware scheduler，以輕量的分場景線性 Batch Latency Predictor 為基礎，結合 (1) SlidingChunker：以 ternary search 在「當前與下一個 iteration」的滑動視窗上聯合最佳化 chunk size；(2) Multi-Level Priority Sorter：以字典序鍵值（SLO 保護旗標、緊迫度、最短剩餘 prefill）排序候選請求；(3) BatchConstructor：以面臨 SLO 風險的請求為 anchor，透過動態規劃（0/1 knapsack）進行 batch 內請求選擇與 token 配置。

key_improvements.en: Up to 30% higher service capacity than advanced scheduling systems under various load conditions; SLO violation rate reduced by 16%-53% under heavy load; 25%-111% higher goodput than Sarathi-EDF and 9.7%-30% higher goodput than QoServe.
key_improvements.zh: 在各種負載條件下，服務容量較先進排程系統最多提升 30%；重負載下 SLO 違反率降低 16%-53%；goodput 較 Sarathi-EDF 高 25%-111%、較 QoServe 高 9.7%-30%。

compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA RTX 3090, NVIDIA RTX A6000, NVIDIA A100
reported_accuracy: Batch latency predictor: MAE 2.52-2.72 ms, RMSE 4.12-4.33 ms, R^2 > 0.99 across RTX 3090 (TP2), A6000 (TP2), A100
validation_workloads: ShareGPT, arXiv-Summarization (Arxiv-v1, Arxiv-v2), Mixed ShareGPT+arXiv (3:1, 5:1)

scope_assumptions.en: Sliding window fixed at size 2 with step 1 (current + next iteration only); predictor is a per-scene linear model over 7 hand-engineered features, trained on offline-collected batch runtime data with online incremental hot-swapped calibration; requests must carry TTFT/TBT SLOs at submission; a lightweight batch forward simulator follows vLLM token-allocation rules; TBT is modeled as per-token deadlines d_{i,k+1} = a_i + L^ttft + k * L^tbt; end-to-end evaluation limited to 7B/8B dense models on RTX 3090 (TP2).
scope_assumptions.zh: 滑動視窗固定為大小 2、步長 1（僅涵蓋當前與下一個 iteration）；predictor 為分場景線性模型，僅使用 7 個人工設計特徵，以離線蒐集的 batch 執行時間資料訓練，並以線上增量、熱替換方式校正；請求提交時須附帶 TTFT/TBT SLO；輕量 batch forward simulator 遵循 vLLM 的 token 配置規則；TBT 建模為逐 token deadline（d_{i,k+1} = a_i + L^ttft + k * L^tbt）；端到端評估僅限於 RTX 3090（TP2）上的 7B/8B dense 模型。

title: Bullet: Boosting GPU Utilization for LLM Serving through Spatial-Temporal GPU Resource Sharing
authors: Zejia Lin; Hongxin Xu; Guanyi Chen; Zhiguang Chen; Yutong Lu; Xianwei Zhang
venue_full: ACM International Conference on Architectural Support for Programming Languages and Operating Systems (ASPLOS 2026)
research_focus: LLM serving, Multi-tenant scheduling, Continuous batching, Performance modeling, Roofline analysis, Hardware co-design, MoE serving

problem_statement.en: Hybrid prefill/decode batching leaves GPUs under-utilised because prefill is compute-intensive while decode is memory-bound. Existing systems treat the two phases as a single shared batch, so they either protect latency by throttling prefill or protect throughput by allowing prefill to disrupt decode.
problem_statement.zh: 混合 prefill/decode batching 會讓 GPU 利用率不足，因為 prefill 偏 compute-bound，而 decode 偏 memory-bound。既有系統把兩個階段放在同一共享 batch 裡處理，結果不是為了保護延遲而限制 prefill，就是為了吞吐而讓 prefill 干擾 decode。

key_innovation.en: Bullet is a spatial-temporal orchestration system that co-executes prefill and decode while dynamically provisioning streaming multiprocessor resources. It combines an SM-scaling roofline model, SLO-aware scheduling, SM masking via libsmctrl, and a concurrent execution engine so prefill can consume otherwise idle compute resources without violating decode latency.
key_innovation.zh: Bullet 是一個 spatial-temporal orchestration 系統，讓 prefill 與 decode 可並行執行，並動態配置 streaming multiprocessor 資源。它結合 SM-scaling roofline model、SLO-aware scheduling、透過 libsmctrl 的 SM masking、以及 concurrent execution engine，使 prefill 能利用閒置 compute 資源，同時不破壞 decode latency。

key_improvements.en: Reports 1.26x average throughput gain and up to 1.55x over state-of-the-art systems while meeting latency targets. On multi-GPU Qwen3-235B-A22B-FP8 serving, Bullet lowers mean latency, TTFT, and TPOT by 17.7x, 16.2x, and 4.2x versus vLLM in the reported configuration; utilisation analysis shows 86.2% active SM cycles and higher Tensor Core and memory-bandwidth utilisation than SGLang.
key_improvements.zh: 在滿足 latency target 下，平均 throughput 提升 1.26x，最高達 1.55x。於多 GPU Qwen3-235B-A22B-FP8 服務設定中，Bullet 相對 vLLM 分別將 mean latency、TTFT、TPOT 降低 17.7x、16.2x、4.2x；利用率分析顯示 active SM cycles 達 86.2%，Tensor Core 與 memory bandwidth 利用率也高於 SGLang。

compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA A100 80GB, NVIDIA H100, NVIDIA H20, HBM
reported_accuracy: SM-scaling roofline model reports mean absolute relative error for decode of 10.5% over 7360 profiled configurations; end-to-end validation is reported through throughput, latency, and SLO-compliance metrics.
validation_workloads: ShareGPT, Azure-Code, arXiv-Summary

scope_assumptions.en: Bullet assumes the serving runtime can enforce SM-level partitioning and run prefill/decode in separate execution streams. Its model is calibrated for specific GPU generations and uses runtime performance estimation rather than a fully portable closed-form predictor across arbitrary kernels and hardware.
scope_assumptions.zh: Bullet 假設服務 runtime 能執行 SM-level partitioning，並以不同 execution streams 分開執行 prefill/decode。其模型針對特定 GPU 世代校準，使用 runtime performance estimation，而不是可任意跨 kernel 與硬體移植的完整 closed-form predictor。

title: Cache-to-Cache: Direct Semantic Communication Between Large Language Models
authors: Tianyu Fu; Zihan Min; Hanling Zhang; Jichao Yan; Guohao Dai; Wanli Ouyang; Yu Wang
affiliations: Tsinghua University, Infinigence AI, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, SLAI, Shanghai AI Laboratory
research_focus: Agentic / Workflow serving

problem_statement.en: Existing multi-LLM systems exchange semantics through text, forcing high-dimensional internal representations into lossy linear token sequences and incurring sequential decoding latency. This bottleneck prevents models with different knowledge or roles from directly sharing complementary contextual understanding.
problem_statement.zh: 現有 multi-LLM 系統透過 text 交換語意，迫使高維內部 representation 壓縮為有損的線性 token sequence，並承擔循序 decoding latency。此瓶頸使具備不同知識或角色的模型無法直接共享互補的 context 理解。

key_innovation.en: C2C trains lightweight per-layer neural fusers that align heterogeneous tokenizers and layers, project a Sharer's KV cache into a Receiver's representation space, and fuse it residually with the Receiver cache. Learnable per-layer gates select where to inject the transferred semantics while both LLMs remain frozen.
key_innovation.zh: C2C 訓練輕量的逐 layer neural fuser，對齊異質 tokenizer 與 layer，將 Sharer 的 KV cache 投影至 Receiver 的 representation space，再以 residual 方式與 Receiver cache 融合。可學習的逐 layer gate 選擇注入所傳遞語意的位置，且兩個 LLM 均保持凍結。

key_improvements.en: Across the evaluated model pairings, C2C achieves 6.4–14.2% higher average accuracy than individual models and 3.1–5.4% higher average accuracy than T2T communication, with an average 2.5× latency speedup.
key_improvements.zh: 在所評測的 model pairing 中，C2C 的平均 accuracy 較 individual model 提升 6.4–14.2%，較 T2T communication 提升 3.1–5.4%，且 latency 平均加速 2.5×。

reuse_metric.en: Average accuracy is the reported reuse/communication-quality metric: C2C improves it by 6.4–14.2% over individual models and by 3.1–5.4% over T2T communication.
reuse_metric.zh: 論文以平均 accuracy 作為重用／通訊品質指標：C2C 較 individual model 提升 6.4–14.2%，並較 T2T communication 提升 3.1–5.4%。

title: CacheBlend: Fast Large Language Model Serving for RAG with Cached Knowledge Fusion
authors: Jiayi Yao; Hanchen Li; Yuhan Liu; Siddhant Ray; Yihua Cheng; Qizheng Zhang; Kuntai Du; Shan Lu; Junchen Jiang
affiliations: University of Chicago, CUHK-Shenzhen, Stanford University, Microsoft Research
research_focus: LLM serving, Long-context / Prefix cache, KV cache offloading

problem_statement.en: In RAG requests containing multiple retrieved text chunks, reusable content is not always at the input prefix, and independently precomputed KV caches omit cross-attention with preceding text. Full KV recompute is expensive, while prefix caching and full KV reuse respectively provide limited acceleration or degrade generation quality.
problem_statement.zh: 在包含多個檢索文本 chunk 的 RAG request 中，可重用內容不一定位於 input prefix，而各自獨立預先計算的 KV cache 會遺漏其與前文的 cross-attention。Full KV recompute 成本高昂，而 prefix caching 與 full KV reuse 分別只能提供有限加速或會降低生成品質。

key_innovation.en: CacheBlend fuses independently precomputed KV caches at arbitrary input positions by selectively recomputing High-KV-Deviation (HKVD) tokens layer by layer to restore cross-attention while reusing the remaining KV tensors. It pipelines selective recomputation with per-layer KV loading so that slower storage can be used without adding TTFT when loading hides recomputation.
key_innovation.zh: CacheBlend 可在任意 input position 融合各自獨立預先計算的 KV cache；其逐層選擇 High-KV-Deviation (HKVD) tokens 進行 selective recompute，以恢復 cross-attention，並重用其餘 KV tensors。系統將 selective recompute 與逐層 KV 載入形成 pipeline，使載入延遲足以遮蔽重算時可使用較慢儲存而不增加 TTFT。

baselines_compared: Full KV recompute, Prefix caching, Full KV reuse, MapReduce, MapRerank

key_improvements.en: CacheBlend reduces TTFT by 2.2–3.3× and increases inference throughput by 2.8–5× versus full KV recompute, with negligible generation-quality loss across four datasets and three models.
key_improvements.zh: 相較於 full KV recompute，CacheBlend 將 TTFT 降低 2.2–3.3×，並將 inference throughput 提升 2.8–5×；在四個資料集與三個模型上僅有可忽略的生成品質損失。

ai_task: LLM Serving, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Question Answering (QA), Summarization
compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA A40, 128 GB RAM, 1 TB NVMe SSD

reuse_metric.en: A 5%–18% selective recompute ratio limits the F1/Rouge-L loss to at most 0.002 versus full KV recompute across all four datasets on Yi-34B.
reuse_metric.zh: 在 Yi-34B 的四個資料集上，5%–18% 的 selective recompute ratio 使相較於 full KV recompute 的 F1/Rouge-L 損失至多為 0.002。

title: Cost-Efficient Large Language Model Serving for Multi-turn Conversations with CachedAttention
authors: Bin Gao; Zhuomin He; Puru Sharma; Qingxuan Kang; Djordje Jevdjic; Junbo Deng; Xingkun Yang; Zhou Yu; Pengfei Zuo
affiliations: National University of Singapore, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Huawei Cloud
research_focus: LLM serving, Long-context / Prefix cache, KV cache offloading, GPU memory tiering, Multi-tenant scheduling

problem_statement.en: Existing LLM serving engines repeatedly recompute the KV caches of historical tokens across multi-turn conversations, because KV caches are discarded to free HBM when a session becomes inactive and must be regenerated when it resumes. This repetitive prefill dominates cost (up to 99% of prefilling) and inflates serving cost and TTFT as conversations grow.
problem_statement.zh: 現有 LLM 服務引擎在多輪對話中會重複計算歷史 token 的 KV cache：當 session 進入非活躍狀態時，KV cache 會被丟棄以釋放 HBM，待對話再度活躍時又須重新 prefill。此重複計算最高佔 prefilling 成本的 99%，並使 serving 成本與 TTFT 隨對話輪數增加而上升。

key_innovation.en: CachedAttention, an attention mechanism that reuses KV caches across conversation turns via a hierarchical KV caching system (AttentionStore) spanning HBM, host DRAM, and disks. It employs layer-wise pre-loading and asynchronous saving to overlap slow-medium KV access with GPU computation, scheduler-aware fetching and eviction to keep hot KV caches in the fastest tier, and positional-encoding-decoupled truncation to keep saved KV caches valid after context-window overflow.
key_innovation.zh: 提出 CachedAttention：一種可跨對話輪次重用 KV cache 的 attention 機制，並搭配橫跨 HBM、host DRAM 與 disk 的階層式 KV caching 系統 AttentionStore。其以 layer-wise 預載入與非同步儲存，將慢速媒介的 KV 存取與 GPU 運算重疊；以 scheduler-aware 的 fetching 與 eviction 將熱門 KV cache 保留於最快層；並藉由解耦 positional encoding 的截斷機制，使 KV cache 在 context window 溢位後仍然有效。

key_improvements.en: Reduces TTFT by up to 87% and improves prompt prefilling throughput by up to 7.8x for multi-turn conversations; lowers end-to-end inference cost by up to 70%. Achieves up to 86% KV cache hit rate and up to 2.7x GPU-time speedup over LRU/FIFO eviction.
key_improvements.zh: 在多輪對話中將 TTFT 最多降低 87%、prompt prefilling 吞吐量最多提升 7.8x；端到端推理成本最多降低 70%。KV cache hit rate 最高達 86%，相較 LRU/FIFO eviction，GPU 時間最多加速 2.7x。

ai_task: LLM Serving, AI Inference KV Cache transfer
offload_trigger: Turn end: the whole session's KV is saved when the conversation turn completes and the session becomes inactive, unconditionally (no reuse-worthiness gate); asynchronous saving overlaps the write with computation.
prefetch_signal_timing: Job-queue hint: the scheduler's waiting queue provides lookahead to prefetch a session's KV from SSD to DRAM before execution, and layer-wise pre-loading overlaps host-to-GPU transfer with prefill computation.
costs_modeled: PCIe bandwidth, host DRAM capacity, transfer-vs-recompute crossover
agent_awareness: Multi-turn conversation session lifecycle: human think-time gaps between turns are assumed long enough to hide transfers; no tool-call or workflow structure.

when_to_offload_rule.en: Offload the entire session's KV cache at every turn end when the session becomes inactive, unconditionally — the human think-time gap is assumed to always cover the transfer.
when_to_offload_rule.zh: 於每次對話輪結束、session 轉為閒置時，無條件卸載整個 session 的 KV cache——假設人類思考時間的空檔恆足以掩蓋傳輸。

title: CacheGen: KV Cache Compression and Streaming for Fast Large Language Model Serving
authors: Yuhan Liu; Hanchen Li; Yihua Cheng; Siddhant Ray; Yuyang Huang; Qizheng Zhang; Kuntai Du; Jiayi Yao; Shan Lu; Ganesh Ananthanarayanan; Michael Maire; Henry Hoffmann; Ari Holtzman; Junchen Jiang
affiliations: University of Chicago, Microsoft, Stanford University
research_focus: LLM serving, Long-context / Prefix cache, KV cache compression, Quantization

problem_statement.en: Reusing the KV cache of long contexts avoids prefill recomputation, but the reused cache often resides on another machine; fetching these multi-GB floating-point tensors over bandwidth-limited links (single-digit Gbps between cloud servers) can take as long as, or longer than, prefill itself, inflating TTFT.
problem_statement.zh: 重用長 context 的 KV cache 可避免 prefill 重算，但被重用的 cache 往往存放於其他機器；在頻寬受限的鏈路上（雲端伺服器間常僅個位數 Gbps）傳輸這些數 GB 級的浮點 tensor，其網路延遲可能與 prefill 相當甚至更長，顯著拉高 TTFT。

key_innovation.en: A KV cache streamer with a custom codec that encodes KV tensors into compact bitstreams instead of keeping tensor shapes: change-based (delta) encoding over token groups, layer-wise quantization exploiting deeper layers' higher loss tolerance, and arithmetic coding with per channel-layer probability distributions; per-chunk streaming then adapts the encoding level (or falls back to text recomputation) under bandwidth fluctuation to keep TTFT within the SLO.
key_innovation.zh: KV cache streamer 搭配客製化 codec，不保留 tensor 形狀而將 KV tensor 編碼為精簡 bitstream：對 token group 進行 change-based（delta）編碼、利用深層 layer 較高容錯度的 layer-wise quantization，以及依 channel-layer 分組機率分布的 arithmetic coding；串流時以 chunk 為單位、隨頻寬波動動態調整編碼等級（或退回文字重算），使 TTFT 維持在 SLO 內。

baselines_compared: Uniform KV quantization, Text context (vLLM), H2O, LLMLingua

key_improvements.en: Reduces KV cache size by 3.5-4.3x vs. the quantization baseline and TTFT by 3.2-3.7x (3.1-4.7x vs. loading text context) with negligible quality impact (<2% accuracy, <0.1 F1/perplexity); further shrinks H2O- and LLMLingua-compressed KV caches by 3.3-4.2x.
key_improvements.zh: 相較 quantization baseline，KV cache 大小縮減 3.5-4.3x、TTFT 降低 3.2-3.7x（相較載入文字 context 為 3.1-4.7x），品質影響可忽略（accuracy 下降 <2%、F1/perplexity 變化 <0.1）；疊加於 H2O 與 LLMLingua 壓縮後的 KV cache 可再縮減 3.3-4.2x。

ai_task: LLM Serving, KV Cache Compression, AI Inference KV Cache transfer
compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA A40, Intel Xeon Gold 6130, 384 GB RAM
offload_trigger: Not Specified (transport-side system: KV of reusable contexts is already stored across nodes; deciding when to offload or retain is out of scope).
prefetch_signal_timing: Reactive on request arrival: the stored KV bitstream is streamed over the network per chunk, with the compression level adapted to current bandwidth (falling back to text recomputation) to keep TTFT within the SLO.
agent_awareness: None: exploits cross-node/cross-request context reuse; no agent timing or workflow structure.

when_to_offload_rule.en: No when-to-offload rule (out of scope); at request arrival it chooses between shipping the compressed KV bitstream and recomputing from text — and picks the per-chunk compression level — based on current network bandwidth and the TTFT SLO.
when_to_offload_rule.zh: 無「何時卸載」規則（不在其範疇）；於請求到達時依當前網路頻寬與 TTFT SLO，在傳輸壓縮後的 KV bitstream 與由文字重算之間做選擇，並逐 chunk 調整壓縮等級。

title: CacheProbe: Auditing Prompt Cache Isolation in Gateway APIs
authors: Ryan Fahey
venue_full: arXiv preprint (accepted at SAGAI '26, Workshop on Secure Agents for Generative AI, co-located with IEEE Symposium on Security and Privacy 2026)
research_focus: Long-context / Prefix cache, Performance modeling

problem_statement.en: Prompt caching reuses parts of a prompt's KV cache across requests to save compute and lower TTFT, but many implementations are insecure against timing attacks and metadata disclosure. Gu et al. (ICML 2025) showed providers cache and that shared caches leak information; most providers responded with per-account / per-organization cache isolation. This paper asks whether an API gateway breaks that isolation: when OpenRouter routes user requests to upstream providers under shared organizational credentials, does it inadvertently create global cache sharing across all OpenRouter users, bypassing provider-level per-tenant isolation guarantees?
problem_statement.zh: prompt cache 透過在請求之間重用某個 prompt 的部分 KV cache 來節省算力並降低 TTFT，但許多實作對 timing attack 與 metadata 洩漏並不安全。Gu et al.（ICML 2025）證明 provider 會做快取，且共享的 cache 會洩漏資訊；多數 provider 因此改採 per-account／per-organization 的 cache 隔離。本文追問 API gateway 是否會破壞此隔離：當 OpenRouter 以共享的組織憑證將使用者請求路由到上游 provider 時，是否會在所有 OpenRouter 使用者之間無意間造成 global cache sharing，進而繞過 provider 層級的 per-tenant 隔離保證。

key_innovation.en: CacheProbe: a two-signal cache-isolation audit that extends Gu et al.'s timing-attack methodology from single providers to an API gateway. Signal 1 (timing side-channel): an interleaved sampling procedure collects paired cache-miss/cache-hit TTFT samples, then applies a two-sample Kolmogorov-Smirnov test with a stringent significance threshold p < 1e-8. Signal 2 (metadata disclosure): it inspects the cached_tokens usage field, declaring a positive when more than 50% of cache-primed requests report cached tokens exceeding 90% of the expected prefix threshold. It runs a 2x3 scenario matrix - {Direct API, OpenRouter Default, OpenRouter BYOK} x {Same account, Cross account} - forcing single-provider routing via OpenRouter's provider.order parameter, so the design isolates whether cross-account cache sharing originates from the routing layer or from shared organizational credentials.
