key_innovation.zh: CacheProbe：一套雙訊號的 cache 隔離 audit，將 Gu et al. 的 timing attack 方法從單一 provider 延伸到 API gateway。訊號一（timing side-channel）以交錯取樣程序收集成對的 cache-miss／cache-hit TTFT 樣本，再套用雙樣本 Kolmogorov-Smirnov 檢定，並採用嚴格的顯著水準 p < 1e-8。訊號二（metadata disclosure）檢視 cached_tokens 這個 usage 欄位，當超過 50% 的 cache-primed 請求所回報的 cached tokens 超過預期 prefix 門檻的 90% 時判為陽性。作者跑一個 2x3 情境矩陣——{Direct API、OpenRouter Default、OpenRouter BYOK} x {同帳號、跨帳號}——並透過 OpenRouter 的 provider.order 參數強制單一 provider 路由，藉此區分跨帳號 cache sharing 究竟源自路由層還是共享的組織憑證。

baselines_compared: Direct-API access (per-provider isolation control); Gu et al. 2025 (Auditing Prompt Caching) timing-attack method

key_improvements.en: Across ~9,000 requests (18 configs = 3 providers x 6 scenarios, 250 sample pairs each), all three providers (OpenAI gpt-4o-mini, Groq gpt-oss-20b, Fireworks qwen3-8b) show correct cross-account isolation via Direct API, but cross-account cache sharing appears via OpenRouter's default (shared-credential) mode: Fireworks cross-account timing p = 4.08e-15; Groq shows 100% cache-hit rate cross-account via metadata (timing p = 0.002, below the 1e-8 bar); OpenAI shows minor leakage with 4.8% of cross-account requests reporting cached tokens above threshold. OpenRouter BYOK mode restores isolation (all p > 0.16, no metadata sharing). Conclusion: the vulnerability stems from shared organizational credentials, not the routing layer itself.
key_improvements.zh: 在約 9,000 個請求（18 種配置 = 3 家 provider x 6 情境，每情境 250 對樣本）中，三家 provider（OpenAI gpt-4o-mini、Groq gpt-oss-20b、Fireworks qwen3-8b）在 Direct API 下皆呈現正確的跨帳號隔離，但在 OpenRouter 的預設（共享憑證）模式下出現跨帳號 cache sharing：Fireworks 跨帳號 timing p = 4.08e-15；Groq 經由 metadata 顯示跨帳號 100% cache-hit（timing p = 0.002，未達 1e-8 門檻）；OpenAI 為輕微洩漏，4.8% 的跨帳號請求回報的 cached tokens 超過門檻。OpenRouter BYOK 模式則恢復隔離（所有 p > 0.16，無 metadata sharing）。結論：漏洞源自共享的組織憑證，而非路由層本身。

reported_accuracy: Detection via two-sample KS test at p < 1e-8 or metadata (>50% of primed requests over 90% prefix threshold). Fireworks OpenRouter cross-account timing p = 4.08e-15; Groq cross-account 100% metadata cache-hit; OpenAI 4.8% cross-account cached-token leakage; all BYOK scenarios p > 0.16 (isolated).
validation_workloads: Synthetic (space-separated single-character ASCII tokens; prompt length 4,096 tokens at 95% prefix fraction, probe shares first 3,891 tokens and differs in final 205; 250 sample pairs per scenario; 500ms inter-request delay; interleaved miss/hit sampling)

scope_assumptions.en: Audits only cache-isolation existence, not practical prompt reconstruction / extraction. Tests just 3 providers and 1 model each; behavior may differ for other providers/models. Uses randomly generated prompts, not realistic application prompts, so cache-hit patterns may not match production. Cache eviction policy, timing, provider load, and time-of-day are uncontrolled. Statistical thresholds are conservative and may miss partial/intermittent sharing. The adversary needs only a valid OpenRouter API key with credits plus provider.order routing control - no access to OpenRouter internals or the victim's account. Experiments ran from an Oracle Cloud US-East (Ashburn, VA) Ubuntu VM, Nov 12 - Dec 8, 2025.
scope_assumptions.zh: 此 audit 僅偵測 cache 隔離是否存在，不實作實際的 prompt reconstruction／extraction。只測試 3 家 provider、每家 1 個模型，其他 provider／模型行為可能不同。使用隨機產生的 prompt 而非真實應用 prompt，cache-hit 模式未必符合生產環境。cache eviction policy、timing、provider 負載與一天中的時段皆未受控。統計門檻偏保守，可能漏掉部分或間歇性的 sharing。攻擊者只需持有具額度的有效 OpenRouter API key 並能以 provider.order 控制路由，無需存取 OpenRouter 內部或受害者帳號。實驗於 Oracle Cloud US-East（維吉尼亞州 Ashburn）的 Ubuntu VM 上進行，時間為 2025 年 11 月 12 日至 12 月 8 日。

title: CachePrune: Privacy-Aware and Fine-Grained KV Cache Sharing for Efficient LLM Inference
authors: Guanlong Wu; Zhaohan Li; Yao Zhang; Zheng Zhang; Jianyu Niu; Ye Wu; Yinqian Zhang
research_focus: LLM serving, Long-context / Prefix cache

problem_statement.en: Cross-user KV cache sharing reduces redundant prefill, but its reuse signal lets adversaries infer other users' prompt content; disabling sharing removes that leakage at the cost of reuse and latency. Coarse fixed-size sharing cannot safely retain the many non-sensitive tokens surrounding a sensitive token.
problem_statement.zh: 跨使用者 KV cache 共享可減少重複 prefill，但其重用訊號可能使攻擊者推知其他使用者的 prompt 內容；全面停用共享雖可消除此類洩漏，卻犧牲重用效益並增加延遲。既有固定大小、粗粒度共享無法安全保留敏感 token 周邊的大量非敏感 token。

key_innovation.en: CachePrune masks detector-identified sensitive tokens and shares only token-granular, variable-length KV segments. A summed-area-table annotator finds self-contextualized reusable spans and attention-ranked tokens for selective recomputation, while a two-stage rolling-hash/SHA-256 retriever matches spans in near-linear time.
key_innovation.zh: CachePrune 透過 sensitivity detector 標記敏感 token，僅共享 token 細粒度、可變長度的 KV segment。其 summed-area-table annotator 尋找具 self-contextualization 的可重用 segment，並依 attention 對 token 排序以執行 selective recompute；兩階段 rolling-hash/SHA-256 retriever 則以近線性時間完成 segment 匹配。

key_improvements.en: With default privacy filtering, CachePrune reports 0% direct recovery of marked sensitive tokens, up to 94.57% cache hit rate, and up to 4.5x lower TTFT than no sharing while preserving comparable generation quality. With privacy disabled, its fine-grained reuse raises match rate by up to 44% over CacheCraft, CacheBlend, and EPIC.
key_improvements.zh: 在預設 privacy filtering 下，CachePrune 對已標記敏感 token 的 direct recovery rate 為 0%，cache hit rate 最高達 94.57%，相較 no-sharing baseline 的 TTFT 最高改善 4.5x，且 generation quality 相近。停用 privacy 約束時，其細粒度重用相較 CacheCraft、CacheBlend 與 EPIC 將 match rate 最高提升 44%。

compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA H100, HBM, Intel Xeon Silver 4510, SATA SSD

reuse_metric.en: Default end-to-end hit rates are 82.88% (QASPER), 56.45% (NarrativeQA), and 94.57% (QMSum), with generation quality comparable to no sharing; without privacy constraints, match rate improves by up to 44% over fixed-chunk reuse.
reuse_metric.zh: 預設 end-to-end hit rate 分別為 82.88% (QASPER)、56.45% (NarrativeQA) 與 94.57% (QMSum)，generation quality 與 no-sharing 相近；停用 privacy 約束時，相較固定 chunk 重用，match rate 最高提升 44%。

title: A Policy-Driven Runtime Layer for Agentic LLM Serving
authors: Rui Zhang; Chaeeun Kim; Liting Hu
research_focus: Agentic / Workflow serving, Long-context / Prefix cache, LLM serving

problem_statement.en: Cross-cutting policies in multi-agent LLM serving (prefix caching, batch shaping, fairness, etc.) need both agent identity from the framework and engine-level events, but neither layer holds both, so each policy today is a one-off patch into one neighbor. For KV caching specifically, recurring agent anchors (0.34 to 0.52 of every first-turn prompt) drop out of reactive LRU prefix caches before the next session arrives.
problem_statement.zh: 多 agent LLM serving 中的跨層政策（prefix caching、batch shaping、公平性等）同時需要框架端的 agent 身分與引擎端的事件，但兩層各自只掌握一半，導致每項政策目前都以一次性補丁塞進其中一側。就 KV caching 而言，跨 session 重複出現的 agent anchor（佔每個首輪 prompt 的 0.34 至 0.52）在下一個 session 到來前，就已被 reactive 的 LRU prefix cache 淘汰。

key_innovation.en: An agent runtime layer: a third tier between agent framework and serving engine exposing four primitives (observe, score, predict, act) with agent identity as the shared coordinate. Instantiated as CacheSage for KV caching: an online first-order Markov agent-transition learner, survival-probability-based eviction scoring, and cross-session prefetch of the predicted next agent's anchor, with <=20 KB state per workload and graceful fallback to LRU.
key_innovation.zh: 提出 agent runtime layer：位於 agent 框架與 serving engine 之間的第三層，以 agent 身分為共享座標，對外提供四個 primitive（observe、score、predict、act）。並以 CacheSage 實例化於 KV caching：線上學習一階 Markov agent 轉移矩陣、以存活機率作為 eviction 評分，並對預測的下一個 agent 之 anchor 進行跨 session prefetch；每個 workload 的狀態 <=20 KB，且可平滑退化為 LRU。

key_improvements.en: +13 to +37 pp KV cache hit-rate lift, 12% to 29% lower mean TTFT, and 6% to 14% higher throughput over an unmodified serving stack across five real multi-agent workloads.
key_improvements.zh: 在五個真實多 agent 工作負載上，相較未修改的 serving stack，KV cache 命中率提升 +13 至 +37 個百分點，平均 TTFT 降低 12% 至 29%，吞吐量提升 6% 至 14%。

ai_task: LLM Serving, Multi-agent Systems

title: Adaptive KV Cache Reuse for Fast Long-Context LLM Serving
authors: Fei Li; Song Liu; Yan Liu; Jinhua Cui; Shiqiang Nie; Jinyu Wang; Weiguo Wu
affiliations: Xi’an Jiaotong University, Huazhong University of Science and Technology
research_focus: LLM serving, Long-context / Prefix cache, KV cache offloading, GPU memory tiering

problem_statement.en: Long-context LLM serving repeatedly prefills recurring non-prefix chunks. Direct KV cache concatenation loses cross-chunk global attention and degrades generation quality, while moving reusable caches from GPU-external storage can make I/O the new TTFT bottleneck.
problem_statement.zh: Long-context LLM serving 會對反覆出現的 non-prefix chunk 重複執行 prefill。直接串接 KV cache 會破壞跨 chunk 的全域 attention 並降低生成品質，而從 GPU 外部儲存移動可重用 KV cache，則可能使 I/O 成為新的 TTFT 瓶頸。

key_innovation.en: CacheTune performs one-time offline frequency-domain analysis to rank per-layer KV pairs, selectively recomputes semantic-critical tokens, and reuses the remaining KVs. It combines sparse KV transfer, multi-stream asynchronous overlap, deferred RoPE recovery, and hardware-aware adaptive recomputation-ratio tuning.
key_innovation.zh: CacheTune 透過一次性的 offline frequency-domain analysis 對各 layer 的 KV pair 排序，僅重算對全域語意關鍵的 token，並重用其餘 KV。系統結合 sparse KV transfer、multi-stream asynchronous overlap、deferred RoPE recovery 與 hardware-aware adaptive recomputation-ratio tuning。

baselines_compared: Full Recompute, Full KV Reuse, vLLM Prefix Caching, CacheBlend, EPIC, CacheSlide, KVLink

key_improvements.en: Across five datasets and three models, CacheTune retains 94.8% of full-recompute generation quality on average while delivering 3.72×–4.86× TTFT speedup and 3.93×–6.21× higher throughput. With adaptive recomputation ratios on SSD/HDD pools, it sustains 2.34×–2.36× TTFT speedup.
key_improvements.zh: 在五個 dataset 與三個 model 上，CacheTune 平均保留 Full Recompute 94.8% 的生成品質，同時達成 3.72×–4.86× TTFT speedup 與 3.93×–6.21× throughput 提升；在 SSD/HDD pool 上採用 adaptive recomputation ratio 時，仍可維持 2.34×–2.36× TTFT speedup。

compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA A100-40GB, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090-24GB, CPU memory, SSD, HDD
gpu_count: 2x NVIDIA A100-40GB GPUs; 2x NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090-24GB GPUs

reuse_metric.en: At a 15% recomputation ratio, CacheTune retains 94.8% of full-recompute generation quality on average across five datasets and three models; its TTFT speedup ranges from 3.72× to 4.86×.
reuse_metric.zh: 在 15% recomputation ratio 下，CacheTune 於五個 dataset 與三個 model 上平均保留 Full Recompute 94.8% 的生成品質，TTFT speedup 為 3.72×–4.86×。

title: Caching for Dollars, Not Hits: An Exact Offline Reference for Cloud-Egress Caching and the Crossover That Decides When It Pays
authors: Madhulatha Mandarapu; Sandeep Kunkunuru
research_focus: Performance modeling

problem_statement.en: When a cache miss fetches from cloud object storage (S3, GCS, Azure Blob), the bill is per-GET-request plus per-byte egress, not latency, so miss costs are heterogeneous — a large or cross-region object can cost orders of magnitude more dollars than a small same-region one. Classic hit-rate caching (LRU, Belady's rule) therefore optimizes the wrong objective, yet no prior benchmark measures how far deployed heuristics sit from the dollar-optimal offline policy on real cloud price structures.
problem_statement.zh: 當 cache miss 需從 cloud object storage（S3、GCS、Azure Blob）取回時，帳單以 per-GET-request 加 per-byte egress 計價而非延遲，因此 miss 成本具異質性——大型或跨區物件的金額可能較小型同區物件高出數個數量級。經典的 hit-rate caching（LRU、Belady 規則）因而最佳化了錯誤的目標；然而先前並無 benchmark 衡量在真實雲端價格結構下，已部署 heuristic 與 dollar-optimal offline policy 之間的差距。

key_innovation.en: Supplies an exact dollar-optimal offline reference: for uniform-size page caches with heterogeneous miss costs the offline dollar-optimum is an integral interval LP (totally unimodular, hence exact in polynomial time and validated cent-exact against brute force); for NP-hard variable sizes it extends the flow-based FOO/PFOO bound from hit-ratio to dollars (cost-FOO), tight to about 4%. It also derives the closed-form crossover s* = GET_fee / egress_rate that decides when dollar-aware caching beats hit-rate caching.
key_innovation.zh: 提供精確的 dollar-optimal offline 參考基準：對於具異質 miss 成本的 uniform-size page cache，offline 的 dollar-optimum 為 integral interval LP（totally unimodular，故可於多項式時間內精確求解，並以 brute force 驗證至分文不差）；對於 NP-hard 的 variable size，則將 flow-based 的 FOO／PFOO 界限由 hit-ratio 推廣至 dollars（cost-FOO），緊度約 4%。此外導出封閉形式的 crossover s* = GET_fee / egress_rate，用以判定 dollar-aware caching 何時勝過 hit-rate caching。

baselines_compared: LRU, LFU, GreedyDual-Size (GDS), GreedyDual-Size-Frequency (GDSF), Belady (hit-rate oracle)

key_improvements.en: Characterizes rather than accelerates: LRU's dollar-regret rises with miss-cost heterogeneity H (Spearman 0.87) while cost-aware GDSF cuts median regret to about 0.13x LRU's; GDSF's residual regret collapses to about 0.0002 exactly when the budget fits the expensive working set (B = N_exp); the crossover s* = f/e is about 4.4 KB on S3 and about 330 B on GCS; and the variable-size cost-FOO bound is tight to a median of about 4%.
key_improvements.zh: 本文為 characterization 而非加速：LRU 的 dollar-regret 隨 miss 成本異質性 H 上升（Spearman 0.87），而 cost-aware 的 GDSF 將中位 regret 降至約 LRU 的 0.13x；當預算恰好容納昂貴 working set（B = N_exp）時，GDSF 的殘餘 regret 精確地收斂至約 0.0002；crossover s* = f/e 在 S3 約為 4.4 KB、在 GCS 約為 330 B；variable-size 的 cost-FOO 界限緊度中位約 4%。

reported_accuracy: Exact offline dollar-optimum validated cent-exact against brute force (250 random instances); variable-size cost-FOO bracket (U-L)/L median about 0.04 (~4%)
validation_workloads: Twitter twemcache production trace (Yang et al. 2020), Wikipedia CDN trace (Song et al. 2020), synthetic Zipf traces

scope_assumptions.en: An offline reference and characterization, not a new online caching algorithm: the dollar-optimum requires full future knowledge (a bound to measure regret against, not a deployable policy). The uniform-size case is exact (totally-unimodular interval LP) but variable sizes are NP-hard (bounded, not exact). Miss cost is modeled purely as GET fee + egress bytes with no latency or cross-tenant contention externality; list prices are date-stamped (June 2026) and re-tiering shifts the crossover s*; adversarial re-pricing is left to future work; the dense interval-LP does not scale past ~10^5 requests (a min-cost-flow form is used for scale).
scope_assumptions.zh: 本文為 offline 參考基準與 characterization，而非新的 online caching 演算法：dollar-optimum 需要完整未來資訊（為衡量 regret 的界限，而非可部署的 policy）。uniform-size 情況為精確解（totally-unimodular interval LP），但 variable size 為 NP-hard（有界而非精確）。miss 成本僅以 GET fee 加 egress bytes 建模，不含延遲或跨租戶 contention 的外部性；list price 標註日期（2026 年 6 月），re-tiering 會移動 crossover s*；adversarial re-pricing 留待未來工作；dense interval-LP 無法擴展至約 10^5 requests 以上（規模化改用 min-cost-flow 形式）。

title: File Caching with Rental Cost and Zapping
authors: Monik Khare; Neal E. Young
research_focus: Long-context / Prefix cache, Performance modeling

problem_statement.en: Classical online file caching (paging) charges only a retrieval cost on a miss, so keeping a file resident in the cache is free; this ignores settings where cache residency itself consumes resources (e.g. energy to keep memory blocks powered on). The paper studies online file caching with a rental cost lambda charged per file per time step (Rental Caching), with zapping (pay N >= 1 once so that all future requests to a file are free), and their combination, asking what competitive ratios are achievable when minimizing retrieval + rental + zapping cost against adversarial request sequences.
problem_statement.zh: 傳統 online file caching（paging）只在 miss 時收取 retrieval cost，檔案留駐 cache 不需付費，因而忽略了「cache 駐留本身消耗資源」的情境（例如記憶體區塊維持供電的能耗）。本文研究三種 online 變體：rental caching（cache 中每個檔案每個 time step 收取 rental cost λ）、caching with zapping（一次性支付 N ≥ 1 後該檔案所有後續請求免費），以及兩者的組合，並在對抗式請求序列下探討最小化 retrieval + rental + zapping cost 可達的 competitive ratio。

key_innovation.en: Reduces every variant to an online covering integer LP (CILP) and applies the Koufogiannakis-Young greedy Delta-competitive online covering algorithm, adding rent-evict (and rent-evict-zap) constraints alongside cache-size constraints. The key modification: raising the rental variables y_{t,s} at rate gamma/lambda with gamma = k*lambda makes the algorithm never do work on cache-size constraints, beating the generic Delta bound in the lambda >= 1/k^2 regimes. Also proves a composition theorem (RentalCachingMeta): an alpha-competitive ski-rental algorithm plus a beta-competitive caching algorithm yield an (alpha+beta)-competitive rental caching algorithm, via a formal reduction of infinite-cache rental caching to ski-rental (pay rent lambda per step vs 'buy' at eviction cost).
key_innovation.zh: 將所有變體歸約為 online covering integer LP（CILP），套用 Koufogiannakis–Young 的 greedy Δ-competitive online covering 演算法，在 cache-size constraint 之外加入 rent-evict（與 rent-evict-zap）constraint。關鍵改造：以修改後的速率 γ/λ（γ = kλ）提升 rental 變數 y_{t,s}，使演算法從不需處理 cache-size constraint，在 λ ≥ 1/k² 的區間突破一般化的 Δ 上界。另證明組合定理（RentalCachingMeta）：α-competitive 的 ski-rental 演算法加上 β-competitive 的 caching 演算法可得 (α+β)-competitive 的 rental caching 演算法，核心是把 infinite-cache rental caching 形式化歸約為 ski-rental（每步付 rent λ，對比以 eviction cost「買斷」）。

baselines_compared: Lopez-Ortiz & Salinger rental paging, LRU, FIFO, FWF, Landlord

key_improvements.en: Rental paging (deterministic): 2-competitive when lambda >= 1/k, (1 + 1/(k*lambda))-competitive when 1/k^2 <= lambda < 1/k, k-competitive when lambda < 1/k^2, with lower bounds 2 - lambda and (k + k*lambda)/(1 + k^2*lambda) — tight within constant factors. Randomized: e/(e-1) when lambda >= 1/k; H_k + e/(e-1) in general. Rental caching: k-competitive (CILP) and (k+2) via the meta theorem. Paging/caching with zapping: upper bound min(N, 2k+1) vs lower bound (2Nk + N - (k+1))/(N + 2k), tight within constant factors. Rental paging with zapping: 3 / (1 + 2/(k*lambda)) / (2k+1) across the same lambda regimes.
key_improvements.zh: Rental paging（deterministic）：λ ≥ 1/k 時 2-competitive，1/k² ≤ λ < 1/k 時 (1 + 1/(kλ))-competitive，λ < 1/k² 時 k-competitive，並有下界 2 − λ 與 (k + kλ)/(1 + k²λ)——在常數因子內緊。Randomized：λ ≥ 1/k 時 e/(e−1)，一般情形 H_k + e/(e−1)。Rental caching：CILP 給出 k-competitive，meta 定理給出 (k+2)。Paging/caching with zapping：上界 min(N, 2k+1)，下界 (2Nk + N − (k+1))/(N + 2k)，在常數因子內緊。Rental paging with zapping：於相同 λ 區間分別為 3、(1 + 2/(kλ))、(2k+1)。

reported_accuracy: Not Reported (proves worst-case competitive ratios; deterministic bounds tight within constant factors in most lambda regimes)
validation_workloads: Adversarial request sequences (worst-case analysis)

scope_assumptions.en: Pre-LLM online-algorithms theory (2012): uniform rental cost lambda for all files and uniform zapping cost N (non-uniform costs stated as an open problem); lambda and N are exogenous system parameters, not a pricing interface — no incentives, mechanism design, or provider/user cost split. Worst-case adversarial competitive analysis with no stochastic arrival model; time-slotted with steps allowed to have no requests; file sizes are positive integers. Randomized lower and upper bounds leave a gap when 1/(k^2 H_k) < lambda < 1/k; randomized bounds for caching with zapping and lower bounds for rental caching with zapping left open.
scope_assumptions.zh: 屬 LLM 之前（2012）的 online algorithms 理論：所有檔案共用單一 rental cost λ 與單一 zapping cost N（非均勻成本列為 open problem）；λ 與 N 為外生系統參數而非 pricing 介面——不含 incentive、mechanism design 或 provider／使用者的成本劃分。採 worst-case 對抗式 competitive analysis，無隨機到達模型；時間離散化且允許無請求的 time step；檔案大小為正整數。當 1/(k²H_k) < λ < 1/k 時 randomized 上下界仍有 gap；caching with zapping 的 randomized bound 與 rental caching with zapping 的下界皆為 open。

title: Compute Or Load KV Cache? Why not Both?
authors: Shuowei Jin; Xueshen Liu; Qingzhao Zhang; Z. Morley Mao
research_focus: LLM serving, Long-context / Prefix cache, KV cache offloading, GPU memory tiering

problem_statement.en: Computing KV caches in the prefill stage is a major bottleneck for long-context LLM inference. Prefix caching avoids recomputation by loading stored KV caches, but suffers high latency from the limited I/O bandwidth of storage devices, so neither compute-only nor load-only strategies minimize time-to-first-token.
problem_statement.zh: 長 context LLM 推理中，prefill 階段計算 KV cache 是主要瓶頸。Prefix caching 雖可藉由載入既有 KV cache 避免重算，但受限於儲存裝置的 I/O 頻寬而延遲偏高；因此單純 compute-only 或 load-only 皆無法有效降低 time-to-first-token。

key_innovation.en: Cake, a KV cache loading system that uses compute and I/O resources in parallel via a bidirectional scheduling strategy: the GPU computes KV from the start of the sequence forward while I/O loads stored KV from the end backward, meeting in the middle. An adaptive scheduling mode shares compute with non-prefix-caching requests to sustain throughput under contention.
key_innovation.zh: 提出 Cake：一種同時並行運用 compute 與 I/O 資源的 KV cache 載入系統，採用雙向排程策略——GPU 由序列開頭往後計算 KV，I/O 由序列尾端往前載入已存的 KV，兩者於中間交會。其 adaptive scheduling 模式可與非 prefix-caching 請求共享 compute，於資源競爭下維持吞吐量。

key_improvements.en: Achieves on average a 2.6x reduction in time-to-first-token compared with compute-only and I/O-only methods; the adaptive scheduling mode improves overall throughput by 26%.
key_improvements.zh: 相較 compute-only 與 I/O-only 方法，平均將 time-to-first-token 降低 2.6x；adaptive scheduling 模式使整體吞吐量提升 26%。

ai_task: LLM Serving, AI Inference KV Cache transfer
compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA A100, NVIDIA H100, HBM, NVMe SSD
offload_trigger: Not Specified (restore-side system: assumes prefix KV already resides in lower-tier storage; when-to-offload is out of scope).
prefetch_signal_timing: Bidirectional restore on request arrival: the GPU recomputes KV chunks from the front of the sequence while I/O loads stored chunks from the tail, meeting in the middle; an adaptive mode shares compute with non-prefix-cache requests under contention.
agent_awareness: None: not agent-aware; exploits only the physical concurrency of GPU compute and storage I/O channels during prefix restore.

when_to_offload_rule.en: No when-to-offload rule (out of scope); its restore rule is to always use both channels — recompute prefix KV from the front while loading cached KV from the tail until they meet — bounding restore time by the faster of the compute and I/O rates.
when_to_offload_rule.zh: 無「何時卸載」規則（不在其範疇）；其回填規則為恆同時使用兩個通道——自序列前端重算 prefix KV、同時自尾端載入已儲存的 KV，直至兩端相遇——使回填時間受限於運算與 I/O 中較快者。

title: CALVO: Improve Serving Efficiency for LLM Inferences with Intense Network Demands
authors: Weiye Wang; Chen Chen; Junxue Zhang; Zhusheng Wang; Hui Yuan; Zixuan Guan; Xiaolong Zheng; Qizhen Weng; Yin Chen; Minyi Guo
affiliations: Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Huawei, University of Science and Technology of China, Institute of Artificial Intelligence (TeleAI) China Telecom
research_focus: Long-context / Prefix cache, Agentic / Workflow serving, Multi-tenant scheduling, Continuous batching, KV cache offloading, Performance modeling

problem_statement.en: Distributed KVCache pools enable large-scale prefix caching, but for long-context, short-query workloads the cross-node KVCache loading time can exceed 88% of TTFT, turning LLM inference into a network-intensive workload. Existing engines (vLLM, LMCache) remain compute-centric: they treat KVCache loading as a subordinate phase to GPU execution and ignore loading delay during scheduling, leading to idle resources and suboptimal scheduling order.
problem_statement.zh: 分散式 KVCache pool 雖能支援大規模 prefix caching，但在 long-context、short-query 工作負載下，跨節點 KVCache 載入時間可佔 TTFT 88% 以上，使 LLM 推理轉變為 network-intensive 工作負載。現有引擎 (vLLM, LMCache) 仍為 compute-centric：將 KVCache loading 視為從屬於 GPU 執行的子階段，且 scheduling 時忽略載入延遲，導致資源閒置與排程順序次佳。

key_innovation.en: CALVO treats KVCache loading as a first-class scheduling concern with two mechanisms: (1) decouples L3->L2 loading, L2->L1 loading and GPU computation into independently managed dispatcher-executor pairs with proactive space allocation, enabling pipelined cross-stage overlap; (2) fits a binary linear cost model T_serve = T_load(K_tokens) + T_comp(T_tokens) from offline profiling and feeds it into SJF (for average TTFT) or LSTF (least-slack-time-first, for SLO attainment) scheduling.
key_innovation.zh: CALVO 將 KVCache loading 提升為一等公民的排程考量，包含兩項機制：(1) 將 L3->L2、L2->L1 載入與 GPU 運算解耦為各自獨立管理的 dispatcher-executor 對，搭配主動空間分配，達成跨階段 pipeline 重疊；(2) 透過離線 profiling 擬合 binary linear cost model T_serve = T_load(K_tokens) + T_comp(T_tokens)，並輸入 SJF (最佳化平均 TTFT) 或 LSTF (least-slack-time-first，最佳化 SLO 達成率) 排程。

key_improvements.en: Up to 61.67% higher SLO attainment than the vLLM-LMCache baseline (ICL workload, QPS=1.2). Average TTFT reduced by over 81.3% on ICL at QPS=1.2. LSTF achieves 73% SLO attainment versus EDF's 58% at the same operating point.
key_improvements.zh: 於 ICL 工作負載 (QPS=1.2) 較 vLLM-LMCache baseline 提升最高 61.67% SLO 達成率；同條件下平均 TTFT 降低逾 81.3%。同操作點下 LSTF SLO 達成率為 73%，優於 EDF 的 58%。

compute_memory_hw: 1x 80GB GPU + 128GB CPU DRAM (local), 512GB DRAM (remote pool); GPU model not specified
node_count: 2 nodes (1 GPU node + 1 CPU DRAM pool node)
reported_accuracy: Loading-time vs context-tokens fit is reported as linear (Figure 6); no MAPE/R^2 disclosed.
validation_workloads: LooGLE, ICL (Many-Shot In-Context Learning), Long Code Arena (Code)

scope_assumptions.en: Targets prefill-only optimization; decode-stage performance not addressed. Cost model is per-request linear in context-token count and assumes stable network conditions; request arrival follows Poisson when traces lack timestamps. Built atop vLLM 0.9.1 and LMCache 0.3.1 with Mooncake Store as the L3 backend; cross-node interconnect is 400 Gbps RDMA. Restricts vLLM-LMCache to prefill one request at a time to avoid mis-batching.
scope_assumptions.zh: 聚焦 prefill 階段最佳化，未處理 decode 階段表現。Cost model 為線性對 context-token 數的單請求函數，並假設網路條件穩定；缺乏時間戳的 trace 採 Poisson 過程模擬到達時間。實作以 vLLM 0.9.1 與 LMCache 0.3.1 為底並以 Mooncake Store 作為 L3 後端；跨節點互連為 400 Gbps RDMA。為避免 batching 錯誤，限制 vLLM-LMCache 一次只 prefill 一個請求。

title: Can LLMs Maintain Fundamental Abilities under KV Cache Compression?
authors: Xiang Liu; Zhenheng Tang; Hong Chen; Peijie Dong; Zeyu Li; Xiuze Zhou; Bo Li; Xuming Hu; Xiaowen Chu
research_focus: Long-context / Prefix cache, Reasoning / Test-time scaling, Datacenter networking

problem_statement.en: Existing KV cache compression methods are primarily evaluated on long-context benchmarks, leaving their impact on fundamental LLM capabilities like arithmetic reasoning, world knowledge, and safety under-explored. Furthermore, these methods often fail to preserve semantic coherence in prompts, leading to significant performance degradation in complex reasoning tasks.
problem_statement.zh: 現有 KV cache 壓縮方法主要在長 context 基準上評估，對 LLM 基礎能力（如算術推理、世界知識與安全性）的影響尚未充分探索；此外，這些方法往往無法保留 prompt 的語義一致性，導致複雜推理任務效能大幅下降。

key_innovation.en: ShotKV, a novel compression framework that separates prefill and decoding phases, preserving complete shot examples during prefill to maintain semantic coherence while dynamically compressing tokens during decoding.
key_innovation.zh: ShotKV 是一種新穎的壓縮框架，將 prefill 與 decoding 階段分開處理：在 prefill 期間保留完整的示例（shot examples）以維持語義一致性，同時在 decoding 期間動態壓縮 token。

baselines_compared: StreamingLLM, SnapKV, H2O, PyramidKV, PyramidInfer, ChunkKV

key_improvements.en: 9%-18% performance improvements on long-context generation tasks under aggressive compression ratios; maintains high performance on many-shot arithmetic reasoning where other methods degrade significantly.
key_improvements.zh: 在激進壓縮比下，長 context 生成任務效能提升 9%–18%；在其他方法顯著退化的多示例算術推理任務中仍維持高效能。

ai_task: LLM Serving, Arithmetic Reasoning, World Knowledge, Commonsense Reasoning, Code Generation, Safety, Long-Context Generation
compute_memory_hw: LLaMA-3.1-8B, LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct, Mistral-7B-Instruct, DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B, NVIDIA A40

title: Cache Merging as a Convergent Replicated State for Multi-Agent Latent Reasoning
authors: Carlos Baquero; Luís Brito
affiliations: Universidade do Porto, Politécnico de Viana do Castelo
research_focus: Reasoning / Test-time scaling, Agentic / Workflow serving

problem_statement.en: Parallel multi-agent latent reasoning merges per-agent KV caches by ordered concatenation with RoPE re-encoding. This BagMerge operator is non-commutative and sensitive to an input ordering that cannot be chosen reliably in advance; it also re-concatenates duplicate deliveries, preventing coordinator-free replica convergence.
problem_statement.zh: 平行 multi-agent latent reasoning 以帶有 RoPE re-encoding 的有序串接合併各 agent 的 KV cache。此 BagMerge operator 不具 commutativity，且效能受無法預先可靠選定的輸入順序影響；重複傳遞的 fragment 亦會被再次串接，使 replica 無法在無 coordinator 的情況下收斂。

key_innovation.en: CanonicalMerge deterministically sorts per-agent KV caches by mean K-norm at a middle transformer layer, with full-content hash tie-breaking, before RoPE-aware concatenation, making the rendered cache byte-identical under input permutations. It stores unshifted, content-addressed cache fragments in LatentFragmentSet, a set-union CvRDT that absorbs byte-identical duplicate deliveries and uses CanonicalMerge as its deterministic render.
key_innovation.zh: CanonicalMerge 在 RoPE-aware concatenation 前，依 middle transformer layer 的 mean K-norm 對各 agent KV cache 進行確定性排序，並以 full-content hash 處理 tie，使 rendered cache 在任意輸入排列下均保持 byte-identical。其以 LatentFragmentSet 保存未移位且 content-addressed 的 cache fragment；此 set-union CvRDT 可吸收 byte-identical 的重複傳遞，並以 CanonicalMerge 作為 deterministic render。

baselines_compared: BagMerge default, BagMerge swap, PackLLM, C0 full-context

key_improvements.en: Across the four N = 2 regime/budget conditions, CanonicalMerge stays within 4 percentage points of the best BagMerge ordering and is statistically indistinguishable from it in the three-draw paired analysis. At a matched 2,048-token budget it scores 0.947 versus PackLLM's 0.50 (+45 percentage points); with fourfold duplicate delivery, it retains 0.93 accuracy and a 308-token cache while naive re-concatenation falls to 0.45 and grows to 1,232 tokens.
key_improvements.zh: 在四個 N = 2 regime/budget 條件中，CanonicalMerge 與最佳 BagMerge 順序的差距不超過 4 percentage points，且三次抽樣的 paired analysis 顯示差異不具統計顯著性。在相同 2,048-token budget 下，其 accuracy 為 0.947，PackLLM 為 0.50 (+45 percentage points)；當每個 fragment 重複傳遞四次時，仍維持 0.93 accuracy 與 308-token cache，而 naive re-concatenation 降至 0.45 並增至 1,232 tokens。

reuse_metric.en: No conventional reuse-rate percentage is reported. Across four N = 2 regime/budget conditions, CanonicalMerge stays within 4 percentage points of the best BagMerge ordering; under R = 1–4 duplicate delivery, LatentFragmentSet keeps accuracy at 0.93 and the rendered cache at 308 tokens.
reuse_metric.zh: 論文未報告傳統 reuse-rate 百分比。在四個 N = 2 regime/budget 條件中，CanonicalMerge 與最佳 BagMerge 順序的差距不超過 4 percentage points；在 R = 1–4 的重複傳遞下，LatentFragmentSet 將 accuracy 維持於 0.93，rendered cache 亦固定為 308 tokens。

title: Checkmate: Breaking the Memory Wall with Optimal Tensor Rematerialization
authors: Paras Jain; Ajay Jain; Aniruddha Nrusimha; Amir Gholami; Pieter Abbeel; Kurt Keutzer; Ion Stoica; Joseph E. Gonzalez
venue_full: Proceedings of Machine Learning and Systems (MLSys) 2020
research_focus: Performance modeling, GPU memory tiering

problem_statement.en: DNN training is memory-bound: every activation tensor produced in the forward pass must be cached for the backward pass, so large models and high-resolution inputs hit a 'memory wall' on accelerator HBM. Rematerialization (checkpointing) trades memory for recomputation, but prior heuristics assume linear/path computation graphs with uniform per-layer cost, which breaks on modern non-linear architectures (residual connections, U-Net) and leaves the keep-vs-recompute schedule sub-optimal.
problem_statement.zh: DNN 訓練受記憶體限制：forward pass 產生的每個 activation tensor 都必須快取供 backward pass 使用，因此大型模型與高解析度輸入會在加速器 HBM 上撞上「memory wall」。Rematerialization（checkpointing）以重算換取記憶體，然而既有 heuristic 假設 computation graph 為線性／path 結構且各層成本均勻，在現代非線性架構（residual connection、U-Net）上並不成立，導致 keep-vs-recompute 排程並非最佳。

key_innovation.en: Formalizes tensor rematerialization as a mixed integer linear program (MILP) that computes the cost-optimal keep-vs-recompute schedule over an arbitrary dataflow DAG under a hard device-memory budget, driven by accelerator-specific profile-based cost models (hardware-aware and memory-aware). A two-phase LP-rounding approximation yields near-optimal schedules in polynomial time when the exact MILP is too large.
key_innovation.zh: 將 tensor rematerialization 形式化為 mixed integer linear program（MILP），在硬性的裝置記憶體預算下，對任意 dataflow DAG 計算成本最佳的 keep-vs-recompute 排程，並以加速器專屬的 profile-based cost model 驅動（hardware-aware 且 memory-aware）。當精確 MILP 規模過大時，另提出 two-phase LP-rounding 近似演算法，於多項式時間內求得近最佳排程。

baselines_compared: Checkpoint-all (ideal), Griewank & Walther (log n / REVOLVE), Chen et al. 2016 (sqrt(n) checkpointing), Chen et al. 2016 greedy

key_improvements.en: Trains real networks with up to 5.1x larger input/batch sizes at minimal (<1%) runtime overhead on linear graphs; on U-Net at the V100 memory budget it runs 1.2x faster than the best baseline and 1.38x faster than linearized sqrt(n); and enables U-Net at batch size 32/GPU with <10% overhead where prior methods require far more memory.
key_improvements.zh: 在線性 graph 上以極低（<1%）的執行時間開銷，訓練輸入／batch size 最高放大 5.1x 的網路；於 V100 記憶體預算下的 U-Net，較最佳 baseline 快 1.2x、較 linearized sqrt(n) 快 1.38x；並可在 <10% 開銷下以 batch size 32/GPU 訓練 U-Net，而既有方法需要更多記憶體。

reported_accuracy: Not Reported (MILP solved to optimality within a 1-hour limit for most instances; yields a provably cost-optimal rematerialization schedule under the profiled cost model)
models_validated: VGG16, VGG19, ResNet50, MobileNet, U-Net, FCN, SegNet
validation_workloads: Image classification & semantic segmentation training (VGG, ResNet, MobileNet, U-Net, FCN, SegNet on NVIDIA V100)

scope_assumptions.en: Assumes a static computation DAG known ahead of time with per-operator memory sizes and compute costs obtained by profiling on the target accelerator; targets single-device training memory (a single NVIDIA V100 memory budget), not inference or multi-device parallelism; gradients are not rematerialized (constant space reserved) and activations are sized at 4-byte FP32; the exact MILP is NP-hard and solved under a 1-hour time limit, so very large batch or heavily-constrained instances may not reach proven optimality (a two-phase LP-rounding approximation is used instead).
scope_assumptions.zh: 假設 computation DAG 為靜態且事先已知，各 operator 的記憶體大小與運算成本透過在目標加速器上 profiling 取得；針對單一裝置的訓練記憶體（單顆 NVIDIA V100 的記憶體預算），不涵蓋 inference 或多裝置 parallelism；gradient 不進行 rematerialization（保留固定空間），activation 以 4-byte FP32 計算大小；精確 MILP 為 NP-hard 且在 1 小時時限內求解，因此在極大 batch 或記憶體極度受限的情況下可能無法達到可證明的最佳解（改用 two-phase LP-rounding 近似）。

title: Chimera: Latency- and Performance-Aware Multi-agent Serving for Heterogeneous LLMs
authors: Kangqi Ni; Wenyue Hua; Xiaoxiang Shi; Jiang Guo; Shiyu Chang; Tianlong Chen
affiliations: University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill, Microsoft, Carnegie Mellon University, Amazon, University of California Santa Barbara
research_focus: Agentic / Workflow serving, Multi-tenant scheduling, Length prediction, Routing / Load balancing, Performance modeling

problem_statement.en: Multi-agent workflows execute as multi-stage chains of LLM calls and are typically served on homogeneous clusters with identical model replicas. This ignores heterogeneous deployments where different model sizes enable finer latency-performance trade-offs, and existing routers treat latency as a fixed model attribute rather than an emergent outcome of queueing and contention under bursty traffic.
problem_statement.zh: 多 agent workflow 由多階段 LLM 呼叫串接而成，現有 serving 系統多在同質叢集中以相同模型副本服務，忽略了異質部署下不同模型尺寸所帶來的延遲與效能權衡空間；既有 router 也常將延遲視為模型固定屬性，未考慮 bursty traffic 下 queueing 與資源競爭所造成的動態延遲。

key_innovation.en: Chimera, a predictive scheduling middleware atop vLLM that couples three lightweight components: a ModernBERT-based semantic router giving per-model confidence scores, a Quantile Regression Forest (QRF) workflow-level total output length predictor for Shortest Total Job First (STJF) scheduling, and an activity monitor that estimates per-engine service-time load from in-flight predicted token volume, jointly informing model selection and queue admission.
key_innovation.zh: Chimera 是建構於 vLLM 之上的 predictive scheduling middleware，整合三個輕量化模組：以 ModernBERT 為基礎的 semantic router 輸出每個模型的 confidence 分數、以 Quantile Regression Forest（QRF）預估 workflow 層級的剩餘 output token 總量以驅動 STJF 排程，以及以 in-flight predicted token volume 估計每個 engine 服務時間負載的 activity monitor，三者共同決定模型選擇與佇列調度。

key_improvements.en: 1.2x-2.4x reduction in end-to-end latency and 8.0-9.5 percentage-point improvement in task performance score on average across APPS code generation and MATH reasoning workflows; scheduling overhead under 2.2% of E2E latency.
key_improvements.zh: 在 APPS 程式生成與 MATH 推理 workflow 上，端到端延遲降低 1.2x-2.4x，task performance score 平均提升 8.0-9.5 個百分點；scheduler 額外開銷低於 E2E 延遲的 2.2%。

ai_task: LLM Serving, Multi-agent Systems
reported_accuracy: Not Reported (QRF predicts median; paper reports downstream latency/performance Pareto rather than length MAPE)
validation_workloads: APPS (code generation), MATH (math reasoning)

scope_assumptions.en: Length prediction targets the conditional median of total workflow output length, trading absolute accuracy for robustness to long tails; scheduling overhead validated only up to RPS=16; semantic router and length predictor run as separate async services on CPU and are profiled per-(workflow, agent_stage); evaluation restricted to single-replica per-model deployments on RTX A6000 (49 GB VRAM); KV cache treatment inherits vLLM's PagedAttention defaults.
scope_assumptions.zh: Length predictor 預測 workflow 總輸出長度的條件中位數，犧牲絕對精度換取對長尾的穩健性；scheduler 開銷僅驗證至 RPS=16；semantic router 與 length predictor 以獨立 async CPU 服務執行並逐 (workflow, agent_stage) 進行 profile；實驗限制於每個模型單副本的 RTX A6000（49 GB VRAM）部署；KV cache 處理沿用 vLLM PagedAttention 預設行為。

title: The Clock Is Not a Constant: Measuring the Token-Count-Dependent SM Frequency Droop in Sustained Tensor-Core GEMM, and Reconstructing Throughput from the Measured Clock on Hopper
research_focus: GPU DVFS, Power-cap clock droop, Roofline efficiency decomposition, LLM GEMM throughput modeling

problem_statement.en: Roofline and ML latency predictors for LLM inference assume the GPU runs at its datasheet boost TFLOP/s, folding any shortfall into a single fitted per-GPU efficiency ceiling. But the SM clock is not a constant: under sustained compute it is an involuntary, power-cap-gated step function of the token count M, so peak boost is never reached and a fixed ceiling silently absorbs an M-dependent clock.
problem_statement.zh: LLM 推理的 roofline 與 ML 延遲預測器假設 GPU 跑在 datasheet boost TFLOP/s，並把任何不足都塞進單一擬合的 per-GPU 效率天花板。但 SM 時脈並非常數：在持續運算下，它是受功耗上限閘控、隨 token 數 M 變化的非自願階梯函數，因此達不到 peak boost，而固定天花板會默默吸收一個隨 M 變化的時脈。

key_innovation.en: Decomposes achieved efficiency as eta_c = f_clk * eta_noclk, pulling the SM clock out as an explicit, transferable factor instead of burying it in a fitted ceiling. Measures (real-DVFS clock telemetry, n=5 randomized order with 95% CIs across H100/H200/A100-80/L40S/Blackwell) that the clock holds near boost while board power is under cap, drops once at the memory->compute crossover, then holds (datacenter) or keeps drooping (tight-cap L40S/Max-Q Blackwell). Establishes the cap->clock->throughput CAUSAL chain on a controllable RTX 5090: cap->clock Pearson r=0.97-0.99 (1.4-1.8 MHz/W), clock->throughput r~1.00, and a clock-lock control (390->15 MHz spread) confirms causation.
key_innovation.zh: 將達成效率分解為 eta_c = f_clk * eta_noclk，把 SM 時脈抽出為明確、可轉移的因子，而非埋進擬合天花板。以真實 DVFS 時脈遙測（n=5 隨機順序、95% CI，涵蓋 H100/H200/A100-80/L40S/Blackwell）量測到：當板級功耗低於上限時時脈維持接近 boost，在 memory->compute 交越點一次性下降，之後維持（資料中心卡）或持續下垂（吃緊上限的 L40S/Max-Q Blackwell）。並在可控的 RTX 5090 上建立 cap->clock->throughput 因果鏈：cap->clock Pearson r=0.97-0.99（1.4-1.8 MHz/W）、clock->throughput r~1.00，且鎖頻控制（390->15 MHz spread）證實因果。

baselines_compared: Not a head-to-head; positions against POLCA, Maliakel et al. (DVFS), Ma et al. (Illusion of Power Capping, decode-only), Ujeniya et al. (DGEMM power-cap), Jia et al. 2019

key_improvements.en: Per-SKU boost->sustained clock droop 19-44% on qkv (A100-80 ~20%, H100 ~30%, H200 ~27%, L40S ~44%); Max-Q Blackwell n=5 ~38% droop (vs rated boost) with CI-significant large-M throughput DECLINE on 3 of 4 projections (o -4.0%, gate_up -3.5%, down -2.2%; qkv ~0%). A datasheet-boost roofline over-predicts compute-bound throughput by 1/f_clk (up to 2.18x on L40S). The throughput decline is card-dependent: tight-cap parts decline (L40S -15%), datacenter parts plateau. Causal chain confirmed by a 5090 cap-dose sweep + clock-lock control.
key_improvements.zh: 各 SKU 的 boost->sustained 時脈下垂在 qkv 上為 19-44%（A100-80 約 20%、H100 約 30%、H200 約 27%、L40S 約 44%）；Max-Q Blackwell n=5 約 38% 下垂（相對額定 boost），且在 4 個投影中有 3 個出現 CI 顯著的大-M throughput 下降（o -4.0%、gate_up -3.5%、down -2.2%；qkv 約 0%）。datasheet-boost roofline 會把 compute-bound throughput 高估 1/f_clk（L40S 最高 2.18x）。throughput 下降具卡片相依性：吃緊上限的卡會下降（L40S -15%），資料中心卡則持平。因果鏈由 5090 cap 劑量掃描 + 鎖頻控制證實。

ai_task: LLM Inference (GEMM throughput characterization)
compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA H100, H200, A100-80GB, L40S, RTX PRO 6000 (Blackwell, Max-Q), RTX 5090
reported_accuracy: Reconstruction (not a prediction MAPE): eta_c = f_clk * eta_noclk closes per cell (pinned-chain residual ~1e-4); measured per-SKU droop 19-44%, n=5 with 95% CIs
workload_family: Synthetic GEMM (Llama-3.1-8B projection shapes: qkv, o, gate_up, down)
validation_workloads: 5-SKU sustained-GEMM clock-telemetry sweep over token counts M=1..32768, n=5 randomized order with 95% CIs (H100/H200/A100-80/L40S/Blackwell); RTX 5090 cross-cap causal sweep 400-575W + clock-lock control

scope_assumptions.en: Workshop measurement-and-modeling note, not a full systems paper. Isolated single-GPU GEMM at Llama projection shapes (not end-to-end serving). The compute-bound throughput decline is card-dependent (tight-cap L40S/Blackwell decline; datacenter cards plateau) and must not be over-claimed as universal. The clock-lock causal control is RTX-5090-only because PACE denies per-process clock-lock on datacenter cards; the datacenter clock-lock control is deferred to permit-clocking hardware.
scope_assumptions.zh: workshop 量測與建模 note，非完整系統論文。隔離的單-GPU GEMM、採 Llama 投影形狀（非端到端 serving）。compute-bound throughput 下降具卡片相依性（吃緊上限的 L40S/Blackwell 下降；資料中心卡持平），不可過度宣稱為普適。鎖頻因果控制僅在 RTX 5090 進行，因 PACE 不允許在資料中心卡上做 per-process 鎖頻；資料中心的鎖頻控制留待可鎖頻硬體。

title: Collective Communication for 100k+ GPUs
authors: Min Si; Pavan Balaji; Yongzhou Chen; Ching-Hsiang Chu; Adi Gangidi; Saif Hasan; Subodh Iyengar; Dan Johnson; Bingzhe Liu; Regina Ren; Deep Shah; Ashmitha Jeevaraj Shetty; Greg Steinbrecher; Yulun Wang; Bruce Wu; Xinfeng Xie; Jingyi Yang; Mingran Yang; Kenny Yu; Minlan Yu; Cen Zhao; Wes Bland; Denis Boyda; Suman Gumudavelli; Prashanth Kannan; Cristian Lumezanu; Rui Miao; Zhe Qu; Venkat Ramesh; Maxim Samoylov; Jan Seidel; Srikanth Sundaresan; Feng Tian; Qiye Tan; Shuqiang Zhang; Yimeng Zhao; Shengbao Zheng; Art Zhu; Hongyi Zeng
research_focus: Datacenter networking, Routing / Load balancing, Collective communication

problem_statement.en: Traditional collective communication libraries like NCCL face throughput and latency bottlenecks at the scale of 100k+ GPUs due to kernel-driven designs and copy-based data transfers. These limitations hinder efficient large-scale LLM training and low-latency inference.
problem_statement.zh: 傳統集合通訊庫（如 NCCL）在 100k+ GPU 規模下，因 kernel 驅動設計與基於拷貝的資料傳輸而面臨吞吐量與延遲瓶頸，進而阻礙大規模 LLM 訓練與低延遲 inference 的效率。

key_innovation.en: NCCLX, a host-driven collective communication framework featuring CTran, which implements zero-copy, SM-free data transfers, and Dynamic Queue Pair Load Balancing (DQPLB) to optimize communication across hierarchical network topologies.
key_innovation.zh: NCCLX 是以 host 驅動的集合通訊框架，搭載 CTran 實現零拷貝、無 SM 的資料傳輸，並透過 Dynamic Queue Pair Load Balancing（DQPLB）優化跨層次網路拓撲的通訊。

key_improvements.en: Up to 12% latency reduction per training step for Llama4, 11x faster training startup at 96k scale, and 15% to 80% end-to-end decoding latency improvement for inference.
key_improvements.zh: Llama4 每訓練步驟延遲最高降低 12%；在 96k GPU 規模下訓練啟動速度提升 11x；inference 端到端 decoding 延遲改善 15%–80%。

ai_task: LLM Serving, AI Model Training, MoE Serving/Decode, Pipeline Parallelism, Tensor Parallelism, Hybrid Sharding Data Parallel
traffic_pattern: AllReduce, AllGather, ReduceScatter, AllToAll, AllToAllv, Point-to-point, RMA

title: Competitive Caching with Machine Learned Advice
authors: Thodoris Lykouris; Sergei Vassilvitskii
venue_full: International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML) 2018; journal version in Journal of the ACM (JACM) 68(4), 2021
research_focus: Long-context / Prefix cache, Performance modeling

problem_statement.en: Online caching (paging) admits no worst-case guarantee that matches practice: any deterministic algorithm is Omega(k)-competitive and the best randomized algorithm is Theta(log k)-competitive, far worse than what simple policies like LRU achieve on real inputs. The question is how to exploit a machine-learned predictor of each element's next request time to beat these worst-case lower bounds when the predictor is accurate, without losing the classical robustness guarantee when it is wrong.
problem_statement.zh: Online caching（paging）缺乏與實務相符的 worst-case 保證：任何 deterministic 演算法皆為 Omega(k)-competitive，最佳 randomized 演算法為 Theta(log k)-competitive，遠差於 LRU 等簡單策略在真實輸入上的表現。核心問題是：如何在 predictor 準確時，利用預測各元素「下次請求時間」的 machine-learned predictor 突破這些 worst-case 下界，同時在 predictor 出錯時仍保有經典的 robustness 保證。

key_innovation.en: Introduces the Online with Machine Learned Advice (OMLA) framework and the Predictive Marker algorithm, which augments the classical Marker algorithm with a black-box next-arrival-time predictor. It achieves competitive ratio 2 + O(min(sqrt(eta/OPT), log k)), where eta is the predictor's total L1 error: the ratio approaches 2 as the predictor improves (consistency) and degrades gracefully to O(log k), matching the best randomized online algorithm, as the predictor worsens (robustness). The analysis treats the predictor as a complete black box, independent of its internals or error distribution.
key_innovation.zh: 提出 Online with Machine Learned Advice（OMLA）框架與 Predictive Marker 演算法，將經典 Marker 演算法以黑箱式的「下次到達時間」predictor 增強。其達到 competitive ratio 2 + O(min(sqrt(eta/OPT), log k))，其中 eta 為 predictor 的 L1 總誤差：當 predictor 越準確，ratio 趨近 2（consistency）；當 predictor 越差，則平滑退化至 O(log k)，與最佳 randomized online 演算法相當（robustness）。分析將 predictor 視為完整黑箱，與其內部機制及誤差分布無關。

baselines_compared: LRU, Marker algorithm, Predictor-only (blindly following the ML oracle)

key_improvements.en: Proves competitive ratio 2 + O(min(sqrt(eta/OPT), log k)) — circumventing the Omega(log k) worst-case lower bound when predictions are accurate while capping the loss at O(log k) when they are not. Empirically, Predictive Marker outperforms LRU (the practical gold standard), the original Marker algorithm, and directly following the predictor, using simple off-the-shelf predictions on real-world datasets.
key_improvements.zh: 證明 competitive ratio 為 2 + O(min(sqrt(eta/OPT), log k))——在預測準確時繞過 Omega(log k) 的 worst-case 下界，在預測不準時亦將損失上限維持於 O(log k)。實驗上，Predictive Marker 於真實資料集使用簡單的現成 predictor，即優於 LRU（實務黃金標準）、原始 Marker 演算法，以及直接依循 predictor 的作法。

reported_accuracy: Not Reported (proves worst-case competitive ratio 2 + O(min(sqrt(eta/OPT), log k)) parametric in predictor error eta)
validation_workloads: Real-world public request traces (empirical) + adversarial request sequences (worst-case analysis)

scope_assumptions.en: Classical unweighted caching (uniform page cost and uniform size, cache of size k) — weighted / size-aware caching (GreedyDual / Landlord) is out of scope; the oracle predicts the next request time of each requested element and is treated as a black box, with all guarantees stated parametrically in the total L1 prediction error eta (agnostic to the error distribution and the predictor's internals); worst-case competitive analysis with no stochastic arrival model; results extend to absolute and squared loss. Subsequent work (Rohatgi 2020; Wei 2020) tightened the bounds under the same prediction model.
scope_assumptions.zh: 屬經典 unweighted caching（page cost 與 size 均勻，cache 大小為 k）——weighted／size-aware caching（GreedyDual／Landlord）不在範圍內；oracle 預測各請求元素的「下次請求時間」並被視為黑箱，所有保證均以 L1 總預測誤差 eta 參數化表述（與誤差分布及 predictor 內部機制無關）；採 worst-case competitive analysis，無隨機到達模型；結果可延伸至 absolute 與 squared loss。後續工作（Rohatgi 2020；Wei 2020）在相同預測模型下收緊了界限。

title: Continuum: Efficient and Robust Multi-Turn LLM Agent Scheduling with KV Cache Time-to-Live
authors: Hanchen Li; Qiuyang Mang; Runyuan He; Qizheng Zhang; Huanzhi Mao; Xiaokun Chen; Hangrui Zhou; Alvin Cheung; Joseph Gonzalez; Ion Stoica
research_focus: Agentic / Workflow serving, Multi-tenant scheduling, Queueing theory, Datacenter networking

problem_statement.en: Existing LLM inference engines use end-of-turn KV cache eviction, which causes significant recomputation or reloading overhead and per-turn queueing delays for multi-turn agentic workloads that interleave inference with variable-duration tool calls.
problem_statement.zh: 現有 LLM inference 引擎在每輪結束後驅逐 KV cache，導致多輪 agentic 工作負載（inference 與不定時長的 tool call 交錯執行）面臨大量重計算或重載開銷，以及每輪的佇列等待延遲。

key_innovation.en: Continuum, a serving system that introduces a KV cache Time-to-Live (TTL) mechanism to selectively pin KV cache in GPU memory based on a cost-benefit model, combined with program-level first-come-first-serve scheduling.
key_innovation.zh: Continuum 是一套 serving 系統，引入 KV cache Time-to-Live（TTL）機制，依據成本收益模型選擇性地將 KV cache 保留在 GPU 記憶體中，並結合程式層級的先到先服務 scheduling。

baselines_compared: vLLM, LMCache, Autellix, InferCept, SGLang, Dynamo

key_improvements.en: Reduces delay by 1.12x to 3.66x and improves throughput by 1.10x to 3.22x on multi-turn agentic workloads; reduces delay for real SWE-agent workloads by up to 8.18x.
key_improvements.zh: 在多輪 agentic 工作負載上，延遲降低 1.12x–3.66x，吞吐量提升 1.10x–3.22x；真實 SWE-agent 工作負載的延遲最高降低 8.18x。

ai_task: LLM Serving, Multi-turn Agentic Workloads, Function Calling, Coding Agents
traffic_pattern: Pipeline Parallelism, Tensor Parallelism, Concurrent flows
offload_trigger: Anti-offload TTL: when an agent emits a tool call, the program's KV is pinned in GPU memory with a cost-benefit TTL; only on TTL expiry is the KV exposed to the underlying eviction/offload policy, and session end releases the final turn.
prefetch_signal_timing: No proactive restore: KV either remains pinned in GPU memory until the tool returns, or after TTL expiry is surrendered to the underlying policy and reloaded/recomputed reactively.
agent_awareness: Agent tool-call gaps with per-tool-function empirical duration distributions; multi-turn agent programs scheduled at program granularity (program-level FCFS).

when_to_offload_rule.en: On each tool call, pin the program's KV in GPU memory for a TTL chosen to maximize the probability the tool returns within TTL (from the per-tool duration distribution) times the benefit (reload cost avoided plus queueing benefit) minus the pinning cost; after expiry the KV falls to the underlying eviction policy.
when_to_offload_rule.zh: 於每次 tool call 時，將 program 的 KV 以 TTL pin 於 GPU 記憶體；TTL 之選擇最大化（依 per-tool 時長分布，tool 於 TTL 內返回之機率）×（可避免的 reload 成本 + 排隊效益）減去 pin 成本；TTL 到期後 KV 交由底層逐出策略處理。

title: Cornfigurator: Automated Planning for Any-to-Any Multimodal Model Serving
authors: Jeff J. Ma; Jae-Won Chung; Jisang Ahn; Yizhuo Liang; Runyu Lu; Akshay Jajoo; Myungjin Lee; Mosharaf Chowdhury
affiliations: University of Michigan, University of Southern California, Cisco Research
research_focus: Multimodal serving, PD disaggregation, Continuous batching, Capacity planning, Performance modeling, Routing / Load balancing

problem_statement.en: Any-to-Any (A2A) multimodal models accept arbitrary combinations of text, image, video, and audio as input/output, forming graphs of heterogeneous components where different request types invoke different component subgraphs and component throughputs differ by up to 200x. Existing serving systems either prescribe fixed strategies tied to special-case architectures (MLLM-only, DiT-only) or require manual expert tuning, leaving no automated planner that finds good colocation/disaggregation plans for generic A2A models.
problem_statement.zh: Any-to-Any（A2A）multimodal 模型可任意組合 text、image、video、audio 作為輸入或輸出，形成由 heterogeneous components 構成的計算圖；不同 request type 走訪不同子圖，且 component 間吞吐量差距可達 200x。既有服務系統要麼將部署策略硬綁定到特殊架構（MLLM-only、DiT-only），要麼需要專家人工調校，缺乏可為通用 A2A 模型自動產生 colocation/disaggregation 計畫的 planner。

key_innovation.en: An automated deployment planner that reasons per-request-type rather than aggregating all requests. The planner enumerates logical subplans (graph topologies via KEEP/MERGE on colocatable edges), merges shared-node subplans into compound subplans, and composes them into logical plans annotated with executor configurations and per-type routing probabilities. A three-phase coarse-to-fine evaluator (network-flow throughput estimate -> Monte Carlo latency CDF -> request-level simulator) prunes Pareto-dominated plans, with goodput defined as throughput of requests meeting per-type latency targets.
key_innovation.zh: 提出針對 A2A 部署的自動 planner：以 per-request-type 而非整體請求進行推理。Planner 列舉 logical subplans（在可 colocate 的 edge 上以 KEEP/MERGE 二元決策枚舉圖拓樸），將共用節點的 subplan 合併為 compound subplan，再組合成 logical plans，並標註 executor 設定與 per-type routing probability。三階段由粗至細的評估器（network-flow 吞吐量估計 -> Monte Carlo 延遲 CDF -> request-level simulator）逐步刪去 Pareto-dominated 計畫；目標為 goodput，即滿足 per-type latency target 的請求吞吐量。

baselines_compared: vLLM, vLLM-Omni, ModServe, EPD, Full Disaggregation

key_improvements.en: 1.24x-2.73x higher goodput than baselines on generic A2A models (Qwen 3 Omni); 1.12x-6.32x higher goodput on special-case MLLMs (InternVL 3 38B, Qwen 3 VL 32B). Cornfigurator either matches or outperforms expert-tuned plans from vLLM-Omni, ModServe, EPD across 8 and 16 GPU budgets.
key_improvements.zh: 在通用 A2A 模型（Qwen 3 Omni）上相較 baseline 達 1.24x-2.73x 較高 goodput；在特殊 MLLM（InternVL 3 38B、Qwen 3 VL 32B）上達 1.12x-6.32x。Cornfigurator 在 8 GPU 與 16 GPU 預算下，皆可匹配或超越 vLLM-Omni、ModServe、EPD 等專家手動調校的部署計畫。

reported_accuracy: Not Reported (qualitative: pipeline retains true optimum after Monte Carlo + simulator pruning per Fig. 7)
validation_workloads: ServeGen workload (with request timestamps)

scope_assumptions.en: Profiler measures throughput/latency at steady-state and subtracts queuing delay via runtime traces; Monte Carlo assumes queuing delay is bounded for well-balanced plans and latency dominated by processing time. Communication overhead between disaggregated executors modeled as a fixed median delay (~10 ms) at each disaggregated edge. Enumeration bounded by subplan merge limit k_c (default 2) and composition limit k_s (default 2). Targets generic A2A serving on a single runtime (Cornserve); single GPU type per cluster in evaluation.
scope_assumptions.zh: Profiler 在 steady-state 量測吞吐量與延遲，並透過 runtime traces 扣除 queuing delay；Monte Carlo 假設 queuing delay 在 balanced plan 下有界、延遲主導項為處理時間。Disaggregated executor 間的通訊額外負擔以固定中位延遲（約 10 ms）建模。Enumeration 受 subplan 合併上限 k_c（預設 2）與組合上限 k_s（預設 2）限制。針對通用 A2A 服務於單一 runtime（Cornserve）；評估中叢集採單一 GPU 型號。

title: Characterizing and Optimizing LLM Inference Workloads on CPU-GPU Coupled Architectures
authors: Prabhu Vellaisamy; Thomas Labonte; Sourav Chakraborty; Matt Turner; Samantika Sury; John Paul Shen
affiliations: Carnegie Mellon University, Samsung Semiconductor Inc., Hewlett Packard Enterprise
research_focus: LLM serving, Performance modeling, Hardware co-design

problem_statement.en: Latency-sensitive LLM inference workloads run on heterogeneous CPU-GPU systems that span loosely-coupled (PCIe-connected) and closely-coupled (NVLink-C2C, unified-memory) architectures, but it is unclear whether tighter coupling is universally better and which fine-grained operator-kernel dynamics determine when a workload becomes CPU-bound versus GPU-bound. Prior framework-tax or aggregate-residual classifications cannot directly attribute inefficiency to launch versus queuing behavior.
problem_statement.zh: 延遲敏感的 LLM inference workload 部署在從 loosely-coupled（PCIe）到 closely-coupled（NVLink-C2C、unified memory）的異質 CPU-GPU 系統上，但更緊耦合是否一定更佳，以及哪些細粒度 operator-kernel 動態決定 workload 何時 CPU-bound 或 GPU-bound 仍不明朗。既有的 framework tax 或聚合殘差分類無法直接歸因到 launch overhead 與 queuing 行為。

key_innovation.en: SKIP, a PyTorch-based system-aware kernel inference profiler that constructs operator-kernel dependency graphs from PyTorch Profiler/CUPTI traces, together with the Total Kernel Launch and Queuing Time (TKLQT) metric that attributes CPU-bound versus GPU-bound regions and identifies the launch-to-queue inflection point. The framework also introduces a proximity-score (PS = f(C)/f(k_i)) based kernel fusion recommendation that automatically detects deterministic kernel chains from traces.
key_innovation.zh: SKIP 是基於 PyTorch 的 system-aware kernel inference profiler，從 PyTorch Profiler/CUPTI trace 建構 operator-kernel dependency graph，並提出 Total Kernel Launch and Queuing Time (TKLQT) 指標，將 workload 歸類為 CPU-bound 或 GPU-bound 並辨識 launch 與 queue 的轉折點。框架另提出 proximity-score (PS = f(C)/f(k_i)) 的 kernel fusion 推薦方法，自動從 trace 偵測 deterministic kernel chain。

baselines_compared: Eager mode, FlashAttention-2, torch.compile, Framework tax

key_improvements.en: GH200 achieves 1.9x-2.7x faster prefill latency for Llama-3.2-1B at large batch sizes (BS=16) versus LC systems, and 1.6x-2.4x faster for Bert-Base-Uncased at BS=64. GH200 stays CPU-bound up to 4x larger batch sizes than LC systems (encoder transition at BS=32 vs. BS=8), and encoder-only models are 4x more CPU-bound on GH200 versus LC. Proximity-score kernel fusion yields idealized prefill speedups of up to 2.7x for GPT2 and up to 6.8x for XLM-Roberta-Base on Intel+H100.
key_improvements.zh: GH200 在 Llama-3.2-1B、大 batch（BS=16）下達成 1.9x-2.7x 較 LC 系統更快的 prefill latency；Bert-Base-Uncased、BS=64 則為 1.6x-2.4x。GH200 維持 CPU-bound 的 batch size 達 LC 系統的 4 倍（encoder 從 BS=8 延後到 BS=32），且 encoder-only 模型在 GH200 上比 LC 系統多 4 倍 CPU-bound。Proximity-score kernel fusion 在 Intel+H100 上為 GPT2 帶來理想 prefill speedup 最高 2.7x、XLM-Roberta-Base 最高 6.8x。

compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA A100 SXM4, NVIDIA H100 PCIe, NVIDIA GH200 Grace Hopper Superchip, AMD EPYC 7313, Intel Xeon Platinum 8468V, HBM3, LPDDR5X
reported_accuracy: Not Reported
validation_workloads: Synthetic (controlled BS sweep at SL=512 / SL=1024, MLPerf Inference SingleStream-style)

scope_assumptions.en: Single-GPU evaluation only; focuses on prefill TTFT (decode phase and full generation not characterized); benchmarks four small LLMs (110M-1.24B) and does not validate on 7B+ or MoE workloads; relies on PyTorch eager mode plus FlashAttention-2 and torch.compile, not vLLM/SGLang serving stacks; consistent input sequence length of 512 tokens unless otherwise noted; methodology depends on CUPTI/PyTorch Profiler tracing on NVIDIA GPUs; AMD MI300A and NVIDIA GB200 are explicitly deferred to future work; kernel fusion speedups are idealized assuming constant per-kernel launch overhead and no positive or negative side effects.
scope_assumptions.zh: 僅評估單 GPU；聚焦 prefill TTFT，未涵蓋 decode phase 與完整 generation；benchmark 限於四個小型 LLM（110M-1.24B），未驗證 7B 以上或 MoE workload；使用 PyTorch eager 加 FlashAttention-2 與 torch.compile，未涵蓋 vLLM/SGLang 等 serving stack；除非特別說明，輸入序列長度固定為 512 tokens；方法依賴 NVIDIA GPU 上的 CUPTI/PyTorch Profiler trace；AMD MI300A 與 NVIDIA GB200 明確列為 future work；kernel fusion speedup 為理想值，假設每個 kernel launch overhead 固定且無其他正負面影響。

title: Custom Keep-Alive Cache Policies
authors: Sushirdeep Narayana; Ian A. Kash
venue_full: arXiv preprint (cs.GT); accepted as conference paper at EAI GameNets 2026
affiliations: Wesleyan University, University of Illinois at Chicago
research_focus: Multi-tenant scheduling, Performance modeling

problem_statement.en: Keep-alive caching in serverless (FaaS) platforms decides how long to keep a function's resources provisioned after an invocation, trading idle (wasted) memory cost against cold-start latency. Prior keep-alive policies assume the cost of a cache miss (cold start) is uniform across all customer applications, but the true cost is application-dependent and private to the customer; current market designs (e.g. AWS Lambda's pay-for-permanent-caching option) offer only coarse customization and force customers to reason about their own arrival process.
problem_statement.zh: serverless（FaaS）平台的 keep-alive caching 需決定函式呼叫結束後資源保留多久，在閒置（浪費）記憶體成本與 cold start 延遲之間權衡。既有 keep-alive 政策假設所有客戶應用的 cache miss（cold start）成本一致，但實際成本因應用而異且屬客戶私有資訊；現行市場設計（如 AWS Lambda 的付費永久快取選項）僅提供粗粒度客製化，且迫使客戶自行推斷其呼叫到達過程。

key_innovation.en: A bid-based market design: each customer submits a single bid θ̂ (their per-cold-start cost) and the provider runs the classic exponential-weights online-learning algorithm over a finite set of fixed TTL keep-alive windows, with θ̂ entering the loss (wasted memory + θ̂ × cold starts). Key structural insight: because the loss is affine in θ̂ with a coefficient monotone in window length, exponential weights is inherently monotone in the bid — no specialized monotone-bandit machinery needed. This enables two payment schemes: Myerson payments (exactly incentive compatible; closed form when T = {0, ∞}) and externality payments (charging exactly the provider's wasted-memory cost; exactly cost-recovering).
key_innovation.zh: 基於投標的市場設計：每位客戶提交單一投標 θ̂（每次 cold start 的成本），provider 以經典 exponential weights 線上學習演算法在有限的固定 TTL keep-alive 視窗集合上學習，θ̂ 進入損失函數（浪費記憶體 + θ̂ × cold start 次數）。關鍵結構洞見：損失對 θ̂ 為 affine 且其係數對視窗長度單調，故 exponential weights 天然對投標單調——無需特製的 monotone bandit 機制。據此設計兩種收費方案：Myerson 付費機制（嚴格 incentive compatible；T = {0, ∞} 時有閉式解）與 externality 付費（恰好收取 provider 的浪費記憶體成本；嚴格 cost recovery）。

baselines_compared: Fixed keep-alive (TTL) window policies (best-in-hindsight regret baseline)

key_improvements.en: The custom policy is asymptotically efficient (vanishing per-round regret vs the best fixed TTL window in hindsight) and monotone in the bid. Myerson payments: customer misreport regret uniformly zero (exact IC); average cost-recovery deficit statistically indistinguishable from zero (-3.93±20.58 Poisson, -0.005±18.01 Hawkes, -4.15±76.75 Azure trace, against total wasted-memory cost of ~170-240). Externality payments: exact cost recovery by construction; positive misreport regret occurs in 16-22% of runs but averages under 2% of total customer cost on synthetic processes (~10% on the Azure trace).
key_improvements.zh: 客製政策具漸近效率（相對事後最佳固定 TTL 視窗的每輪 regret 趨近零）且對投標單調。Myerson 付費：客戶誤報 regret 恆為零（嚴格 IC）；平均 cost recovery 缺口在統計上與零無法區分（Poisson −3.93±20.58、Hawkes −0.005±18.01、Azure trace −4.15±76.75，總浪費記憶體成本約 170–240）。Externality 付費：依構造嚴格 cost recovery；16–22% 的執行出現正誤報 regret，但在合成過程平均低於客戶總成本的 2%（Azure trace 約 10%）。

compute_memory_hw: Intel Core i5-8500U (4 cores, 12 GB RAM; CPU-only simulation host)
reported_accuracy: Not Reported (no latency prediction; reports incentive-compatibility regret and cost-recovery statistics instead)
validation_workloads: Synthetic (Poisson), Synthetic (Hawkes via Ogata modified thinning), Azure Functions trace (Shahrad et al. 2020; 3173 Hawkes-fit applications)

scope_assumptions.en: Single-parameter mechanism: the customer reports one static cold-start cost θ̂ at deployment, applied to all future arrivals. Provider's caching cost is a fixed constant c_p per unit time (memory only); policies restricted to a finite discretized set of TTL windows T; full-information experts setting (the provider can compute counterfactual cold starts for every window, unlike bandit feedback). Efficiency and IC/IR guarantees are asymptotic — behavior can be poor for rarely invoked functions (authors suggest heuristic defaults for the first few arrivals). Externality payments are only empirically approximately IC; Myerson payments are only empirically approximately cost-recovering. Azure evaluation restricted to Hawkes-fit applications with at most 180 arrivals (3173 apps). Targets serverless function-image caching, not LLM/KV caches.
scope_assumptions.zh: single-parameter 機制：客戶於部署時回報單一靜態 cold start 成本 θ̂，適用於所有未來到達。provider 快取成本為固定常數 c_p（每單位時間，僅記憶體）；政策限制在有限離散化的 TTL 視窗集合 T；full-information experts 設定（provider 可對每個視窗計算反事實 cold start，異於 bandit 回饋）。效率與 IC/IR 保證皆為漸近性——對呼叫極少的函式表現可能不佳（作者建議前幾次到達採用啟發式預設政策）。Externality 付費僅在實證上近似 IC；Myerson 付費僅在實證上近似 cost recovery。Azure 評估限於符合 Hawkes 過程、至多 180 次到達的應用（3173 個）。標的為 serverless 函式映像快取，而非 LLM/KV cache。

title: Demystifying Serverless Costs on Public Platforms: Bridging Billing, Architecture, and OS Scheduling
authors: Changyuan Lin; Yuanzhi Ma; Mohammad Shahrad
venue_full: Proceedings of the Twenty-First European Conference on Computer Systems (EuroSys '26)
affiliations: University of British Columbia, Johns Hopkins University
research_focus: Multi-tenant scheduling, Performance modeling

problem_statement.en: Public serverless platforms charge higher per-unit resource prices than VMs or containers (an AWS Lambda function costs ~2.1-2.4x identically-provisioned EC2/Fargate), and billing practices — wall-clock allocation-based billing, turnaround-time billing, usage rounding, coarse granularity, and fixed invocation fees — further inflate bills. Why serverless is expensive, and how billing models, serving architectures, and OS scheduling jointly produce these costs, had not been holistically characterized.
problem_statement.zh: 公有 serverless 平台每單位資源價格高於 VM 與 container（AWS Lambda 函式價格約為同規格 EC2/Fargate 的 2.1–2.4 倍），且計費做法——以 wall-clock 資源分配計費、以 turnaround time 計費、用量進位、粗計費粒度與固定 invocation fee——進一步推高帳單。serverless 為何昂貴，以及計費模型、請求服務架構與 OS 排程如何共同造成這些成本，先前未被整體性刻劃。

key_innovation.en: First top-down, cross-layer cost characterization of public serverless platforms: (1) deconstructs the billing models of 12 platforms into a unified cost formula and replays 558.74M requests from Huawei's public serverless traces to quantify billable-vs-actual resource inflation; (2) benchmarks the three mainstream serving architectures (API long polling, HTTP server, code/binary execution), concurrency models, and keep-alive resource-allocation behavior on AWS, GCP, Azure, IBM, and Cloudflare; (3) a user-space scheduler-profiling method (detecting >500 microsecond monotonic-clock jumps) that reverse-engineers each provider's CPU bandwidth control period and timer frequency (AWS 20 ms/250 Hz, GCP 100 ms/1000 Hz, IBM 10 ms/250 Hz), revealing quantized CPU scheduling and systematic CPU overallocation, with a closed-form model of execution duration under CFS/EEVDF bandwidth control.
key_innovation.zh: 首個對公有 serverless 平台的自頂向下跨層成本刻劃：(1) 將 12 個平台的計費模型解構為統一成本公式，並以 Huawei 公開 serverless trace 重放 558.74M 個請求，量化可計費資源相對實際用量的膨脹；(2) 在 AWS、GCP、Azure、IBM 與 Cloudflare 上對三種主流請求服務架構（API long polling、HTTP server、code/binary execution）、並行模型與 keep-alive 資源配置行為進行基準測試；(3) 提出 user-space 排程剖析方法（偵測 >500 microsecond 的 monotonic clock 跳變），逆向推得各 provider 的 CPU bandwidth control 週期與 timer 頻率（AWS 20 ms/250 Hz、GCP 100 ms/1000 Hz、IBM 10 ms/250 Hz），揭示量化的 CPU 排程與系統性 CPU overallocation，並給出 CFS/EEVDF bandwidth control 下執行時間的閉式模型。

baselines_compared: AWS EC2, AWS Fargate (per-unit price comparison anchors; measurement study, no system baselines)

key_improvements.en: Headline findings (measurement study): current billing practices inflate billable resources up to 4.35x beyond actual consumption (billable vCPU time up to 3.63x and billable memory up to 4.35x actual on GCP; 2.49x/2.72x even on AWS with 1 ms granularity); 42.1% of cold starts consume more billable resources than all subsequent requests in the same sandbox; HTTP-server serving architectures add up to 5.93 ms average latency; misconfigured multi-concurrency raises GCP execution duration and cost up to 9.65x; a user-side burst-decomposition exploit cut billable GB-seconds by 66.7% yet increased the actual AWS bill by 76.7% due to invocation fees.
key_improvements.zh: 主要量化發現（量測研究）：現行計費做法使可計費資源膨脹至實際用量的最高 4.35 倍（GCP 上可計費 vCPU 時間平均最高 3.63 倍、可計費記憶體最高 4.35 倍；即使 AWS 具 1 ms 粒度仍達 2.49x/2.72x）；42.1% 的 cold start 消耗的可計費資源超過同一 sandbox 內後續所有請求的總和；HTTP server 服務架構平均額外增加最高 5.93 ms 延遲；並行設定不當時 GCP 執行時間與成本最高上升 9.65 倍；user 端將長任務拆為短 burst 的 exploit 可減少 66.7% 可計費 GB-seconds，但因 invocation fee，AWS 實際帳單反增 76.7%。

compute_memory_hw: Intel Xeon E5-2673 v4 (in-house VMs, 10 vCPUs each, for local scheduler profiling)
reported_accuracy: Not Reported (scheduler-parameter inference validated by matching throttle/runtime distributions of local CFS/EEVDF runs with corresponding configurations)
validation_workloads: Huawei public serverless traces (558.74M requests), FunctionBench (PyAES), SeBS (video processing), Minimal echo function (synthetic)

scope_assumptions.en: Point-in-time measurement study (platform behaviors, prices, and keep-alive practices as of 2025-05-15; these evolve). Billing analysis covers basic billable resources (vCPU, memory) only — GPUs, storage, and network bandwidth are out of scope. Deliberately does not quantify relative contributions of each cost component, since breakdowns depend on workload, configuration, and provider policies; reports raw billable resources rather than dollar costs to avoid per-unit price distortions. Trace analysis excludes requests with zero CPU usage or missing pod IDs/flavors. Scheduler profiling covers AWS, GCP, and IBM only, inferring parameters from user space without provider confirmation. Studies generic serverless functions; nothing LLM- or token-related.
scope_assumptions.zh: 屬特定時點的量測研究（平台行為、價格與 keep-alive 做法以 2025-05-15 為準，且持續演變）。計費分析僅涵蓋基本可計費資源（vCPU、記憶體），GPU、儲存與網路頻寬不在範圍內。刻意不量化各成本因素的相對貢獻，因其高度依賴工作負載、組態與 provider 政策；以原始可計費資源而非美元成本呈現，以避免單價差異的干擾。trace 分析排除 CPU 用量為零或缺少 pod ID/flavor 的請求。排程剖析僅涵蓋 AWS、GCP 與 IBM，參數由 user space 推得、未經 provider 證實。研究對象為一般 serverless 函式，與 LLM 或 token 計費無關。

title: See What I See, Know What I Think: Dense Latent Communication Across Heterogeneous Agents
authors: Siyi Chen; Xiaoyan Zhang; Meng Wu; Jonathan Tremblay; Valts Blukis; Stan Birchfield; Rene Vidal; Alvaro Velasquez; Sijia Liu; Qing Qu
affiliations: University of Michigan, NVIDIA, University of Pennsylvania, University of Colorado Boulder, Michigan State University
research_focus: Agentic / Workflow serving

problem_statement.en: Multi-agent systems communicate mainly through text, incurring lossy and expensive sender-side decoding and receiver-side re-encoding. Existing KV-cache communication is largely limited to homogeneous models, while heterogeneous methods commonly assume shared input and transfer only sparse steering signals rather than dense context and reasoning state.
problem_statement.zh: 多 agent 系統主要透過 text 通訊，sender 端 decode 與 receiver 端重新 encode 會增加計算成本並造成資訊損失。既有 KV cache 通訊大多限於同質模型；異質方法通常假設雙方共享輸入，且僅傳遞稀疏 steering signal，未能保存 dense context 與 reasoning state。

key_innovation.en: A dense heterogeneous KV-cache alignment interface that strips and restores model-specific RoPE, aligns layers monotonically, transforms each KV group with gated MLPs, and trains in two phases—receiver-cache reconstruction followed by mixed context-aware/context-unaware generation.
key_innovation.zh: 提出異質 agent 間的 dense KV cache alignment interface：先移除並恢復各模型的 RoPE，以單調映射對齊不同深度的 layer，透過 gated MLP 逐 KV group 轉換，並採用 receiver-cache reconstruction 與 context-aware/context-unaware 混合 generation 的兩階段訓練。

key_improvements.en: Across all six heterogeneous directions, the method matches or exceeds T2T on every in-domain task while using 2–3× less compute. In context-unaware 8B→4B transfer, it reaches 91.4/81.6/93.6 accuracy on GSM8K/MATH-500/ARC-C at 6.6 TFLOPs—within 1–2 percentage points of context-aware T2T with about 5× fewer FLOPs.
key_improvements.zh: 在六個異質傳遞方向的所有 in-domain task 上，該方法均匹配或優於 T2T，計算量降低 2–3×。在 context-unaware 8B→4B 傳遞中，GSM8K/MATH-500/ARC-C 準確率達 91.4/81.6/93.6，僅需 6.6 TFLOPs；相較 context-aware T2T 約減少 5× FLOPs，準確率差距僅 1–2 percentage points。

repair_mechanism: Position re-alignment (RoPE), Learned fusion / link tokens

reuse_metric.en: Context-unaware transfer remains within 0–10 percentage points of the method's context-aware accuracy across all six model directions and six benchmarks; in homogeneous self-communication, retaining 250/288 KV groups (87%) approaches the full-cache ceiling.
reuse_metric.zh: context-unaware 傳遞在六個模型方向與六項 benchmark 上，與同方法 context-aware 準確率的差距維持在 0–10 percentage points；在同質 self-communication 中，保留 250/288 個 KV group (87%) 即接近完整 cache 的性能上限。

title: DistServe: Disaggregating Prefill and Decoding for Goodput-optimized Large Language Model Serving
authors: Yinmin Zhong; Shengyu Liu; Junda Chen; Jianbo Hu; Yibo Zhu; Xuanzhe Liu; Xin Jin; Hao Zhang
venue_full: USENIX Symposium on Operating Systems Design and Implementation
affiliations: Peking University, StepFun, UC San Diego
research_focus: PD disaggregation, LLM serving, Multi-tenant scheduling, Capacity planning, Performance modeling, Queueing theory

problem_statement.en: Existing LLM serving systems colocate prefill and decode phases and batch them together, which causes prefill-decode interference, couples resource allocation and parallelism plans for two phases with very different compute and latency profiles, and forces providers to over-provision GPUs to meet both TTFT and TPOT SLOs simultaneously.
problem_statement.zh: 現有 LLM serving 系統將 prefill 與 decode 共置並一起 batch，導致 prefill-decode 互相干擾，並把兩個計算特性與延遲需求差異極大的階段在資源配置與 parallelism 規劃上強行耦合，迫使服務商為了同時滿足 TTFT 與 TPOT SLO 而過度配置 GPU。

key_innovation.en: DistServe disaggregates prefill and decode into separate GPU instances, co-optimizes each phase's parallelism strategy (intra-op vs inter-op) via an M/D/1-queue-based simulator and a placement algorithm that distinguishes high- and low-node-affinity clusters, and uses a pull-based KV-cache transfer pattern over NVLink or InfiniBand to keep the disaggregation overhead negligible.
key_innovation.zh: DistServe 將 prefill 與 decode 解耦到獨立 GPU instance，透過以 M/D/1 queue 為基礎的 simulator 與區分 high/low node-affinity 叢集的 placement 演算法，分別共同最佳化兩階段的 parallelism 策略（intra-op 對 inter-op），並以 pull-based KV cache transfer 配合 NVLink 或 InfiniBand，使解耦合的通訊額外開銷接近可忽略。

key_improvements.en: Up to 7.4x more requests served or 12.6x tighter SLO compared to state-of-the-art systems while staying within latency constraints for over 90% of requests; on ShareGPT chatbot workloads sustains 2.0x-4.6x higher request rate than vLLM and 1.6x-7.4x higher than DeepSpeed-MII.
key_improvements.zh: 相較 state-of-the-art 系統可服務多達 7.4x 請求量或滿足 12.6x 更嚴格的 SLO，且 90% 以上請求滿足延遲限制；於 ShareGPT chatbot workload 上請求率較 vLLM 提升 2.0x-4.6x、較 DeepSpeed-MII 提升 1.6x-7.4x。

ai_task: LLM Serving, Disaggregated Prefill/Decoding
traffic_pattern: Continuous Batching, Pipeline Parallelism, Tensor Parallelism
reported_accuracy: Not Reported (M/D/1 queue model and per-phase simulator; paper reports placement-search wall time and SLO attainment rather than per-phase latency MAPE)
validation_workloads: ShareGPT (chatbot), HumanEval (code completion), LongBench (summarization)

scope_assumptions.en: Assumes uniform prompt length and Poisson arrivals in the placement-time analysis; uses MHA OPT models in evaluation to keep KV cache pressure high so transfer overhead is meaningfully tested; cross-node KV transfer assumes InfiniBand (e.g., 800 Gbps) or NVLink (e.g., 600 GB/s intra-node); does not implement preemption or fault tolerance; periodic replanning triggered only when offline workload profile shifts; one prefill or decode instance corresponds to one full copy of model weights.
scope_assumptions.zh: Placement 階段分析假設 prompt 長度均勻且為 Poisson 到達；評估採用 MHA OPT 模型以維持 KV cache 壓力，確保 transfer overhead 被有效檢驗；跨節點 KV transfer 假設使用 InfiniBand（如 800 Gbps）或 NVLink（如節點內 600 GB/s）；未實作 preemption 與 fault tolerance；replanning 僅在離線 workload profile 變動時觸發；每個 prefill 或 decode instance 對應一份完整模型權重。

title: Pushing the Performance Envelope of DNN-based Recommendation Systems Inference on GPUs
authors: Rishabh Jain; Vivek M. Bhasi; Adwait Jog; Anand Sivasubramaniam; Mahmut T. Kandemir; Chita R. Das
affiliations: The Pennsylvania State University, University of Virginia
research_focus: GPU memory tiering, Hardware co-design, Performance modeling, Roofline analysis

problem_statement.en: In DNN-based recommendation (DLRM) GPU inference, the embedding stage is the primary bottleneck, causing up to a 3.2x embedding-only slowdown because gather operations over large embedding tables incur frequent, irregular memory accesses with low SM occupancy and long-latency global-memory load stalls. The paper asks how to keep frequently reused (hot) embedding rows close to the cores instead of repeatedly fetching them from HBM across successive kernel invocations.
problem_statement.zh: 在基於 DNN 的推薦模型（DLRM）GPU 推理中，embedding 階段是主要瓶頸，造成最高達 3.2 倍的 embedding-only 變慢：對大型 embedding table 做 gather 會產生頻繁且不規則的記憶體存取，導致 SM 佔用率偏低與長延遲的 global-memory load stall。論文探討如何把頻繁重用的熱門 embedding row 留在靠近運算核心的位置，而不是在連續的 kernel 呼叫之間反覆從 HBM 重新讀取。

key_innovation.en: Three composable, plug-and-play kernel-level techniques layered on the PyTorch EmbeddingBag CUDA kernel: (1) OptMT — direct compiler optimizations (e.g. capping register usage via -maxrregcount to lift warp-level parallelism/occupancy); (2) RPF — register-resident software prefetching that issues loads early to overlap long-latency stalls; and (3) L2P (L2 pinning) — the cache-reuse contribution: a dedicated prefetch_pin_L2 kernel issues inline PTX 'prefetch.global.L2::evict_last' on the hottest embedding rows so those rows are pinned with highest eviction priority in the GPU L2 cache and stay resident ACROSS kernel launches, turning otherwise cold cross-kernel HBM re-reads into L2 hits.
key_innovation.zh: 在 PyTorch EmbeddingBag 的 CUDA kernel 上疊加三項可組合、即插即用的 kernel 層技術：(1) OptMT — 直接的編譯器最佳化（例如以 -maxrregcount 限制暫存器用量以提升 warp-level parallelism 與佔用率）；(2) RPF — 暫存器駐留的軟體 prefetch，提前發出 load 以掩蓋長延遲 stall；(3) L2P（L2 pinning）— 本文的快取重用核心貢獻：一個專用的 prefetch_pin_L2 kernel 對最熱門的 embedding row 發出 inline PTX 'prefetch.global.L2::evict_last'，將這些 row 以最高保留優先序釘在 GPU L2 cache 中，使其在「跨 kernel 呼叫」之間持續駐留，把原本跨 kernel 的冷 HBM 重讀轉化為 L2 命中。

key_improvements.en: Combined OptMT+RPF+L2P improves the embedding stage by up to 103% and the overall DLRM inference pipeline by up to 77% on A100. OptMT (compiler) alone gives up to ~53%. Cache/inter-kernel L2 reuse is central to the motivation (the paper is indexed under 'Cache residency control' and 'Prefetching') but is the smallest incremental knob: L2 pinning contributes only ~13.5% on top of RPF+OptMT, because once register prefetching already hides much of the latency the remaining headroom from pinning hot rows in L2 across kernels is modest.
key_improvements.zh: 在 A100 上，OptMT+RPF+L2P 三者合併可將 embedding 階段提升最高 103%、整體 DLRM 推理管線提升最高 77%。單獨 OptMT（編譯器）可達約 53%。Cache／跨 kernel 的 L2 重用是動機核心（論文索引於『Cache residency control』與『Prefetching』），但屬於增益最小的旋鈕：L2 pinning 相對於 RPF+OptMT 僅再貢獻約 13.5%——因為當暫存器 prefetch 已掩蓋大部分延遲後，再把熱門 row 跨 kernel 釘在 L2 所剩的提升空間有限。

baselines_compared: Off-the-shelf PyTorch EmbeddingBag (base), OptMT, RPF+OptMT, L2P+OptMT
compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA A100, HBM2e, GPU L2 cache
reported_accuracy: Not Reported (this is an optimization/characterization paper, not a latency-prediction model)
validation_workloads: DLRM embedding access traces with hot/cold row partitioning across memory-access patterns (one-item, high-hot, med-hot, low-hot, random)

scope_assumptions.en: Focuses on the embedding (gather) stage of DLRM inference on a single NVIDIA A100; techniques are implemented as drop-in modifications to the PyTorch EmbeddingBag CUDA kernel (built against PyTorch v2.1.0, CUDA arch sm_80).
