L2 pinning relies on the sm_80 'prefetch.global.L2::evict_last' PTX residency-control primitive and on a static hot-row index list; results are reported for A100-class L2 capacity and do not model multi-GPU, quantization, or KV-cache hierarchies.
scope_assumptions.zh: 聚焦於單張 NVIDIA A100 上 DLRM 推理的 embedding（gather）階段；各技術以對 PyTorch EmbeddingBag CUDA kernel 的即插即用修改實作（基於 PyTorch v2.1.0、CUDA 架構 sm_80）。L2 pinning 依賴 sm_80 的 'prefetch.global.L2::evict_last' PTX 駐留控制原語與一份靜態的熱門 row 索引清單；結果以 A100 等級的 L2 容量回報，未涵蓋多 GPU、量化或 KV-cache 層級的建模。

source.notes: Affiliations and incremental-gain framing verified against arXiv:2410.22249 PDF page 1 and the cloned repo's opt_designs/l2_pinning/EmbeddingBag_timed.cu (prefetch.global.L2::evict_last in the prefetch_pin_L2 kernel).

title: Don't Break the Cache: An Evaluation of Prompt Caching for Long-Horizon Agentic Tasks
authors: Elias Lumer; Faheem Nizar; Akshaya Jangiti; Kevin Frank; Anmol Gulati; Mandar Phadate; Vamse Kumar Subbiah
research_focus: Long-context / Prefix cache, Agentic / Workflow serving, LLM serving

problem_statement.en: Long-horizon agentic tasks span dozens of tool-calling API calls with context windows accumulating tens of thousands of tokens. Although OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google all offer prompt caching, no prior work quantifies its cost savings or compares caching strategies for multi-turn agentic workloads, where dynamic session-specific tool results interleave with static system prompts and naive full-context caching can paradoxically increase latency.
problem_statement.zh: 長程 agentic 任務跨越數十次 tool-calling API 呼叫，context window 累積達數萬 token。儘管 OpenAI、Anthropic 與 Google 皆提供 prompt caching，然而先前並無研究量化其於 multi-turn agentic workload 的成本節省，亦未比較各種 caching 策略；動態且 session 相依的 tool result 與靜態 system prompt 交錯，naive 的 full-context caching 甚至可能反而增加延遲。

key_innovation.en: A UUID-based cache-boundary control methodology that implements four controlled cache conditions against live provider APIs: No Cache (UUID prepended to the system prompt breaks all caching), Full Context (provider-automatic caching), System Prompt Only (UUID appended after the system prompt), and Exclude Tool Results (dual UUIDs after the system prompt and after each tool result). Evaluated with a LangChain Deep Agents web-search agent on DeepResearch Bench: 40 sessions per condition per model (500+ sessions total), 10,000-token system prompts, warmup calls to prime caches, >24h between conditions to let TTL-based cache entries expire, and independent-samples t-tests at alpha=0.05.
key_innovation.zh: 提出以 UUID 控制 cache boundary 的方法論，於實際 provider API 上實作四種受控 cache 條件：No Cache (於 system prompt 開頭前置 UUID 以破壞所有快取)、Full Context (provider 自動快取)、System Prompt Only (於 system prompt 之後附加 UUID)、Exclude Tool Results (於 system prompt 與每個 tool result 之後皆附加 UUID)。以 LangChain Deep Agents 建構 web-search agent，於 DeepResearch Bench 上每個模型每條件執行 40 個 session (合計逾 500 個 session)，system prompt 為 10,000 token；藉由 warmup 呼叫預先建立 cache，各條件間等待逾 24 小時使 TTL 到期，並以 independent-samples t-test (alpha=0.05) 檢定顯著性。

key_improvements.en: Prompt caching reduces API costs by 41-80% and improves TTFT by 13-31% across providers (best cache mode per model: GPT-5.2 79.6% cost / 13.0% TTFT; Claude Sonnet 4.5 78.5% / 22.9%; Gemini 2.5 Pro 41.4% / 6.1%; GPT-4o 45.9% / 30.9%). Cost savings are consistent across strategies (typically within 2-4 percentage points), but full-context caching can regress latency (GPT-4o TTFT -8.8%). Ablation: cost savings scale linearly with prompt size (10-45% at 500 tokens up to 54-89% at 50,000 tokens) and remain stable across 3-50 tool calls; below provider minimum caching thresholds, TTFT regresses 10-18%.
key_improvements.zh: Prompt caching 使 API 成本降低 41-80%，TTFT 改善 13-31% (各模型最佳 cache mode：GPT-5.2 成本 79.6% / TTFT 13.0%；Claude Sonnet 4.5 78.5% / 22.9%；Gemini 2.5 Pro 41.4% / 6.1%；GPT-4o 45.9% / 30.9%)。成本節省在各策略間一致 (通常差距僅 2-4 個百分點)，然而 full-context caching 可能使延遲倒退 (GPT-4o TTFT -8.8%)。Ablation 顯示成本節省隨 prompt size 線性擴展 (500 token 時 10-45%，50,000 token 時可達 54-89%)，且在 3-50 次 tool call 間保持穩定；低於 provider 最低快取門檻時，TTFT 反而倒退 10-18%。

reported_accuracy: Not Reported (measurement study; significance via independent-samples t-tests at alpha=0.05, n=40 sessions per condition)
models_validated: GPT-5.2, GPT-4o, Claude Sonnet 4.5, Gemini 2.5 Pro
validation_workloads: DeepResearch Bench (100 PhD-level research questions with real web-search tool calls), Synthetic ablation (prompt sizes 500-50,000 tokens; 3-50 tool calls)

scope_assumptions.en: Each session starts with a fresh context, so only within-session (not cross-session) cache benefits are measured. Single benchmark (DeepResearch Bench) and single agent framework (LangChain Deep Agents). Pricing (Table 3), minimum caching thresholds (1,024 tokens for OpenAI/Anthropic, 4,096 for Google), and TTL policies (5 minutes to 24 hours) reflect early-January-2026 provider documentation and are subject to change. Provider caching internals are black-box; TTFT exhibits natural variance from server load, geography, and provider infrastructure (ablation runs show higher variance than the main study). Authors advise practitioners to run experiments representative of their own workloads rather than relying solely on published benchmarks.
scope_assumptions.zh: 每個 session 皆以全新 context 開始，因此僅測量 session 內 (而非跨 session) 的快取效益。僅使用單一 benchmark (DeepResearch Bench) 與單一 agent 框架 (LangChain Deep Agents)。定價 (Table 3)、最低快取門檻 (OpenAI/Anthropic 為 1,024 token，Google 為 4,096 token) 與 TTL 政策 (5 分鐘至 24 小時) 依 2026 年 1 月初的 provider 文件為準，且可能變動。Provider 快取內部為 black-box；TTFT 受 server 負載、地理位置與 provider 基礎設施影響而有自然變異 (ablation 的變異高於主實驗)。作者建議實務者應以自身 workload 進行代表性實驗，而非僅依賴已發表的 benchmark 數據。

title: DOPD: A Dynamic PD-Disaggregation Architecture for Maximizing Goodput in LLM Inference Serving
authors: Junhan Liao; Minxian Xu; Wanyi Zheng; Yan Wang; Kejiang Ye; Rajkumar Buyya; Chengzhong Xu
affiliations: Shenzhen Institutes of Advanced Technology, Chinese Academy of Sciences, University of Chinese Academy of Sciences, Southern University of Science and Technology, Inner Mongolia University, The University of Melbourne, University of Macau
research_focus: Multi-tenant scheduling, PD disaggregation, Datacenter networking

problem_statement.en: Static PD-disaggregation architectures suffer from producer-consumer imbalances due to heterogeneous LLM workloads and mixed-length requests, leading to resource wastage or SLO violations. The paper aims to dynamically adjust the prefill-to-decoding (P/D) ratio to maximize goodput and resource efficiency.
problem_statement.zh: 靜態 PD 解耦架構因異質 LLM 工作負載與混合長度請求而產生生產者-消費者失衡，導致資源浪費或 SLO 違規。本文旨在動態調整 prefill 與 decoding 的比例（P/D ratio），以最大化 goodput 與資源效率。

key_innovation.en: DOPD (Dynamic Optimal Prefill/Decoding), a framework that uses ARIMA-based load forecasting to compute an optimal P/D ratio and employs a length-aware request scheduling policy to mitigate resource mismatches under high concurrency.
key_innovation.zh: DOPD（Dynamic Optimal Prefill/Decoding）是一套框架，利用基於 ARIMA 的負載預測計算最優 P/D ratio，並採用感知請求長度的 scheduling 策略，以緩解高並發下的資源不匹配問題。

key_improvements.en: Up to 1.5x increase in overall system goodput, up to 67.5% reduction in P90 TTFT, up to 22.8% reduction in P90 TPOT, and over 99% SLO attainment.
key_improvements.zh: 系統整體 goodput 最高提升 1.5x、P90 TTFT 降低最多 67.5%、P90 TPOT 降低最多 22.8%，SLO 達成率超過 99%。

ai_task: LLM Inference Serving, Disaggregated Prefill/Decoding
traffic_pattern: Mixed-length requests, BurstGPT, Azure conversation and code traces

title: DUALMAP: ENABLING BOTH CACHE AFFINITY AND LOAD BALANCING FOR DISTRIBUTED LLM SERVING
authors: Ying Yuan; Pengfei Zuo; Bo Wang; Zhangyu Chen; Zhipeng Tan; Zhou Yu
affiliations: Huazhong University of Science and Technology, Huawei
research_focus: Multi-tenant scheduling, Datacenter networking, Routing / Load balancing

problem_statement.en: Distributed LLM serving systems face a fundamental trade-off between cache-affinity scheduling (which maximizes KV cache reuse but causes load imbalance) and load-balancing scheduling (which distributes load evenly but degrades cache hit rates). Existing schedulers operate within a single mapping space, failing to achieve both objectives simultaneously.
problem_statement.zh: 分散式 LLM serving 系統在快取親和性 scheduling（最大化 KV cache 重用但導致負載不均）與負載均衡 scheduling（均勻分配負載但降低快取命中率）之間存在根本性取捨。現有 scheduler 在單一映射空間內運作，無法同時達成兩個目標。

key_innovation.en: DualMap, a dual-mapping scheduling strategy that maps each request to two candidate instances using independent hash functions and selects the optimal instance based on system state, effectively combining the 'power of two choices' for load balancing with prefix-aware mapping for cache affinity.
key_innovation.zh: DualMap 是一種雙映射 scheduling 策略，利用獨立雜湊函數將每個請求映射至兩個候選實例，再依據系統狀態選擇最優實例，有效地將「二選一」（power of two choices）的負載均衡與前綴感知映射的快取親和性相結合。

baselines_compared: Cache Affinity, Least Loaded, Min TTFT, Preble

key_improvements.en: Up to 2.25x increase in effective request capacity, 55.4%-97.4% reduction in P50 TTFT, and 82.3%-97% reduction in P90 TTFT.
key_improvements.zh: 有效請求容量最高提升 2.25x；P50 TTFT 降低 55.4%–97.4%；P90 TTFT 降低 82.3%–97%。

ai_task: LLM Serving, Context Caching, Multi-turn Conversations, Tool-Agent Interactions

title: DualPath: Breaking the Storage Bandwidth Bottleneck in Agentic LLM Inference
authors: Yongtong Wu; Shaoyuan Chen; Yinmin Zhong; Rilin Huang; Yixuan Tan; Wentao Zhang; Liyue Zhang; Shangyan Zhou; Yuxuan Liu; Shunfeng Zhou; Mingxing Zhang; Xin Jin; Panpan Huang
research_focus: Agentic / Workflow serving, Multi-tenant scheduling, PD disaggregation, Datacenter networking, RDMA / Transport

problem_statement.en: Agentic LLM inference is bottlenecked by storage I/O imbalance in disaggregated architectures, where prefill engines are bandwidth-saturated while decoding engines remain idle. This leads to severe GPU underutilization during KV-Cache loading.
problem_statement.zh: Agentic LLM inference 在解耦架構中受制於儲存 I/O 失衡：prefill 引擎頻寬飽和，而 decoding 引擎卻閒置，導致 KV cache 載入期間 GPU 嚴重低利用。

key_innovation.en: DualPath introduces a dual-path KV-Cache loading architecture that enables loading KV-Cache into decoding engines and transferring it to prefill engines via RDMA, combined with a workload-aware scheduler to balance network and compute resources.
key_innovation.zh: DualPath 引入雙路徑 KV cache 載入架構：將 KV cache 載入 decoding 引擎後再透過 RDMA 傳輸至 prefill 引擎，並搭配感知工作負載的 scheduler 以平衡網路與計算資源。

baselines_compared: SGLang (with HiCache and Mooncake), Basic (unmodified internal framework), Oracle

key_improvements.en: Up to 1.87x offline inference throughput increase and 1.96x average online serving throughput improvement.
key_improvements.zh: 離線 inference 吞吐量最高提升 1.87x，線上 serving 平均吞吐量提升 1.96x。

ai_task: Agentic LLM Inference, LLM Serving, RL Training Rollout
traffic_pattern: AllToAll, ReduceScatter, AllGather, RDMA, KV-Cache transfer
routing_and_congestion_control: Virtual Lanes (VL), Weighted Round Robin (WRR), PFC

title: A Dynamic LLM-Powered Agent Network for Task-Oriented Agent Collaboration
authors: Zijun Liu; Yanzhe Zhang; Peng Li; Yang Liu; Diyi Yang
research_focus: Agentic / Workflow serving, Reasoning / Test-time scaling

problem_statement.en: Existing LLM multi-agent collaboration systems use a fixed number of agents and a static communication structure, which is suboptimal and costly across heterogeneous tasks and domains. DyLAN targets the question of how to automatically select an effective team of agents from a candidate pool and let them collaborate in a query-adaptive (dynamic) communication structure.
problem_statement.zh: 現有的 LLM 多 agent 協作系統採用固定數量的 agent 與靜態的通訊結構,面對異質任務與不同領域時,此設計並非最佳且成本高昂。DyLAN 針對的問題是:如何從候選 agent 池中自動挑選出有效的 agent 團隊,並使其在一個隨查詢自適應(動態)的通訊結構中協作。

key_innovation.en: A two-stage framework — Team Optimization then Task Solving — whose core mechanism is an unsupervised "Agent Importance Score" computed by backward-propagating peer LLM ratings through a Temporal Feed-Forward message-passing Network (T-FFN) to pick the best agent team offline, followed by inference-time dynamic agent activation with LLM-Ranker-based per-round team reformation (pruning weak agents mid-collaboration) and a Byzantine-consensus early-stopping rule.
key_innovation.zh: 一套兩階段框架——先進行團隊最佳化(Team Optimization),再進行任務求解(Task Solving)。其核心機制為一種無監督的「Agent Importance Score」:透過在時序前饋訊息傳遞網路(Temporal Feed-Forward message-passing Network,T-FFN)中反向傳播來自同儕 LLM 的評分,以離線方式挑選出最佳 agent 團隊;隨後於推論階段進行動態 agent 啟用,並以 LLM-Ranker 為基礎在每一輪重組團隊(於協作中途剪除表現較弱的 agent),同時搭配一條 Byzantine 共識的提早停止(early-stopping)規則。

baselines_compared: Single Execution, CoT / Complex CoT, PHP, Self-Consistency, LLM-Blender, LLM Debate, Reflexion, CodeT, LATS

key_improvements.en: HumanEval 82.9 pass@1 (single-agent 73.2) at 16.85 calls; MMLU 70.5% at 4.39 calls; up to +25 pts on single MMLU subjects.
key_improvements.zh: HumanEval 82.9 pass@1(單 agent 73.2),16.85 次呼叫;MMLU 70.5%,4.39 次呼叫;單一 MMLU 科目最高 +25 分。

structure_space: Team composition (agent set), Temporal / cross-round edges, Termination / depth
decision_mechanism: Heuristic scoring / ranking
benchmarks_used: HumanEval, WebShop, MMLU, MATH

agent_scenario.en: Multiple LLM agents sharing one backbone (all GPT-3.5-turbo or all GPT-4) but differentiated by role/persona system prompts collaborate over T rounds in a temporal feed-forward message-passing network. A candidate pool is pruned in Stage 1 to a small task-specific team (roughly 3-8 agents). During Task Solving an LLM Ranker/judge node scores peer answers each round to prune weak agents, and a >2/3 majority-agreement rule triggers early stopping. Task-specific tool use: WebShop agents act in the shopping environment ReAct-style, HumanEval agents use code-execution feedback. It is task-oriented / single-domain per run rather than a general open-ended orchestrator.
agent_scenario.zh: 多個 LLM agent 共用同一個 backbone(全為 GPT-3.5-turbo 或全為 GPT-4),但藉由角色 / persona 的 system prompt 加以區分,並在一個時序前饋訊息傳遞網路中歷經 T 輪協作。第一階段將候選池剪除為一個小型、任務專屬的團隊(約 3 至 8 個 agent)。在任務求解過程中,一個 LLM Ranker / judge 節點於每一輪對同儕答案評分以剪除較弱的 agent,並以 >2/3 多數同意規則觸發提早停止。任務專屬的工具使用:WebShop agent 以 ReAct 風格在購物環境中行動,HumanEval agent 則使用程式碼執行回饋。此系統為任務導向 / 每次執行針對單一領域,而非通用的開放式 orchestrator。

title: Efficiently Scaling LLM Reasoning with Certaindex
authors: Yichao Fu; Junda Chen; Siqi Zhu; Zheyu Fu; Zhongdongming Dai; Yonghao Zhuang; Yian Ma; Aurick Qiao; Tajana Rosing; Ion Stoica; Hao Zhang
affiliations: UCSD, Tsinghua University, Carnegie Mellon University, Snowflake, UC Berkeley
research_focus: Long-context / Prefix cache, Reasoning / Test-time scaling, Multi-tenant scheduling, Continuous batching, Performance modeling

problem_statement.en: Test-time reasoning algorithms (CoT, self-consistency, MCTS, REBASE) wastefully spend tokens long after the model's intermediate answer has stabilised, with reasoning models such as DeepSeek-R1 producing about 3x more tokens than necessary on tasks such as AMC23. Existing serving stacks lack a runtime signal to detect this answer stabilisation and terminate early, leaving substantial token budget unrecovered.
problem_statement.zh: Test-time reasoning 演算法（CoT、self-consistency、MCTS、REBASE）在模型的中間答案已穩定後仍持續花費 tokens，DeepSeek-R1 等 reasoning model 在 AMC23 等任務上產生的 tokens 數量約為實際需要的 3x。現有 serving stack 缺乏 runtime 信號偵測此答案穩定狀態並提前終止，因此大量 token 預算被浪費。

key_innovation.en: Introduces certaindex, an algorithm-agnostic stability metric computed from semantic entropy across reasoning paths (for SC/MCTS/REBASE) or from reward-model scores (for MCTS/REBASE). Builds Dynasor, a reasoning-aware serving layer on top of SGLang that uses certaindex for (i) certaindex-based intra-program scheduling with early exit, (ii) gang scheduling for requests in the same reasoning program, and (iii) program-aware approximate SJF inter-program scheduling with finish-time fairness.
key_innovation.zh: 提出 certaindex：一個與演算法無關的穩定性指標，對 SC、MCTS、REBASE 由 reasoning paths 的 semantic entropy 計算，對含 reward model 的 MCTS、REBASE 則直接取 reward 分數。基於 certaindex 在 SGLang 之上建構 Dynasor，提供三項機制：(i) certaindex 驅動的 intra-program scheduler 支援 early exit；(ii) 同 reasoning program 內請求的 gang scheduling；(iii) program-aware 的近似 SJF inter-program scheduler，並以 finish-time fairness 防止飢餓。

key_improvements.en: Up to 50% compute savings at equal accuracy in batch inference (CoT, SC, MCTS, REBASE). Up to 3.3x higher sustainable request rate under P90 deadline attainment vs SGLang and Parrot in online serving; 4.7x tighter SLOs at the same attainment rate. Token savings of 11-29% across DeepSeek-Qwen-distilled 7B/14B/32B on AIME24, AMC23, MATH500; for the top 1% of problems, 53% (AIME) and 81% (MATH500) token reduction. DeepSeek-R1 saves 12% tokens on AIME and 24% on AMC.
key_improvements.zh: 在 batch inference (CoT、SC、MCTS、REBASE) 上以相同精度節省最多 50% 計算。Online serving 下相對 SGLang 與 Parrot 將可支撐的 request rate 提升最多 3.3x（P90 deadline attainment 標準），或在相同 attainment 下將 SLO 收緊 4.7x。DeepSeek-Qwen-distilled 7B/14B/32B 在 AIME24、AMC23、MATH500 上節省 11-29% tokens；最難的 top 1% 問題則達 53%（AIME）與 81%（MATH500）的 token 節省。DeepSeek-R1 在 AIME 節省 12% tokens、AMC 節省 24%。

gpu_count: 2x A100 80GB for MCTS/REBASE (LLM + reward model); 1x A100 80GB for SC
reported_accuracy: Certaindex H achieves Pearson correlation of 0.68 and Kendall's Tau of 0.61 with ground-truth required steps, vs 0.40/0.35 for path length and 0.40/0.34 for mean log-probability entropy
models_validated: DeepSeek-Qwen-Distilled 7B/14B/32B, DeepSeek-R1, Llama3.1-8B-Instruct, Llama2-7B, Llemma-7B, Llemma-34B, Skywork-7B, QwQ, Gemma, Phi
validation_workloads: AIME24, AMC23, MATH500, GSM8K, ASDiv, LiveCodeBench, GAME24

scope_assumptions.en: Targets reasoning-program workloads where intermediate answers can be probed; does not yet integrate with advanced serving techniques such as PD-disaggregation or chunked-prefill. Thresholds are profiler-calibrated per (algorithm, dataset, LLM) and may need recalibration under data distribution shifts. Probe-in-the-middle inserts a prompt to force an interim answer; correctness depends on the model honoring this prompt. Acknowledges potential side-channel and bias risks in multi-tenant settings.
scope_assumptions.zh: 鎖定可在中途探測答案的 reasoning-program workload；尚未整合 PD-disaggregation、chunked-prefill 等進階 serving 技術。Threshold 為 profiler 校準後與 (algorithm, dataset, LLM) 綁定，當資料分佈漂移時可能需重新校準。Probe-in-the-middle 透過插入特定 prompt 強制模型給出中間答案，其有效性依賴模型對該 prompt 的響應。論文亦提示在多租戶情境下可能存在側通道與偏差風險。

title: EPIC: Efficient Position-Independent Caching for Serving Large Language Models
authors: Junhao Hu; Wenrui Huang; Weidong Wang; Haoyi Wang; Tiancheng Hu; Qin Zhang; Hao Feng; Xusheng Chen; Yizhou Shan; Tao Xie
affiliations: Peking University, Nanjing University, Huawei Cloud
research_focus: LLM serving, Long-context / Prefix cache

problem_statement.en: Prefix-based context caching can reuse KV vectors only when requests share an exact prefix, so immutable documents and few-shot examples preceded by different content must be recomputed. Position-independent reuse increases cache opportunities but deviates from standard attention and can degrade accuracy.
problem_statement.zh: 以 prefix 為基礎的 context caching 僅能在 request 具有完全相同 prefix 時重用 KV 向量，因此，當 immutable document 或 few-shot example 前置不同內容時，仍須重新計算。position-independent reuse 雖可擴大 cache 重用機會，卻會偏離標準 attention 機制並造成準確率下降。

key_innovation.en: EPIC formalizes Position-Independent Caching as a compile–link framework: immutable chunks are compiled into independent KV caches and then assembled on demand. Its LegoLink algorithm uses a static positional heuristic to selectively recompute only the first k tokens (k ≤ 32) of each non-initial chunk, mitigating attention sinks with O(kN) rather than O(N²) recomputation.
key_innovation.zh: EPIC 將 Position-Independent Caching 形式化為 compile–link 兩階段框架：先把 immutable chunks 編譯為彼此獨立的 KV cache，再於 request 到達時進行組合。LegoLink 採用靜態 positional heuristic，僅選擇性重算每個非首個 chunk 的前 k 個 tokens（k ≤ 32），以 O(kN) 而非 O(N²) 的重算成本緩解 attention sink。

key_improvements.en: Compared with CacheBlend-15, LegoLink-16 reduces TTFT by up to 8× and raises throughput by up to 7× under asynchronous workloads; in synchronous workloads, LegoLink improves TTFT by up to 3× while limiting accuracy loss to within 7%.
key_improvements.zh: 相較於 CacheBlend-15，LegoLink-16 在 asynchronous workload 下使 TTFT 最高降低 8×，並將 throughput 最高提升 7×；在 synchronous workload 下，LegoLink 的 TTFT 最高改善 3×，且準確率損失控制在 7% 以內。

ai_task: LLM Serving, RAG
compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA A100-80GB, Intel Xeon Platinum 8358P, 1TB DRAM

reuse_metric.en: Across the evaluated datasets, immutable tokens constitute approximately 95%–99% of each prompt; EPIC reports negligible or no accuracy loss, with LegoLink-2 limiting accuracy drops to 0%–7%.
reuse_metric.zh: 在評測資料集中，immutable tokens 約占每個 prompt 的 95%–99%；EPIC 報告的準確率損失可忽略或為零，且 LegoLink-2 將準確率降幅控制在 0%–7%。

title: Etalon: Holistic Performance Evaluation Framework for LLM Inference Systems
authors: Amey Agrawal; Anmol Agrawal; Nitin Kedia; Jayashree Mohan; Souvik Kundu; Nipun Kwatra; Ramachandran Ramjee; Alexey Tumanov
affiliations: Georgia Institute of Technology, Microsoft Research India, Intel AI Lab
research_focus: Long-context / Prefix cache, Speculative decoding, MoE serving, Multi-tenant scheduling, Continuous batching, Capacity planning

problem_statement.en: Conventional LLM serving metrics (TTFT, TBT, TPOT, normalised latency) fail to capture user-facing experience in real-time streaming applications. TPOT and normalised latency hide intermittent decode stalls by averaging over many tokens; TBT CDFs reveal tail spikes but not their per-request frequency or temporal position; TBT also miscounts non-uniform generators such as speculative decoding. The result is an inability to define a single SLO that reflects glitch-free user experience.
problem_statement.zh: 既有 LLM 服務評估指標（TTFT、TBT、TPOT、normalised latency）無法完整刻畫即時串流應用下的使用者體驗。TPOT 與 normalised latency 因平均掉大量 token，掩蓋了 decode 過程中的間歇性 stall；TBT CDF 雖能呈現 tail 尖峰，卻無法呈現其在單一請求中的發生頻率與時間位置；TBT 亦無法正確處理如 speculative decoding 等非均勻產生 token 的策略。導致業界難以定義一個能反映「無卡頓使用者體驗」的單一 SLO。

key_innovation.en: Two complementary user-centric metrics. fluidity-index: a deadline-based metric where each token i has deadline D_i = D_p + i*D_d; slack accumulates from early tokens and is reset on a miss; the metric reports the fraction of deadlines met per request. fluid token generation rate: the maximum sustainable throughput such that >=99% of requests achieve fluidity-index >= 0.9. Both are black-box and apply to any API endpoint, enabling apples-to-apples comparison across open-source and proprietary services.
key_innovation.zh: 提出兩項互補、以使用者為中心的指標。fluidity-index：以 deadline 為基礎的指標，第 i 個 token 的 deadline 為 D_i = D_p + i*D_d；提早產生的 token 形成 slack 並可累積、遇 miss 時清空；指標回報每筆請求中達標 deadline 的比例。fluid token generation rate：在 >=99% 請求達 fluidity-index >= 0.9 的條件下，系統可持續維持的最大吞吐量。兩者皆為 black-box，可套用於任意 API endpoint，使開源系統與專有服務得以對等比較。

baselines_compared: TTFT, TBT, TPOT, normalised latency; vLLM, Sarathi-Serve, Anyscale, Groq, Fireworks

key_improvements.en: Quantifies that vLLM suffers 3x worse tail-TBT throughput than Sarathi-Serve under chunked-prefill, a gap hidden by TPOT-based metrics. Reveals Groq tail-TBT is 4x worse than its TPOT-implied throughput suggests. At 25 ms target TBT, fluidity-index-based capacity for Llama3-8B on H100 is ~0.6 QPS for both vLLM and Sarathi-Serve, with vLLM exhibiting higher deadline-miss rate at lower percentiles.
key_improvements.zh: 量化指出在 chunked-prefill 條件下，vLLM 的 tail-TBT 吞吐量比 Sarathi-Serve 差 3x，此差距為 TPOT-based 指標所掩蓋；亦揭示 Groq 的 tail-TBT 比其 TPOT 推估值差 4x。在 25 ms target TBT、Llama3-8B 於 H100 設定下，fluidity-index 容量於 vLLM 與 Sarathi-Serve 皆約為 0.6 QPS，但 vLLM 在低百分位的 deadline-miss rate 較高。

reported_accuracy: Not Reported (black-box; not a predictive model)
validation_workloads: Arxiv-Summarization, LMSys-Chat-1M, custom prompts (256-8k tokens) against Anyscale/Groq/Fireworks

scope_assumptions.en: Black-box: not a generative latency model — Etalon measures, it does not predict. Prefill-deadline D_p must be calibrated per system by profiling prefill time as a function of input length (vLLM used as reference). A small empirical scheduling-slack term SD is required and is left to user choice; no auto-tuning. Decode targets D_d are pre-set (25 ms strict, 50 ms medium, 100 ms relaxed). Does not auto-tune system knobs (chunk size, block size). API-only proprietary systems cannot expose prefill-only timing, so prefill SLO calibration is approximate for them.
scope_assumptions.zh: Black-box；不是延遲生成模型 — Etalon 為量測而非預測。Prefill deadline D_p 需依各系統 profile prefill time 對 prompt length 的曲線單獨校準（論文以 vLLM 作為 reference）。需設定一小段經驗性的 scheduling-slack SD，由使用者決定，未提供自動化調整。Decode 目標 D_d 為預設值（25 ms 嚴格、50 ms 中等、100 ms 寬鬆）。不自動調整系統參數（chunk size、block size）。對僅提供 API 的專有系統，因無法觀測純 prefill 時間，prefill SLO 校準屬近似。

title: EVICPRESS: Joint KV-Cache Compression and Eviction for Efficient LLM Serving
authors: Shaoting Feng; Yuhan Liu; Hanchen Li; Xiaokun Chen; Samuel Shen; Kuntai Du; Zhuohan Gu; Rui Zhang; Yuyang Huang; Yihua Cheng; Jiayi Yao; Qizheng Zhang; Ganesh Ananthanarayanan; Junchen Jiang
research_focus: Datacenter networking

problem_statement.en: Existing KV cache management systems treat eviction and compression as separate, sub-optimal processes, failing to account for varying context sensitivities to lossy compression and the resulting impact on generation quality and latency.
problem_statement.zh: 現有 KV cache 管理系統將驅逐與壓縮視為各自獨立的次優流程，未能考量不同 context 對有損壓縮的敏感程度差異，以及其對生成品質與延遲的影響。

key_innovation.en: A unified utility function that quantifies the trade-off between generation quality and loading delay, enabling joint, per-context optimization of lossy compression and multi-tier eviction.
key_innovation.zh: 一套統一的效用函數，量化生成品質與載入延遲之間的取捨，從而實現對有損壓縮與多層驅逐的逐 context 聯合最優化。

baselines_compared: vLLM, LMCache, IMPRESS, Prefill, Eviction only, keydiff, knorm, snapkv

key_improvements.en: Up to 2.19x faster TTFT at equivalent quality; 1.43-3.77x TTFT reduction compared to fixed compression/eviction baselines; 2.0-3.6x higher throughput at 80% quality target.
key_improvements.zh: 在等效品質條件下 TTFT 最高加速 2.19x；相較於固定壓縮/驅逐基準，TTFT 降低 1.43–3.77x；在 80% 品質目標下吞吐量提升 2.0–3.6x。

ai_task: LLM Serving, Long-context LLM Inference

title: Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Collaboration Networks for Software Development
authors: Yue Hu; Yuzhu Cai; Yaxin Du; Xinyu Zhu; Xiangrui Liu; Zijie Yu; Yuchen Hou; Shuo Tang; Siheng Chen
research_focus: Agentic / Workflow serving, Reasoning / Test-time scaling

problem_statement.en: Existing LLM multi-agent systems for software development rely on human-designed, static agent workflows and topologies that cannot adapt to a specific task, and are evaluated mostly on function-level (not software-level) coding. The paper asks how a multi-agent collaboration network can self-evolve its agents and connections at test time for each task.
problem_statement.zh: 既有的 LLM 軟體開發多 agent 系統,依賴由人工設計的靜態 agent workflow 與拓撲,無法針對特定任務進行調適,且評測多集中於函式層級(而非軟體層級)的程式碼生成。本文探討多 agent 協作網路如何在測試時針對每個任務,自我演化其 agent 與連接關係。

key_innovation.en: EvoMAC treats a multi-agent collaboration (MAC) network as a differentiable-analog graph and introduces "textual backpropagation": a gradient agent converts unit-test execution feedback into per-agent textual gradients, and an updating agent applies them to add/remove agents, rewrite agent prompts, and restructure inter-agent connections, iteratively refining the whole network per task. It also proposes rSDE-Bench, a software-level (Website/Game) coding benchmark with automatically-verifiable requirements.
key_innovation.zh: EvoMAC 將多 agent 協作(MAC)網路視為一個可微分類比的圖結構,並提出「文字反向傳播」(textual backpropagation):由一個 gradient agent 將 unit-test 執行回饋轉換為各 agent 的文字梯度,再由一個 updating agent 據以新增/移除 agent、改寫 agent 的 prompt,並重構 agent 之間的連接,對整個網路逐任務地迭代精修。本文另提出 rSDE-Bench,一個具備可自動驗證需求的軟體層級(Website/Game)程式碼生成 benchmark。

baselines_compared: MetaGPT, AutoGen, MapCoder, AgentVerse, ChatDev, GPT-4o-Mini, Claude-3.5-Sonnet, Gemini-1.5-Flash

key_improvements.en: rSDE-Bench Website-Basic 89.38% vs 62.90% single-agent; HumanEval 94.51% (GPT-4o-Mini).
key_improvements.zh: rSDE-Bench Website-Basic 89.38% 對單 agent 62.90%;HumanEval 94.51%(GPT-4o-Mini)。

structure_space: Edge topology (spatial), Team composition (agent set), Prompts (joint)
decision_mechanism: Textual gradient (LLM feedback)
benchmarks_used: rSDE-Bench, HumanEval

agent_scenario.en: Single domain (software development). Three coordinated components, each itself a MAC network of LLM agents: a coding team (self-organized via a coding organizer agent) whose agents are dynamically assigned subtasks and whose team grows/shrinks per task via evolution, a testing team (self-organized via a testing organizer agent) that generates the target-proxy unit tests, and an updating team of two agents (a gradient agent producing textual gradients and an updating agent that edits the network). Tool: a code compiler / execution environment acts as the "environmental tool" producing execution logs. The number of coding agents is not fixed — it is set and revised per task by the textual-backpropagation loop.
agent_scenario.zh: 單一領域(軟體開發)。三個協調運作的組件,各自本身即為一個由 LLM agent 構成的 MAC 網路:一為 coding team(經由 coding organizer agent 自我組織),其 agent 動態分派子任務,團隊規模並隨演化逐任務地增減;二為 testing team(經由 testing organizer agent 自我組織),負責生成作為 target-proxy 的 unit test;三為由兩個 agent 組成的 updating team(一個 gradient agent 產生文字梯度,一個 updating agent 編修網路)。工具:程式碼 compiler /執行環境作為「環境工具」,產生執行 log。coding agent 的數量並非固定,而是由文字反向傳播迴圈逐任務地設定與修正。

title: Expected Attention: KV Cache Compression by Estimating Attention from Future Queries Distribution
authors: Alessio Devoto; Maximilian Jeblick; Simon Jégou
research_focus: KV cache compression, Long-context / Prefix cache, LLM serving

problem_statement.en: KV cache memory consumption is a major bottleneck for long-context LLM inference, yet attention-score-based pruning is impractical: attention scores from future tokens are unavailable at compression time, and Flash Attention never materializes the full attention matrix, making even past scores inaccessible.
problem_statement.zh: KV cache 的記憶體用量是長 context LLM 推理的主要瓶頸；然而基於 attention 分數的剪枝在實務上難以落地：壓縮當下無法取得未來 token 的 attention 分數，且 Flash Attention 不會實體化完整的 attention 矩陣，連過去的分數也無從存取。

key_innovation.en: Expected Attention: a training-free compression method that models future queries as a Gaussian distribution (exploiting the near-Gaussian statistics of LLM hidden states) and computes each KV pair's expected attention score in closed form via the moment-generating function, weighting by the value-vector norm to rank and evict low-impact KV pairs in both prefill and decode. Also releases KVPress, a PyTorch library benchmarking 20+ KV cache compression methods with a public leaderboard.
key_innovation.zh: Expected Attention：一種 training-free 壓縮方法，利用 LLM hidden state 近似 Gaussian 分佈的統計特性，將未來 query 建模為 Gaussian 分佈，並透過 moment-generating function 以閉式解計算每個 KV pair 的期望 attention 分數，再結合 value 向量範數對 KV pair 排序並剔除低影響者，同時適用於 prefill 與 decode。另開源 KVPress：以 PyTorch 實作、收錄 20 餘種 KV cache 壓縮方法並附公開 leaderboard 的基準測試函式庫。

baselines_compared: SnapKV, TOVA, KeyDiff, DuoAttention, KNorm, StreamingLLM, Q-Filters

key_improvements.en: Prunes up to 60% of the KV cache while preserving quality; at 50% compression matches the uncompressed baseline on needle-in-a-haystack while halving KV cache size; saves up to 15 GB peak memory at 120k context on Llama3.1-8B; consistently outperforms baselines across both prefill and decode.
key_improvements.zh: 可剪除最多 60% 的 KV cache 而維持品質；在 50% 壓縮率下於 needle-in-a-haystack 測試與未壓縮基準持平，同時將 KV cache 大小減半；Llama3.1-8B 於 120k context 下峰值記憶體最多節省 15 GB；在 prefill 與 decode 兩種情境均一致優於各基準方法。

ai_task: KV Cache Compression, LLM Serving

title: Exploring CXL-based KV Cache Storage for LLM Serving
authors: Yupeng Tang; Runxiang Cheng; Ping Zhou; Tongping Liu; Fei Liu; Wei Tang; Kyoungryun Bae; Jianjun Chen; Wu Xiang; Rui Shi
affiliations: Yale University, University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign, ByteDance
research_focus: Long-context / Prefix cache, Datacenter networking, GPU memory tiering

problem_statement.en: LLM serving systems face memory bottlenecks when storing KV cache for long-context requests, which can overwhelm GPU and host memory and limit throughput.
problem_statement.zh: LLM serving 系統在儲存長 context 請求的 KV cache 時面臨記憶體瓶頸，可能耗盡 GPU 與主機記憶體，進而限制吞吐量。

key_innovation.en: Leveraging CXL-based memory expansion to store and offload KV cache, enabling direct data transfer between CXL memory and GPU via PCIe.
key_innovation.zh: 藉由 CXL 記憶體擴展來儲存與卸載 KV cache，實現 CXL 記憶體與 GPU 之間透過 PCIe 的直接資料傳輸。

baselines_compared: Full KV re-compute, Prefix caching with GPU

key_improvements.en: 30% increase in batch size, 87% reduction in GPU requirements, 7.5x higher GPU utilization for prefill
key_improvements.zh: batch size 提升 30%、GPU 需求減少 87%、prefill 的 GPU 利用率提升 7.5x。

ai_task: LLM Serving, KV Cache storage
compute_memory_hw: Intel Xeon Platinum, NVIDIA H100, CXL memory expansion card (256 GB DDR5)

title: Fairness-Aware and Latency-Controllable Scheduling for Chunked-Prefill LLM Serving
authors: Haoxin Liu; Jiayi Wang; Yueshen Xu; Rui Li
research_focus: LLM serving, Multi-tenant scheduling, Continuous batching, Performance modeling

problem_statement.en: In chunked-prefill LLM serving, the default FCFS policy degrades fairness under mixed workloads — short requests suffer chunk-level head-of-line blocking while long requests risk starvation — and static token budgets ignore that identical token counts can incur very different execution times, causing unpredictable latency jitter and low GPU utilization.
problem_statement.zh: 在 chunked-prefill 的 LLM serving 中，預設的 FCFS 排程在混合工作負載下造成公平性劣化：短請求受 chunk 層級的 head-of-line blocking 影響，長請求則面臨飢餓風險；同時靜態 token budget 忽略相同 token 數可能對應差異極大的執行時間，導致延遲抖動不可預測且 GPU 利用率偏低。

key_innovation.en: Three lightweight scheduling mechanisms atop Sarathi-Serve: (1) an aging policy that ranks prefill candidates by P_i = α·(waiting time) + β·(remaining prefill tokens), maintained via a max-heap in O(k log n); (2) LPRS, which replaces the static token budget with an offline-trained MLP batch-latency predictor and a discrete chunk-size search that minimizes deviation from a target latency budget; (3) APC, a dynamic activity cap with minimum-effective-progress and warm-start rules that suppresses fragmented prefill chunks.
key_innovation.zh: 在 Sarathi-Serve 之上的三個輕量排程機制：(1) Aging 策略以 P_i = α·等待時間 + β·剩餘 prefill tokens 排序 prefill 候選請求，透過 max-heap 以 O(k log n) 維護；(2) LPRS 以離線訓練的 MLP batch 延遲預測器取代靜態 token budget，並以離散搜尋選擇 chunk 大小、最小化與目標延遲預算的偏差；(3) APC 以動態 activity cap、最小有效進度與 warm-start 規則抑制碎片化的 prefill chunk。

key_improvements.en: Aging reduces mean E2E latency by over 10% (10.24%) and mean TTFT by 11.27% vs FCFS at 256-token chunks; under high concurrency LPRS cuts P99 prefill latency from 924.22 ms to 889.45 ms; APC reduces mean request E2E latency by 22.26% and P90 by 24.62% while raising average prefill chunk size from 0.78 to 6.29.
key_improvements.zh: Aging 在 256-token chunk 下較 FCFS 降低平均 E2E 延遲逾 10%（10.24%）、平均 TTFT 降低 11.27%；高並發下 LPRS 將 P99 prefill 延遲由 924.22 ms 降至 889.45 ms；APC 使平均請求 E2E 延遲降低 22.26%、P90 降低 24.62%，並將平均 prefill chunk 大小由 0.78 提升至 6.29。

compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA RTX 4090, NVIDIA RTX 5090, NVIDIA RTX PRO 5000, Huawei Ascend 910B
gpu_count: 1x RTX 4090 / 2x RTX 5090 / 1x RTX PRO 5000 / 1x Ascend 910B (per experiment)
reported_accuracy: MAPE 1.26% (MAE 1.13 ms, RMSE 1.53 ms; 99% of predictions within 5 ms)
validation_workloads: ShareGPT, Synthetic (49:1 short:long prompt mix for APC)

scope_assumptions.en: The latency predictor is trained offline per deployment from 36,868 profiled scheduling rounds on the same hardware; LPRS/APC experiments fix TP=PP=1 on a single GPU; validation is limited to 8B-scale models, sequences up to 4,096 tokens, and single-node scale — the authors defer larger models, longer contexts, multi-node deployment, and multi-tenant settings to future work.
scope_assumptions.zh: 延遲預測器需針對部署環境離線訓練（在相同硬體上蒐集 36,868 筆排程回合樣本）；LPRS/APC 實驗固定 TP=PP=1、僅使用單一 GPU；驗證僅涵蓋 8B 規模模型、最長 4,096 tokens 的序列與單節點規模——作者將更大模型、更長 context、多節點部署與多租戶情境列為未來工作。

title: Faster MoE LLM Inference for Extremely Large Models
authors: Haoqi Yang; Luohe Shi; Qiwei Li; Zuchao Li; Ping Wang; Bo Du; Mengjia Shen; Hai Zhao
affiliations: Wuhan University, Wuhan Second Ship Design And Research Institute, Shanghai Jiao Tong University
research_focus: MoE serving, Multi-tenant scheduling, Continuous batching, Performance modeling, Roofline analysis

problem_statement.en: Fine-grained MoE LLMs such as DeepSeek-V2 and DeepSeek-V3 (64-256 experts with 6-8 activated per token) are gaining popularity, but their inference efficiency dynamics under varying batch sizes are poorly understood, and it is unclear how reducing the number of activated experts n_a or the total experts n_e trades off MoE efficiency against language modeling performance.
problem_statement.zh: DeepSeek-V2 與 DeepSeek-V3 等 fine-grained MoE LLM（64 至 256 個 expert、每 token 啟用 6 至 8 個）逐漸普及，但其在不同批次大小下的推理效率動態尚未被充分研究；同時，減少 activated expert 數 n_a 或總 expert 數 n_e 如何在 MoE 效率與語言建模性能間取捨，目前仍不清楚。

key_innovation.en: A roofline-based analytical efficiency model for fine-grained MoE inference that derives per-token arithmetic intensity AI(d, d_i, L) = 6L(d_i * d) / (3d_i d + 2L(d_i + d)), reveals a weakened batch effect (MoE is inherently not faster than FFN at the same activated parameter count because additional experts must be loaded as tokens increase), and uses this model to motivate expert skipping (reducing n_a per token) and pre-inference expert pruning (reducing n_e globally) as orthogonal acceleration strategies. The paper further introduces soft count expert pruning that uses gate-score-weighted activation counts to select retained experts.
key_innovation.zh: 以 roofline 為基礎、針對 fine-grained MoE 推理的分析式效率模型，導出每 token 的 arithmetic intensity AI(d, d_i, L) = 6L(d_i * d) / (3d_i d + 2L(d_i + d))，揭示 MoE 的 weakened batch effect（在相同 activated parameter 下，MoE 並非天生比 FFN 快，因為 token 增加時必須額外載入更多 expert），並以此模型推導出兩條彼此正交的加速策略：expert skipping（降低每 token 的 n_a）與 pre-inference expert pruning（全域降低 n_e）。論文並提出以 gate score 加權 activation count 進行 expert 篩選的 soft count pruning 方法。

baselines_compared: FFN/dense (roofline reference), Random pruning, Structured pruning (odd/even/first-half/last-half indices), Activate Count pruning, Soft Count pruning (Muzio et al.), Hard Count pruning

key_improvements.en: Expert skipping increases throughput by at least 10% on DeepSeek-V3 with no performance loss; up to 50% speedup observed at low concurrency when n_a = 2. Pre-inference expert pruning yields up to 2.3x speedup at low throughput. Soft count pruning consistently outperforms random and structured pruning: retaining 48 of 64 experts (DeepSeek-V2-Lite) gives 64.2% average benchmark score versus a 66.0 baseline, while random selection drops to 60.7%.
key_improvements.zh: Expert skipping 在 DeepSeek-V3 上提升吞吐至少 10% 且無性能損失；n_a = 2 時於低 concurrency 觀察到最高 50% 加速。Pre-inference expert pruning 在低吞吐條件下提供最高 2.3x 加速。Soft count pruning 一致優於 random 與 structured pruning：在 DeepSeek-V2-Lite 上保留 64 個 expert 中的 48 個時，平均 benchmark 分數 64.2，相較 baseline 66.0 僅微幅下降，而 random selection 則降至 60.7。

reported_accuracy: Not Reported
validation_workloads: ARC (Easy and Challenge), BoolQ, OpenBookQA, RTE, Winogrande, Synthetic (1024 input tokens + 1024 output tokens)

scope_assumptions.en: Model assumes intra-node NVLink bandwidth around 160 GB/s and inter-node InfiniBand around 50 GB/s as a baseline for EP analysis; analysis focuses on FFN/MoE blocks and treats shared experts and attention as a fixed backbone; expert pruning experiments use SGLang with a specific version, and at concurrency 192 throughput after expert reduction unexpectedly decreased, attributed to a possible underlying SGLang strategy switch.
scope_assumptions.zh: EP 分析以節點內 NVLink 約 160 GB/s 與跨節點 InfiniBand 約 50 GB/s 作為基線；分析聚焦於 FFN 與 MoE block，將 shared expert 與 attention 視為固定 backbone；expert pruning 實驗使用特定版本的 SGLang，在 concurrency 192 時觀察到 expert 縮減後吞吐反而下降，作者推測可能與 SGLang 內部策略切換有關。

title: FASTPS: A Fast Publish-Subscribe service using RDMA
authors: Arjun Balasubramanian; Mohammed Danish Shaikh
venue_full: International Journal of Applied Earth Observation and Geoinformation
research_focus: Datacenter networking, RDMA / Transport

problem_statement.en: Existing Queue Management Systems (QMS) suffer from CPU bottlenecks when handling heavy fan-out structures and struggle to provide both low latency and high throughput for modern ephemeral data workloads.
problem_statement.zh: 現有佇列管理系統（QMS）在處理大規模扇出結構時面臨 CPU 瓶頸，難以同時為現代短暫性資料工作負載提供低延遲與高吞吐量。

key_innovation.en: A publish-subscribe service that deeply integrates RDMA one-sided reads and writes to bypass remote CPU involvement for data access and polling, enabling efficient fan-out and low-latency communication.
key_innovation.zh: 一套深度整合 RDMA 單側讀寫的發布-訂閱服務，藉由繞過遠端 CPU 介入來處理資料存取與輪詢，從而實現高效扇出與低延遲通訊。

ai_task: Distributed ML training, Parameter Server model, Reinforcement Learning

title: Flow-Controlled Scheduling for LLM Inference with Provable Stability Guarantees
authors: Zhuolun Dong; Junyu Cao
affiliations: The University of Texas at Austin
research_focus: Multi-tenant scheduling, Continuous batching, Length prediction, Performance modeling, Queueing theory

problem_statement.en: Real-world LLM inference faces stochastic arrivals with heterogeneous input and output lengths; aggregate KV-cache memory under continuous batching fluctuates sharply and can trigger preemption or dropping, yet existing scheduling logic is heuristic and lacks provable stability guarantees.
problem_statement.zh: 真實世界 LLM 推理面對隨機到達與異質輸入/輸出長度，continuous batching 下 KV cache 聚合用量劇烈波動，易觸發搶佔或丟棄；既有 scheduling 策略多為啟發式，缺乏可證明的穩定性保證。

key_innovation.en: A discrete-time token-level queueing model of an LLM serving system with a KV-cache budget M, plus a flow-control admission policy that caps activation rate per request class to b_k > lambda_k. Derives a necessary condition for stability of any policy and proves sufficient conditions under which the proposed policy attains stability; Nested LIFO eviction handles unknown output lengths.
key_innovation.zh: 建立離散時間 token-level queueing 模型刻畫 KV cache 預算 M 之 LLM 服務系統，並提出 flow-control admission 策略，將每類別請求啟用速率限制為 b_k > lambda_k。導出任意策略穩定的必要條件，並證明該策略於充分條件下達穩定；未知輸出長度時採 LIFO 驅逐處理。

baselines_compared: alpha-protection greedy, MC benchmark, MC-SF, Amin algorithm, Hindsight optimal (Gurobi)

key_improvements.en: Outperforms alpha-greedy, MC benchmark, MC-SF (known output) and Amin (unknown output) on average latency, P95 latency, request throughput, and token throughput across all simulated T in [200, 1000]; achieves performance close to hindsight-optimal integer-programming solution.
key_improvements.zh: 在 T 介於 200 至 1000 的所有模擬區間，於平均延遲、P95 延遲、request throughput 與 token throughput 皆優於 alpha-greedy、MC benchmark、MC-SF（已知輸出）與 Amin（未知輸出）；性能接近 Gurobi 求解的 hindsight-optimal 整數規劃解。

reported_accuracy: Theoretical: overflow events bounded by T * exp(-C(A, epsilon) M^2)
models_validated: Llama-2-70B (scale reference for M = 16492 on 2x A100)
validation_workloads: Synthetic (Poisson arrivals, three prefill/decode classes), real-world dataset with over 210000 prompts (50000 sampled)

scope_assumptions.en: Discrete time-slotted model on a single computational worker with hard KV-cache budget M = 16492 (matching Llama-2-70B on 2x A100). Continuous-time evaluation uses Microsoft Vidur for process times; Poisson arrivals throughout. Algorithm 2 requires bounded input/output lengths. Activation budget b is grid-searched; small b is conservative, large b degenerates to greedy with LIFO eviction.
scope_assumptions.zh: 單一運算節點離散時隙模型，硬性 KV cache 預算 M = 16492（對應 Llama-2-70B 於 2x A100）；連續時間評估採 Microsoft Vidur 計算 process time，且全篇假設 Poisson 到達。Algorithm 2 要求輸入/輸出長度有上界。啟用預算 b 採網格搜尋：b 過小則保守、b 過大則退化為 greedy 加 LIFO 驅逐。

title: FlowKV: A Disaggregated Inference Framework with Low-Latency KV Cache Transfer and Load-Aware Scheduling
authors: Weiqing Li; Guochao Jiang; Xiangyong Ding; Zhangcheng Tao; Chuzhan Hao; Chenfeng Xu; Yuewei Zhang; Hao Wang
research_focus: Multi-tenant scheduling, PD disaggregation, Datacenter networking, Routing / Load balancing

problem_statement.en: Disaggregated LLM inference suffers from high KV cache transfer latency due to fragmented memory allocation and inefficient communication kernels, alongside computational imbalances between prefill and decode nodes.
problem_statement.zh: 解耦式 LLM inference 因記憶體分配碎片化與低效通訊 kernel，導致 KV cache 傳輸延遲高，且 prefill 與 decode 節點之間存在計算失衡。

key_innovation.en: FlowKV introduces a KV cache structure optimization that enables contiguous tensor transfers to minimize NCCL calls, combined with a Load-Aware Scheduler for dynamic request routing and flexible node role allocation.
key_innovation.zh: FlowKV 引入 KV cache 結構優化，使連續張量傳輸成為可能，以最小化 NCCL 呼叫次數；並搭配負載感知 scheduler，實現動態請求路由與靈活的節點角色分配。

key_improvements.en: 96% reduction in average KV cache transfer latency, 15.2%-48.9% inference acceleration on LongBench, and 25%-95% throughput improvement depending on the baseline.
key_improvements.zh: 平均 KV cache 傳輸延遲降低 96%；在 LongBench 上 inference 加速 15.2%–48.9%；依基準線不同，吞吐量提升 25%–95%。

ai_task: LLM Serving, Disaggregated Prefill/Decoding

title: FlowReasoner: Reinforcing Query-Level Meta-Agents
authors: Hongcheng Gao; Yue Liu; Yufei He; Longxu Dou; Chao Du; Zhijie Deng; Bryan Hooi; Min Lin; Tianyu Pang
research_focus: Agentic / Workflow serving, Reasoning / Test-time scaling

problem_statement.en: Existing automated multi-agent-system (MAS) design methods search or optimize a single workflow at the task/domain level, so every query in a task is served by the same fixed system. The paper targets query-level MAS design: automatically producing one bespoke, personalized multi-agent workflow tailored to each individual user query rather than one system per task.
problem_statement.zh: 現有的自動化多智能體系統(MAS)設計方法在任務層級或領域層級搜尋或最佳化單一 workflow,因此同一任務中的每個 query 均由相同的固定系統處理。本文著眼於 query 層級的 MAS 設計:針對每一則使用者 query 自動產生一套量身訂製、個人化的多智能體 workflow,而非為每個任務提供單一系統。

key_innovation.en: A query-level meta-agent (FlowReasoner) that first acquires MAS-construction reasoning by distilling DeepSeek-R1, then is refined with reinforcement learning (GRPO) on external execution feedback under a multi-objective reward (pass-rate performance + AST complexity + workflow diversity/efficiency), so at inference it reasons deliberatively and generates a fresh multi-agent system per query.
key_innovation.zh: 本文提出一個 query 層級的 meta-agent(FlowReasoner):首先透過蒸餾 DeepSeek-R1 取得 MAS 建構的推理能力,再於外部執行回饋之上,以 RL(GRPO)在多目標獎勵(pass-rate 表現 + AST 複雜度 + workflow 多樣性/效率)下進一步精煉,使其在推論階段進行審慎推理,並為每一則 query 生成一套全新的多智能體系統。

baselines_compared: o1-mini, GPT-4o-mini, Self-Refine, LLM-Debate, LLM-Blender, AutoAgents, ADAS, Aflow, MaAS

key_improvements.en: 81.89% over 3 coding benchmarks: +5.08 vs MaAS, +10.52 vs vanilla o1-mini.
key_improvements.zh: 三個程式碼評測整體 81.89%:較 MaAS +5.08,較原生 o1-mini +10.52。

structure_space: Workflow code, Operator / node graph
decision_mechanism: Policy gradient / REINFORCE, Trained generator (SFT)
benchmarks_used: BigCodeBench, HumanEval, MBPP

agent_scenario.en: One trained query-level meta-agent that, per user query, generates and then iteratively refines a bespoke multi-agent workflow. The generated workflow composes worker roles from a fixed six-operator set (Code Generator, Format Generator, Review, Revise, Ensemble, Code Test) executed by an underlying worker LLM (o1-mini in the main setting; also Qwen2.5-Coder-32B, Claude 3.5, GPT-4o-mini in generalization tests). Single domain: code generation. Protocol: deliberative reasoning to emit the MAS as Python code, followed by external-execution-feedback-driven iterative optimization with the iteration count fixed at 10.
agent_scenario.zh: 一個經訓練的 query 層級 meta-agent,針對每一則使用者 query 生成並隨後迭代精煉一套量身訂製的多智能體 workflow。所生成的 workflow 由固定的六個 operator 集合(Code Generator、Format Generator、Review、Revise、Ensemble、Code Test)組合出 worker 角色,並由底層 worker LLM 執行(主要設定為 o1-mini;泛化測試中另含 Qwen2.5-Coder-32B、Claude 3.5、GPT-4o-mini)。單一領域:程式碼生成。協定:以審慎推理將 MAS 產出為 Python 程式碼,隨後進行由外部執行回饋驅動的迭代最佳化,迭代次數固定為 10。

title: Frontier: Simulating the Next Generation of LLM Inference Systems
authors: Yicheng Feng; Xin Tan; Kin Hang Sew; Yimin Jiang; Yibo Zhu; Hong Xu
venue_full: SIGCOMM Workshop on Networks for AI Computing (DOI 10.1145/3766882.3767173)
affiliations: The Chinese University of Hong Kong, StepFun
research_focus: MoE serving, Multi-tenant scheduling, PD disaggregation, Continuous batching, Capacity planning, Performance modeling, Routing / Load balancing, Hardware co-design

problem_statement.en: Existing LLM inference simulators such as Vidur and LLMServingSim are built around a replica-centric abstraction that cannot natively represent disaggregated PD/AF architectures, MoE expert-parallelism, or system-level policies; their single-proxy-length attention surrogate also exhibits errors above 55% on batches with skewed sequence lengths.
problem_statement.zh: Vidur、LLMServingSim 等既有 LLM 推理模擬器以 replica 為中心進行抽象，無法原生表達 disaggregated PD/AF 架構、MoE expert parallelism 與系統層級策略；其以單一 proxy length 近似 attention 的方式在序列長度差異大的 batch 上誤差可超過 55%。

key_innovation.en: A stage-centric, event-driven simulator with a GlobalController + ClusterWorker hierarchy that natively models PD/AF disaggregation, MoE expert routing and GroupedGEMM straggler effects; uses a random-forest-based ExecutionPredictor over distributional sequence-length features and pluggable scheduling policies for vLLM/SGLang/TRT-LLM-style engines.
key_innovation.zh: 提出以階段為中心、事件驅動的模擬器，採用 GlobalController 與 ClusterWorker 階層架構，原生建模 PD/AF disaggregation、MoE expert routing 與 GroupedGEMM straggler 效應；以 random forest 為基礎的 ExecutionPredictor 利用序列長度的分布特徵建模，並提供可插拔的排程策略以模擬 vLLM、SGLang 與 TRT-LLM 等引擎。

key_improvements.en: Over 94% of Attention operator cases under 10% relative error and over 95% of GroupedGEMM cases under 6%, versus Vidur's >55% Attention error on skewed batches; end-to-end throughput prediction within 19.0%-23.2% relative error on a PD-disaggregated system.
key_improvements.zh: Attention 運算子超過 94% 的案例相對誤差小於 10%、GroupedGEMM 超過 95% 的案例小於 6%；相較 Vidur 在序列長度不均的 batch 上 Attention 誤差超過 55%；於 PD-disaggregated 系統上之端到端吞吐量預測的相對誤差落在 19.0% 至 23.2% 之間。

reported_accuracy: Attention >94% cases <10% error; GroupedGEMM >95% cases <6% error; end-to-end 19.0%-23.2% throughput error
validation_workloads: Synthetic batches sweeping batch size 4-32 with avg input 32-256 and output 128-1024 tokens; vLLM 0.10.1 with SharedStorageConnector KV interface

scope_assumptions.en: Operator-level focus on Attention and GroupedGEMM only; end-to-end validation limited to Qwen2-7B-Instruct and a 1:1 PD ratio; relies on pluggable scheduler/batching modules and ExecutionPredictor calibration per cluster.
scope_assumptions.zh: Operator 層級僅聚焦於 Attention 與 GroupedGEMM；端到端驗證僅限於 Qwen2-7B-Instruct 與 1:1 的 PD 比例；倚賴每個叢集的 ExecutionPredictor 校準，以及可插拔的 scheduler 與 batching 模組。

title: From Prefix Cache to Fusion RAG Cache: Accelerating LLM Inference in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
authors: Jiahao Wang; Weiyu Xie; Mingxing Zhang; Boxing Zhang; Jianwei Dong; Yuening Zhu; Chen Lin; Jinqi Tang; Yaochen Han; Zhiyuan Ai; Xianglin Chen; Yongwei Wu; Congfeng Jiang
venue_full: Proceedings of the ACM on Management of Data (SIGMOD 2026)
affiliations: Hangzhou Dianzi University, Tsinghua University, Approaching.AI
research_focus: LLM serving, Long-context / Prefix cache

problem_statement.en: RAG appends retrieved chunks to prompts, making prefill dominate end-to-end latency (95.53% of inference time on Musique). Chunk-wise KVCache reuse (Full Reuse) discards cross-attention between chunks and severely degrades generation quality, while existing selective-recomputation methods (CacheBlend, Cache-Craft) fail to restore quality at low recomputation ratios.
problem_statement.zh: RAG 將檢索到的 text chunk 附加至 prompt，使 prefill 主導端到端延遲（在 Musique 上占推理時間的 95.53%）。以 chunk 為單位的 KVCache 重用（Full Reuse）喪失 chunk 之間的 cross-attention，導致生成品質顯著下降；既有的選擇性重算方法（CacheBlend、Cache-Craft）在低重算比例下亦難以恢復品質。

key_innovation.en: FusionRAG optimizes both stages of two-stage RAG caching: offline Similarity-Guided Preliminary Cross-attention Preprocessing embeds information from each chunk's top-n most similar chunks into its cached KV, while online Query-Guided Selection picks critical tokens via the model's own query-key attention instead of position-biased KV deviation. System support includes Alternative Path prefix-cache matching (one KVCache replica per chunk), an asynchronous KVCache scheduler over a disk-CPU-GPU hierarchy, and the Q-Sparse-Attn Triton kernel for batched sparse recomputation.
key_innovation.zh: FusionRAG 同時優化 two-stage RAG cache 的兩個階段：離線階段以 Similarity-Guided Preliminary Cross-attention Preprocessing 將每個 chunk 的 top-n 相似 chunk 資訊嵌入其快取 KV；線上階段以 Query-Guided Selection 依模型自身的 query-key attention（而非受位置偏差影響的 KV deviation）挑選關鍵 token。系統層面則提供 Alternative Path prefix cache 匹配（每個 chunk 僅保留一份 KVCache 副本）、跨 disk-CPU-GPU 階層的非同步 KVCache scheduler，以及支援批次稀疏重算的 Q-Sparse-Attn Triton kernel。

baselines_compared: Full Attention, Full Reuse, CacheBlend, Cache-Craft, FlashAttention, SDPA

key_improvements.en: By recomputing fewer than 15% of tokens, achieves up to 70% higher Normalized-F1 than CacheBlend/Cache-Craft; reduces TTFT by 2.66-9.39x versus Full Attention; delivers 1.2-4.3x throughput in multi-question serving.
key_improvements.zh: 在重算不到 15% token 的情況下，Normalized-F1 較 CacheBlend/Cache-Craft 最高提升 70%；TTFT 較 Full Attention 降低 2.66-9.39x；多問題服務情境下吞吐量提升 1.2-4.3x。

ai_task: LLM Serving, RAG

title: G-Designer: Architecting Multi-agent Communication Topologies via Graph Neural Networks
authors: Guibin Zhang; Yanwei Yue; Xiangguo Sun; Guancheng Wan; Miao Yu; Junfeng Fang; Kun Wang; Tianlong Chen; Dawei Cheng
research_focus: Agentic / Workflow serving, Reasoning / Test-time scaling

problem_statement.en: Existing LLM multi-agent systems use hand-crafted or fixed communication topologies (chain/star/tree/complete graph) that are neither task-adaptive nor token-efficient, and are fragile to adversarial agents. The paper asks how to automatically design a task-aware, sparse, robust inter-agent communication topology per query.
problem_statement.zh: 現有 LLM multi-agent 系統採用人工設計或固定的通訊 topology(chain/star/tree/complete graph),既無法隨任務調適,亦不具 token 效率,且對 adversarial agent 相當脆弱。本文探討如何針對每一 query,自動設計出具任務感知能力、稀疏且穩健的 agent 間通訊 topology。

key_innovation.en: A variational graph auto-encoder (VGAE) encodes agent nodes plus a task-specific virtual node (the encoded query) and decodes a customized directed communication topology per query, trained end-to-end with a policy-gradient task-utility loss plus a nuclear-norm sparsity regularizer so graph complexity scales with task difficulty.
key_innovation.zh: 本文提出一套 variational graph auto-encoder(VGAE):其編碼 agent 節點以及一個任務專屬的 virtual node(即編碼後的 query),並針對每一 query 解碼出量身訂製的有向通訊 topology。整體以 end-to-end 方式訓練,採用 policy-gradient 的任務效用損失,並加入 nuclear-norm 稀疏正則項,使圖的複雜度隨任務難度而縮放。

baselines_compared: Vanilla, CoT, ComplexCoT, Self-Consistency, PHP, Chain, Star, Tree, Complete Graph, Random Graph

key_improvements.en: Best average on the 6-benchmark harness (MMLU 84.50%); up to 95.33% token reduction on HumanEval.
key_improvements.zh: 六評測組平均最佳(MMLU 84.50%);HumanEval token 最多減少 95.33%。

structure_space: Edge topology (spatial)
decision_mechanism: Graph neural generator (GNN/VAE), Differentiable mask / pruning, Policy gradient / REINFORCE
backbone_models: all-MiniLM-L6-v2 (text encoder for node features, D=384)
benchmarks_used: MMLU, GSM8K, MultiArith, SVAMP, AQuA, HumanEval

agent_scenario.en: Default N=5 gpt-4 agents collaborating over K=3 dialogue rounds on a per-query directed communication graph; each agent node has attributes (base LLM, role, state, plugins) and a task-specific virtual node (encoded query) is bidirectionally linked to all agents as an information sink. Single-domain: the VGAE is trained separately per benchmark (only 40 queries each). Tasks span general reasoning, math, and code generation.
agent_scenario.zh: 預設為 N=5 個 gpt-4 agents,在每一 query 專屬的有向通訊圖上,經 K=3 輪對話進行協作;每一 agent 節點具備屬性(base LLM、角色、狀態、plugins),而一個任務專屬的 virtual node(編碼後的 query)則與所有 agent 雙向連結,作為資訊匯集點(information sink)。單領域設定:VGAE 針對每一 benchmark 分別訓練(每項僅 40 個 query)。任務涵蓋一般推理、數學與程式碼生成。

title: Demystifying AI Platform Design for Distributed Inference of Next-Generation LLM models
authors: Abhimanyu Rajeshkumar Bambhaniya; Ritik Raj; Geonhwa Jeong; Souvik Kundu; Sudarshan Srinivasan; Suvinay Subramanian; Midhilesh Elavazhagan; Madhu Kumar; Tushar Krishna
affiliations: Georgia Institute of Technology, Meta, Intel Labs, Intel, Google
research_focus: Long-context / Prefix cache, Speculative decoding, Reasoning / Test-time scaling, MoE serving, Continuous batching, Quantization, Capacity planning, Performance modeling, Roofline analysis, Hardware co-design, GPU memory tiering

problem_statement.en: Designing AI platforms for LLM inference requires jointly reasoning about diverse model architectures (dense, GQA, MoE, Mamba), serving optimizations (chunked prefill, speculative decoding, quantization, KV pruning) and hardware design choices (HBM size, ICN bandwidth, parallelism), but no existing analytical tool spans this full design space across both prefill and decode.
problem_statement.zh: 為 LLM 推理設計 AI 平台需同時考量多樣的模型架構（dense、GQA、MoE、Mamba）、serving 優化（chunked prefill、speculative decoding、quantization、KV pruning）與硬體設計選擇（HBM 容量、ICN 頻寬、parallelism），但既有分析工具均無法在 prefill 與 decode 兩階段上覆蓋此完整設計空間。

key_innovation.en: GenZ, an analytical framework combining a Model Profiler, NPU Characterizer and Platform Characterizer; it uses a roofline-based per-operator model with measured efficiency factors to estimate TTFT/TPOT/latency/utilization/energy under TP+PP+EP parallelism with multi-level memory and ICN topologies, plus collective costs via ASTRA-sim integration.
key_innovation.zh: GenZ 是結合 Model Profiler、NPU Characterizer 與 Platform Characterizer 的分析式框架；採用 roofline-based 的 per-operator 模型與量測得到的效率因子，估算 TP+PP+EP 平行化下的 TTFT、TPOT、延遲、利用率與能耗，並透過整合 ASTRA-sim 估算 collective 通訊成本。

key_improvements.en: Validated against measurements on 8x NVIDIA H100, 2x A100, Intel Gaudi2, AMD MI300X and 8x Sambanova SN40L achieving a geomean error of 5.82% across architectures; prefill/decode geomean errors of 2.73% and 1.85% on NVIDIA platforms, 1.43% for chunked-prefill on 2x A100.
key_improvements.zh: 在 8x NVIDIA H100、2x A100、Intel Gaudi2、AMD MI300X 與 8x Sambanova SN40L 上驗證，跨架構幾何平均誤差為 5.82%；NVIDIA 平台 prefill 與 decode 的幾何平均誤差分別為 2.73% 與 1.85%，2x A100 上的 chunked-prefill 為 1.43%。

compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA H100, NVIDIA A100, NVIDIA V100, AMD MI300X, Intel Gaudi2, Sambanova SN40L, HBM
gpu_count: Up to 8x H100, 2x A100, 1x MI300X, 1x Gaudi2, 8x SN40L
reported_accuracy: Geomean error 5.82% (latency); 2.73%/1.85% prefill/decode
models_validated: Llama-2-7B, Llama-2-13B, Llama-3-8B, Llama-3.1-8B, Llama-3.1-70B, OPT-175B, Mixtral-8x22B, GPT-3, Gemma-2-2B/27B, Mamba
validation_workloads: Synthetic (input 512-2048, output 200, batch 1-32); LLM-Inference-Bench data

scope_assumptions.en: Assumes static load-balanced expert routing for MoE prefill; non-overlapping compute and collectives by default; efficiency factors derived from A100 runtimes and extrapolated; does not model dynamic expert imbalance, dynamic batching, or training workloads.
scope_assumptions.zh: MoE prefill 階段假設 expert 路由靜態且負載均衡；預設 compute 與 collective 不重疊；效率因子源自 A100 量測並外推；不建模動態 expert 不均、動態 batching 或訓練負載。

title: GoodServe: Towards High-Goodput Serving of Agentic LLM Inferences over Heterogeneous Resources
authors: Boxiao Du; Boning Huangfu; Yizhou Luo; Chen Chen; Zijun Li; Minchen Yu; Xiaoyi Fan; Minyi Guo
affiliations: Shanghai Jiao Tong University, The Chinese University of Hong Kong (Shenzhen), Shenzhen MSU-BIT University
research_focus: LLM serving, Agentic / Workflow serving, Multi-tenant scheduling, Routing / Load balancing, Length prediction, Performance modeling

problem_statement.en: Agentic LLM inferences require fully-formed outputs, making end-to-end latency (TTLT) SLOs the key service metric rather than TTFT/TPOT. On heterogeneous GPU pools, existing request-routing strategies (random, round-robin, least-request, prefix-cache, Llumnix, Preble) are SLO-agnostic and, given highly uncertain decode lengths and fluctuating instance capability, fail to attain high goodput.
problem_statement.zh: Agentic LLM inference 需要完整生成的輸出，因此關鍵服務指標是端到端延遲（TTLT）SLO 而非 TTFT/TPOT。在異質 GPU 資源池上，既有的 request routing 策略（random、round-robin、least-request、prefix-cache、Llumnix、Preble）對 SLO 無感知，加上 decode 長度高度不確定與 instance 能力動態波動，難以達成高 goodput。

key_innovation.en: A predict-and-rectify goodput-centric router: a Mixture-of-Experts-style ensemble of small MLPs (TF-IDF features, 45.1M parameters, K=9 experts) predicts request output length; EMA-smoothed black-box profiling estimates each GPU's queuing/prefill/decode coefficients; a just-enough heuristic routes each request to the least-capable instance that still meets its E2E-SLO (O(M) per request), with periodic SLO-risk re-checks triggering token-ID-based (rather than KV-cache) request migration.
key_innovation.zh: 以 predict-and-rectify 方式運作的 goodput 導向 router：以 Mixture-of-Experts 式小型 MLP ensemble（TF-IDF 特徵、共 45.1M 參數、K=9 個 experts）預測請求輸出長度；以 EMA 平滑的 black-box profiling 估計各 GPU 的 queuing/prefill/decode 係數；just-enough 啟發式將請求路由到仍能滿足其 E2E-SLO 的最弱 instance（每請求 O(M)），並定期重估 SLO 違約風險，必要時觸發以 token ID（而非 KV cache）傳輸的 request migration。

baselines_compared: Random, Round-robin, Least-request, Lowest-TPM, Preble, Llumnix

key_improvements.en: Up to 27.4% goodput improvement over the second-best routing method (Preble); token-ID based migration achieves 7.1x-15.3x lower migration latency than KV-cache transfer; per-request routing overhead stays at 5.0 ms even at 10,000 RPS over 512 simulated instances.
key_improvements.zh: goodput 較次佳的 routing 方法（Preble）最高提升 27.4%；以 token ID 為基礎的 migration 延遲較 KV cache 傳輸低 7.1x-15.3x；在 512 個模擬 instance、10,000 RPS 下，每請求 routing 開銷仍僅 5.0 ms。

ai_task: LLM Serving
compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA H800, NVIDIA A800, NVIDIA A40, NVIDIA V100
gpu_count: 4 heterogeneous GPU instances: H800 (80GB), A800 (80GB), A40 (48GB), V100 (32GB, TP=2)
reported_accuracy: Normalized MAE 1.4x lower than LLM-based and up to 3.8x lower than history-based predictors (no absolute MAPE); prediction latency ~2.5 ms per request
validation_workloads: BIRD-bench, SWE-bench, LiveCodeBench, Mooncake trace

scope_assumptions.en: Assumes PD-multiplexed (non-disaggregated) instances, with only an extension path sketched for PD-disaggregated setups; no admission control — requests predicted infeasible are still routed best-effort; EMA-smoothed black-box capability estimation relies on the Law of Large Numbers over batched iterations and short-term stability; predictions are acknowledged imperfect and rectified by SLO-risk re-checks every 50 iterations.
scope_assumptions.zh: 假設 PD-multiplexed（非解耦合）instance，對 PD 解耦合部署僅概述延伸途徑；無 admission control——預測無法達標的請求仍以 best-effort 方式路由；EMA 平滑的 black-box 能力估計依賴批次迭代下的大數法則與短期穩定性；作者承認預測必有誤差，並透過每 50 次迭代的 SLO 違約風險重新檢查加以矯正。

title: GPTSwarm: Language Agents as Optimizable Graphs
authors: Mingchen Zhuge; Wenyi Wang; Louis Kirsch; Francesco Faccio; Dmitrii Khizbullin; Jürgen Schmidhuber
affiliations: AI Initiative, King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST);
research_focus: Agentic / Workflow serving

problem_statement.en: Human-designed prompt-engineering and multi-agent orchestration techniques are disparate, hand-crafted, and hard to improve automatically, spread across many incompatible code bases. There is no unified, optimizable representation of LLM agents and their inter-agent collaboration that lets both node prompts and agent connectivity be improved automatically.
problem_statement.zh: 人工設計的 prompt engineering 與 multi-agent 協作編排技術彼此割裂、皆須手工打造,且難以自動改良,並散布於眾多互不相容的程式庫之中。目前缺乏一種統一且可最佳化的表示法,能同時對 LLM agent 及其 agent 間協作加以描述,使得節點層級的 prompt 與 agent 之間的連接性皆可被自動改良。

key_innovation.en: Represent LLM agents (and composite societies of agents) as directed acyclic computational graphs — nodes are LLM/tool operations, edges are information flow — and automatically optimize them two ways: node optimization (an LLM "improver" refines per-node prompts) and edge optimization (relax discrete edge existence into continuous per-edge inclusion probabilities and run REINFORCE policy gradient on task-outcome utility to reshape connectivity, e.g. pruning adversarial agents).
key_innovation.zh: 將 LLM agent(以及由多個 agent 組成的複合社群)表示為有向無環的計算圖:節點為 LLM 或工具操作,邊為資訊流動,並以兩種方式對其自動最佳化。其一為節點最佳化,由一個 LLM「improver」精修各節點的 prompt;其二為邊最佳化,將離散的邊存在與否鬆弛為連續的逐邊納入機率,並依任務結果效用執行 REINFORCE policy gradient 以重塑連接性,例如剪除對抗性 agent。

baselines_compared: Single IO agent, Chain of Thought, Tree of Thought, Reflexion, Multiagent Debate, DyLAN, AutoGPT, GPT-4 with plugins, Full graph / random / uniform-theta edge distributions

key_improvements.en: Crossword 0.800 vs ToT 0.668; HumanEval 0.76→0.88; GAIA L1 +47% over GPT-4-Turbo; ~20x cheaper optimization than DyLAN.
key_improvements.zh: Crossword 0.800(ToT 0.668);HumanEval 0.76→0.88;GAIA L1 較 GPT-4-Turbo +47%;最佳化成本約為 DyLAN 的 1/20。

structure_space: Edge topology (spatial), Prompts (joint), Operator / node graph
decision_mechanism: Policy gradient / REINFORCE, Textual gradient (LLM feedback)
benchmarks_used: MMLU, Crossword, HumanEval, GAIA

agent_scenario.en: Agents are DAGs of operation nodes (IO/direct-answer, Chain-of-Thought, Tree-of-Thought, Reflexion, tool/web-search, and vision nodes). Multiple agent graphs are composed into a "swarm" via inter-agent edges (up to 7 Tree-of-Thought agents in the collaborative MMLU/GAIA settings), with final answers aggregated by majority vote / self-consistency or "choose best". Single-domain: a separate graph is optimized per benchmark. A robustness/adversarial protocol injects K deliberately-wrong agents (1T1A, 3T3A, 5T5A, 7T7A) and shows edge optimization filters them out.
agent_scenario.zh: agent 為由操作節點構成的 DAG,節點類型包含 IO/直接作答、Chain-of-Thought、Tree-of-Thought、Reflexion、工具/網路搜尋以及視覺節點。多個 agent 圖透過 agent 間的邊組合為一個「swarm」(在 MMLU/GAIA 協作情境中最多達 7 個 Tree-of-Thought agent),最終答案以多數投票/self-consistency 或「choose best」加以彙整。單一領域情境下,針對每個 benchmark 分別最佳化一個獨立的圖。一套穩健性/對抗性協定注入 K 個刻意作答錯誤的 agent(1T1A、3T3A、5T5A、7T7A),並顯示邊最佳化能將其濾除。

title: HarMoEny: Efficient Multi-GPU Inference of MoE Models
authors: Zachary Doucet; Rishi Sharma; Martijn de Vos; Rafael Pires; Anne-Marie Kermarrec; Oana Balmau
research_focus: MoE serving, Multi-tenant scheduling, Routing / Load balancing, Collective communication

problem_statement.en: Multi-GPU MoE inference under expert parallelism suffers from dynamic expert popularity skew across batches: a handful of popular experts receive a disproportionate share of tokens (up to 60% on layer 0 of Qwen), causing GPUs hosting popular experts to bottleneck the all-to-all synchronization and leaving up to 86% GPU idle time. Profiling-based placement strategies (ExFlow, FasterMoE) cannot adapt fast enough to the skew that shifts request-by-request.
problem_statement.zh: 在 expert parallelism 下的多 GPU MoE 推論面臨動態的 expert popularity skew：少數 popular expert 承擔過高 token 比例（Qwen 第 0 層可達 60%），導致承載 popular expert 的 GPU 卡住 all-to-all 同步，GPU 空轉時間最高可達 86%。ExFlow、FasterMoE 等仰賴 profiling 的放置策略無法快速適應每筆請求都在變化的 skew。

key_innovation.en: HarMoEny combines two lightweight techniques: (i) load-aware token rebalancing where a small metadata exchange (~4kB) lets each GPU deterministically reroute tokens from overloaded GPUs to underutilized ones at every batch, and (ii) asynchronous expert prefetching that overlaps loading the next required expert weights from system memory with current expert computation via a dedicated CUDA stream, achieving near-perfect load balance without any profiling.
key_innovation.zh: HarMoEny 結合兩項輕量機制：(i) load-aware token rebalancing，透過約 4kB 的 metadata 交換，使每個 GPU 在每個 batch 都能確定性地將過載 GPU 的 token 改派到低載 GPU；(ii) asynchronous expert prefetching，藉由獨立 CUDA stream 將下一個所需 expert 的權重從系統記憶體與當前 expert 計算重疊載入，無須任何 profiling 即可達到近乎完美的負載平衡。

key_improvements.en: 37%-70% throughput increase and 34%-41% TTFT reduction over the next-best baseline; up to 84.7% reduction of all-to-all waiting time; up to 9.1x speedup over DeepSpeed at 90% skew; asynchronous fetching delivers 5.5x speedup of expert loading on V100 GPUs.
key_improvements.zh: 吞吐量提升 37%-70%、TTFT 降低 34%-41%（相較次佳基線）；all-to-all 等待時間最多降低 84.7%；在 90% skew 情境下較 DeepSpeed 最高加速 9.1x；asynchronous fetching 於 V100 GPUs 上將 expert 載入加速 5.5x。

reported_accuracy: Not Reported (system paper; rebalancing closed token distribution to near-uniform per ECDF plots)
models_validated: Switch Transformer (12 transformer blocks, 128 experts per MoE block), Qwen1.5-MoE (24 blocks, 60 experts)
validation_workloads: BookCorpus, WikiText, WMT19, Random (synthetic), Constant (synthetic with controlled skew alpha in [0,1])

scope_assumptions.en: Single-node 8-GPU server with V100 GPUs and NVLink; assumes at least two experts fit in GPU memory (required for asynchronous fetching to hide load latency); token threshold q is tuned per hardware via a closed-form lower bound derived from FLOPS, expert size and PCIe bandwidth; evaluation uses static batching and reports mean latency rather than tail; experiments cover only Switch Transformer and Qwen1.5-MoE.
scope_assumptions.zh: 單節點 8-GPU 伺服器（V100 + NVLink）；asynchronous fetching 要求 GPU 至少能裝下兩個 expert 才能隱藏載入延遲；token threshold q 依硬體經由 FLOPS、expert 大小與 PCIe 頻寬導出的封閉解進行調校；實驗採 static batching、僅回報平均延遲而非 tail；評估限於 Switch Transformer 與 Qwen1.5-MoE。

title: Efficient LLM Serving for Agentic Workflows: A Data Systems Perspective (Extended)
authors: Noppanat Wadlom; Junyi Shen; Yao Lu
research_focus: Agentic / Workflow serving, Long-context / Prefix cache, Continuous batching, Performance modeling, Multi-tenant scheduling

problem_statement.en: Existing LLM serving stacks (e.g., vLLM) optimize individual inference calls but treat agentic workflows as a stream of opaque UDFs, losing visibility into inter-operator and inter-workflow prompt and KV-state sharing opportunities. This produces redundant prefill work across operators, passive prefix caching, and operator-level cost myopia that prevents cross-call optimization in batch agentic workloads.
problem_statement.zh: 現有 LLM serving 棧（如 vLLM）著重單一推理 call 的優化，卻將 agentic workflow 視為一連串不透明的 UDF，因而看不到 operator 與 workflow 間 prompt 與 KV state 共享的機會；其結果是跨 operator 重複 prefill、被動式 prefix cache 與 operator 級別的成本盲點，無法在 batch agentic workload 中跨 call 做整體優化。

key_innovation.en: Helium models agentic workflows as DAGs of LLM-as-operators and applies classic query-optimization principles: a Templated Radix Tree (TRT) captures the global prompt-prefix structure and dependencies, a cost-based cache-aware scheduler minimizes total token-step makespan over this TRT, and a proactive KV cache plus prompt cache pre-warms shared prefixes ahead of execution, jointly maximizing intra- and inter-workflow KV reuse.
key_innovation.zh: Helium 將 agentic workflow 視為以 LLM-as-operator 為節點的 DAG，並引入經典 query optimization 原理：以 Templated Radix Tree（TRT）描述全域 prompt prefix 結構與相依關係，由 cost-based、cache-aware 的 scheduler 最小化此 TRT 上的 total token-step makespan；同時以 proactive KV cache 與 prompt cache 預先暖啟共享 prefix，整體最大化 intra- 與 inter-workflow 的 KV 重用。

baselines_compared: vLLM, OpWise, LangGraph, AgentScope, Parrot, KVFlow

key_improvements.en: Up to 1.56x speedup over the strongest baseline (KVFlow) on primitive workflows; up to 1.34x speedup on a multi-stage Trading workflow; up to 100.92x speedup over the unmodified vLLM baseline; scheduling optimality gap of 0.9-3.6% vs an offline MILP optimum.
key_improvements.zh: 於 primitive workflow 上相較最強 baseline KVFlow 最多加速 1.56x；多階段 Trading workflow 加速最多 1.34x；相較未改動的 vLLM baseline 最多加速 100.92x；scheduling optimality gap 相較離線 MILP 最佳解僅 0.9-3.6%。

ai_task: LLM Serving, Multi-agent Systems
reported_accuracy: Not Reported (cost model expressed in token-steps; paper reports optimality gap of 0.9-3.6% vs MILP rather than absolute latency MAPE)
validation_workloads: MMLU, TAT-QA, Amazon Reviews (Map-Reduce / Debate / Reflect / Iterative / Parallel primitive workflows); composite Trading workflow

scope_assumptions.en: Scope restricted to LLM calls plus local data operations (no remote APIs); agents within a workflow share the same base LLM and differ only in prompts; semantic-preserving optimizations only (no proxy models or approximations); cost model based on offline operator profiles with a normalization constant per worker, assuming homogeneous worker hardware; cache scope limited to deterministic operators (greedy or temperature-0 sampling) with LRU eviction.
scope_assumptions.zh: 範圍限定於 LLM call 與本地資料運算（不含遠端 API）；同一 workflow 內 agent 共用相同 base LLM、僅 prompt 不同；只允許 semantic-preserving 優化（不含 proxy model 或近似）；成本模型以離線 operator profile 為基礎並對每個 worker 設定 normalization 常數，假設 worker 硬體同質；cache 範圍限於確定性 operator（greedy 或 temperature-0 取樣）並採 LRU eviction。

title: Helix: Serving Large Language Models over Heterogeneous GPUs and Network via Max-Flow
authors: Yixuan Mei; Yonghao Zhuang; Xupeng Miao; Juncheng Yang; Zhihao Jia; Rashmi Vinayak
venue_full: ACM International Conference on Architectural Support for Programming Languages and Operating Systems (ASPLOS) 2025
research_focus: LLM serving on heterogeneous and geo-distributed GPU clusters

problem_statement.en: Existing high-throughput LLM serving systems assume a homogeneous cluster of identical GPUs on a uniform interconnect, but production fleets increasingly mix a few flagship accelerators (H100, A100) with large numbers of cheaper inference GPUs (L4, T4) spread across regions joined by slow wide-area links. Naive model placement and request scheduling cannot extract throughput from such hardware: uniform partitioning idles strong GPUs behind weak ones, and compute-balanced placement that ignores the network congests slow inter-region links.
problem_statement.zh: 現有的高吞吐量 LLM 服務系統假設叢集由相同 GPU 組成、連在均質互連上，但生產機隊越來越常混用少量旗艦加速器（H100、A100）與大量較便宜的推論級 GPU（L4、T4），且分散在以慢速廣域連線相接的各區域。簡單的模型放置與請求排程無法從這種硬體榨出吞吐量：均勻切分使強 GPU 被弱 GPU 拖住而閒置，而忽略網路、僅平衡運算的放置又會壅塞慢速的跨區連線。

key_innovation.en: Helix is the first system to jointly optimize model placement and request scheduling for heterogeneous GPU clusters. It proves that, for a fixed placement, maximum serving throughput equals the max-flow of a directed graph whose edge capacities encode the per-second token throughput of each GPU and network link. A mixed-integer linear program with a linear number of variables and constraints then searches over layer assignments to maximize that max-flow, and a runtime 'per-request pipeline' scheduler routes every request along its own source-to-sink path via interleaved weighted round-robin whose weights come from the optimal flow.
key_innovation.zh: Helix 是第一個針對異質 GPU 叢集同時最佳化模型放置與請求排程的系統。它證明：對固定放置而言，最大服務吞吐量等於一張有向圖的最大流，其邊容量編碼每顆 GPU 與每條網路連線每秒的 token 吞吐量。接著以一個變數與約束數量皆為線性的混合整數線性規劃，在層分配空間中搜尋以最大化該最大流；執行時期的「逐請求管線」排程器則以取自最優流量的權重，透過交錯加權輪詢將每個請求路由至各自的源到匯路徑。

baselines_compared: Petals (greedy decentralized placement), Swarm / SWARM Parallelism (compute-balanced pipeline stages), Separate Pipelines (one full pipeline per machine type), random and shortest-queue scheduling

key_improvements.en: Up to 3.3x higher serving throughput and up to 66% lower prompt latency / 24% lower decode latency vs. baselines (abstract headline). Detailed results: 2.14x over Swarm on single-cluster LLaMA-30B offline; 1.94x over Swarm and 1.86x over Separate Pipelines on LLaMA-70B offline; ~2.0x over Swarm and ~1.5x over Separate Pipelines on the geo-distributed cluster; 2.72x over Separate Pipelines on the 42-node, 7-GPU-type cluster.
key_improvements.zh: 服務吞吐量最高提升 3.3 倍，prompt 延遲最高降低 66%、decode 延遲最高降低 24%（摘要標題數字）。詳細結果：單叢集 LLaMA-30B 離線相較 Swarm 為 2.14 倍；LLaMA-70B 離線相較 Swarm 為 1.94 倍、相較 Separate Pipelines 為 1.86 倍；跨區域叢集相較 Swarm 約 2.0 倍、相較 Separate Pipelines 約 1.5 倍；42 節點、7 種 GPU 的叢集相較 Separate Pipelines 為 2.72 倍。

software_simulator: Custom high-fidelity discrete-event simulator (14k LoC Python), validated to <5% error against the prototype on all metrics
network_topology: Single region (24 nodes, 10 Gb/s intra) and 3-region geo-distributed (10 Gb/s intra-region, 100 Mb/s / 50 ms inter-region)
ai_task: LLM Serving
traffic_pattern: Heterogeneous pipeline parallelism, per-request pipelines, online and offline serving over Azure Conversation and Code traces
compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA A100 (40/80 GB), V100, L4 (24 GB), T4 (16 GB) — heterogeneous mix; up to 7 GPU types
network_hw: Commodity Ethernet (10 Gb/s intra-region, 100 Mb/s inter-region links)
transport_and_interconnect: ZeroMQ over TCP for inter-node communication
routing_and_congestion_control: Max-flow-weighted interleaved weighted round-robin (IWRR) with KV-cache high-water-mark masking
reported_accuracy: <5% error vs. prototype on all metrics (throughput, prompt latency, decode latency)
parallelism_coverage: Heterogeneous pipeline parallelism (per-request pipelines); tensor parallelism within multi-GPU nodes
batching_policy: Best-effort dynamic batching (includes all requests arrived during the previous batch, no extra waiting)
kv_cache_treatment: Unified page pool atop vLLM enabling partial inference; per-node expected-KV tracking with high-water-mark masking to prevent OOM
validation_workloads: Azure LLM Conversation and Azure LLM Code traces
tail_latency: Reports full prompt- and decode-latency distributions; geo-distributed Swarm reaches ~70 s average prompt latency for LLaMA-70B vs. far lower for Helix
downstream_use: MILP-based model placement search and per-request pipeline scheduling within the Helix serving system

scope_assumptions.en: Static per-cluster placement (each node holds one contiguous block of layers); MILP given a 10-min per-cluster timeout and 4-hour total budget on a 14-core CPU; for hundreds of nodes the fleet is partitioned into sub-clusters solved independently; KV usage estimated from average output length.
scope_assumptions.zh: 每個叢集為靜態放置（每個節點持有一段連續的層）；MILP 每叢集逾時 10 分鐘、在 14 核 CPU 上共 4 小時搜尋預算；對於數百節點則先將機隊劃分為子叢集再各自獨立求解；KV 使用量由平均輸出長度估算。

source.method: manual extraction from arXiv:2406.01566v1 and Thesys-lab/Helix-ASPLOS25 repo

title: Cost-Efficient Multimodal LLM Inference via Cross-Tier GPU Heterogeneity
authors: Donglin Yu
research_focus: Multimodal serving, PD disaggregation, Continuous batching, Capacity planning, Performance modeling, GPU memory tiering

problem_statement.en: Multimodal LLM inference splits into a compute-bound vision encoding phase and a memory-bandwidth-bound language decoding phase, yet existing serving systems deploy both on homogeneous datacenter GPUs, paying an HBM tax on the vision phase and a tensor-core tax on the decode phase. Prior stage-level disaggregation (PD/EPD) still transfers GB-scale KV caches per request, demanding NVLink or InfiniBand and precluding cross-tier deployment over commodity PCIe.
problem_statement.zh: Multimodal LLM 推理可拆解為 compute-bound 的 vision encoding 階段與 memory-bandwidth-bound 的 language decoding 階段；既有服務系統皆部署於同質 datacenter GPU，使 vision 階段浪費昂貴 HBM、decode 階段又閒置 tensor core。先前的 stage-level 解耦合（PD/EPD）每筆請求仍需傳輸 GB 等級的 KV cache，必須仰賴 NVLink 或 InfiniBand，無法在 commodity PCIe 上跨層級部署。

key_innovation.en: Modality-level disaggregation that partitions at the vision encoder/language decoder boundary, reducing per-request cross-device transfer from O(L·s_ctx) KV bytes to O(N_v·d) embedding bytes (MB-scale, 12x-196x reduction across MLLM architectures). A closed-form cost model (Eqs. 5-8) decomposes T_e2e = T_vision + T_xfer + T_prefill + T_decode and proves heterogeneous deployment is cost-optimal when phases are separable. HeteroServe runtime maps vision to consumer RTX 4090 and decode to A100, with cross-type work stealing for utilization recovery.
