key_innovation.zh: Modality-level 解耦合：將 inference graph 切在 vision encoder 與 language decoder 邊界，使每筆請求跨裝置傳輸量從 O(L·s_ctx) KV bytes 降至 O(N_v·d) embedding bytes（MB 等級，跨 MLLM 架構達 12x-196x 縮減）。論文提出 closed-form cost model（Eqs. 5-8），將 T_e2e = T_vision + T_xfer + T_prefill + T_decode 分解，並證明在 phase-separable workload 下，異質部署為成本最優。HeteroServe runtime 將 vision 配置於消費級 RTX 4090、decode 配置於 A100，並透過 cross-type work stealing 回收利用率。

key_improvements.en: Heterogeneous configuration (2x RTX 4090 + 2x A100, $38k) achieves 37% higher Tokens/$ over homogeneous 4x A100 baseline ($64k) at matched latency. Engine optimizations alone raise throughput by 54% over vLLM v0.3.0 on identical hardware. Cost model predicts 31.4% savings; observed 40.6%. Work stealing yields additional 1.13x speedup.
key_improvements.zh: 異質部署（2x RTX 4090 + 2x A100，$38k）相較同質 4x A100 baseline（$64k），在匹配延遲下 Tokens/$ 提升 37%。Engine optimizations 在同硬體上相較 vLLM v0.3.0 吞吐量提升 54%。Cost model 預測節省 31.4%；實測達 40.6%。Work stealing 額外帶來 1.13x 加速。

reported_accuracy: Predicts 31.4% cost savings vs. 40.6% observed (relative error ~23%)
validation_workloads: COCO 2017 validation (prompt: Describe this image in detail, max output 128 tokens)

scope_assumptions.en: Assumes standard transformer KV caching (no activation recomputation, KV offloading, or speculative decoding altering intermediate state sizes); assumes phase-separable workloads; PCIe Gen4 x16 bandwidth (~25 GB/s); embedding transfer time treated as negligible (<0.3% overhead). T_lang grouped as T_prefill + T_decode; ignores network latency beyond the cross-tier embedding hop.
scope_assumptions.zh: 假設使用標準 transformer KV caching（不含 activation recomputation、KV offloading 或會改變中介狀態大小的 speculative decoding）；假設 workload 為 phase-separable；PCIe Gen4 x16 頻寬約 25 GB/s；embedding 傳輸時間視為可忽略（<0.3% overhead）。將 T_lang 合併為 T_prefill + T_decode；忽略跨層級 embedding 傳輸以外的網路延遲。

title: HexAGenT: Efficient Agentic LLM Serving via Workflow- and Heterogeneity-Aware Scheduling
authors: You Peng; Youhe Jiang; Wenshuang Li; Xu Xu; Ke Zhou; Jiawei Jiang; Chen Wang; Binhang Yuan
affiliations: HKUST, Webank, Wuhan University, Tsinghua University
research_focus: LLM serving, Agentic / Workflow serving, Multi-tenant scheduling, PD disaggregation, Performance modeling

problem_statement.en: Agentic LLM applications execute user requests as multi-step workflows whose DAG structure is revealed only incrementally at runtime, so users experience the end-to-end latency of the entire workflow rather than of any single LLM call. Existing per-call scheduling policies and PD-disaggregated systems do not jointly handle online-revealed workflow DAGs, heterogeneous prefill/decode placement, decode KV-capacity constraints, and cross-stage transfer latency on heterogeneous GPU clusters.
problem_statement.zh: Agentic LLM 應用將使用者請求展開為多步驟 workflow，其 DAG 結構僅在執行期間逐步揭露，使用者感受到的是整個 workflow 的端到端延遲，而非任何單一 LLM 呼叫。既有的 per-call scheduling 策略與 PD 解耦合系統，無法在異質 GPU 叢集上同時處理線上揭露的 workflow DAG、異質 prefill/decode placement、decode KV 容量限制與跨階段傳輸延遲。

key_innovation.en: A workflow- and heterogeneity-aware scheduler that models each request as an online-revealed DAG, maintains a running standalone-completion-horizon estimate H_w(t) per workflow, ranks ready calls by projected scaled-SLO risk, and jointly selects prefill placement, decode placement, and local queue priority while accounting for decode KV-capacity and cross-stage KV-transfer latency; plans are applied asynchronously so scheduling never blocks the serving path.
key_innovation.zh: 一套 workflow 與異質性感知的 scheduler：將每個請求建模為線上揭露的 DAG，為每個 workflow 維護持續更新的獨立完成時間估計 H_w(t)，依 projected scaled-SLO 風險對 ready 呼叫排序，並在考量 decode KV 容量與跨階段 KV 傳輸延遲的前提下，聯合決定 prefill placement、decode placement 與本地佇列優先權；scheduling plan 以非同步方式套用，確保不阻塞 serving 路徑。

key_improvements.en: Across representative agentic workloads and heterogeneous A100/H100/H200 clusters, reduces the SLO scale required for timely workflow completion by an average of 20.1% at 95% attainment and 33.0% at 99% attainment, with maximum reductions of 45.0% and 80.5%.
key_improvements.zh: 在代表性 agentic workload 與異質 A100/H100/H200 叢集上，將準時完成 workflow 所需的 SLO scale 平均降低 20.1%（95% attainment）與 33.0%（99% attainment），最大降幅分別為 45.0% 與 80.5%。

ai_task: LLM Serving, Disaggregated Prefill/Decoding, Multi-agent Systems
compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA A100, NVIDIA H100, NVIDIA H200
reported_accuracy: Not Reported (robustness study: avg Req99 degradation ≤1.5% for Llama, ≤9.5% for Qwen under 10-30% injected estimation error)
validation_workloads: ShareGPT, BFCL-v3, LATS (HotpotQA), Mixed

scope_assumptions.en: Scaled-SLO targets are defined relative to each workflow's standalone execution horizon on the same cluster; per-call output lengths are estimated via proxy-model-based sequence length prediction and service times via a roofline-style latency model; once a call starts prefill (or is locked to a planned decode instance) it cannot migrate. A robustness study shows the scheduler tolerates up to 30% multiplicative estimation error.
scope_assumptions.zh: Scaled-SLO 目標以各 workflow 在同一叢集上的獨立執行時間（standalone horizon）為基準定義；每次呼叫的輸出長度採 proxy-model 序列長度預測、服務時間採 roofline 式延遲模型估計；呼叫一旦開始 prefill（或已鎖定至規劃的 decode instance）即不可遷移。強健性實驗顯示 scheduler 可容忍最高 30% 的乘法性估計誤差。

title: High-Performance On-Orbit Intelligent Computing and Real-Time Services for Remote Sensing Satellites Based on Large-Scale Computing Power in Space
authors: Guoping Wang; Gang Wan; Zhijuan Su; Yang Wang; Yutong Jia; Gong Li; Shi Liang
affiliations: Space Engineering University, Aerospace Information Research Institute, Chinese Academy of Sciences, Beijing Institute of Space Mechanics and Electricity, Xidian University
research_focus: Datacenter networking

problem_statement.en: Traditional remote sensing satellite systems suffer from limited onboard computing power, high latency due to 'space sensing-ground computing' models, and insufficient communication bandwidth for massive data transmission.
problem_statement.zh: 傳統遙感衛星系統受限於星載算力不足、「天基感知-地面計算」模式引發的高延遲，以及海量資料傳輸所需的通訊頻寬不足。

key_innovation.en: A distributed, collaborative space-based cloud computing framework that leverages large-scale, heterogeneous onboard computing resources (CPU+FPGA+GPU+AI) and inter-satellite links to enable real-time, on-orbit intelligent processing.
key_innovation.zh: 一套分散式協同的天基雲計算框架，利用大規模異質星載計算資源（CPU+FPGA+GPU+AI）與星間鏈路，實現即時的在軌智能處理。

key_improvements.en: Achieves up to 275 Tops per kilogram of computing power and 4 Tops/Watt energy efficiency, enabling real-time on-orbit processing and reduced reliance on ground-based data centers.
key_improvements.zh: 每公斤算力最高達 275 TOPS，能效達 4 TOPS/Watt，實現即時在軌處理並降低對地面資料中心的依賴。

network_topology: Constellation, Formation flying, Satellite-ground integrated network
ai_task: Remote Sensing, Target detection, Semantic segmentation, Change monitoring, Multi-modal fusion, Intelligent task scheduling
traffic_pattern: Inter-satellite communication, Satellite-ground communication, Data downlink, Task-driven request-response
compute_memory_hw: CPU, GPU, FPGA, AI chips, DSP
network_hw: Inter-satellite laser communication terminals, TT&C data transmission stations
transport_and_interconnect: Inter-satellite laser communication, Satellite-ground communication links, 6G mobile network
routing_and_congestion_control: Deterministic routing in time-varying networks, Autonomous service migration

title: HPCC: high precision congestion control
authors: Yuliang Li; Rui Miao; Hongqiang Harry Liu; Yan Zhuang; Fei Feng; Lingbo Tang; Zheng Cao; Ming Zhang; Frank Kelly; Mohammad Alizadeh; Minlan Yu
venue_full: Conference on Applications, Technologies, Architectures, and Protocols for Computer Communication
affiliations: Harvard University, Alibaba Group Holding Limited, University of Cambridge, Massachusetts Institute of Technology
research_focus: Datacenter networking, RDMA / Transport, Congestion control, In-network computing

problem_statement.en: Existing high-speed congestion control schemes for RDMA networks struggle to simultaneously achieve ultra-low latency, high bandwidth utilization, and network stability, often leading to PFC storms or deep packet queues.
problem_statement.zh: 現有 RDMA 網路的高速壅塞控制方案難以同時實現超低延遲、高頻寬利用率與網路穩定性，往往引發 PFC storm 或深度封包佇列。

key_innovation.en: HPCC (High Precision Congestion Control) leverages In-network Telemetry (INT) to obtain precise link load information, allowing senders to compute accurate flow rate updates and control inflight bytes to maintain near-zero queues.
key_innovation.zh: HPCC（High Precision Congestion Control）利用網路內遙測（INT）獲取精確的鏈路負載資訊，使發送端得以計算準確的流量速率更新並控制在途位元組數，從而維持近零佇列。

key_improvements.en: 95% reduction in 99th-percentile flow completion time (FCT) compared to DCQCN, near-zero in-network queues, and elimination of PFC pauses under incast events.
key_improvements.zh: 相較於 DCQCN，p99 流完成時間（FCT）降低 95%；網路內佇列接近零；incast 事件下的 PFC 暫停現象得以消除。

ai_task: Distributed Deep Learning, Cloud Storage, Database, HPC
network_hw: Barefoot Tofino, Broadcom Tomahawk3, Broadcom Trident3

title: Idleness is Relative: Exploiting Tool-Call Idle Windows for Offloading in Agentic Systems with MORI
authors: Tian Xia; Hanchen Li; Zhifei Li; Xiaokun Chen; Hao Kang; Yifan Qiao; Yi Xu; Ion Stoica
affiliations: UC Berkeley, Renmin University of China, Stanford University, Georgia Institute of Technology
research_focus: LLM serving, Agentic / Workflow serving, KV cache offloading, GPU memory tiering, Multi-tenant scheduling, Routing / Load balancing

problem_statement.en: Agentic sessions issue tens of model invocations interleaved with tool calls, accumulating KV cache that exceeds GPU HBM capacity and must be offloaded to CPU DRAM. Tool-call durations span orders of magnitude and are unknown until completion, so re-placing entries on every call is impractical; LRU and binary busy/idle labels misalign with the fixed GPU-to-CPU capacity ratio, leaving one tier underutilized while the other is oversubscribed.
problem_statement.zh: Agentic session 會發出數十次 model 呼叫並穿插 tool call，累積的 KV cache 容易超過 GPU HBM 容量，因而需 offload 至 CPU DRAM。然而 tool call 時長橫跨多個數量級且完成前無從得知，逐次搬移 KV cache 並不可行；LRU 與二元 busy/idle 分類皆無法對齊固定的 GPU-to-CPU 容量比，導致一層記憶體閒置而另一層超載。

key_innovation.en: MORI treats idleness as a continuous, relative spectrum: a windowed idleness metric (fraction of recent time spent in tool calls over the last k=5 inference-tool-call cycles) ranks all active programs; the busiest are placed in GPU HBM and the most idle in CPU DRAM, with the partition boundary shifting dynamically to match hardware capacity. Sticky placement avoids churn, three-tier queues (GPU/CPU/Waiting) enforce admission control at each tier, and affinity-aware load balancing routes requests across replicas to preserve cached KV state.
key_innovation.zh: MORI 將 idleness 視為連續且相對的光譜：以視窗化 idleness 指標（最近 k=5 個 inference–tool-call 週期中 tool call 時間佔比）對所有活躍 program 排序，最忙者置於 GPU HBM、最閒者置於 CPU DRAM，分界隨硬體容量動態調整。並藉由 sticky placement 避免反覆搬移、以三層佇列（GPU/CPU/Waiting）在各層實施 admission control，且在多 replica 間以 affinity-aware load balancing 保留既有 KV cache 局部性。

key_improvements.en: 20-71% higher output throughput and 18-43% lower TTFT than the best offloading baseline (ThunderAgent+Offloading) at 80 concurrent programs; 1.6-2.1x higher throughput than non-offloading systems; in multi-replica (DP=3) deployment, 54-79% higher throughput while sustaining 99%+ GPU utilization.
key_improvements.zh: 在 80 個並行 program 下，相較最佳 offloading baseline（ThunderAgent+Offloading）輸出 throughput 提升 20–71%、TTFT 降低 18–43%；較無 offloading 的系統 throughput 高 1.6–2.1x；多 replica（DP=3）部署下 throughput 提升 54–79%，同時維持 99%+ 的 GPU 利用率。

ai_task: LLM Serving, Multi-agent Systems, AI Inference KV Cache transfer
compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA H200, NVIDIA B200, HBM, DRAM
offload_trigger: Periodic scheduler control loop (default 5s tick) detecting GPU-tier capacity violation: when aggregate KV cache of GPU-queue programs exceeds HBM capacity, programs are demoted until usage fits; placement is otherwise sticky.
prefetch_signal_timing: Reactive: a program returning from its tool call is gated until the scheduler promotes it back to the GPU queue when capacity allows, lowest-idleness programs first; reload is a CPU-to-GPU PCIe transfer with cache affinity to the replica that computed it. No tool-call-duration prediction.
agent_awareness: Exploits tool-call idle windows and the busy/idle structure of agentic programs: each agent session is tracked as a program across its lifetime, with a windowed relative-idleness metric over the last k=5 inference/tool-call cycles; subagent spawning is treated as one long tool call.

when_to_offload_rule.en: Offload only when the aggregate KV cache of GPU-resident programs exceeds HBM capacity; then demote the programs with the highest windowed relative idleness (preferring Acting over Reasoning programs) to CPU DRAM until usage fits, otherwise keep placement unchanged (sticky placement).
when_to_offload_rule.zh: 僅當 GPU 常駐 programs 的 KV cache 總量超出 HBM 容量時才卸載；此時依 windowed relative idleness（優先選擇 Acting 而非 Reasoning 的 programs）由高至低將 programs 卸載至 CPU DRAM，直至符合容量限制；否則維持既有配置（sticky placement）。

title: In-Orbit Processing or Not? Sunlight-Aware Task Scheduling for Energy-Efficient Space Edge Computing Networks
authors: Weisen Liu; Zeqi Lai; Qian Wu; Hewu Li; Qi Zhang; Zonglun Li; Yuanjie Li; Jun Liu
research_focus: Multi-tenant scheduling, KV cache offloading, Datacenter networking, Energy / Carbon

problem_statement.en: Space edge computing (SEC) faces significant energy constraints due to the additional power consumption of on-board hardware, which negatively impacts battery lifetime and task execution. Naive offloading to ground stations can overwhelm downlinks and introduce unacceptable latency for time-sensitive tasks.
problem_statement.zh: 太空邊緣計算（SEC）面臨顯著的能源限制，星載硬體的額外功耗會縮短電池壽命並影響任務執行；而簡單地將任務卸載至地面站可能導致下行鏈路擁塞，並對時間敏感任務引入難以接受的延遲。

key_innovation.en: PHOENIX, a sunlight-aware task scheduling framework that dynamically offloads space tasks to 'sunlight-sufficient' edges (satellites with near-100% sunlit ratio) or ground stations to minimize battery depth-of-discharge (DoD) while meeting task deadlines.
key_innovation.zh: PHOENIX 是一套日照感知任務 scheduling 框架，動態地將太空任務卸載至「日照充足」的邊緣節點（日照率接近 100% 的衛星）或地面站，以最小化電池放電深度（DoD），同時滿足任務截止時間要求。

key_improvements.en: Reduces maximum battery DoD by up to 54.8% and prolongs battery lifetime to 2.9x compared to state-of-the-art solutions.
key_improvements.zh: 相較於現有最優方案，最大電池放電深度最高降低 54.8%，電池壽命延長至 2.9x。

ai_task: Space Edge Computing, Ship Detection, Wildfire Segmentation
compute_memory_hw: Nvidia Jetson AGX Orin Developer Kit

title: InferCept: Efficient Intercept Support for Augmented Large Language Model Inference
authors: Reyna Abhyankar; Zijian He; Vikranth Srivatsa; Hao Zhang; Yiying Zhang
research_focus: Datacenter networking

problem_statement.en: Existing LLM inference systems treat external tool interceptions as request terminations, leading to unnecessary recomputation of KV caches and inefficient GPU memory usage. This recomputation accounts for 37-40% of total model forwarding time.
problem_statement.zh: 現有 LLM 推理系統將外部 tool 呼叫視為請求終止，導致 KV cache 被迫重新計算，造成 GPU 記憶體的浪費。此類重新計算佔整體模型前向傳遞時間的 37–40%。

key_innovation.en: INFERCEPT, a min-waste interception framework that dynamically chooses between preserving, swapping, or chunked recomputation of KV caches to minimize GPU memory waste during external tool interceptions.
key_innovation.zh: INFERCEPT 是一個以最小化浪費為目標的 interception 框架，能在外部 tool 呼叫期間動態選擇保留、swap 或分塊重計算 KV cache，從而將 GPU 記憶體浪費降至最低。

key_improvements.en: 1.6x-2x higher serving throughput, 2x more completed requests per second, 1.3x-12x lower normalized latency.
key_improvements.zh: serving throughput 提升 1.6x–2x，每秒完成請求數提升 2x，normalized latency 降低 1.3x–12x。

ai_task: LLM Serving, Augmented LLM Inference, Tool-augmented LLM, Multi-step Chatbot, Image Generation, Text-to-Speech
traffic_pattern: Iteration-level scheduling, Request interception, KV cache transfer
offload_trigger: Tool/API-call interception: at each interception the framework decides per sequence whether to keep KV in GPU memory, swap it to CPU, or discard it and later recompute.
prefetch_signal_timing: Reactive on interception return: swap-in starts strictly after the tool call returns; swap-out volume is bounded per iteration by a load-adaptive budget so transfers overlap the current forward pass.
costs_modeled: PCIe bandwidth, GPU FLOPs recompute, transfer-vs-recompute crossover
agent_awareness: Tool-call interceptions in augmented-LLM serving: the min-waste decision fires at each interception; no per-tool duration prediction and no multi-agent sharing.

when_to_offload_rule.en: At every interception, choose the action (keep in HBM, swap to CPU, or discard-and-recompute) that minimizes expected wasted GPU memory-time given swap and recompute costs, with per-iteration swap volume bounded by a load-adaptive budget.
when_to_offload_rule.zh: 於每次 interception 時，在 keep（保留於 HBM）、swap（換出至 CPU）與 discard（丟棄後重算）之間，選擇使預期浪費之 GPU 記憶體×時間最小的動作；每次迭代的 swap 量受負載自適應預算限制。

title: InfiniGen: Efficient Generative Inference of Large Language Models with Dynamic KV Cache Management
authors: Wonbeom Lee; Jungi Lee; Junghwan Seo; Jaewoong Sim
venue_full: USENIX Symposium on Operating Systems Design and Implementation
research_focus: KV cache offloading, Datacenter networking

problem_statement.en: The enormous memory footprint of the KV cache in LLM inference scales with sequence length and batch size, creating a performance bottleneck when offloading to CPU memory due to limited PCIe bandwidth. Existing KV cache eviction methods suffer from accuracy degradation and lack scalability for long-text generation.
problem_statement.zh: LLM 推理中 KV cache 的記憶體佔用隨序列長度與 batch size 線性增長，在受限 PCIe 頻寬下卸載至 CPU 記憶體時形成效能瓶頸。現有 KV cache eviction 方法存在精度下降問題，且難以擴展至長文本生成場景。

key_innovation.en: InfiniGen, a dynamic KV cache management framework that uses minimal rehearsal of attention computation to speculate and prefetch only essential KV cache entries from CPU memory, combined with offline weight skewing to improve speculation precision.
key_innovation.zh: InfiniGen 是一個動態 KV cache 管理框架，透過對 attention 計算進行輕量推演（minimal rehearsal），預測並僅從 CPU 記憶體中預取必要的 KV cache 項目；同時結合離線權重偏移（offline weight skewing）以提升推測精度。

baselines_compared: FlexGen, CUDA Unified Virtual Memory (UVM), H2O, Quantization

key_improvements.en: Up to 3.00x speedup over prior KV cache management methods and up to 32.6 percentage point increase in accuracy.
key_improvements.zh: 相較於先前 KV cache 管理方法，速度最高提升 3.00x，準確率最高提升 32.6 個百分點。

ai_task: LLM Serving, LLM Inference, Long-text generation
compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA RTX A6000, Intel Xeon Gold 6136, DDR4-2666

title: InfoFlow KV: Information-Flow-Aware KV Recomputation for Long Context
authors: Xin Teng; Canyu Zhang; Shaoyi Zheng; Danyang Zhuo; Tianyi Zhou; Shenji Wan
venue_full: Proceedings of the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (PMLR 306)
affiliations: New York University, New York University Shanghai, Duke University, MBZUAI
research_focus: LLM serving, Long-context / Prefix cache, Multimodal serving

problem_statement.en: RAG-based long-context question answering is bottlenecked by inference-time prefilling over large retrieved contexts. Precomputing per-document KV caches breaks cross-chunk causal dependencies, and existing selective recomputation methods (CacheBlend, EPIC) select tokens via heuristics or representation discrepancies without modeling whether the selected tokens can actually influence generation.
problem_statement.zh: RAG 長 context 問答的推理瓶頸在於對大量檢索內容的 prefill 計算。預先為個別文件計算 KV cache 會破壞跨 chunk 的因果相依性，而既有的選擇性重算方法（CacheBlend、EPIC）僅依靠啟發式規則或表徵差異挑選 token，未建模所選 token 是否真能影響生成結果。

key_innovation.en: Casts selective KV recomputation as an information-flow problem: a prompt-conditioned attention-norm criterion, computed under an inference-consistent global RoPE reconstruction of retrieved chunks, selects tokens that are both semantically relevant and positionally able to propagate information; an information-flow-guided chunk reordering strategy additionally places informative chunks closer to the prompt.
key_innovation.zh: 將選擇性 KV 重算建模為 information flow 問題：在與推理一致的全域 RoPE 位置重建下，以 prompt 條件化的 attention-norm 準則挑選既語義相關、又在位置結構上能傳遞資訊的 token；並進一步提出 information-flow 導向的 chunk 重排序策略，將資訊量高的 chunk 移近 prompt。

key_improvements.en: Best or second-best accuracy on four LongBench QA benchmarks across Qwen3-14B, Llama-3.1-8B and GLM-4-9B at a fixed 15% recomputation ratio, outperforming CacheBlend and EPIC; with 4-GPU sequence parallelism, up to 3.49x TTFT speedup over single-GPU full prefill and 2.57x over Ring Attention at 32K tokens; consistent gains on Qwen3-VL-8B vision-language benchmarks.
key_improvements.zh: 在固定 15% 重算比例下，於 Qwen3-14B、Llama-3.1-8B 與 GLM-4-9B 的四項 LongBench QA 基準上取得最佳或次佳精度，優於 CacheBlend 與 EPIC；在 4-GPU sequence parallelism 下，32K token 時 TTFT 較單 GPU full prefill 最高加速 3.49x、較 Ring Attention 加速 2.57x；於 Qwen3-VL-8B 視覺語言基準亦有一致增益。

ai_task: LLM Serving, RAG
gpu_count: 4x H100 (sequence-parallel efficiency runs); 1x A100 (single-GPU latency runs)

title: Enabling Agents to Communicate Entirely in Latent Space
authors: Zhuoyun Du; Runze Wang; Huiyu Bai; Zouying Cao; Xiaoyong Zhu; Yu Cheng; Bo Zheng; Wei Chen; Haochao Ying
venue_full: Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics
affiliations: Zhejiang University, Alibaba, Zhejiang Key Laboratory of Medical Imaging Artificial Intelligence, Shanghai Jiao Tong University
research_focus: Reasoning / Test-time scaling, Agentic / Workflow serving

problem_statement.en: Natural-language multi-agent systems compress rich high-dimensional internal states into sequential discrete tokens, discarding alternative reasoning paths and adding redundant decode-re-encode latency. Prior hidden-state communication remains tied to language trajectories or requires ad hoc layer selection.
problem_statement.zh: 以 natural language 運作的多 agent 系統，會將豐富的高維內部 state 壓縮為循序離散 token，因而捨棄替代推理路徑，並增加冗餘的 decode-re-encode latency。既有 hidden-state 通訊仍依附於 language trajectory，或需要臨時性的 layer 選擇。

key_innovation.en: Interlat directly transmits temporally aligned last-layer hidden-state sequences from a reasoning sender to an actor, where a trainable self-attention/projector communication adapter and <bop>/<eop> delimiters enable interpretation; a token-to-latent curriculum with separation and plan-alignment objectives forces use of task-relevant latent content. A separate latent-reasoning model autoregressively generates fixed-length compressed messages under task, uncertainty-weighted agreement, and geometry-alignment losses.
key_innovation.zh: Interlat 將 reasoning sender 在時間上對齊的 last-layer hidden-state sequence 直接傳至 actor，並以可訓練的 self-attention/projector communication adapter 與 <bop>/<eop> delimiter 支援解析；token-to-latent curriculum 搭配 separation 與 plan-alignment objective，促使 actor 使用與 task 相關的 latent content。另一個 latent-reasoning model 則在 task、uncertainty-weighted agreement 與 geometry-alignment loss 約束下，auto-regressively 生成固定長度的 compressed message。

key_improvements.en: On unseen ALFWorld tasks with Qwen2.5-0.5B, Interlat reaches 57.46% success versus 47.26% for Text and 44.03% for No-Comm. In a separate Qwen2.5-7B compression study, training-free truncation to eight latent steps reduces message-generation latency from 9.19s to 0.39s (nearly 24×) while maintaining competitive performance.
key_improvements.zh: 在 Qwen2.5-0.5B 的 unseen ALFWorld task 上，Interlat 的 success rate 為 57.46%，高於 Text 的 47.26% 與 No-Comm 的 44.03%。在另一項 Qwen2.5-7B compression 實驗中，training-free truncation 至八個 latent step，可在維持具競爭力表現的同時，將 message-generation latency 由 9.19s 降至 0.39s（接近 24× 加速）。

reuse_metric.en: Trained compression reduces each latent message to eight steps, about 1.8% of the full sequence, while retaining 66.43%/60.45% seen/unseen ALFWorld success versus 70.48%/65.42% with full-length latent communication.
reuse_metric.zh: 經訓練的 compression 將每則 latent message 縮減至八個 step，約為完整 sequence 的 1.8%；其 ALFWorld seen/unseen success rate 為 66.43%/60.45%，而完整 latent communication 則為 70.48%/65.42%。

title: Irminsul: MLA-Native Position-Independent Caching for Agentic LLM Serving
authors: Bole Ma; Jan Eitzinger; Harald Köstler
affiliations: Erlangen National High Performance Computing Center
research_focus: LLM serving, Long-context / Prefix cache, Agentic / Workflow serving, Energy / Carbon

problem_statement.en: Agentic workloads place bit-identical tokens at shifted positions every turn, voiding exact-prefix caches at the first byte of divergence (operators report TTFT spikes of 10–16s on unchanged content). Prior position-independent caching (PIC) systems must correct RoPE over the full d_K-dimensional key — an architectural cost imposed by GQA, since GQA fuses position inseparably into the K tensor.
problem_statement.zh: Agentic 工作負載在每一輪都把位元相同的 token 放到位移後的位置，使 exact-prefix cache 在第一個分歧位元組即失效（營運者回報未變更內容仍出現 10–16 秒的 TTFT 尖峰）。既有的 position-independent caching（PIC）系統必須對完整 d_K 維的 key 修正 RoPE——這是 GQA 將位置資訊與 K tensor 不可分離地融合所造成的架構性成本。

key_innovation.en: First MLA-native PIC system: MLA factors each KV row into a position-free 512-dim latent c_KV and a 64-dim RoPE key k_r correctable in closed form via a single δ-rotation. Irminsul extends SGLang's radix cache with content-hash keying over CDC-chunked segments (Gear-hash boundaries + xxHash64 fingerprints), a δ-rotation rule fuseable into FlashMLA, and a first-chunk carve-out that sidesteps the attention-sink regime.
key_innovation.zh: 第一個 MLA 原生的 PIC 系統：MLA 將每個 KV row 分解為與位置無關的 512 維 latent c_KV 與 64 維 RoPE key k_r，後者可藉單一 δ-rotation 以封閉形式修正。Irminsul 在 SGLang 的 radix cache 上加入以 content hash 為鍵的 CDC 分塊（Gear-hash 邊界 + xxHash64 指紋）、可融合進 FlashMLA 的 δ-rotation 規則，以及避開 attention-sink 區域的 first-chunk carve-out。

baselines_compared: SGLang (exact-prefix RadixAttention), Naive KV reuse, Fixed-block hashing

key_improvements.en: Recovers up to ~83% of prompt tokens above exact-prefix on agentic traffic (77.2% on DeepSeek-V2-Lite, 82.7% on JoyAI-48B for agent-metadata rotation); 63% prefill energy saving per MLA cache hit; δ-rotation error 4.7×10⁻³ rel-L2 in bf16; CDC+fallback finds 3.8–4.8× more reuse than fixed-block hashing offline.
key_improvements.zh: 在 agentic 流量上於 exact-prefix 之外額外回收最高約 83% 的 prompt token（agent-metadata rotation 下 DeepSeek-V2-Lite 為 77.2%、JoyAI-48B 為 82.7%）；每次 MLA cache hit 節省 63% 的 prefill 能耗；δ-rotation 誤差在 bf16 下為 4.7×10⁻³ rel-L2；離線分析中 CDC+fallback 找到的可重用量為 fixed-block hashing 的 3.8–4.8 倍。

ai_task: LLM Serving

title: JITServe: SLO-aware LLM Serving with Imprecise Request Information
authors: Wei Zhang; Zhiyu Wu; Yi Mu; Rui Ning; Banruo Liu; Nikhil Sarda; Myungjin Lee; Fan Lai
affiliations: University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign, Google, Cisco Research
research_focus: Multi-tenant scheduling, Agentic / Workflow serving, Length prediction, Performance modeling, Continuous batching

problem_statement.en: Existing LLM request schedulers focus on aggregate performance metrics like throughput or average latency, failing to meet diverse application-level SLOs (latency-sensitive, deadline-sensitive, compound) and struggling with unpredictable request information.
problem_statement.zh: 現有 LLM 請求 scheduler 著重於吞吐量或平均延遲等整體指標，無法滿足多樣化的應用層 SLO（latency-sensitive、deadline-sensitive、compound），且難以應對不可預測的請求資訊。

key_innovation.en: JITServe, an SLO-aware scheduler that uses imprecise request information (Quantile Regression Forest-based response length upper-bound estimation and pattern-graph matching for dependency estimation) and a Grouped Margin Goodput Maximization (GMAX) algorithm to allocate just-in-time bandwidth.
key_innovation.zh: JITServe 是一個 SLO 感知 scheduler，透過不精確的請求資訊（以 Quantile Regression Forest 預估 response length 上界、以 pattern graph matching 估計請求依賴），並以 Grouped Margin Goodput Maximization（GMAX）演算法進行 just-in-time 頻寬分配。

baselines_compared: vLLM, Sarathi-Serve, Autellix, Learn to Rank (LTR)

key_improvements.en: 1.4x-6.3x service goodput improvement over state-of-the-art baselines; 28.5%-83.2% resource savings at equivalent goodput; within 3-9% of an oracle scheduler with perfect foresight.
key_improvements.zh: 相較於 state-of-the-art baseline，service goodput 提升 1.4x-6.3x；在相同 goodput 下可節省 28.5%-83.2% 資源；效能落在具完美預知的 oracle scheduler 的 3-9% 之內。

ai_task: LLM Serving, Multi-agent Systems
reported_accuracy: Not Reported (QRF upper-bound estimator; paper reports SLO violation rates and goodput rather than length-prediction MAPE)
validation_workloads: Alpaca, LMSys-Chat, Search Arena (deep research), Math Reasoning, Agentic CodeGen, Microsoft production trace

scope_assumptions.en: QRF length predictor is conservatively biased toward upper-bound estimates and is incrementally refined every ~50 generated tokens; pattern-graph matching assumes historical workflow patterns exist for the incoming request type; evaluation conducted on 16x A100 with up to ~10K requests per run over one-hour windows; built atop vLLM and inherits its prefix-cache and chunked-prefill assumptions.
scope_assumptions.zh: QRF length predictor 偏向保守的 upper-bound 估計，並大約每 50 個 generated token 進行一次增量更新；pattern graph matching 假設新進請求類型已有歷史 workflow 樣式可比對；實驗在 16x A100 上、以一小時為窗每次處理約 10K 請求；系統以 vLLM 為底座，繼承其 prefix cache 與 chunked-prefill 設計假設。

source.updated_notes: Added inference-modeling domain + venue normalization (arXiv preprint).

title: Juniper: Networking the AI Data Center
authors: Not Specified
venue_full: International Conference on Transparent Optical Networks
research_focus: Datacenter networking, RDMA / Transport

problem_statement.en: AI training workloads suffer from network-induced bottlenecks, specifically leaf-to-spine and spine-to-leaf congestion caused by elephant flows and incast, which lead to increased job completion times and reduced GPU utilization.
problem_statement.zh: AI 訓練工作負載面臨網路誘發的效能瓶頸，尤其是 elephant flows 與 incast 引起的 leaf-to-spine 與 spine-to-leaf 壅塞，進而延長作業完成時間並降低 GPU 利用率。

key_innovation.en: An open, standards-based Ethernet fabric design utilizing RoCEv2, combined with intent-based automation via Juniper Apstra and high-radix spine switches (PTX10000) to enable scalable, lossless, and rail-optimized AI back-end networks.
key_innovation.zh: 採用 RoCEv2 的開放標準 Ethernet fabric 設計，結合 Juniper Apstra 的意圖驅動自動化與高 radix spine 交換機（PTX10000），構建可擴展、無損且 rail-optimized 的 AI 後端網路。

key_improvements.en: 320% typical ROI in data center deployments via Apstra automation, support for 18,000+ GPUs in a 2-layer Clos fabric, and migration path to 800GbE/1.6TbE.
key_improvements.zh: 透過 Apstra 自動化，資料中心部署的典型 ROI 達 320%；2 層 Clos fabric 可支援 18,000+ GPU；並提供向 800GbE/1.6TbE 的遷移路徑。

ai_task: LLM Serving, AI Model Training, AI Inference
network_hw: PTX10000, QFX5200, QFX5230, QFX5240, Juniper Express Silicon, Broadcom Tomahawk ASICs

title: Keep-Alive Caching for the Hawkes process
authors: Sushirdeep Narayana; Ian A. Kash
venue_full: 39th Conference on Uncertainty in Artificial Intelligence (UAI 2023)
research_focus: Multi-tenant scheduling, Performance modeling

problem_statement.en: In serverless (FaaS) platforms there is no fixed-size cache to fill: keeping a function image warm costs the provider resources per unit time, while evicting it causes cold-start latency at the next invocation. The relevant question is when it is worth keeping an object in the cache, not what to evict. TTL-style keep-alive policies used in practice (AWS Lambda, Azure Functions) are only worst-case 2-approximations (ski rental) when tuned on costs alone, and precise per-object optimal caching decisions were lacking.
problem_statement.zh: serverless（FaaS）平台沒有固定容量的 cache 需要填滿：函式映像保持 warm 需按時間支付 provider 資源成本，逐出後下一次呼叫則產生 cold start 延遲。關鍵問題是「何時值得把物件留在 cache」，而非「該逐出哪個物件」。實務採用的 TTL 式 keep-alive 政策（AWS Lambda、Azure Functions）若僅以成本調參，最壞情況只是 2-approximation（ski rental），且缺乏逐物件的精確最佳快取決策。

key_innovation.en: A cost model trading per-unit-time caching cost c_p against cache-miss cost c_cs, with optimal policies characterized by hazard-rate threshold crossings: keep-alive window boundaries lie at 0, infinity, or solutions of c_p − c_cs·λ(x|H) = 0 (Theorem 2). For Hawkes processes with exponential excitation this yields a closed-form history-dependent optimal window τ_opt = (1/β)(log α + log Σ_j e^{β(t_j−t_{m−1})} − log(c_p/c_cs − λ0)), plus a history-independent optimized-TTL heuristic (averaging optimal windows over simulated arrivals) backed by history-independent upper/lower bounds (Corollary 2.3).
key_innovation.zh: 以每單位時間快取成本 c_p 與 cache miss 成本 c_cs 的權衡建立成本模型，並以 hazard rate 門檻穿越刻劃最佳政策：keep-alive 視窗邊界落在 0、無窮大、或 c_p − c_cs·λ(x|H) = 0 的解（Theorem 2）。對具指數激發函數的 Hawkes process，導出依賴歷史的閉式最佳視窗 τ_opt = (1/β)(log α + log Σ_j e^{β(t_j−t_{m−1})} − log(c_p/c_cs − λ0))，並提出與歷史無關的 optimized-TTL 啟發式（對模擬到達的最佳視窗取平均），輔以與歷史無關的上下界（Corollary 2.3）。

baselines_compared: Fixed keep-alive (TTL) windows (5-120 min), Azure 10-min default keep-alive, Offline optimal (oracle)

key_improvements.en: On Azure Functions traces, applying the optimal policy to the 25% of applications best fit by a Hawkes process reduces cache resource use by ~4.5% on treated applications (0.95% overall) and saves ~1.012 cold starts per treated application per day versus length-tuned fixed policies; the history-independent optimized-TTL retains ~95% of the optimal policy's improvement. Offline optimal (oracle) bound: 4.038 cold-start savings / 0.269 memory savings on Hawkes applications.
key_improvements.zh: 在 Azure Functions trace 上，對最符合 Hawkes process 的 25% 應用套用最佳政策，可使受處理應用的 cache 資源使用降低約 4.5%（整體 0.95%），且相較逐視窗長度調參的固定政策，每個受處理應用每天平均減少約 1.012 次 cold start；與歷史無關的 optimized-TTL 保留最佳政策約 95% 的改進。offline optimal（oracle）上界：Hawkes 應用 cold start 節省 4.038 / 記憶體節省 0.269。

reported_accuracy: Not Reported (no latency prediction; reports cost, cold-start, and wasted-memory savings relative to fixed keep-alive policies)
validation_workloads: Synthetic (Hawkes via Ogata modified thinning; 600 arrivals x 100 realizations), Azure Functions trace (Shahrad et al. 2020; parameters fit on day 8, KS goodness-of-fit on day 7, evaluated on day 9)

scope_assumptions.en: Infinite-capacity cache (cost-based, not eviction-based): the provider can always dedicate more resources, so the decision is when to keep, not what to evict. Loading time/cost into the cache is assumed zero, making the cost formula a lower bound on true cost. The provider must know or estimate the arrival distribution; analysis is restricted to Poisson and Hawkes processes with exponential excitation, and the optimal Hawkes policy must be recomputed after every arrival. Azure evaluation assumes zero function execution time and uniform memory across applications, treats only the 25% of applications with best Hawkes goodness-of-fit (KS test), caps history at 200 previous arrivals, and evaluates a single day. Costs c_p and c_cs are provider-side model parameters uniform within each experiment — no client-declared lifecycle signals (TTLs, leases, or per-application cold-start costs) are used; per-customer customization is noted as future work. Targets serverless function-image caching, not LLM/KV caches.
scope_assumptions.zh: 無限容量 cache（基於成本而非逐出）：provider 永遠可投入更多資源，決策問題是「何時保留」而非「逐出哪個」。假設載入 cache 的時間與成本為零，成本公式因此是真實成本的下界。provider 需已知或可估計到達分布；分析限於 Poisson 與指數激發的 Hawkes process，且 Hawkes 最佳政策須在每次到達後重新計算。Azure 評估假設函式執行時間為零、所有應用記憶體相同，僅處理 Hawkes 適合度（KS 檢定）最佳的 25% 應用，歷史上限 200 次到達，且僅評估單日。成本 c_p 與 c_cs 為 provider 端模型參數且在單一實驗內一致——不使用任何客戶端宣告的生命週期訊號（TTL、lease 或每應用 cold start 成本）；逐客戶客製化被列為未來工作。標的為 serverless 函式映像快取，而非 LLM/KV cache。

title: KernelSight-LM: A Kernel-Level LLM Inference Simulator
authors: Xiteng Yao; Taeho Kim; Hengzhi Pei; Xinle Liu; Kyle Ulrich; Leonard Lausen; Ashish Khetan; Xiang Song; George Karypis; Martin Herbordt
research_focus: LLM serving, Performance modeling, Roofline analysis, Capacity planning, Continuous batching, Long-context / Prefix cache, Hardware co-design

problem_statement.en: End-to-end LLM inference behavior couples serving-layer policies (batching, scheduling, prefix caching) with low-level GPU kernel execution on rapidly evolving architectures, forcing slow, deployment-specific benchmarking; prior tools either measure on the target GPU (cannot extrapolate) or forecast across GPUs (blind to serving dynamics).
problem_statement.zh: LLM inference 的端到端行為將 serving 層策略（batching、scheduling、prefix caching）與底層 GPU kernel 執行及快速演進的硬體架構耦合在一起，迫使業界進行緩慢且綁定特定部署的 benchmarking；既有工具要麼依賴目標 GPU 上的量測（無法外推），要麼跨 GPU 預測（無法反映 serving 動態）。

key_innovation.en: A kernel-level latency predictor (roofline with wave quantization x learned per-family efficiency heads + NCCL all-reduce communication model + measured host-overhead model) composed through a Vidur-based discrete-event simulator that re-implements vLLM v1's scheduler with continuous batching, chunked prefill, and two-tier prefix caching; two prediction tiers trade target-GPU data for accuracy (Tier A: datasheet-only zero-shot cross-generation; Tier B: one model-agnostic microbenchmark sweep on the target).
key_innovation.zh: kernel 級延遲預測器（roofline 結合 wave quantization x 各 kernel family 的學習式效率頭 + NCCL all-reduce 通訊模型 + 量測式 host 開銷模型），並透過基於 Vidur 的 discrete-event 模擬器組合：逐步重現 vLLM v1 scheduler 的 continuous batching、chunked prefill 與兩層 prefix caching；提供兩個預測層級以目標 GPU 資料換取精度（Tier A：僅憑 datasheet 的 zero-shot 跨世代預測；Tier B：在目標 GPU 上跑一次與模型無關的 microbenchmark sweep）。

key_improvements.en: Predicts per-kernel latency on an unseen GPU generation (GB200) to 12.1% error, 1.8x better than the roofline baseline NeuSight (22.0%); target-measured tier reaches 3.8% per-kernel error, 7.3x over AIConfigurator (27.7%); end-to-end p50 errors across six model families of 15.4%/12.8%/3.0% (TTFT/TPOT/throughput) cross-generation and 14.3%/6.2%/2.7% target-measured.
key_improvements.zh: 在未見過的 GPU 世代（GB200）上預測 per-kernel latency 誤差為 12.1%，較 roofline baseline NeuSight（22.0%）改善 1.8x；target-measured 層級將 per-kernel 誤差降至 3.8%，較 AIConfigurator（27.7%）改善 7.3x；六個模型家族的端到端 p50 誤差在跨世代層級為 15.4%/12.8%/3.0%（TTFT/TPOT/throughput），target-measured 層級為 14.3%/6.2%/2.7%。

compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA A100, NVIDIA A10G, NVIDIA A40, NVIDIA H100, NVIDIA H200, NVIDIA L4, NVIDIA L40S, NVIDIA GB200, NVIDIA GB10, NVIDIA RTX 5090
gpu_count: 8x per AWS instance (A100/A10G/H100/H200/L4), 4x GB200; TP up to 4
reported_accuracy: Per-kernel MAPE 12.1% (Tier A) / 3.8% (Tier B); E2E p50 TTFT/TPOT/throughput 15.4%/12.8%/3.0% (A), 14.3%/6.2%/2.7% (B)
models_validated: Llama-3.2-1B/3B, Llama-3.1-8B, Llama-3.3-70B, Qwen2.5-0.5B, Qwen3-4B/8B/14B/32B, DeepSeek-LLM-7B/67B, DeepSeek-Coder-33B, Phi-2, Phi-4-mini, Phi-4, Gemma-2-9B, Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3
validation_workloads: Production trace (conversation, up to 500 requests per configuration), Kernel microbenchmarks (CUDA-graph)

scope_assumptions.en: Cross-generation transfer of the learned efficiency factor is weakest for attention kernels (efficiency 3-3.5x off roofline with up to 3.8x cross-device spread), motivating one-shot per-architecture attention calibration; TTFT error grows from 15% to 74% past saturation (rho ~1.2) because the host model excludes the saturated regime; validated on dense decoder-only models with vLLM v0.19.0, TP up to 4; GB200 held out as cross-generation target; edge GPUs (RTX 5090, GB10) excluded from the training ladder.
scope_assumptions.zh: 學習式效率因子的跨世代轉移在 attention kernel 上最弱（效率偏離 roofline 3-3.5x，跨裝置差異最高 3.8x），因此需要對每個新架構做一次 attention 校準；超過飽和點（rho 約 1.2）後 TTFT 誤差由 15% 升至 74%，因為 host 模型未涵蓋飽和情境；驗證僅涵蓋 dense decoder-only 模型，使用 vLLM v0.19.0、TP 最多 4；GB200 作為跨世代測試時完全保留，邊緣 GPU（RTX 5090、GB10）不納入訓練階梯。

title: An Interpretable Latency Model for Speculative Decoding in LLM Serving
authors: Linghao Kong; Megan Flynn; Michael Peng; Nir Shavit; Mark Kurtz; Alexandre Marques
research_focus: Speculative decoding, MoE serving, Multi-tenant scheduling, Continuous batching, Capacity planning, Performance modeling, Roofline analysis

problem_statement.en: Speculative decoding (SD) is typically evaluated in isolated or fixed-batch settings, but production serving systems such as vLLM use continuous batching, so request load varies over time and the effective batch size emerges from the scheduler rather than being directly controlled. As a result, SD speedups observed in single-stream benchmarks often diminish, vanish, or reverse under realistic serving load, and prior work lacks an interpretable model that links request rate, acceptance rate, and draft length to end-to-end latency.
problem_statement.zh: Speculative decoding (SD) 過往多在 single-stream 或固定 batch 的情境下評估，但生產級服務系統如 vLLM 採用 continuous batching，請求負載隨時間變動，effective batch size 由 scheduler 動態決定而非外部設定。因此 single-stream 量測到的 SD 加速在實際負載下往往逐漸衰減、消失甚至反轉，而既有研究缺乏一個能將 request rate、acceptance rate、draft length 與端到端延遲串接起來的可解釋模型。

key_innovation.en: A closed-form, speculation-aware latency model derived from a roofline-style decomposition L = C1 + B x C2 combined with Little's Law (B = RPS x L), yielding L = C1 / (1 - RPS x C2). The framework decomposes per-request demand into load-independent and load-dependent components for prefill, drafting, and verification, then introduces an MoE-aware extension that scales coefficients by an expert-coverage factor phi(T) = 1 - (1 - m/M)^T.
key_innovation.zh: 以 roofline 風格分解 L = C1 + B x C2，結合 Little's Law (B = RPS x L) 推出封閉式 speculation-aware 延遲模型 L = C1 / (1 - RPS x C2)。該框架將 per-request demand 拆解為與負載無關與隨負載變動的兩個部分，分別對應 prefill、drafting、verification 三個階段，並提出 MoE-aware 延伸：以 expert-coverage 因子 phi(T) = 1 - (1 - m/M)^T 對各係數進行修正。

baselines_compared: Vanilla autoregressive decoding (no SD), EAGLE-3 SD, Vanilla multi-model SD (independent drafter)

key_improvements.en: Demonstrates universal latency collapse onto y = 1/(1 - x) with R^2 close to 1.00 across Llama-3.1-8B/70B, Qwen3-0.6B/1.7B/4B/8B/14B/32B, gpt-oss-20b, Qwen3-30B-A3B, and Qwen3-235B-A22B. Leave-n-out generalization preserves R^2 close to the full-data fit on Qwen3-8B/14B/32B for held-out prefill-decode configurations. MoE-aware extension raises low-load R^2 from 0.902 to 0.997 for gpt-oss-20b, 0.830 to 0.976 for Qwen3-30B-A3B, and 0.906 to 0.989 for Qwen3-235B-A22B.
key_improvements.zh: 在 Llama-3.1-8B/70B、Qwen3 系列（0.6B、1.7B、4B、8B、14B、32B）、gpt-oss-20b、Qwen3-30B-A3B 與 Qwen3-235B-A22B 上，所有量測 collapse 至 y = 1/(1 - x) 曲線，R^2 接近 1.00。Leave-n-out 泛化測試在 Qwen3-8B/14B/32B 的未見 prefill/decode 配置下，預測 R^2 仍接近完整資料擬合。MoE-aware 延伸把低負載段 R^2 從 gpt-oss-20b 的 0.902 提升至 0.997、Qwen3-30B-A3B 從 0.830 提升至 0.976、Qwen3-235B-A22B 從 0.906 提升至 0.989。

gpu_count: 1x A100 SXM (most experiments); 4x A100 SXM (Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct); 8x A100 SXM (Qwen3-235B-A22B); 1x H100 (robustness check)
reported_accuracy: R^2 close to 1.00 on most Qwen3/Llama-3.1 configurations; R^2 of 0.997 for gpt-oss-20b and 0.989 for Qwen3-235B-A22B under MoE-aware extension
models_validated: Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct, Qwen3-0.6B, Qwen3-1.7B, Qwen3-4B, Qwen3-8B, Qwen3-14B, Qwen3-32B, gpt-oss-20b, Qwen3-30B-A3B, Qwen3-235B-A22B
validation_workloads: Synthetic (Jane Austen's Pride and Prejudice, prefill/decode lengths {256, 512, 768, 1024}, sweeps over acceptance rate 50%-100% and draft length 1-10)

scope_assumptions.en: Targets the stable pre-saturation regime; excludes the saturation boundary where preemption makes latency unstable. Fits mean latency, with P95/P99 covered as an extension. Fitted coefficients are system-specific (GPU, parallelism strategy, scheduler, serving engine); model is treated as a lightweight profiling framework rather than a universal set of constants. Adaptive drafting and tree verification may introduce additional cost terms not captured. Acceptance process modeled as a constant per-token probability alpha, independent of position.
scope_assumptions.zh: 模型專注於 stable pre-saturation 區段，排除接近 saturation boundary 因 preemption 造成的不穩定。主要擬合 mean latency，P95 與 P99 視為延伸。擬合得到的係數與系統綁定（GPU、平行化策略、scheduler、serving engine），論文將模型定位為輕量級 profiling 框架而非通用常數表。Adaptive drafting 與 tree verification 等機制可能引入未被建模的額外成本項目。Acceptance 過程被建模為與位置無關、常數的 per-token 機率 alpha。

title: A Token/KV-Cache Communication Media Selection and Resource Allocation Strategy for Multi-Agent Collaboration
authors: Lipeng Dai; Luping Xiang; Kun Yang
affiliations: State Key Laboratory of Novel Software Technology at Nanjing University, Institute of Intelligent Networks and Communications (NINE) at Nanjing University (Suzhou Campus)
research_focus: Agentic / Workflow serving, Performance modeling

problem_statement.en: Token-based communication limits network payload but forces receiver-side prefill and token generation, whereas KV-cache transfer bypasses redundant prefill but sends large tensors over constrained, stochastic wireless links. Because task size, compute capacity, and channel conditions vary, neither medium uniformly minimizes E2E latency in embodied multi-agent systems.
problem_statement.zh: token-based communication 可限制網路 payload，卻要求 receiver 執行 prefill 與 token generation；KV-cache transfer 可略過冗餘 prefill，但須經由受限且具隨機性的 wireless link 傳輸大型 tensor。由於任務規模、運算能力與 channel condition 持續變動，兩種 medium 均無法在 embodied multi-agent system 中一致地使 E2E latency 最小化。

key_innovation.en: The JMSRA framework analytically models marginal computation and wireless latency for token and KV-cache transmission, derives a per-link bandwidth threshold for mode switching, and jointly selects each agent's medium and bandwidth. It solves the resulting mixed-integer nonlinear program with bidirectional greedy mode search and bisection-based bandwidth allocation.
key_innovation.zh: JMSRA framework 以 analytical model 描述 token 與 KV-cache transmission 的邊際運算及 wireless latency，推導單一 link 的 mode-switching bandwidth threshold，並聯合選擇各 agent 的 communication medium 與 bandwidth。其以雙向 greedy mode search 及 bisection-based bandwidth allocation 求解所形成的 mixed-integer nonlinear program。

baselines_compared: All-NL (average allocation), All-KV (average allocation), All-NL (optimized allocation), All-KV (optimized allocation)

key_improvements.en: With 20 assistant agents and a 5-TFLOPS executive agent, JMSRA selects KV mode for 18 assistants and reaches 23.54 s marginal latency, about 75% below All-NL (>90 s) and below All-KV (~41 s). With a 35-TFLOPS executive agent, it adapts toward NL and reaches 13.05 s versus ~13.5 s for All-NL and ~41 s for All-KV.
key_improvements.zh: 在 20 個 assistant agents 與 5-TFLOPS executive agent 的設定下，JMSRA 為其中 18 個 assistants 選擇 KV mode，將 marginal latency 降至 23.54 s；相較 All-NL (>90 s) 約降低 75%，且低於 All-KV (~41 s)。當 executive agent 具備 35 TFLOPS 時，系統轉而偏向 NL，達到 13.05 s，優於 All-NL 的約 13.5 s 與 All-KV 的約 41 s。

reuse_metric.en: Not Specified

title: KV Packet: Recomputation-Free Context-Independent KV Caching for LLMs
authors: Chuangtao Chen; Grace Li Zhang; Xunzhao Yin; Cheng Zhuo; Bing Li; Ulf Schlichtmann
affiliations: Technical University of Munich, Technical University of Darmstadt, Zhejiang University, Technische Universität Ilmenau
research_focus: LLM serving, Long-context / Prefix cache, KV cache compression

problem_statement.en: Precomputed document KV caches are context-dependent: when retrieved documents appear under new prefixes or alongside other chunks, naive concatenation omits cross-document dependencies and severely degrades accuracy. Existing model-adaptation or selective-recomputation approaches either modify the base model or retain inference FLOPs and TTFT overhead.
problem_statement.zh: 預先計算的文件 KV cache 具有 context dependency：當檢索文件置於新的 prefix 或與其他 chunk 並列時，直接拼接會遺失跨文件依賴並大幅降低準確率。既有模型適配方法需要修改 base model，而 selective recompute 方法仍會產生 inference FLOPs 與 TTFT 開銷。

key_innovation.en: KV Packet wraps each frozen, independently cached document with lightweight trainable Header and Trailer soft-token adapters. A self-supervised distillation objective aligns packet-based outputs with a full-attention teacher while freezing the base model and document embeddings; RoPE shifts then permit direct packet concatenation without inference-time document-token recomputation.
key_innovation.zh: KV Packet 以輕量、可訓練的 Header 與 Trailer soft-token adapter 包裹每個凍結且獨立 cache 的文件。其 self-supervised distillation objective 在凍結 base model 與文件 embedding 的前提下，使 packet-based output 對齊 full-attention teacher；再以 RoPE 位移進行位置對齊，於 inference 時直接拼接各 packet，無須重算文件 token。

baselines_compared: Full Recompute, No Recompute, No Cache, CacheBlend, A3, Random recomputation, EPIC, SAM-KV, CUR, KVzap, LeverageScore, TOVA, Random pruning, Single Cache

key_improvements.en: Inference-time FLOPs are 5–6 orders of magnitude lower than Full Recompute while F1 remains comparable in most evaluated settings. On Llama, the paper reports TTFT speedups of 1.36× on Biography, 3.3× on HotpotQA, 19.45× on Needle-in-a-Haystack, and 5.81× on MusiQue.
key_improvements.zh: inference-time FLOPs 較 Full Recompute 降低 5–6 個數量級，同時在多數評測設定中維持相當的 F1。在 Llama 實驗中，論文報告 Biography、HotpotQA、Needle-in-a-Haystack 與 MusiQue 的 TTFT 分別加速 1.36×、3.3×、19.45× 與 5.81×。

reuse_metric.en: Recomputation-free reuse: no document tokens are recomputed at inference, and F1 is comparable to Full Recompute in most evaluated configurations; the paper reports a performance gap for Qwen on MusiQue.
reuse_metric.zh: 重用過程不需重算：inference 時不重算任何文件 token，且在多數評測設定中維持與 Full Recompute 相當的 F1；論文亦指出 Qwen 在 MusiQue 上仍有性能落差。

title: Accelerating LLM Inference Throughput via Asynchronous KV Cache Prefetching
authors: Yanhao Dong; Yubo Miao; Weinan Li; Xiao Zheng; Chao Wang; Jiesheng Wu; Feng Lyu
research_focus: LLM serving, Continuous batching, GPU memory tiering, Hardware co-design, Roofline analysis

problem_statement.en: LLM decode is memory-bound: each autoregressive step must reload the entire KV Cache of prior tokens from HBM into compute units, and HBM bandwidth cannot meet the throughput demand. In the native vLLM XFormers attention kernel this causes severe GPU cache misses during the KV-load phase, frequent high-latency HBM accesses, and massive warp stalls (the Long Scoreboard consuming over 72% of cycles per instruction), so memory bandwidth is underutilized and inference throughput is bottlenecked.
problem_statement.zh: LLM 解碼階段屬於記憶體受限：每個自回歸步驟都必須把先前所有 token 的 KV Cache 從 HBM 重新載入計算單元，而 HBM 頻寬無法滿足吞吐需求。在原生 vLLM XFormers attention kernel 中，這會在 KV 載入階段造成嚴重的 GPU cache miss、頻繁的高延遲 HBM 存取，以及大量 warp stall（Long Scoreboard 佔據每指令週期超過 72%），導致記憶體頻寬利用率低落、推理吞吐受限。

key_innovation.en: An L2-cache-oriented asynchronous KV Cache prefetching method implemented inside the vLLM XFormers attention kernel. While the kernel computes attention over the current KV block, it issues the Hopper `cp.async.bulk.prefetch.L2.global` instruction to proactively stage the NEXT KV block (4096 bytes per key and per value) from HBM into the GPU's 60MB L2 cache. This is active intra-kernel prefetch of high-reuse KV: the prefetched data lands in L2 so that when the kernel reaches the next block it scores an L2 cache hit instead of paying full HBM latency, hiding HBM access latency within otherwise-idle computation windows and preventing data-dependency-induced warp stalls. Cache eviction priority is tuned so prefetched data does not cause capacity-overflow thrashing.
key_innovation.zh: 在 vLLM XFormers attention kernel 內部實作的「以 L2 cache 為導向的非同步 KV Cache 預取」方法。當 kernel 正在對當前 KV block 計算 attention 時，發出 Hopper 的 `cp.async.bulk.prefetch.L2.global` 指令，主動把「下一個」KV block（key 與 value 各 4096 bytes）從 HBM 預先搬進 GPU 的 60MB L2 cache。這是對高重用 KV 的主動 intra-kernel（核內）預取：預取資料落在 L2，使 kernel 處理下一個 block 時命中 L2 cache、不必承受完整 HBM 延遲，從而在原本閒置的計算視窗內隱藏 HBM 存取延遲並避免資料依賴造成的 warp stall。同時調整 cache eviction priority，避免預取資料造成容量溢位的 thrashing。

key_improvements.en: L2-cache reuse of the next KV block is the entire contribution: prefetching raises the attention-kernel L2 cache hit rate from the baseline 0.06-55.90% up to 43.70% / 73.01% / 82.66% / 77.11% across Llama2-7B / Llama3-8B / Qwen2.5-7B / Qwen2.5-14B, cutting Cycles-Per-Instruction by 65.8-67.5% and slashing Long-Scoreboard stall cycles (e.g. Llama2-7B 21.34 -> 4.13). This yields up to 2.15x attention-kernel speedup (1.84-2.15x range) and up to 1.97x end-to-end throughput, surpassing FlashAttention-3 by up to 110% (Qwen2.5-7B) and 4-76% on other models, on a single H20; multi-GPU TP gains are 4-59% (Llama3-8B) and 4-76% (Qwen2.5-14B), decaying as TP scales and KV heads per GPU shrink. Peak speedup at batch 128 / 8K output tokens before L2 capacity / HBM limits trigger recomputation. Effect scales with KV-head count: GQA models (more Q heads per KV block) reuse the prefetched L2 block more, so benefit; the aggressive 7:1 GQA of Qwen2.5-7B limits headroom and gives a 2-5% e2e regression vs FA3.
key_improvements.zh: 「下一個 KV block 的 L2-cache 重用」就是論文的全部貢獻：預取把 attention kernel 的 L2 cache 命中率從基線 0.06-55.90% 提升到 Llama2-7B / Llama3-8B / Qwen2.5-7B / Qwen2.5-14B 的 43.70% / 73.01% / 82.66% / 77.11%，使每指令週期（CPI）下降 65.8-67.5%，並大幅削減 Long-Scoreboard stall 週期（如 Llama2-7B 由 21.34 降至 4.13）。由此在單張 H20 上達到最高 2.15x 的 attention kernel 加速（1.84-2.15x 區間）與最高 1.97x 的端到端吞吐，相較 FlashAttention-3 最高勝出 110%（Qwen2.5-7B），其餘模型 4-76%；多 GPU TP 增益為 4-59%（Llama3-8B）與 4-76%（Qwen2.5-14B），隨 TP 擴展、每 GPU 的 KV head 變少而遞減。峰值加速出現在 batch 128 / 8K 輸出 token，再大則受 L2 容量與 HBM 上限觸發重算。效益與 KV head 數相關：GQA 模型（每個 KV block 服務更多 Q head）對預取進 L2 的 block 重用更多而獲益；Qwen2.5-7B 的 7:1 激進 GQA 壓縮了優化空間，相較 FA3 出現 2-5% 端到端回退。

compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA H20 (60MB L2, 96GB HBM, 4.0TB/s), Intel Xeon Platinum 8469C
reported_accuracy: Not Reported (measured 2.15x attention-kernel speedup, 1.97x e2e throughput; L2 hit rate up to 82.66%)
validation_workloads: Synthetic (input length 512; output tokens 512-8192; batch size 1-128)

scope_assumptions.en: Decode-phase attention only, inside the vLLM XFormers backend (FP16); FlashAttention-3 kernel itself is not modified, only compared against. Benefit is proportional to KV-head count, so it favors GQA with more Q heads per KV block and degrades for aggressive GQA (Qwen2.5-7B 7:1 shows a 2-5% e2e regression vs FA3) and for MHA (Llama2-7B baseline L2 hit rate is near 0). Gains assume the next KV block fits in L2 and total KV fits in HBM; at batch 128 / 8K tokens, exceeding L2 capacity or HBM triggers vLLM recomputation and throughput degrades. Multi-GPU benefit decays as TP partitions attention heads (KV heads per GPU drop to 1/2, 1/4, 1/8). Prefetch size is a fixed 4096-byte bulk copy per block; only H20 (Hopper) is evaluated.
scope_assumptions.zh: 僅針對解碼階段的 attention，且在 vLLM XFormers backend（FP16）內；並未修改 FlashAttention-3 kernel 本身，只與之比較。效益與 KV head 數成正比，因此偏好「每個 KV block 服務更多 Q head」的 GQA，對激進 GQA（Qwen2.5-7B 7:1，相較 FA3 端到端回退 2-5%）與 MHA（Llama2-7B 基線 L2 命中率近乎 0）則退化。增益的前提是下一個 KV block 能放進 L2、且整體 KV 能放進 HBM；在 batch 128 / 8K token 時，一旦超出 L2 容量或 HBM 就會觸發 vLLM 重算而吞吐下降。多 GPU 下，TP 切分 attention head（每 GPU 的 KV head 降為 1/2、1/4、1/8）使效益遞減。預取大小為每個 block 固定 4096-byte 的 bulk copy；僅在 H20（Hopper）上評估。

source.notes: Inter-kernel/L2/cache reuse is the central contribution: cp.async.bulk.prefetch.L2.global stages the next KV block into L2 for high-speed reuse; verified in repo attention_kernels.cuh lines 281-287 (key) and 425-430 (value).

title: When KV Cache Reuse Fails in Multi-Agent Systems: Cross-Candidate Interaction is Crucial for LLM Judges
authors: Sichu Liang; Zhenglin Wang; Jiajia Chu; Pengfei Xia; Hui Zang; Deyu Zhou
research_focus: LLM serving, Long-context / Prefix cache, Agentic / Workflow serving

problem_statement.en: Cross-agent KV cache reuse can reduce repeated judge prefill, but judge agents must jointly compare candidate blocks whose KV tensors were formed under different execution contexts. Existing reuse schemes may leave end-task accuracy stable while changing which candidate the judge selects, undermining attribution and auditability.
problem_statement.zh: 跨 agent 的 KV cache 重用可減少 judge prefill 的重複運算，但 judge agent 必須聯合比較多個 candidate block，而其 KV tensors 是在不同 execution context 下形成。既有重用方案可能在最終任務 accuracy 維持穩定時改變 judge 所選候選，進而削弱 attribution 與 auditability。

key_innovation.en: A judge-centric diagnostic framework that introduces Judge Consistency Rate (JCR) to measure selection invariance against dense prefill. Attention-region analysis and a cross-candidate masking ablation trace failures to weakened cross-candidate interaction, while PAL-KV pools anchors across agents to test and largely rule out agent identity as the dominant cause.
key_innovation.zh: 提出以 judge 為中心的診斷框架，並以 Judge Consistency Rate (JCR) 衡量相對於 dense prefill 的選擇不變性。attention region 分析與 cross-candidate masking ablation 將失效歸因於跨候選互動減弱；PAL-KV 則跨 agent 彙集 anchor，以檢驗並大致排除 agent identity 為主要成因。

key_improvements.en: Across MMLU, GSM8K, and HumanEval with shuffled candidates, Naïve Reuse attains 100% candidate-block reuse but only 19.88–27.95% JCR, while KVCOMM/PAL-KV attain 21.74–51.75% JCR. Masking cross-candidate attention under dense prefill reduces JCR from 100% to 22.22–32.03%, identifying interaction loss as the key failure mechanism.
key_improvements.zh: 在 MMLU、GSM8K 與 HumanEval 的候選 shuffle 設定中，Naïve Reuse 雖達到 100% candidate-block 重用率，JCR 僅為 19.88–27.95%；KVCOMM/PAL-KV 的 JCR 為 21.74–51.75%。在 dense prefill 下遮蔽 cross-candidate attention，會使 JCR 由 100% 降至 22.22–32.03%，顯示互動損失是主要失效機制。

reuse_metric.en: JCR is the share of examples for which reuse selects the same candidate as dense prefill. With shuffled candidates, Naïve Reuse reuses 100% of candidate blocks but reaches only 19.88–27.95% JCR; KVCOMM/PAL-KV reuse 31.86–66.96% and reach 21.74–51.75% JCR.
reuse_metric.zh: JCR 表示重用方法與 dense prefill 選擇相同候選的樣本比例。在候選 shuffle 設定中，Naïve Reuse 重用 100% 的 candidate block，但 JCR 僅為 19.88–27.95%；KVCOMM/PAL-KV 的重用率為 31.86–66.96%，JCR 為 21.74–51.75%。

title: KVComm: Enabling Efficient LLM Communication through Selective KV Sharing
authors: Xiangyu Shi; Marco Chiesa; Gerald Q. Maguire Jr.; Dejan Kostić
research_focus: Agentic / Workflow serving

problem_statement.en: Natural-language inter-LLM communication requires costly decoding steps and can discard information during sampling, while hidden-state protocols concentrate information in the final token and transfer too little activation state. Multi-agent systems therefore need an effective communication medium that reduces sender computation and transmission without sacrificing task quality.
problem_statement.zh: 以自然語言進行 inter-LLM communication 需要成本高昂的多步 decoding，且可能在 sampling 過程中遺失資訊；hidden-state protocol 又會使資訊集中於最後一個 token，僅能傳遞有限的 activation state。因此，multi-agent system 需要在不犧牲任務品質的前提下，降低 sender 運算與傳輸成本的有效 communication medium。

key_innovation.en: KVComm prefills the sender context, scores layers using query-to-context attention mass plus a Gaussian middle-layer prior, and transmits only the top-scoring, potentially non-contiguous layers' KV pairs. The receiver concatenates them into the corresponding attention layers during prefill and decoding.
key_innovation.zh: KVComm 對 sender context 執行 prefill，以 query-to-context attention mass 與以中間 layer 為中心的 Gaussian prior 計算 layer 分數，僅傳輸得分最高且可不連續的 layers 之 KV pairs；receiver 在對應 attention layer 的 prefill 與 decoding 階段串接這些 KV pairs。

baselines_compared: Baseline (no communication), Skyline, NLD, CIPHER, AC, Random selection

key_improvements.en: KVComm reduces computation cost by 2.5x to 6x relative to Skyline and communication cost by up to 3x relative to transmitting every layer's KV pairs, while retaining comparable task performance.
key_improvements.zh: KVComm 相較 Skyline 將運算成本降低 2.5x 至 6x，並相較傳輸所有 layers 的 KV pairs 將 communication cost 最高降低 3x，同時維持相近的任務表現。

reuse_metric.en: Comparable to the Skyline upper bound while transmitting as few as 30% of layers' KV pairs; up to 3x lower communication cost than transmitting every layer.
reuse_metric.zh: 僅傳輸少至 30% layers 的 KV pairs，即可達到與 Skyline 上界相近的表現；相較傳輸所有 layers，communication cost 最高降低 3x。

title: KVCOMM: Online Cross-context KV-cache Communication for Efficient LLM-based Multi-agent Systems
authors: Hancheng Ye; Zhengqi Gao; Mingyuan Ma; Qinsi Wang; Yuzhe Fu; Ming-Yu Chung; Yueqian Lin; Zhijian Liu; Jianyi Zhang; Danyang Zhuo; Yiran Chen
venue_full: Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems
research_focus: LLM serving, Long-context / Prefix cache, Agentic / Workflow serving

problem_statement.en: Multi-agent LLM pipelines repeatedly prefill overlapping contexts when agents exchange messages, causing redundant computation and high TTFT. Direct KV cache reuse fails because agent-specific prefixes place shared content at different positions and induce context-dependent cache-offset variance.
problem_statement.zh: 多 agent LLM pipeline 在 agent 交換訊息時，會對重疊 context 重複執行 prefill，造成冗餘運算並提高 TTFT。由於 agent 專屬 prefix 使共享內容位於不同位置，並引發與 context 相關的 KV cache offset variance，因此無法直接重用 KV cache。

key_innovation.en: KVCOMM is a training-free, prompt-adaptive framework that maintains an online anchor pool of observed context-dependent KV cache offsets. It matches embedding-similar anchors, interpolates their offsets, performs RoPE de-rotation/re-rotation for positional alignment, and adds the estimated Key/Value offsets to the base KV cache before decoding.
key_innovation.zh: KVCOMM 是免訓練且可依 prompt 調適的框架，透過 online anchor pool 保存觀察到的 context-dependent KV cache offset。系統匹配 embedding 相近的 anchor、內插其 offset，並以 RoPE de-rotation/re-rotation 完成位置對齊，再將估計的 Key/Value offset 加至 base KV cache 後執行 decoding。

key_improvements.en: Across RAG, math reasoning, and collaborative coding workloads, KVCOMM achieves over 70% reuse without quality degradation. In a five-agent setting, it provides up to 7.8x speedup over the standard prefill pipeline and reduces TTFT from ~430 ms to ~55 ms.
key_improvements.zh: 在 RAG、數學推理與協作 coding 工作負載下，KVCOMM 達成超過 70% 的重用率且品質無損。在 5-agent 設定中，相較 standard prefill pipeline 最高可加速 7.8x，並將 TTFT 由約 430 ms 降至約 55 ms。

ai_task: LLM Serving, Multi-agent Systems, RAG

reuse_metric.en: Over 70% agent-level reuse across RAG, math reasoning, and collaborative coding workloads without quality degradation; Reuse Rate is the proportion of agents reusing all KV caches during the complete serving procedure.
reuse_metric.zh: 在 RAG、數學推理與協作 coding 工作負載中，agent-level 重用率超過 70%，且未造成品質下降；Reuse Rate 定義為在完整 serving 流程中重用全部 KV cache 的 agent 比例。

title: KVEraser: Learning to Steer KV Cache for Efficient Localized Context Erasing
authors: Mufei Li; Shikun Liu; Dongqi Fu; Haoyu Wang; Yinglong Xia; Hong Li; Hong Yan; Pan Li
venue_full: ICML 2026 Workshop on the Impact of Memorization on Trustworthy Foundation Models
research_focus: Long-context / Prefix cache, Agentic / Workflow serving

problem_statement.en: After a context has been prefilled, deleting a short stale, incorrect, or harmful span invalidates the KV states of every later token because the span's influence has propagated through the suffix. Exact context erasing therefore requires recomputing the entire suffix, making cost scale with suffix length rather than erased-span length.
problem_statement.zh: context 完成 prefill 後，若刪除短小且過時、錯誤或有害的 span，由於其影響已沿 suffix 傳播，後續所有 token 的 KV state 都會失效。精確 context erasing 因而必須重算整個 suffix，使成本隨 suffix length 而非 erased-span length 擴張。

key_innovation.en: KVEraser uses a trainable eraser initialized from the generator backbone to replace only the erased interval's KV states with length-preserving steering states conditioned on the preserved prefix cache and erased span, while reusing the remaining prefix and suffix cache unchanged. Two-stage span-neighbor pre-training and task-specific fine-tuning teach the surrogate cache to reproduce counterfactual decoding behavior.
key_innovation.zh: KVEraser 採用由 generator backbone 初始化的 trainable eraser，根據 preserved prefix KV cache 與 erased span 產生等長 steering state，僅替換待刪除區間的 KV state，並維持其餘 prefix 與 suffix cache 不變。兩階段的 span-neighbor pre-training 與 task-specific fine-tuning，訓練 surrogate cache 重現刪除該 span 後的 counterfactual decoding behavior。

baselines_compared: Full recompute, Delete-and-shift, Instruction-only forgetting, Local suffix repair (erase), Local suffix repair (query)

key_improvements.en: On the controlled NIAH benchmark, KVEraser achieves near-perfect exact match across 1K–32K contexts, matching full recomputation; over this range, its latency increases by only 24% versus 17.6x for full recomputation. On unseen long-document QA, it performs best among approximate baselines and delivers a 3–4x speedup over full recomputation.
key_improvements.zh: 在 controlled NIAH benchmark 上，KVEraser 於 1K–32K context 皆取得近乎完美的 exact match，與 full recomputation 相當；此範圍內其 latency 僅增加 24%，full recomputation 則增加 17.6x。在未見過的 long-document QA 上，KVEraser 在 approximate baseline 中表現最佳，並較 full recomputation 加速 3–4x。

compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA A100 80GB, 1.7 TiB RAM, 24 CPU cores

reuse_metric.en: No reuse-rate percentage is reported. By replacing only the erased interval and reusing the remaining KV cache unchanged, KVEraser achieves near-perfect exact match across 1K–32K contexts, matching full recomputation; across three unseen QA datasets, its average exact match is 0.879.
reuse_metric.zh: 論文未報告重用率百分比。KVEraser 僅替換待刪除區間並重用其餘 KV cache，在 1K–32K context 上取得近乎完美的 exact match，與 full recomputation 相當；在三個未見過的 QA 資料集上，其平均 exact match 為 0.879。

title: KVFlow: Efficient Prefix Caching for Accelerating LLM-Based Multi-Agent Workflows
authors: Zaifeng Pan; Ajjkumar Patel; Zhengding Hu; Yipeng Shen; Yue Guan; Wan-Lu Li; Lianhui Qin; Yida Wang; Yufei Ding
research_focus: Agentic / Workflow serving, Datacenter networking

problem_statement.en: Existing LLM serving systems use LRU-based KV cache eviction, which fails to anticipate future agent usage in multi-agent workflows, leading to frequent cache misses and high recomputation or swapping overhead.
problem_statement.zh: 現有 LLM serving 系統採用 LRU 策略進行 KV cache eviction，無法預判多 agent workflow 中的未來使用需求，導致頻繁的 cache miss 及高昂的重計算或 swap 開銷。

key_innovation.en: KVFlow, a workflow-aware KV cache management framework that uses an Agent Step Graph to predict future agent execution and implements a fine-grained eviction policy combined with fully overlapped KV prefetching.
key_innovation.zh: KVFlow 是一個 workflow 感知的 KV cache 管理框架，利用 Agent Step Graph 預測未來 agent 執行步驟，並結合細粒度 eviction 策略與完全重疊的 KV 預取機制。

key_improvements.en: Up to 1.83x speedup for single workflows with large prompts and up to 2.19x speedup for scenarios with many concurrent workflows.
key_improvements.zh: 大 prompt 的單一 workflow 場景最高加速 1.83x；多個並發 workflow 場景最高加速 2.19x。

ai_task: LLM Serving, Multi-agent Systems, Agentic Workflow
compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA A10G, NVIDIA H100, Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen2.5-32B
offload_trigger: GPU memory pressure: when GPU memory becomes constrained, KVFlow first evicts all varying (dynamic) suffixes, then fixed-prompt prefix KV nodes in descending order of workflow-derived eviction priority, backing evicted agents' fixed-prompt KV up to CPU memory.
prefetch_signal_timing: Workflow-graph lookahead: steps-to-execution values from the Agent Step Graph identify which agents run next; their KV is asynchronously prefetched from CPU to GPU while the current agent executes, overlapping PCIe transfer with compute; status-aware scheduling dispatches requests only after loading completes.
agent_awareness: Exploits the multi-agent workflow graph: an Agent Step Graph with per-agent steps-to-execution (propagated through branching and synchronization) drives eviction priority and prefetching; also exploits multi-agent prefix sharing in the tree-structured cache and fixed-vs-dynamic prompt structure.

when_to_offload_rule.en: When GPU memory becomes constrained, first evict all varying suffixes, then evict fixed-prompt KV cache nodes in descending order of steps-to-execution-derived priority (agents furthest from next activation first), backing evicted fixed-prompt KV up to CPU memory.
when_to_offload_rule.zh: 當 GPU 記憶體不足時，先逐出所有動態變化的 suffix，再依 steps-to-execution 推得之優先序由高至低逐出各 agent 固定 prompt 的 KV cache 節點（距下次執行最遠的 agent 最先被逐出），並將其卸載至 CPU 記憶體作為次級快取。

title: KVzip: Query-Agnostic KV Cache Compression with Context Reconstruction
authors: Jang-Hyun Kim; Jinuk Kim; Sangwoo Kwon; Jae W. Lee; Sangdoo Yun; Hyun Oh Song
venue_full: Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2025, Oral)
affiliations: Seoul National University, Neural Processing Research Center, NAVER AI Lab
research_focus: KV cache compression, Long-context / Prefix cache, LLM serving

problem_statement.en: As context length grows, KV caches dominate memory and attention latency. Existing query-aware KV eviction methods (e.g. SnapKV, PyramidKV) score importance using the immediate query, so the compressed cache overfits the initial query: reusing it across diverse subsequent queries degrades accuracy even at a 90% cache budget, while re-prefilling per query is costly.
problem_statement.zh: 隨 context 長度增加，KV cache 佔用大量記憶體並拉高 attention 延遲。既有 query-aware KV 淘汰方法（如 SnapKV、PyramidKV）依當前 query 評估重要性，使壓縮後的 cache 過度貼合初始 query：跨多樣後續 query 重用時，即使 cache 預算高達 90% 仍出現明顯效能退化，而逐 query 重新 prefill 的成本又過高。

key_innovation.en: Query-agnostic KV eviction: each KV pair's importance is the maximum cross-attention it receives while the LLM reconstructs the original context from the cache via a repeat prompt in a single teacher-forced forward pass. Chunked scoring (2K-token chunks) reduces scoring cost from O(n_c^2) to linear O(m*n_c), and the same scores support both pair-level eviction and DuoAttention-style head-level context-independent eviction.
key_innovation.zh: Query-agnostic 的 KV 淘汰機制：以 LLM 透過 repeat prompt 從 cache 重建原始 context 的單次 teacher-forced forward pass，取每個 KV pair 收到的最大 cross-attention 作為重要性分數。Chunked scoring（2K token 分塊）將評分成本由 O(n_c^2) 降為線性 O(m*n_c)；同一組分數亦同時支援 pair-level 淘汰與 DuoAttention 式 head-level（context 無關）淘汰。

key_improvements.en: Reduces KV cache size by 3-4x and FlashAttention decoding latency by ~2x with negligible loss on QA, retrieval, reasoning, and code tasks up to 170K context; remains accurate up to 70% eviction where query-aware baselines degrade even at 10%; replaces DuoAttention's tens-of-GPU-hours head scoring with a few forward passes within a minute; with 4-bit KV quantization shrinks a 124K-token cache from 16.3 GB to 1.2 GB.
key_improvements.zh: 在 QA、檢索、推理與程式理解任務（context 最長 170K）上，KV cache 縮小 3-4x、FlashAttention decode 延遲約降 2x 且效能損失可忽略；淘汰比例達 70% 仍維持精度，而 query-aware 基線在 10% 淘汰即開始退化；DuoAttention 需數十 GPU-hours 的 head 評分被一分鐘內的少數 forward passes 取代；搭配 4-bit KV 量化可將 124K token 的 cache 由 16.3 GB 壓縮至 1.2 GB。

ai_task: KV Cache Compression, LLM Serving

title: Fast Inference for Augmented Large Language Models
authors: Rana Shahout; Cong Liang; Shiji Xin; Qianru Lao; Yong Cui; Minlan Yu; Michael Mitzenmacher
research_focus: LLM serving, Agentic / Workflow serving, KV cache offloading, Length prediction

problem_statement.en: Augmented LLMs interleave decoding with external API/tool calls, and existing serving systems either waste KV cache memory during API calls or, like InferCept, manage that memory but still schedule requests FCFS, causing head-of-line blocking and long request completion times under load.
problem_statement.zh: Augmented LLM 在 decode 過程中穿插外部 API/工具呼叫，現有服務系統或在 API call 期間浪費 KV cache 記憶體，或如 InferCept 雖管理該記憶體但仍採用 FCFS 排程，導致 head-of-line blocking 並在高負載下顯著拉長請求完成時間。

key_innovation.en: LAMPS unifies API-call memory handling with scheduling: an OPT-125M-based classifier predicts pre-API output length (50 bins of 10 tokens) and per-API-type statistics predict API duration; each request is assigned the memory-waste-minimizing handling strategy (Preserve / Discard-and-Recompute / Swap) before processing, and requests are ranked by predicted memory-consumption-over-time, with a per-request starvation-prevention counter.
key_innovation.zh: LAMPS 將 API call 期間的記憶體處置與排程統一：以 OPT-125M 分類器預測 pre-API 輸出長度（50 個各 10 tokens 的 bins），並依 API 類型統計預測 API 時長；在請求處理前即指派使記憶體浪費最小的處置策略（Preserve / Discard-and-Recompute / Swap），並依預測之 memory-over-time（記憶體使用量對時間的積分）對請求排序，輔以每請求的 starvation 防止計數器。

key_improvements.en: Improves end-to-end latency by 27%-85% and reduces TTFT by 4%-96% compared to InferCept, with greater gains over vLLM; up to 50.23% higher throughput than InferCept on the multi-API dataset.
key_improvements.zh: 相較於 InferCept，端到端延遲改善 27%-85%、TTFT 降低 4%-96%，相較於 vLLM 增益更大；在 multi-API 資料集上吞吐量較 InferCept 最高提升 50.23%。

compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA A100 (80GB, capped at 40GB), AMD EPYC 7313
offload_trigger: A request's KV cache leaves GPU memory when the request encounters an API/tool call during decoding and its pre-assigned handling strategy is Swap (offload to CPU) or Discard (free and later recompute); the strategy is chosen before the request is processed, based on predicted pre-API output length and predicted API duration.
prefetch_signal_timing: Event-driven, not speculative: when the API call finishes, the request re-enters the waiting queue and its KV is swapped back in (or recomputed for Discard) once the scheduler admits it; predicted API duration is used only ahead of time to pick the handling strategy, not to prefetch before the API returns.
agent_awareness: Exploits that augmented-LLM API calls fall into fixed classes (math, QA, virtual environment, chatbot, image generation, TTS, ToolBench tools) with low intra-class duration variance, enabling per-type API-duration prediction; pre-API output length is predicted from the prompt via OPT-125M, and multi-API requests are segmented per API call.

when_to_offload_rule.en: Before a request runs, evaluate the predicted memory waste of Preserve (idle memory over API duration), Discard-and-Recompute (recomputation forward-pass cost), and Swap (transfer stall cost) using InferCept's waste equations with predicted pre-API length and API duration, assign the minimum-waste strategy, and rank requests for scheduling by their memory-over-time integral under that strategy.
when_to_offload_rule.zh: 在請求執行前，以 InferCept 的 waste 方程式結合預測之 pre-API 長度與 API 時長，評估 Preserve（API 期間閒置記憶體）、Discard-and-Recompute（重算 forward-pass 成本）與 Swap（傳輸停頓成本）的預測記憶體浪費，指派浪費最小的策略，並依該策略下的 memory-over-time 積分對請求進行排程排序。

title: Latent Cache Flow: Model-to-Model Communication Without Text
authors: Maximillian Rossi; Prajwal Raghunath; Eugene Wu
research_focus: Agentic / Workflow serving, KV cache compression

problem_statement.en: Text-mediated communication between LLM agents incurs autoregressive decoding latency and loses information during discrete-token projection. Cache-to-Cache avoids text but uses a 956 MB position-wise adapter and requires sharer and receiver contexts to be token-aligned, which is unsuitable when agents have different contexts.
problem_statement.zh: LLM agent 透過 text 通訊時，autoregressive decode 會增加延遲，離散 token 投影也會造成資訊損失。Cache-to-Cache 雖避免 text，卻使用 956 MB 的逐位置 adapter，並要求 sharer 與 receiver 的 context 在 token 層級對齊，因此不適用於不同 context 的 agent。

key_innovation.en: Latent Cache Flow jointly translates keys and values through a shared low-dimensional bottleneck with learned gates and layer pruning. Its LCF-X extension hierarchically pools the sharer's full KV cache into a fixed-size, position-free summary that conditions a receiver with a different context.
key_innovation.zh: Latent Cache Flow 以共享的低維 bottleneck 聯合轉換 key 與 value，並結合 learned gate 與 layer pruning。其 LCF-X 擴充透過 hierarchical pooling，將 sharer 的完整 KV cache 彙整為固定大小、與位置無關的 summary，使具有不同 context 的 receiver 能直接據此推論。

baselines_compared: Cache-to-Cache (C2C), Text-to-Text (T2T), Receiver-only, Sharer-only, Optimal-Routing Frontier (ORF)

key_improvements.en: A pruned 13 MB LCF adapter outperforms the 956 MB C2C adapter in shared-context evaluation. Across different contexts, LCF-X improves F1 by 7.5% and Exact Match by 23% over text communication while reducing TTFT from 410 ms to 48 ms (8.5×).
key_improvements.zh: 在 shared-context 評測中，經 pruning 的 13 MB LCF adapter 優於 956 MB 的 C2C adapter。在不同 context 間，LCF-X 相較 text 通訊將 F1 提升 7.5%、Exact Match 提升 23%，並把 TTFT 從 410 ms 降至 48 ms (8.5×)。

compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA A100 80GB, NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell

reuse_metric.en: The 9-layer LCF-128 preserves a 31.26 weighted accuracy versus C2C's 29.13 with a 13 MB versus 956 MB projector (76× smaller); LCF-X reaches 35.13 F1 and 25.28 EM across disjoint contexts.
reuse_metric.zh: 9-layer LCF-128 以 13 MB projector 達到 31.26 的 weighted accuracy，優於 C2C 使用 956 MB projector 時的 29.13，容量縮減 76×；LCF-X 在互斥 context 間達到 35.13 F1 與 25.28 EM。

title: Latent Collaboration in Multi-Agent Systems
authors: Jiaru Zou; Ruizhong Qiu; Gaotang Li; Xiyuan Yang; Katherine Tieu; Pan Lu; Ke Shen; Hanghang Tong; Yejin Choi; Jingrui He; James Zou; Mengdi Wang; Ling Yang
venue_full: Proceedings of the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (PMLR 306)
affiliations: Princeton University, Stanford University, University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign
research_focus: Reasoning / Test-time scaling, Agentic / Workflow serving

problem_statement.en: Text-mediated LLM multi-agent systems repeatedly decode rich continuous internal reasoning into discrete token sequences and re-encode those sequences at downstream agents, losing information and adding substantial generation cost. Existing latent methods do not provide an end-to-end framework that unifies within-agent latent reasoning with lossless cross-agent communication.
problem_statement.zh: 以 text 為媒介的 LLM 多 agent 系統，必須將豐富的連續內部推理反覆 decoding 為離散 token sequence，再由下游 agent 重新編碼，因而造成資訊損失與顯著生成成本。既有 latent 方法尚未提供同時整合 agent 內 latent reasoning 與無損跨 agent 通訊的端到端框架。

key_innovation.en: LatentMAS is a training-free framework in which each agent autoregressively generates last-layer hidden states as latent thoughts, mapped back to the input space with a one-time linear alignment operator. It transfers the predecessor's complete layer-wise KV cache, covering input context and latent thoughts, through shared working memory and exact cache concatenation, so only the final agent decodes text.
key_innovation.zh: LatentMAS 是免訓練框架；每個 agent 將 last-layer hidden state auto-regressively 生成為 latent thought，並以一次性計算的 linear alignment operator 映射回 input space。系統透過 shared working memory 與精確的 cache concatenation，傳遞前一 agent 的完整逐 layer KV cache（涵蓋 input context 與 latent thought），僅由最後一個 agent decoding text。

key_improvements.en: Across nine benchmarks and five Qwen3/Llama3 backbones, LatentMAS improves accuracy over Single by an average of 14.6% and 13.3% in sequential and hierarchical settings, and by 2.8% and 4.6% over the corresponding TextMAS baselines. Relative to sequential and hierarchical TextMAS, it reduces output-token usage by 70.8% and 83.7% and provides 4× and 4.3× faster end-to-end inference, respectively.
key_improvements.zh: 在九項 benchmark 與五種 Qwen3/Llama3 backbone 上，LatentMAS 在 sequential 與 hierarchical 設定中相較 Single 的平均 accuracy 分別提升 14.6% 與 13.3%，相較對應 TextMAS 則分別提升 2.8% 與 4.6%。相較 sequential 與 hierarchical TextMAS，其 output-token 用量分別減少 70.8% 與 83.7%，端到端 inference 分別加速 4× 與 4.3×。

agent_role: Executor / worker, Judge / aggregator, Planner, Coder

reuse_metric.en: The complete layer-wise KV working memory, including the input context and generated latent thoughts, is transferred to the next agent without re-encoding. Under the theorem's same-model, same-input assumption, Theorem 3.3 establishes output equivalence to directly inputting the predecessor's outputs; the sequential evaluation reports a 14.6% average accuracy gain over Single.
reuse_metric.zh: 完整的逐 layer KV working memory（包含 input context 與生成的 latent thought）無須重新編碼即可傳至下一個 agent。在 theorem 的 same-model、same-input 假設下，Theorem 3.3 證明其 output 等價於直接輸入前一 agent 的輸出；sequential 評測則報告相較 Single 的平均 accuracy 提升 14.6%。

title: LCGuard: Latent Communication Guard for Safe KV Sharing in Multi-Agent Systems
authors: Sadia Asif; Mohammad Mohammadi Amiri; Momin Abbas; Prasanna Sattigeri; Karthikeyan Natesan Ramamurthy
research_focus: Agentic / Workflow serving

problem_statement.en: KV caches used for latent communication in multi-agent LLM systems can encode sensitive inputs and intermediate reasoning that remain recoverable even when agents never disclose them in text. Existing output-level safeguards and system-level cache isolation do not regulate the information content of intentionally shared KV representations.
