problem_statement.zh: 多 agent LLM 系統以 KV cache 進行 latent communication 時，其中可能編碼敏感輸入與中間推理資訊；即使 agent 未透過 text 明確揭露，這些資訊仍可能遭重建。既有 output-level safeguard 與系統層級 cache isolation 無法管控刻意共享之 KV representation 的資訊內容。

key_innovation.en: LCGuard applies a lightweight residual bottleneck transformation to keys and values before cross-agent transmission and jointly trains these communication functions against adversarial reconstruction decoders. Its minimax objective preserves downstream utility while suppressing locally and compositionally reconstructable private information.
key_innovation.zh: LCGuard 在跨 agent 傳輸前，分別對 Key 與 Value 套用輕量 residual bottleneck transformation，並使 communication function 與 adversarial reconstruction decoder 進行聯合訓練。其 minimax objective 在維持下游效用的同時，抑制局部與跨 agent 組合後仍可重建的私密資訊。

baselines_compared: Vanilla KV Sharing, LatentMAS, KVComm, PrivAct, ADAPT, Per-Agent LCGuard

key_improvements.en: Full-System LCGuard reduces attack success rate by approximately 65–75% while preserving most task performance. In Qwen3-4B sequential PrivacyLens, ASR falls from 0.871 with Vanilla KV Sharing to 0.216 while helpfulness remains 0.710 versus 0.780.
key_improvements.zh: Full-System LCGuard 將 attack success rate 降低約 65–75%，同時保留大部分任務效能。在 Qwen3-4B sequential PrivacyLens 設定中，ASR 由 Vanilla KV Sharing 的 0.871 降至 0.216，而 helpfulness 仍達 0.710，相較基準為 0.780。

reuse_metric.en: Approximately 65–75% lower ASR while preserving most task performance; for Qwen3-4B sequential PrivacyLens, Full-System LCGuard retains 0.710 helpfulness versus 0.780 for Vanilla KV Sharing while reducing ASR from 0.871 to 0.216.
reuse_metric.zh: ASR 約降低 65–75%，同時保留大部分任務效能；在 Qwen3-4B sequential PrivacyLens 設定中，Full-System LCGuard 的 helpfulness 為 0.710，相較 Vanilla KV Sharing 的 0.780，且 ASR 由 0.871 降至 0.216。

title: Lexico: Extreme KV Cache Compression via Sparse Coding  over Universal Dictionaries
authors: Junhyuck Kim; Jongho Park; Jaewoong Cho; Dimitris Papailiopoulos
research_focus: Datacenter networking

problem_statement.en: Large Language Models are limited by significant memory requirements for the KV cache, which grows linearly with sequence length and model size, creating a bottleneck for generation speed on memory-constrained GPUs.
problem_statement.zh: LLM 的 KV cache 記憶體需求隨序列長度與模型規模線性增長，在記憶體受限的 GPU 上形成生成速度瓶頸。

key_innovation.en: Lexico, a KV cache compression method that uses sparse coding over a small, input-agnostic universal dictionary to approximate key-value vectors as sparse linear combinations of dictionary atoms.
key_innovation.zh: Lexico 是一種 KV cache 壓縮方法，透過對小型、與輸入無關的通用字典進行稀疏編碼，將 key-value 向量近似為字典原子的稀疏線性組合。

baselines_compared: KIVI, ZipCache, per-token quantization, PyramidKV, SnapKV

key_improvements.en: Maintains 90-95% performance at 15-25% of full KV-cache memory; achieves up to 1.7x better compression than 2-bit quantization in low-memory regimes.
key_improvements.zh: 在僅使用完整 KV cache 記憶體 15–25% 的條件下仍保留 90–95% 效能；在低記憶體場景下壓縮率比 2-bit 量化最高高出 1.7x。

ai_task: LLM Serving, LLM Inference, Long-context understanding, Complex reasoning
compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA A100, Llama-3-8B, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct, Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct, Mistral-7B-Instruct, Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct

title: Leyline: KV Cache Directives for Agentic Inference
authors: Bole Ma; Jan Eitzinger; Harald Köstler
affiliations: Erlangen National High Performance Computing Center
research_focus: LLM serving, Long-context / Prefix cache, Agentic / Workflow serving

problem_statement.en: Policy-driven edits in agentic conversations remove or replace earlier tool outputs and shift downstream content, violating the append-only assumption of prefix caching. Existing serving stacks therefore re-prefill the changed suffix because they lack a policy-facing primitive that preserves valid cached work across semantic edits.
problem_statement.zh: Agentic 對話中的 policy-driven edit 會移除或替換先前的 tool output，並改變後續內容的位置，因而破壞 prefix caching 的 append-only 假設。既有 serving stack 缺乏可在語意編輯後保留有效 cached work 的 policy-facing primitive，因此必須對變更後的 suffix 重新執行 prefill。

key_innovation.en: Leyline exposes a declarative (span, replacement) directive with AMORTIZE and FORGET modes. Its SGLang integration preserves the unchanged radix prefix and, for AMORTIZE edits, freshly prefills the replacement while applying a closed-form RoPE delta-rotation to downstream MLA K_pe slots instead of recomputing the unchanged suffix.
key_innovation.zh: Leyline 提供具 AMORTIZE 與 FORGET mode 的宣告式 (span, replacement) directive。其 SGLang 整合會保留未變動的 radix prefix；對 AMORTIZE edit，系統僅對 replacement 執行 fresh prefill，並以封閉式 RoPE delta-rotation 校正後續 MLA K_pe slot，而不重算未變動的 suffix。

baselines_compared: SGLang RadixCache, Cache-off, Full re-prefill, keep_all policy

key_improvements.en: The splice path raises replay cache-hit rate by +11.2 percentage points over standard RadixCache and reduces p50 end-to-end latency by up to 241 ms (4.4%) at concurrency 8. Separately, a truncation policy raises debug-gym solve rate by +14.3 percentage points, from 31.2% to 45.5%.
key_improvements.zh: Splice path 相較標準 RadixCache 將 replay cache-hit rate 提升 +11.2 percentage points，並於 concurrency 8 時將 p50 端到端 latency 最多降低 241 ms（4.4%）。此外，truncation policy 將 debug-gym solve rate 提升 +14.3 percentage points，由 31.2% 增至 45.5%。

ai_task: LLM Serving
gpu_count: 1-4x GPUs per configuration (4x H200 TP=4; 2x H100; 1x H200; 1x H100)

reuse_metric.en: Replay cache-hit rate is 60.8% versus 49.6% for standard RadixCache (+11.2 percentage points) at every tested concurrency; first-token agreement with RadixCache ranges from 94.5% to 100% across the batch-scaling sweep.
reuse_metric.zh: 在所有測試的 concurrency 下，replay cache-hit rate 皆為 60.8%，相較標準 RadixCache 的 49.6% 提升 +11.2 percentage points；batch-scaling sweep 中與 RadixCache 的 first-token agreement 為 94.5% 至 100%。

title: Throughput-Optimal Scheduling Algorithms for LLM Inference and AI Agents
authors: J.G. Dai; Tianze Deng; Yueying Li; Tianyi Peng
affiliations: Cornell University, University of Chicago Booth, Columbia Business School
research_focus: Agentic / Workflow serving, Multi-tenant scheduling, Continuous batching, Capacity planning, Performance modeling, Queueing theory

problem_statement.en: Practitioners adopt LLM inference schedulers (FasterTransformer, vLLM, Orca, Sarathi-Serve) without a principled theoretical framework for evaluating throughput optimality and stability across workloads, models, and hardware.
problem_statement.zh: 實務上 FasterTransformer、vLLM、Orca、Sarathi-Serve 等 LLM 推理 scheduler 缺乏可比較吞吐量最佳性與穩定性的原則性理論架構，難以在不同工作負載、模型與硬體間進行嚴謹評估。

key_innovation.en: A queueing-theoretic framework with a fluid-limit analysis for multi-class batched processing networks under K-FCFS scheduling. Models batch processing time as a piecewise constant function of token load and proves that all work-conserving iteration-level schedulers achieve maximum throughput, while non-work-conserving schedulers (FasterTransformer, vanilla vLLM) are not maximally stable.
key_innovation.zh: 提出 LLM 推理的 queueing theory 架構，並對 K-FCFS scheduling 下的多類別批次處理網路發展 fluid-limit 分析。將 batch 處理時間建模為 token load 的 piecewise constant 函式，證明所有 work-conserving 的 iteration-level scheduler 皆達吞吐量最佳性，而非 work-conserving scheduler（FasterTransformer 與 vanilla vLLM）並非最大穩定。

key_improvements.en: Theoretical: proves Orca and Sarathi-Serve are throughput-optimal and FasterTransformer/vanilla vLLM are unstable under moderate load. Empirical: under Poisson arrivals (14 queries/s, 129 prefill + 112 decode tokens) on CodeLlama-34B with A100, queues in FasterTransformer and vLLM diverge while Sarathi-Serve stays stable; piecewise constant model attains R^2 above 0.97 across configurations.
key_improvements.zh: 理論上證明 Orca 與 Sarathi-Serve 為吞吐量最佳，FasterTransformer 與 vanilla vLLM 在中等負載下不穩定。實驗上以 CodeLlama-34B 在 A100、Poisson 到達率 14 queries/s（prefill 129、decode 112 tokens）測試，FasterTransformer 與 vLLM 佇列發散，Sarathi-Serve 維持穩定；piecewise constant 模型於各設定下 R^2 皆超過 0.97。

reported_accuracy: R^2 > 0.97 for piecewise constant batch-time fit
validation_workloads: Synthetic (Poisson arrivals), Production code traces (Patel et al. 2023), ShareGPT

scope_assumptions.en: Focuses on throughput aspect; SLO attainment left as future work. Batch processing time approximated as piecewise constant in token load, requiring measured constants per model and tensor-parallel configuration. Cyclic routing topologies and batch-size constraints can void throughput-optimality even for work-conserving algorithms. AI-agent extension assumes DAG/fork-join routing.
scope_assumptions.zh: 聚焦於吞吐量分析，SLO 達成留待後續工作。將 batch 處理時間近似為 token load 的 piecewise constant，需依模型與 tensor parallelism 設定量測常數。在 cyclic routing 拓樸與 batch size 限制下，即使 work-conserving 演算法亦可能失去吞吐量最佳性。AI-agent 延伸假設 DAG 或 fork-join routing。

title: LIFE: Forecasting LLM Inference Performance via Hardware-Agnostic Analytical Modeling
authors: Rajeev Patwari; Ashish Sirasao; Devleena Das
research_focus: Long-context / Prefix cache, Continuous batching, KV cache compression, LoRA / Multi-adapter, Performance modeling, Hardware co-design

problem_statement.en: Forecasting LLM inference performance on heterogeneous edge devices (CPUs, NPUs, integrated GPUs) is difficult because workload demands shift with prompt and generation lengths, and existing approaches rely on GPU-specific benchmarking or ML-based latency predictors that lack hardware generality.
problem_statement.zh: 在 CPU、NPU、integrated GPU 等異質終端裝置上預測 LLM 推理性能極具挑戰，因為計算與記憶體需求隨 prompt 與 generation 長度動態變化，而既有方法多仰賴 GPU 專屬 benchmarking 或受限於特定硬體的 ML 型延遲預測器，缺乏跨硬體的通用性。

key_innovation.en: LIFE, a modular analytical framework that builds a hierarchical operator-level workload model (compute ops, memory R/W, dispatch calls) configurable for datatypes, KV cache compression, LoRA, chunked prefill, attention variants, and operator fusion; it forecasts TTFT, TPOT and TPS using only TOPS and memory-bandwidth specs plus operator efficiency factors, without requiring per-device benchmark datasets.
key_innovation.zh: LIFE 是一套模組化的分析式框架，建構階層式 operator 層級工作負載模型（compute ops、memory R/W、dispatch calls），可配置 datatype、KV cache 壓縮、LoRA、chunked prefill、attention 變體與 operator fusion；僅以 TOPS 與記憶體頻寬規格加上 operator 效率因子，即可預測 TTFT、TPOT 與 TPS，無須個別硬體的 benchmark 資料集。

key_improvements.en: Forecasts closely match measurements on AMD Ryzen 9 HX 370 CPU, AMD Ryzen AI Max+ 395 NPU/iGPU and NVIDIA V100 GPU across Llama-2-7B variants; no headline aggregate accuracy is reported, only per-configuration trend-match.
key_improvements.zh: 在 AMD Ryzen 9 HX 370 CPU、AMD Ryzen AI Max+ 395 NPU/iGPU 與 NVIDIA V100 GPU 上對 Llama-2-7B 變體的預測值與量測值相當吻合；論文未提供整體量化精度，僅以個別配置的趨勢吻合作為驗證。

compute_memory_hw: AMD Ryzen 9 HX 370, AMD Ryzen AI Max+ 395 (NPU+iGPU), NVIDIA V100
gpu_count: 1x V100, plus AMD Ryzen CPU/NPU/iGPU setups
reported_accuracy: Not Reported (qualitative trend-match only)
models_validated: Llama-2-7B (bf16-bf16, bf16-int4, bf16-int4-kv4, bf16-int4-mla, bf16-int4-lora, QuaRot-w4a4kv4, fp16-fp16)
validation_workloads: Synthetic (prompt lengths 32-65536, fixed Llama-2-7B configs)

scope_assumptions.en: Hardware-agnostic but requires user-supplied per-operator efficiency factors; validation limited to Llama-2-7B and small set of edge accelerators; does not cover multi-GPU parallelism, MoE, multimodal, or speculative decoding (left for future work).
scope_assumptions.zh: 雖宣稱硬體無關，但仍需使用者提供每個 operator 的效率因子；驗證僅限於 Llama-2-7B 與少量 edge accelerators，未涵蓋 multi-GPU 平行化、MoE、multimodal 與 speculative decoding（列為未來工作）。

title: Lightwave Fabrics: At-Scale Optical Circuit Switching for Datacenter and Machine Learning Systems
authors: Hong Liu; Ryohei Urata; Kevin Yasumura; Xiang Zhou; Roy Bannon; Jill Berger; Pedram Dashti; Norm Jouppi; Cedric Lam; Sheng Li; Erji Mao; Daniel Nelson; George Papen; Mukarram Tariq; Amin Vahdat
venue_full: IEEE/LEOS International Conference on Optical MEMS
research_focus: Datacenter networking, Network topology
zotero_collections: CS8803 Data Center Network and System (2026 Spring)

problem_statement.en: The paper addresses the limitations of static datacenter network topologies in meeting the dynamic communication demands of large-scale machine learning and datacenter workloads.
problem_statement.zh: 本文針對靜態資料中心網路拓撲在應對大規模機器學習與資料中心工作負載之動態通訊需求方面的不足進行探討。

key_innovation.en: Lightwave Fabrics, an at-scale optical circuit switching (OCS) architecture that enables dynamic, on-demand network reconfiguration to optimize topology for specific traffic patterns.
key_innovation.zh: Lightwave Fabrics 是一種大規模光路交換（OCS）架構，支援動態按需網路重組，以針對特定流量模式最佳化拓撲。

ai_task: Machine Learning Systems, Datacenter Networks

title: LIMINAL: Exploring The Frontiers of LLM Decode Performance
authors: Michael Davies; Neal Crago; Karthikeyan Sankaralingam; Christos Kozyrakis
research_focus: Long-context / Prefix cache, MoE serving, Capacity planning, Performance modeling, Collective communication, Hardware co-design, GPU memory tiering

problem_statement.en: Existing LLM inference performance studies are point evaluations tied to specific silicon, which conflate hardware bottlenecks with implementation artifacts and cannot reveal the fundamental architectural limits of auto-regressive decode under current and near-future memory, compute and interconnect technologies.
problem_statement.zh: 既有 LLM 推理效能研究多為與特定晶片綁定的點狀評估，難以區分硬體瓶頸與實作層面的副作用，亦無法揭示在目前與近未來的記憶體、運算與互連技術下，auto-regressive decode 的根本架構極限。

key_innovation.en: An analytical, hardware- and application-agnostic limit-study model expressing decode latency as max(T_Compute, T_Mem) + T_Exposed, where compute, memory, and collective communication terms are derived from FLOPs, bytes-loaded and expert-guided collective counts; enables systematic sweep over xPU configurations from HBM3 through HBM4, 3D-DRAM, and on-die SRAM.
key_innovation.zh: 提出與硬體、應用無關的解析式 limit-study 模型，將 decode latency 表示為 max(T_Compute, T_Mem) + T_Exposed，其中各分量由 FLOPs、bytes-loaded 與專家指定的 collective 數量推導；可系統性掃描從 HBM3、HBM4、3D-DRAM 至 on-die SRAM 等 xPU 配置。

baselines_compared: Measured TPOT on 8xH100 server using vLLM with PyTorch profiler (Llama3-8B, Llama3-70B, Llama4-Scout, Qwen3-4B, Qwen3-30B)

key_improvements.en: MAPE of 7.6% versus measured TPOT with R^2 of 0.948; identifies HBM3 ceiling around 5,300 UTPS per user for GPT-OSS 120B; shows 3D-DRAM yields 1.1-4.2x UTPS gain over HBM3; reaching >10,000 UTPS requires algorithmic co-evolution.
key_improvements.zh: 相對於實測 TPOT 之 MAPE 為 7.6%，R^2 為 0.948；指出 HBM3 對 GPT-OSS 120B 的單使用者吞吐天花板約為 5,300 UTPS；3D-DRAM 相較 HBM3 可帶來 1.1 至 4.2x 的 UTPS 提升；超越 10,000 UTPS 必須仰賴演算法層面的協同演進。

compute_memory_hw: Modeled xPU configurations (HBM3, HBM4, advanced 3D-DRAM, on-die SRAM, 2.25 FP8 PFLOPS/sec tensor + 0.2 FP8 PFLOPS/sec scalar); validation on NVIDIA H100
gpu_count: 8x H100 (validation); modeled TP8 and TP128 systems
models_validated: Llama3-8B, Llama3-70B, Llama3-405B, Llama4-Scout, Llama4-Maverick, DeepSeek-V3, Qwen3-4B, Qwen3-30B, Qwen3-235B, Kimi-K2, GPT-OSS-20B, GPT-OSS-120B
validation_workloads: Synthetic sweeps over batch sizes 1-128 (powers of 2) and context lengths 1K-8K (steps of 1K); BF16 weights/activations on 8xH100 with vLLM PyTorch profiler

scope_assumptions.en: Assumes near-perfect prefetching and idealized memory access; abstracts away microarchitectural details, software overheads (OS, driver, runtime), interconnect topology and mapping optimization; collective latency modeled by expert rules with up to five collectives per transformer layer; focuses on current SOTA algorithms only.
scope_assumptions.zh: 假設近乎完美的 prefetching 與理想化的記憶體存取；抽象掉微架構細節、軟體 overhead（作業系統、驅動、runtime）、互連拓樸與 mapping 優化；collective latency 由專家規則決定，每個 transformer layer 至多 5 個 collective；僅考量目前 state-of-the-art 演算法。

title: On the Limits of Learned Importance Scoring for KV Cache Compression
authors: Brady Steele
research_focus: LLM serving, Long-context / Prefix cache, KV cache compression

problem_statement.en: KV cache memory grows linearly with sequence length, creating a critical bottleneck for long-context inference. Although learned importance scorers are assumed to identify more useful tokens than hand-crafted heuristics, it is unclear whether non-query-aware token-level scoring adds predictive signal under a fixed retention budget.
problem_statement.zh: KV cache 的記憶體占用隨 sequence length 線性成長，因而形成 long-context inference 的關鍵瓶頸。儘管 learned importance scorer 通常被假定能比手工 heuristic 更準確地識別有用 token，但在固定 retention budget 下，non-query-aware 的逐 token scoring 是否提供額外預測信號仍未獲充分驗證。

key_innovation.en: The paper builds Speculative Importance Prediction (SIP), a 1.7M-parameter non-query-aware scorer combining KV features, positional encoding, recent attention, cross-attention, and multi-horizon future-attention prediction, and subjects it to a five-seed, four-budget, three-task evaluation. Mutual-information, ablation, and calibration analyses isolate why learned KV features fail to outperform position and prefill-attention heuristics.
key_innovation.zh: 本文建構 Speculative Importance Prediction (SIP)，這是一個 1.7M-parameter non-query-aware scorer，結合 KV features、positional encoding、recent attention、cross-attention 與 multi-horizon future-attention prediction，並以 5 個 random seeds、4 種 retention budgets 與 3 項任務進行評測。Mutual-information、ablation 與 calibration 分析進一步辨識 learned KV features 無法超越 position 與 prefill-attention heuristics 的原因。

baselines_compared: Full Cache, Random, Position-Heuristic, Prefill-Attn, H2O, StreamingLLM

key_improvements.en: Across 5 seeds, 4 retention levels, and 3 tasks, SIP achieves no statistically significant improvement over simple baselines. At 50% retention, Prefill-Attn outperforms SIP on language-modeling perplexity (8.82 vs. 8.91), QA exact match (70.3% vs. 68.2%), and Needle-in-Haystack accuracy (92.8% vs. 89.5%).
key_improvements.zh: 在 5 個 random seeds、4 種 retention levels 與 3 項任務中，SIP 相較於簡單 baselines 均未取得統計顯著改進。在 50% retention 下，Prefill-Attn 在 language-modeling perplexity (8.82 vs. 8.91)、QA exact match (70.3% vs. 68.2%) 與 Needle-in-Haystack accuracy (92.8% vs. 89.5%) 上皆優於 SIP。

selection_signal: Accumulated attention, Learned / distilled scorer, Positional heuristic

reuse_metric.en: Across 10%, 25%, 50%, and 75% cache retention, SIP has no statistically significant advantage over simple baselines; at 50% retention it records 8.91 perplexity, 68.2% QA exact match, and 89.5% Needle-in-Haystack accuracy.
reuse_metric.zh: 在 10%、25%、50% 與 75% KV cache retention 下，SIP 相較於簡單 baselines 均無統計顯著優勢；在 50% retention 下，其 perplexity 為 8.91、QA exact match 為 68.2%，Needle-in-Haystack accuracy 為 89.5%。

title: LLM-Inference-Bench: Inference Benchmarking of Large Language Models on AI Accelerators
authors: Krishna Teja Chitty-Venkata; Siddhisanket Raskar; Bharat Kale; Farah Ferdaus; Aditya Tanikanti; Ken Raffenetti; Valerie Taylor; Murali Emani; Venkatram Vishwanath
venue_full: IEEE/ACM SC Workshop on Performance Modeling, Benchmarking and Simulation
research_focus: MoE serving, Continuous batching, Capacity planning, Hardware co-design

problem_statement.en: Benchmarking LLM inference performance across diverse hardware platforms and inference frameworks is crucial for understanding scalability and throughput characteristics, yet no prior work systematically compares NVIDIA, AMD, Intel Habana, and SambaNova accelerators on a unified set of LLaMA, Mistral and Qwen models.
problem_statement.zh: 在多樣化的硬體平台與推理框架上對 LLM 推理效能進行基準測試，對於理解可擴展性與吞吐量特性至關重要；然而過去並無研究系統性地在統一的 LLaMA、Mistral 與 Qwen 模型集合上比較 NVIDIA、AMD、Intel Habana 與 SambaNova 等加速器。

key_innovation.en: A comprehensive benchmarking suite (LLM-Inference-Bench) that evaluates throughput, TTFT, ITL, power and perplexity for 7B-70B LLMs across vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, llama.cpp and DeepSpeed-MII on NVIDIA A100/H100/GH200/MI250/MI300X plus Intel Gaudi2 and SambaNova SN40L; results are exposed through an interactive dashboard.
key_innovation.zh: 提出涵蓋多框架、多加速器的綜合基準測試套件 LLM-Inference-Bench，於 vLLM、TensorRT-LLM、llama.cpp 與 DeepSpeed-MII 上評估 7B 至 70B LLM 在 NVIDIA A100/H100/GH200/MI250/MI300X 以及 Intel Gaudi2 與 SambaNova SN40L 的吞吐量、TTFT、ITL、功耗與 perplexity，並透過互動式 dashboard 公開結果。

key_improvements.en: Not Specified (measurement study, no headline speedup). Reports relative comparisons such as TensorRT-LLM delivering the highest throughput on NVIDIA, Mistral-7B and LLaMA-3-8B running 1.9x and 2.79x faster than LLaMA-2-7B on H100 and A100 respectively, and LLaMA-3-70B on H100 being 7.8x faster than on A100 at batch 64.
key_improvements.zh: Not Specified（屬量測研究，無代表性加速比）。論文以相對比較呈現結果：在 NVIDIA 平台上 TensorRT-LLM 取得最高吞吐量；於 H100 與 A100 上，Mistral-7B 與 LLaMA-3-8B 分別比 LLaMA-2-7B 快 1.9x 與 2.79x；LLaMA-3-70B 在 H100 上於 batch 64 時較 A100 快 7.8x。

compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA A100, NVIDIA H100, NVIDIA GH200, AMD MI250, AMD MI300X, Intel Gaudi2, SambaNova SN40L
gpu_count: Up to 4x A100 / 4x H100; 8 SN40L RDUs; 4 Gaudi2 HPUs
reported_accuracy: Not Reported (measurement study)
models_validated: LLaMA-2-7B, LLaMA-2-70B, LLaMA-3-8B, LLaMA-3-70B, Mistral-7B, Mixtral-8x7B, Qwen-2-7B, Qwen-2-72B, DeciLM-7B, Gemma-7B, OPT-6.7B, GPT-J-6B, Aquila-7B, Bloom-7.1B
validation_workloads: Synthetic (input/output lengths 128-2048, batch sizes 1-64), LongBench (for perplexity)

scope_assumptions.en: Power measurements reported only for NVIDIA GPUs via pynvml; out-of-the-box numbers for AMD MI250/MI300X and Gaudi2 without special optimization flags; SN40L limited to 8 RDUs in this study; uniform input/output lengths per experiment.
scope_assumptions.zh: 功耗量測僅在 NVIDIA GPU 上透過 pynvml 取得；AMD MI250/MI300X 與 Gaudi2 為未開啟特殊優化旗標的 out-of-the-box 數據；SN40L 於本研究限於 8 個 RDU；每組實驗的輸入/輸出長度為一致設定。

title: LLM Inference Unveiled: Survey and Roofline Model Insights
authors: Zhihang Yuan; Yuzhang Shang; Yang Zhou; Zhen Dong; Zhe Zhou; Chenhao Xue; Bingzhe Wu; Zhikai Li; Qingyi Gu; Yong Jae Lee; Yan Yan; Beidi Chen; Guangyu Sun; Kurt Keutzer
affiliations: Infinigence-AI, Illinois Institute of Technology, Carnegie Mellon University, Peking University, Tencent AI Lab, Institute of Automation CAS, University of Wisconsin Madison, University of California Berkeley
research_focus: Long-context / Prefix cache, KV cache compression, Quantization, Performance modeling, Roofline analysis, Hardware co-design

problem_statement.en: The efficient LLM inference field has expanded rapidly across model compression, fast decoding, system and hardware optimization, but lacks a unified framework that pinpoints bottlenecks (compute-bound vs memory-bound) when deploying a given LLM on specific hardware so practitioners can pick the right optimization.
problem_statement.zh: 高效 LLM 推理領域在模型壓縮、快速解碼、系統與硬體優化等方向快速擴張，但缺乏統一框架來定位特定 LLM 在指定硬體上的瓶頸（compute-bound 或 memory-bound），導致實務上難以挑選合適的優化方法。

key_innovation.en: LLM-Viewer, an open-source Roofline-based analysis tool that performs network-wise per-layer analysis on user-supplied LLM and hardware (computation capacity, memory bandwidth) plus inference config (batch size, sequence length, stage) and optimization config (quantization bitwidth, FlashAttention, decoding method), producing per-layer max performance, memory footprint and batch-size-vs-performance curves with a web viewer.
key_innovation.zh: LLM-Viewer 是開源的 Roofline 分析工具，對使用者提供的 LLM 與硬體（計算能力、記憶體頻寬）以及推理設定（batch size、sequence length、stage）與優化設定（量化位寬、FlashAttention、decoding 方法）進行 network-wise 的逐層分析，輸出每層最大性能、記憶體佔用與 batch-size-vs-performance 曲線，並提供 web viewer。

key_improvements.en: Not Specified (survey paper; LLM-Viewer provides qualitative bottleneck identification rather than a single headline accuracy number, e.g. showing Llama-2-7B prefill is compute-bound while decode is memory-bound on Nvidia A6000).
key_improvements.zh: Not Specified（綜述論文；LLM-Viewer 主要提供瓶頸定性分析，未以單一精度數字總結，例如展示 Llama-2-7B 在 Nvidia A6000 上 prefill 為 compute-bound、decode 為 memory-bound）。

compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA A6000, NVIDIA H100, Intel 13900K, HBM, GDDR, DDR
reported_accuracy: Not Reported (qualitative roofline bound identification)
validation_workloads: Synthetic (sequence lengths 2^4 to 2^10 for prefill; batch sizes 1-16; sequence length up to 200K for KV-cache memory analysis)

scope_assumptions.en: Pure analytical Roofline framework; does not account for real kernel inefficiencies, dispatch overhead, or distributed (TP/PP/EP) collectives; assumes peak compute and peak bandwidth specs from datasheets; survey scope covers four optimization axes (parameter, algorithm, system, hardware) for decoder-only Transformer LLMs.
scope_assumptions.zh: 純分析式 Roofline 框架；未考量實際 kernel 效率、dispatch overhead 或分散式（TP/PP/EP）collective 通訊；以 datasheet 上的峰值計算與頻寬規格為依據；綜述範圍涵蓋 decoder-only Transformer LLM 的參數、演算法、系統與硬體四大優化軸線。

title: LLM-Pilot: Characterize and Optimize Performance of your LLM Inference Services
authors: Malgorzata Lazuka; Andreea Anghel; Thomas Parnell
venue_full: International Conference for High Performance Computing, Networking, Storage and Analysis (SC '24)
research_focus: Continuous batching, Capacity planning, Performance modeling

problem_statement.en: Cluster administrators must pick cost-effective GPU profiles for previously unseen LLM inference services subject to nTTFT and ITL SLOs, but a-priori performance on a given GPU is unknown and exhaustive per-LLM benchmarking is impractical because the cluster is near-saturated.
problem_statement.zh: 叢集管理者需為從未部署過的 LLM 推理服務挑選符合 nTTFT 與 ITL SLO 且具成本效益的 GPU 配置，但給定 GPU 上的事前效能未知，而叢集資源近乎飽和，無法對每個 LLM 進行詳盡 benchmark。

key_innovation.en: A two-stage system: (1) an offline performance characterization tool that benchmarks each LLM under a realistic workload generator derived from 17.3M production requests, auto-tuning maximum batch weight via binary search; (2) an online GPU recommendation tool using an XGBoost regressor with sample-weighting and monotonicity constraints over (LLM, GPU profile, user count) to recommend the cheapest deployment satisfying SLOs.
key_innovation.zh: 兩階段系統：(1) 離線性能特性化工具，以源自 17.3M 真實請求的工作負載生成器對每個 LLM 進行 benchmark，並以二分搜尋自動調校 maximum batch weight；(2) 線上 GPU 推薦工具，採用具樣本權重與單調性約束的 XGBoost 迴歸器，依 (LLM, GPU 配置, 使用者數) 推薦符合 SLO 且最具成本效益的部署。

baselines_compared: PARIS, Selecta, Morphling, PerfNet, PerfNetV2, Static policy

key_improvements.en: Delivers on performance requirements 33% more frequently than state-of-the-art (success rate 0.80 vs Static 0.65, PARIS 0.62, Selecta 0.53) while reducing recommended GPU cost by 60% on average; achieves the best S/O score across all baselines.
key_improvements.zh: 達成效能需求的頻率較既有方法高出 33%（success rate 0.80，相較 Static 0.65、PARIS 0.62、Selecta 0.53），同時平均降低 60% 的 GPU 成本；S/O score 在所有 baseline 中最高。

compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA H100 (80GB), NVIDIA A100 (40GB), NVIDIA A10 (24GB), NVIDIA T4 (16GB), NVIDIA V100 (16GB)
gpu_count: Up to 4x per profile across 14 GPU profiles
reported_accuracy: Not Reported (success rate 0.80, S/O score reported instead of MAPE)
models_validated: google/flan-t5-xl (3B), google/flan-t5-xxl (11B), google/flan-ul2 (20B), ibm/mpt-7b-instruct (7B), bigscience/mt0-xxl (13B), Salesforce/codegen2-16B, Llama-2-7B, Llama-2-13B, EleutherAI/gpt-neox-20B, bigcode/starcoder (15B)
validation_workloads: Production trace (17.3M requests over 5.5 months from IBM internal LLM platform; 2500 users; 24 LLMs)

scope_assumptions.en: Targets dense decoder/encoder-decoder LLMs served on TGIS with continuous batching; recommendations made for a fixed concurrency target (U=200, L1=100ms nTTFT, L2=50ms ITL); pods have exclusive GPU access (no co-location); benchmarking dataset of similar size takes ~8h per LLM.
scope_assumptions.zh: 目標為 TGIS 平台上以 continuous batching 服務的 dense decoder 或 encoder-decoder LLM；推薦結果基於固定的並發目標（U=200、L1=100ms nTTFT、L2=50ms ITL）；每個 pod 獨佔 GPU（無共置）；同等規模 benchmark 資料集每個 LLM 約需 8 小時。

title: LLMCO2: Advancing Accurate Carbon Footprint Prediction for LLM Inferences
authors: Zhenxiao Fu; Fan Chen; Shan Zhou; Haitong Li; Lei Jiang
research_focus: MoE serving, Continuous batching, Capacity planning, Performance modeling, Roofline analysis, Energy / Carbon

problem_statement.en: Predicting carbon footprint of LLM inference is harder than for training because of lower and highly variable model FLOPS utilization, distinct prefill/decode phases, hardware-specific characteristics (peak throughput, memory and network bandwidth), and skewed real-world configuration distributions (small batch, short prompt) that prior equation-based or ML-based predictors fail to capture.
problem_statement.zh: 預測 LLM 推理的碳足跡比訓練更困難：模型 FLOPS 使用率偏低且變動大、prefill 與 decode 兩階段特性不同、硬體特性（峰值吞吐量、記憶體與網路頻寬）影響顯著，且真實世界配置分布偏斜（小 batch、短 prompt），既有方程式或 ML 預測器均無法妥善捕捉。

key_innovation.en: A GNN-based regressor that represents each transformer layer as a directed acyclic graph of kernels with two sets of node features (one for prefill, one for decode) annotated by Roofline performance as a hardware-specific feature; combined with a focused data sampling algorithm that prioritizes common production configurations and fine-grains data around high-error regions.
key_innovation.zh: 以 GNN 為基礎的迴歸器，將每個 transformer 層表示為 kernel 的有向無環圖，每個節點同時保留 prefill 與 decode 兩組特徵，並以 Roofline 性能作為硬體特定特徵；搭配聚焦式資料抽樣演算法，優先採樣常見產線配置並在高誤差區域進行細粒度補採。

key_improvements.en: Reduces average MAPE from 31.9% (DeepEn) and 28.5% (NNLQP) to 15.5%, an improvement of 51.4% and 45.6% respectively; improves EBA(10%) by 160% and 123% over DeepEn and NNLQP across six LLM families.
key_improvements.zh: 將平均 MAPE 從 31.9%（DeepEn）與 28.5%（NNLQP）降至 15.5%，分別改善 51.4% 與 45.6%；在六個 LLM 家族上 EBA(10%) 分別較 DeepEn 與 NNLQP 提升 160% 與 123%。

compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA T4, NVIDIA L4, NVIDIA A100, NVIDIA H100, HBM, GDDR
gpu_count: 1, 2, or 4 GPUs per inference across 4 GPU types
reported_accuracy: MAPE 15.5% (mean across six LLM families); EBA(10%) 45.7%
models_validated: Bloom-560m/1b1/1b7/3b/7b1, Gemma-2b/7b, Gemma2-2b/9b/27b, Qwen2-0.5b/1.5b/7b/72b, Llama3.1-8b/70b, Mixtral-8x7b
validation_workloads: Azure LLM serving traces (19,336 chat entries + 8,199 code completion entries); 17 LLMs across 6 families with NVML-measured ground-truth energy

scope_assumptions.en: Assumes batch sizes <=2 in line with Azure continuous batching; training data drawn from 50K combined (architecture, inference, hardware) configurations; predicts operational energy times PUE times carbon intensity using fixed PUE/carbon factors; does not cover pipeline parallelism or expert parallelism for MoE.
scope_assumptions.zh: 假設 batch size <=2，符合 Azure continuous batching 設定；訓練資料取自 50K 組合（架構、推理、硬體）；以固定 PUE 與碳排強度將 operational energy 乘上 PUE 與 carb_inten 換算碳足跡；不涵蓋 pipeline parallelism 或 MoE 的 expert parallelism。

title: LMCache: An Efficient KV Cache Layer for Enterprise-Scale LLM Inference
authors: Yuhan Liu; Yihua Cheng; Jiayi Yao; Yuwei An; Xiaokun Chen; Shaoting Feng; Yuyang Huang; Samuel Shen; Rui Zhang; Kuntai Du; Junchen Jiang
research_focus: Long-context / Prefix cache, Multi-tenant scheduling, Continuous batching, KV cache offloading, Capacity planning, Performance modeling, Datacenter networking

problem_statement.en: KV cache size in modern LLM inference has grown to exceed GPU memory capacity, and existing solutions lack efficient mechanisms for offloading, transferring, and managing these caches across distributed engines.
problem_statement.zh: 現代 LLM 推理的 KV cache 體積已超出 GPU 記憶體容量，而現有方案缺乏高效的 KV cache 卸載、傳輸與跨分散式引擎管理機制。

key_innovation.en: LMCache, a unified KV caching layer that treats KV cache as a first-class data structure, featuring batched data movement, compute-I/O pipelining, and a modular connector interface for compatibility with evolving inference engines.
key_innovation.zh: LMCache 是一個統一的 KV caching 層，將 KV cache 視為一等公民資料結構，提供批次資料移動、計算與 I/O 流水線化，以及模組化連接器介面，以相容於持續演進的推理引擎。

key_improvements.en: Up to 15x throughput increase, 1.9-8.1x lower TTFT, and 7-92% lower ITL compared to baselines.
key_improvements.zh: 吞吐量最高提升 15x，TTFT 降低 1.9–8.1x，ITL 降低 7–92%。

ai_task: LLM Serving, Disaggregated Prefill/Decoding, Context Caching
compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA H100, B200, AMD GPU, Ascend, TPU
reported_accuracy: Not Reported (system paper; reports throughput/TTFT/ITL speedup rather than predictive error)
models_validated: Llama-3.1-8B, Llama-3.1-70B, DeepSeek-V3, Qwen2.5-32B (production traces of enterprise workloads)
validation_workloads: Production trace (enterprise reuse-heavy workloads), Synthetic, ShareGPT

scope_assumptions.en: Treats KV cache as a first-class data structure with batched movement and compute–I/O pipelining; empirical model of per-user reuse distributions on enterprise workloads reports more than 19% of users reusing stored tokens more than 1.5 times. The paper does not publish a closed-form analytical predictor for TTFT/ITL — performance gains are characterized empirically via large-scale production traces and tiered (GPU↔CPU↔SSD↔Redis) latency measurements.
scope_assumptions.zh: 將 KV cache 視為一等公民資料結構，提供批次資料移動與 compute–I/O 流水線化；在企業流量上實測，每名使用者重用儲存 token 超過 1.5 次的比例高於 19%。論文並未發表 TTFT/ITL 的 closed-form 解析預測器，效能增益是透過大規模生產流量與 GPU↔CPU↔SSD↔Redis tiered latency 量測進行實證刻畫。

offload_trigger: After computation: the storage manager saves KV of tokens not yet in the backend, per layer (layer-wise mode) or after the scheduling iteration; dynamic offloading additionally duplicates free GPU pages to CPU memory proactively, and decode-generated KV is stored in delayed batches.
destination_tiers: HBM, host DRAM, local SSD, remote DRAM pool, remote SSD, disaggregated store
prefetch_signal_timing: Reactive on request arrival with queue-aware prefetching: KV of an admitted-but-queued query is prefetched from slower tiers to a faster target tier during the queueing interval; loading into GPU is pipelined layer-wise on separate CUDA streams, overlapping transfer with computation.
agent_awareness: Exploits prefix reuse across queries (context caching): multi-turn dialogues, fixed system prompts, document analysis, RAG and coding-assistant histories; no tool-call-gap or workflow-graph exploitation (agentic workloads only as outlook).

when_to_offload_rule.en: Store the KV cache of tokens not already present in the backend to lower-tier storage immediately after they are computed (layer-wise or per scheduling iteration), except during decoding, where storing is delayed and batched until a predefined chunk of new tokens has accumulated.
when_to_offload_rule.zh: 於運算完成後，即將 backend 中尚未存有之 token 的 KV cache 卸載至較低層級儲存（依 layer 或依排程迭代觸發）；惟於 decode 階段採延遲批次策略，待新生成 token 累積至預定 chunk 數量後方進行批次寫入。

title: LookaheadKV: Fast and Accurate KV Cache Eviction by Glimpsing into the Future without Generation
authors: Jinwoo Ahn; Ingyu Seong; Akhil Kedia; Junhan Kim; Hyemi Jang; Kangwook Lee; Yongkweon Jeon
research_focus: LLM serving, Long-context / Prefix cache, KV cache compression

problem_statement.en: KV cache size grows linearly with input length, making memory a bottleneck for long-context inference. Existing low-cost eviction heuristics estimate prompt-token importance inaccurately, while draft-based future-attention methods improve eviction quality only by adding costly response generation and substantial prefill overhead.
problem_statement.zh: KV cache 容量隨 input length 線性成長，使記憶體成為 long-context inference 的瓶頸。既有低成本 eviction heuristic 對 prompt token 重要性的估計不夠準確，而 draft-based future-attention 方法雖可改善 eviction 品質，卻須額外執行高成本的 response generation，並造成顯著的 prefill overhead。

key_innovation.en: LookaheadKV appends 32 learnable lookahead tokens and selectively activated lookahead LoRA modules during prefill, distilling true future-response attention distributions with a KL-divergence objective. Lookahead-to-prompt attention then predicts per-layer and per-head token importance so that only Top-K prompt KV pairs are retained, without generating a draft response.
key_innovation.zh: LookaheadKV 在 prefill 階段加入 32 個 learnable lookahead tokens 與選擇性啟用的 lookahead LoRA modules，並以 KL-divergence objective 蒸餾真實 future response 的 attention distribution。lookahead-to-prompt attention 隨後預測逐 layer、逐 head 的 token 重要性，使系統無須生成 draft response 即可僅保留 Top-K prompt KV pairs。

baselines_compared: FullKV, SnapKV, PyramidKV, StreamingLLM, LAQ, SpecKV

key_improvements.en: LookaheadKV reports less than 2.16% eviction overhead at 32K context length and up to a 14.5× overhead reduction versus draft-based approaches; empirically, its 32K TTFT overhead is 38.04 ms versus 553.68 ms for LAQ.
key_improvements.zh: LookaheadKV 在 32K context 下報告低於 2.16% 的 eviction overhead，且相較 draft-based 方法最高降低 14.5×；實測 32K TTFT overhead 為 38.04 ms，而 LAQ 為 553.68 ms。

selection_signal: Draft / lookahead attention, Learned / distilled scorer

reuse_metric.en: At cache budget C = 128 on LLaMA3.1-8B, LookaheadKV records a 47.72 average LongBench score versus 49.88 for FullKV, while exceeding LAQ (46.61), SpecKV (45.45), and SnapKV (43.50).
reuse_metric.zh: 在 LLaMA3.1-8B、cache budget C = 128 下，LookaheadKV 的 LongBench 平均分數為 47.72，FullKV 為 49.88；其結果高於 LAQ (46.61)、SpecKV (45.45) 與 SnapKV (43.50)。

title: LRAgent: Efficient KV Cache Sharing for Multi-LoRA LLM Agents
authors: Hyesung Jeon; Hyeongju Ha; Jae-Joon Kim
research_focus: LLM serving, Long-context / Prefix cache, Agentic / Workflow serving, KV cache compression, LoRA / Multi-adapter

problem_statement.en: Multi-LoRA agent systems share a pretrained backbone but independently compute and store KV caches for the same long, tool-augmented trajectories. Existing sharing methods do not exploit the adapter structure, leaving substantial memory and redundant-prefill overhead while risking loss of role-specific behavior under direct sharing.
problem_statement.zh: 多 LoRA agent 系統雖共用 pretrained backbone，仍會針對相同的長篇 tool-augmented trajectory 分別計算與儲存 KV cache。既有共享方法未利用 adapter 結構，因此仍承受顯著的 memory 與冗餘 prefill 開銷；若直接共享，亦可能損害 role-specific behavior。

key_innovation.en: LRAgent decomposes each cache into a shared base component from pretrained weights and a low-rank adapter component from LoRA weights. BaseShared retains a per-agent LR cache, BaseLRShared shares that cache through a shared-A multi-LoRA design, and Flash-LoRA-Attention reconstructs adapter contributions without materializing them at full dimension.
key_innovation.zh: LRAgent 將每份 cache 分解為由 pretrained weights 產生的共享 base component，以及由 LoRA weights 產生的 low-rank adapter component。BaseShared 為各 agent 保留獨立 LR cache；BaseLRShared 透過 shared-A multi-LoRA 設計進一步共享該 cache；Flash-LoRA-Attention 則無須將 adapter contribution materialize 至完整維度即可完成重建。

key_improvements.en: Against Non-Shared caching, BaseLRShared improves throughput by up to 2.46x and reduces TTFT by up to 4.44x. BaseShared and BaseLRShared reduce KV-cache memory by nearly one third while limiting the average accuracy drop to at most 0.7 and 1.5 percentage points, respectively.
key_improvements.zh: 相較 Non-Shared caching，BaseLRShared 的 throughput 最高提升 2.46x，TTFT 最高降低 4.44x。BaseShared 與 BaseLRShared 均將 KV cache memory 降低近三分之一，且平均 accuracy drop 分別不超過 0.7 與 1.5 個百分點。

reuse_metric.en: Relative to Non-Shared caching, BaseShared limits the average accuracy drop to at most 0.7 percentage points and BaseLRShared to at most 1.5 percentage points across HotpotQA and ScienceQA.
reuse_metric.zh: 相較 Non-Shared caching，在 HotpotQA 與 ScienceQA 上，BaseShared 的平均 accuracy drop 不超過 0.7 個百分點，BaseLRShared 則不超過 1.5 個百分點。

title: Lumen-1 Application for Part-5 Experimental License Narrative
authors: Ezra Feilden
affiliations: Lumen Orbit, Inc., SpaceX, Astro Digital, Cryptosat, Aptos Inc., Leaf Space, RBC
research_focus: Datacenter networking

problem_statement.en: The paper aims to demonstrate technologies for an in-orbit edge computing node to facilitate efficient processing of Earth observation data, reducing the need for terrestrial downlinks.
problem_statement.zh: 本文旨在驗證在軌邊緣運算節點的相關技術，以促進地球觀測資料的高效處理，降低對地面下行鏈路的依賴。

key_innovation.en: Development of an orbital data center concept utilizing a low-radiation environment at 325 km altitude and an L-band intersatellite link (ISL) for edge computing connectivity.
key_innovation.zh: 提出在軌資料中心概念，利用 325 km 高度的低輻射環境，並以 L-band 星際鏈路（ISL）提供邊緣運算連接。

ai_task: In-orbit edge computing, Earth observation data processing
compute_memory_hw: Astro Digital US Corvus Micro platform, Flight Computer, Commercial off-the-shelf software defined radio (SDR), Cryptosat cEDGE module
network_hw: S-band radio, UHF radio, L-band intersatellite radio terminal, Iridium 4x9663 and 1x9770 transceiver modems

title: Multi-agent Architecture Search via Agentic Supernet
authors: Guibin Zhang; Luyang Niu; Junfeng Fang; Kun Wang; Lei Bai; Xiang Wang
affiliations: 1 National University of Singapore; 2 Tongji University; 3 Nanyang Technological University; 4 Shanghai AI Laboratory; 5 University of Science and Technology of China (Guibin Zhang: NUS+Tongji;
research_focus: Agentic / Workflow serving, Reasoning / Test-time scaling, LLM serving

problem_statement.en: Existing automated multi-agent-system (MAS) design methods search for a single static, one-size-fits-all agentic workflow, which cannot dynamically allocate inference resources to each query's difficulty/domain and wastes tokens/LLM-calls on easy queries while still being suboptimal for heterogeneous domains (e.g., GAIA's file-reading vs web-search tasks). The paper asks how to instead learn a distribution over agentic architectures that samples a tailored, cost-appropriate MAS per query.
problem_statement.zh: 現有的自動化 multi-agent system (MAS) 設計方法僅搜尋單一靜態、一體適用的 agentic workflow,無法依據各 query 的難度或領域動態配置推理資源;此類方法在簡單 query 上浪費 token 與 LLM 呼叫次數,同時對異質領域(例如 GAIA 中的檔案閱讀任務與網路搜尋任務)而言仍屬次佳。本文轉而探討如何學習一個涵蓋各種 agentic 架構的分布,以便針對每一個 query 抽樣出量身訂製且成本相稱的 MAS。

key_innovation.en: MaAS optimizes an "agentic supernet" — a parameterized probabilistic distribution over multi-layer agentic operator workflows — from which a controller network samples a query-dependent sub-architecture (custom MAS) per query; the supernet distribution is trained offline by a cost-aware Monte-Carlo policy gradient while the operators (prompts/temperature/node structure) are updated via an agent textual gradient.
key_innovation.zh: MaAS 最佳化一個「agentic supernet」,即涵蓋多層 agentic operator workflow 的參數化機率分布;controller 網路自該 supernet 中依 query 抽樣出一個相依於 query 的子架構(客製化 MAS)。supernet 分布以成本感知的 Monte-Carlo policy gradient 進行離線訓練,而各 operator(prompt、temperature、節點結構)則透過 agent textual gradient 更新。

baselines_compared: Vanilla, CoT, ComplexCoT, Self-Consistency, MultiPersona, LLM-Debate, LLM-Blender, DyLAN, AgentVerse, MacNet

key_improvements.en: Avg 83.59% vs AFlow 82.25%; training $3.38 vs AFlow $22.50; inference at 6–45% of baseline token cost.
key_improvements.zh: 五評測平均 83.59% 對 AFlow 82.25%;訓練成本 $3.38 對 AFlow $22.50;推理 token 成本為基線的 6–45%。

structure_space: Operator / node graph, Termination / depth, Prompts (joint), Edge topology (spatial)
decision_mechanism: Supernet controller sampling, Policy gradient / REINFORCE, Textual gradient (LLM feedback)
optimization_signal: Cost-aware utility, Task utility (accuracy), Textual feedback
benchmarks_used: GSM8K, MATH, MultiArith, HumanEval, MBPP, GAIA

agent_scenario.en: A general (cross-domain) framework, not fixed-count agents: a single controller samples a query-dependent DAG of agentic operators, each operator being a composite of LLM calls + tools (I/O, CoT, CoT-SC, ReAct, Reflexion, multi-agent Debate, Web-search, Evaluator-optimizer, early-exit). Depth is up to L=4 layers; multiple operators can be active per layer. Tasks span math reasoning, code generation, and GAIA tool-use (web search, file reading, python execution, multimodal). Notable protocol detail: layer-wise autoregressive sampling with a MoE-style controller and an early-exit operator that lets easy queries resolve with a single I/O or ReAct call while hard queries invoke deeper debate/reflexion/tool workflows.
agent_scenario.zh: 此為通用(跨領域)框架,而非固定數量的 agent:單一 controller 抽樣出一個相依於 query 的 agentic operator DAG,每個 operator 皆為 LLM 呼叫與工具的複合體(I/O、CoT、CoT-SC、ReAct、Reflexion、multi-agent Debate、Web-search、Evaluator-optimizer、early-exit)。深度至多 L=4 層,每層可同時啟用多個 operator。任務涵蓋數學推理、程式碼生成與 GAIA 工具使用(網路搜尋、檔案閱讀、python 執行、多模態)。值得注意的協定細節為:採用逐層自迴歸抽樣搭配 MoE 式 controller,並設有 early-exit operator,使簡單 query 得以透過單次 I/O 或 ReAct 呼叫即解決,而困難 query 則呼叫更深層的 debate、reflexion 或工具 workflow。

title: Make It Real: An End-to-End Implementation of A Physically Disaggregated Data Center
authors: Yiying Zhang
research_focus: PD disaggregation, Datacenter networking

problem_statement.en: Monolithic server-centric architectures lead to resource stranding and inefficient utilization, where hardware resources cannot be independently scaled or managed.
problem_statement.zh: 單體式以伺服器為中心的架構導致資源閒置與利用率低下，各硬體資源無法獨立擴展或管理。

key_innovation.en: Physically disaggregated data center architecture where hardware resources (CPU, memory, storage, network) are decomposed into independent, network-attached device pools managed by a splitkernel operating system.
key_innovation.zh: 物理解耦合資料中心架構：將 CPU、記憶體、儲存與網路等硬體資源分解為獨立的網路附接設備池，並由 splitkernel 作業系統統一管理。

baselines_compared: Single-machine Linux, traditional server-based disaggregation, swap systems

key_improvements.en: 1.4x performance-per-dollar (LegoOS), 52% CapEx saving, 56% OpEx saving, 1.86x performance-per-dollar (SuperNIC), 16-84% resource consumption reduction (Scad)
key_improvements.zh: LegoOS 性價比提升 1.4x，CapEx 節省 52%，OpEx 節省 56%；SuperNIC 性價比提升 1.86x；Scad 資源消耗降低 16–84%。

ai_task: Machine Learning, Data Analytics, Serverless Computing, Microservices
traffic_pattern: Remote memory access, RPC-like communication, Asymmetric compute-to-memory traffic

title: Marconi: Prefix Caching for the Era of Hybrid LLMs
authors: Rui Pan; Zhuang Wang; Zhen Jia; Can Karakus; Luca Zancato; Tri Dao; Yida Wang; Ravi Netravali
research_focus: Long-context / Prefix cache, Speculative decoding, Agentic / Workflow serving, Multi-tenant scheduling, Continuous batching, Capacity planning, Performance modeling

problem_statement.en: Hybrid LLMs interleave Attention layers with State Space Model (SSM) layers, but SSM states are updated in place and cannot be rolled back to represent arbitrary prefixes. To support prefix caching, existing systems fine-grain checkpoint SSM states every k tokens, producing many large entries that are mostly never reused: only 0.4% of SSM states are reused versus 25% of KVs at block size 32, causing cache thrashing and a poor memory-vs-compute savings tradeoff.
problem_statement.zh: Hybrid LLM 將 Attention layer 與 State Space Model (SSM) layer 交錯堆疊，但 SSM 狀態以 in-place 更新，無法回滾以代表任意 prefix。為支援 prefix caching，現有系統每 k 個 token 做細粒度 checkpoint，產生大量且多數從未重用的 SSM state 條目：block size 32 下 SSM state 僅 0.4% 被重用，KV 則為 25%，造成 cache thrashing 及 memory-vs-compute 取捨惡化。

key_innovation.en: Marconi introduces (1) a judicious cache admission policy that uses a radix tree of past requests plus a speculative-insertion check to admit only SSM states with high reuse likelihood (purely-input prefixes verified across requests; input-and-output prefixes only at the last-decoded-token branch), and (2) a FLOP-aware eviction policy with utility score S(n) = recency(n) + alpha * flop_efficiency(n), where flop_efficiency normalizes FLOP savings by memory consumption, enabling holistic management of KVs and SSM states that have different memory/compute tradeoffs.
key_innovation.zh: Marconi 提出 (1) judicious cache admission policy：以過往請求建構的 radix tree 結合 speculative insertion 檢查，僅接納高重用機率的 SSM state（purely-input prefix 須在多次請求間驗證；input-and-output prefix 僅在 last-decoded-token 分支處接納）；(2) FLOP-aware eviction policy：使用 utility score S(n) = recency(n) + alpha * flop_efficiency(n)，其中 flop_efficiency 以記憶體消耗對 FLOP savings 做正規化，藉此整合管理 KV 與 SSM state 兩種不同的 memory/compute 取捨。

baselines_compared: vLLM+ (extended for Hybrid), SGLang+ (extended for Hybrid)

key_improvements.en: Up to 34.4x higher token hit rate on SWEBench versus vLLM+ (average 4.5x, 7.3x, 34.4x on LMSys, ShareGPT, SWEBench). P95 TTFT reductions of 36.1%, 71.1%, 46.8% (275.4 ms, 103.3 ms, 617.0 ms) versus vanilla inference, and 17.2%/12.8%/24.7% (131.1 ms, 18.5 ms, 325.7 ms) larger reductions than SGLang+.
key_improvements.zh: 於 SWEBench 相較 vLLM+ token hit rate 最高提升 34.4x（LMSys/ShareGPT/SWEBench 平均 4.5x、7.3x、34.4x）；相較 vanilla inference 之 P95 TTFT 降低 36.1%、71.1%、46.8% (275.4 ms、103.3 ms、617.0 ms)，相較 SGLang+ 額外多降 17.2%、12.8%、24.7% (131.1 ms、18.5 ms、325.7 ms)。

compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA A100-40GB, Intel Xeon Platinum 8275CL CPU, 1152 GB DDR4 RAM
gpu_count: 4x A100-40GB (single p4d.24xlarge has 8x; 4 used per experiment)
reported_accuracy: Not Reported (system paper; alpha tuned by offline grid search over bootstrap requests to maximize hit rate)
models_validated: 7B Hybrid with {4 Attention, 24 SSM, 28 MLP} layers, Jamba-1.5-Mini (12B active / 52B total, Attention-SSM Hybrid, state dim 128)
validation_workloads: LMSys-Chat-1M, ShareGPT, SWEBench (SWE-Agent on real GitHub issues)

scope_assumptions.en: Targets SSM-Attention Hybrid models; assumes layer composition fixed at chunked-state-passing SSMs or those needing two-pass prefill, with Attention:SSM ratios from 1:2 to 1:8 in evaluation. Models pure Transformers reduce to vanilla SGLang behavior. Cache admission uses speculative insertion before each prefill (slight overhead); eviction operates on radix-tree nodes with <=1 child (not just leaves). FLOP estimates approximate redundant compute across Attention/SSM/MLP layers; ignores downstream-task quality (only token-hit-rate / TTFT measured).
scope_assumptions.zh: 聚焦 SSM-Attention Hybrid 模型；假設層組合為 chunked-state-passing SSM 或需 two-pass prefill 之模型，評估 Attention:SSM 比例介於 1:2 至 1:8。純 Transformer 退化為 vanilla SGLang 行為。Cache admission 於每次 prefill 前進行 speculative insertion（有少量 overhead）；eviction 作用於 radix tree 中子節點數 <=1 的節點（不限於 leaf）。FLOP 估計近似 Attention/SSM/MLP layer 的冗餘運算；忽略下游任務品質，僅量測 token hit rate 與 TTFT。

title: MARS: Efficient, Adaptive Co-Scheduling for Heterogeneous Agentic Systems
authors: Yifei Wang; Hancheng Ye; Yechen Xu; Cong Guo; Chiyue Wei; Qinsi Wang; Dongting Li; Tingjun Chen; Hai "Helen" Li; Danyang Zhuo; Yiran Chen
research_focus: Agentic / Workflow serving, Multi-tenant scheduling, Continuous batching, LLM serving

problem_statement.en: Agentic workloads induce a temporal shift (single-turn to multi-turn LLM+tool loops) and a spatial shift (chat-scale to repository-scale, GPU-only to GPU+CPU co-located execution). Existing throughput-centric, request-oblivious serving engines cannot coordinate the heterogeneous, coupled GPU+CPU resource demands of multi-turn agent sessions, leading to KV-cache thrash, head-of-line blocking on long prefills, and GPU-CPU coupled queueing.
problem_statement.zh: Agentic workload 帶來時間軸位移（單輪推論轉為多輪 LLM 與工具循環）與空間軸位移（chat 規模轉為 repository 規模、GPU-only 轉為 GPU 與 CPU 共置執行）。現有以 throughput 為中心、忽略 request 屬性的 serving engine 無法協調多輪 agent session 對 GPU 與 CPU 的耦合需求，導致 KV cache 反覆抖動、長 prefill 造成 head-of-line 阻塞，以及 GPU 與 CPU 間的耦合排隊。

key_innovation.en: MARS introduces session-aware co-scheduling around three components: (i) a Unified Information Stream that exports GPU memory pressure (gpu_submit/1st_token/end events) and CPU tool-execution pressure as low-overhead telemetry; (ii) an External Control Plane that adaptively sizes the admission window W_adm via AIMD over dual-pressure signals; (iii) an Internal Agent-Centric Scheduler combining a Priority-Aware Coordinator (Multi-Level Feedback Queue keyed on initial footprint + accumulated service + waiting time) with an Opportunistic Co-Scheduler that incrementally fits requests by chunk-shrinking instead of evicting.
key_innovation.zh: MARS 提出 session-aware 的協同排程，包含三個組件：(i) Unified Information Stream，將 GPU 記憶體壓力（gpu_submit/1st_token/end 事件）與 CPU 工具執行壓力以低成本 telemetry 形式匯出；(ii) External Control Plane，依雙壓力訊號透過 AIMD 動態調整 admission window W_adm；(iii) Internal Agent-Centric Scheduler，由 Priority-Aware Coordinator（以初始 footprint、累計服務、等待時間為鍵的 Multi-Level Feedback Queue）與 Opportunistic Co-Scheduler（以 chunk-shrink 替代 eviction 漸進塞入 request）組成。

key_improvements.en: Up to 5.94x lower mean end-to-end latency and up to 1.34x lower P95 latency over the strongest baseline across 28 operating points on H100/H200. In OpenHands real deployment on H200, task completion time improves by up to 1.87x.
key_improvements.zh: 在 H100 與 H200 上涵蓋 28 個操作點時，相較最強 baseline 平均 end-to-end 延遲最高降低 5.94x、P95 延遲最高降低 1.34x。在 H200 上以 OpenHands 實際部署時，任務完成時間最高提升 1.87x。

ai_task: LLM Serving, Multi-agent Systems
compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA H100 NVL (96 GB), NVIDIA H200 NVL (144 GB), AMD EPYC 9355, DRAM
reported_accuracy: Not Reported (system paper; uses telemetry-driven AIMD rather than predictive accuracy metric)
validation_workloads: SWE-bench, GitTaskBench, Terminal-Bench, RepoBench, InfBench (mixed into four input-length regimes ILR-1 to ILR-4)

scope_assumptions.en: Built on vLLM V1 with backend serving and batching layers unchanged (only V1 scheduling layer extended). Targets single-node deployments with co-located tool execution and CPU pinning isolating engine from tools. Dynamic SLO-Aware Goodput defines per-request SLO target as alpha x T_ideal with alpha measured at concurrency=1; alpha=3 used in the headline plot. Goodput evaluation requires per-request slack factor and treats tool execution as host-CPU-bound.
scope_assumptions.zh: 建構於 vLLM V1，僅延伸 V1 排程層，backend serving 與 batching 層維持不變。針對單節點部署，工具與 LLM 共置且以 CPU pinning 隔離。Dynamic SLO-Aware Goodput 將每筆 request 的 SLO 目標設為 alpha x T_ideal，T_ideal 在 concurrency=1 量得，主結果圖採用 alpha=3。Goodput 評估需 per-request slack factor，且假設工具執行為 host-CPU bound。

title: MAS-GPT: Training LLMs to Build LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems
authors: Rui Ye; Shuo Tang; Rui Ge; Yaxin Du; Zhenfei Yin; Siheng Chen; Jing Shao
affiliations: Not Specified (affiliation block absent from arXiv HTML, ar5iv, PMLR v267, and ICML virtual pages; authors: Rui Ye, Shuo Tang, Rui Ge, Yaxin Du, Zhenfei Yin, Siheng Chen, Jing Shao)
research_focus: Agentic / Workflow serving, Reasoning / Test-time scaling

problem_statement.en: Designing an effective LLM-based multi-agent system (MAS) is labor-intensive, and existing automated methods either produce a single fixed MAS applied to every query or require many extra LLM inference calls to search/optimize an MAS per query. The goal is to generate a query-adaptive, executable MAS efficiently in a single inference.
problem_statement.zh: 設計一個有效的、基於 LLM 的 multi-agent system (MAS) 需耗費大量人力,而現有的自動化方法或是產生單一固定的 MAS 並套用於所有 query,或是需為每個 query 額外執行大量 LLM inference 呼叫以搜尋/最佳化 MAS。其目標在於以單次 inference 高效地生成一個因應 query 而自適應調整、且可執行的 MAS。

key_innovation.en: Reframes MAS construction as a generative language task: an open-source medium-sized LLM (MAS-GPT, supervised-fine-tuned from Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct) is trained offline on a consistency-filtered corpus of (query, executable-MAS-as-Python-code) pairs, so at inference it emits an entire query-adaptive MAS as runnable Python code in a single forward pass, which is then executed by a separate executor LLM.
key_innovation.zh: 本方法將 MAS 的建構重新界定為一項生成式語言任務:一個開源的中型 LLM(MAS-GPT,由 Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct 經 supervised fine-tuning 而得)於離線階段在一個經一致性過濾的 (query, 以 Python code 表示的可執行 MAS) 配對語料上訓練,使其在 inference 時能於單次 forward pass 中,將整個因應 query 而自適應的 MAS 以可執行的 Python code 形式輸出,再由另一個獨立的 executor LLM 執行之。

baselines_compared: Single/Vanilla inference, Chain-of-Thought, Self-Consistency, LLM-Debate, Self-Refine, Quality-Diversity, SPP, AgentVerse, GPTSwarm, DyLAN

key_improvements.en: 9-benchmark avg 65.47% vs runner-up 60.54%; +13.34% for o1-preview on AIME-2024; one ~0.5-call generation pass.
key_improvements.zh: 九評測平均 65.47% 對次佳 60.54%;o1-preview 在 AIME-2024 +13.34%;單次(約 0.5 次呼叫)生成。

structure_space: Workflow code, Team composition (agent set), Prompts (joint), Roles / profiles
decision_mechanism: Trained generator (SFT)
benchmarks_used: MATH, GSM8K, GSM-Hard, HumanEval, HumanEval+, MMLU, GPQA, SciBench, AIME-2024

agent_scenario.en: The deliverable is a query-adaptive collaboration of multiple LLM agents (e.g., debaters, refiners, aggregators, single-agent CoT) expressed as one executable Python program; the number and roles of agents vary per query, from a single agent to multi-agent debate / self-refine patterns. All agents in a given MAS are driven by the same executor LLM, and MAS-GPT is a single general (not single-domain) generator spanning math, coding, and QA. No external tools (web/code sandbox beyond the LLM calls) are part of the protocol; the corpus contains 7,580 unique MAS designs. At inference the pipeline is two-stage: MAS-GPT generates the MAS code once (a single forward pass), then the executor LLM runs it to answer the query (code execution is not sandboxed per the repo).
agent_scenario.zh: 交付成果為多個 LLM agent 之間因應 query 而自適應的協作(例如 debater、refiner、aggregator、single-agent CoT),並以單一可執行的 Python 程式表達;agent 的數量與角色隨 query 而變,範圍從單一 agent 到 multi-agent debate / self-refine 等模式。給定 MAS 中的所有 agent 皆由同一個 executor LLM 驅動,而 MAS-GPT 為單一通用(而非單一領域)的生成器,涵蓋數學、coding 與 QA。協定中不包含任何外部工具(除 LLM 呼叫之外的 web/code sandbox);語料包含 7,580 個獨特的 MAS 設計。在 inference 時,pipeline 分為兩階段:MAS-GPT 先生成一次 MAS code(單次 forward pass),再由 executor LLM 執行之以回答 query(依 repo 所述,code 執行並未經 sandbox 隔離)。

title: MasRouter: Learning to Route LLMs for Multi-Agent Systems
authors: Yanwei Yue; Guibin Zhang; Boyang Liu; Guancheng Wan; Kun Wang; Dawei Cheng; Yiyan Qi
venue_full: Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics 2025
research_focus: Agentic / Workflow serving, LLM serving

problem_statement.en: Existing LLM routing methods only choose a single best LLM per query for single-agent use, ignoring the collaboration-mode and agent-role decisions a multi-agent system (MAS) requires, while MAS pipelines incur large token/API overhead. The paper introduces "Multi-Agent System Routing" (MASR): for each query, jointly decide the collaboration mode, allocate agent roles, and assign an appropriate LLM to each agent so as to balance task performance and cost.
problem_statement.zh: 現有的 LLM routing 方法僅針對每個 query 從候選中選擇單一最佳的 LLM 供 single-agent 使用,忽略了 multi-agent system (MAS) 所需的協作模式與 agent 角色決策,同時 MAS pipeline 亦帶來龐大的 token/API 開銷。本文提出「Multi-Agent System Routing」(MASR):針對每個 query,聯合決定協作模式、配置 agent 角色,並為每個 agent 指派適當的 LLM,以在任務效能與成本之間取得平衡。

key_innovation.en: MasRouter is a cascaded controller network that makes three sequential per-query decisions — collaboration mode (via a variational latent-variable / VAE-style model) then role allocation (structured probabilistic cascade) then per-agent LLM routing (multinomial distribution) — trained end-to-end by policy gradient (REINFORCE) on a performance-minus-lambda*cost objective, using a Gamma-function relaxation to keep the discrete agent count differentiable.
key_innovation.zh: MasRouter 為一個級聯式 (cascaded) controller 網路,針對每個 query 依序做出三項決策:先決定協作模式 (透過 variational latent-variable / VAE 式模型),再進行角色配置 (結構化機率級聯),最後為每個 agent 進行 LLM routing (multinomial distribution)。整體以 policy gradient (REINFORCE) 端到端訓練,最佳化目標為 performance 減去 lambda 乘上 cost;並採用 Gamma-function 鬆弛以維持離散 agent 數量的可微性。

baselines_compared: Vanilla single-agent, CoT, ComplexCoT, Self-Consistency SC, Chain, Tree, Complete Graph, LLM-Debate, GPTSwarm

key_improvements.en: Avg 85.93 on 5 benchmarks (best of 20 baselines); HumanEval cost $0.363→$0.185 (−52%).
key_improvements.zh: 五評測平均 85.93(20 個基線中最佳);HumanEval 成本 $0.363→$0.185(−52%)。

structure_space: Edge topology (spatial), Roles / profiles, Team composition (agent set)
decision_mechanism: Policy gradient / REINFORCE, Supernet controller sampling, Graph neural generator (GNN/VAE)
backbone_models: DeepSeek-v3 (held-out / unseen model used for inductive-generalization test)
gpt-3.5-turbo (appears only in Vanilla single-agent baseline table)
benchmarks_used: MMLU, GSM8K, MATH, HumanEval, MBPP

agent_scenario.en: General/multi-domain LLM-powered MAS. For each query a cascaded controller constructs the MAS: it picks a collaboration mode from the repository (CoT, Reflexion, self-consistency, MacNet-Chain, MacNet-Complete-Graph), decides the number of agents (up to gamma=6) adapted to query difficulty, assigns each agent a role from a 26-role pool (some tool-augmented, e.g. programmers with compilers, researchers with Wikipedia), and routes each agent to an LLM backbone drawn from a heterogeneous pool of 4 candidate LLMs. The agents then collaborate to solve knowledge (MMLU), math (GSM8K, MATH), and code (HumanEval, MBPP) tasks. Protocol: cascaded sampling collaboration-mode -> roles -> per-agent LLM, executed anew per query at inference.
agent_scenario.zh: 通用/跨領域的 LLM 驅動 MAS。針對每個 query,一個級聯式 controller 建構出該 MAS:自 repository 中挑選協作模式 (CoT、Reflexion、self-consistency、MacNet-Chain、MacNet-Complete-Graph),依 query 難度決定 agent 數量 (最多 gamma=6),自 26 種角色的池中為每個 agent 指派角色 (部分為 tool-augmented,例如配備 compiler 的 programmer、配備 Wikipedia 的 researcher),並將每個 agent route 至由 4 個候選 LLM 組成的異質池中所選出的 LLM backbone。這些 agent 隨後協作以解決知識 (MMLU)、數學 (GSM8K、MATH) 與程式 (HumanEval、MBPP) 任務。Protocol:級聯式取樣協作模式 -> 角色 -> 各 agent 的 LLM,於推論階段對每個 query 重新執行一次。

title: Multi-Agent Design: Optimizing Agents with Better Prompts and Topologies
authors: Han Zhou; Xingchen Wan; Ruoxi Sun; Hamid Palangi; Shariq Iqbal; Ivan Vulić; Anna Korhonen; Sercan Ö. Arık
affiliations: Google (Google Cloud AI Research) — Han Zhou, Xingchen Wan, Ruoxi Sun, Hamid Palangi, Shariq Iqbal, Sercan Ö.
research_focus: Agentic / Workflow serving

problem_statement.en: Designing a multi-agent system for a new task means jointly choosing agent prompts and the interaction topology, but this joint prompt+topology design space is enormous and mostly hand-crafted, and prior automated methods (ADAS, AFlow) search it inefficiently. The paper asks how to automatically and efficiently design effective MAS by optimizing prompts and topologies together.
problem_statement.zh: 為新任務設計 multi-agent system,意味著必須同時選定各 agent 的 prompt 與其互動 topology;然而此 prompt 與 topology 的聯合設計空間極為龐大,且多半仰賴人工手工設計,而既有的自動化方法(ADAS、AFlow)對此空間的搜尋效率不彰。本文探討如何透過聯合最佳化 prompt 與 topology,自動且高效地設計出有效的 MAS。

key_innovation.en: Multi-Agent System Search (MASS): a three-stage interleaved offline optimizer that (1) does block-level local prompt optimization so topology search operates over already-strong building blocks, (2) prunes the topology space to an influential subset using each block's measured incremental influence (Softmax-over-influence probabilistic rejection sampling) and searches topologies under a compute budget, then (3) runs workflow-level global prompt optimization on the best topology to fit inter-agent dependencies.
key_innovation.zh: Multi-Agent System Search(MASS):一套三階段交錯進行的離線最佳化器,其流程為:(1) 先執行 block 層級的局部 prompt 最佳化,使 topology 搜尋得以在已具強度的建構單元上進行;(2) 依據各 block 所量測到的增量影響力(採 Softmax-over-influence 的機率式 rejection sampling)將 topology 空間剪枝至具影響力的子集,並在計算預算限制下搜尋 topology;(3) 於最佳 topology 上執行 workflow 層級的全域 prompt 最佳化,以契合 agent 之間的相依關係。

baselines_compared: Chain-of-Thought, Self-Consistency @ 9 agents, Self-Refine, Multi-Agent Debate, ADAS, AFlow

key_improvements.en: Avg 78.79 vs debate 70.26 / ADAS 69.72 (Gemini-1.5-Pro, 8 tasks); ablation: prompts contribute ~3x more than topology.
key_improvements.zh: 八任務平均 78.79 對辯論 70.26、ADAS 69.72(Gemini-1.5-Pro);消融顯示 prompt 貢獻約為拓撲的 3 倍。

structure_space: Edge topology (spatial), Operator / node graph, Prompts (joint), Termination / depth
decision_mechanism: Heuristic scoring / ranking
optimization_signal: Task utility (accuracy), Validation-set score, Agent-importance score
benchmarks_used: MATH, DROP, HotpotQA, MuSiQue, 2WikiMultiHopQA, MBPP, HumanEval, LiveCodeBench

agent_scenario.en: A homogeneous LLM MAS (single backbone per system) built from an initial CoT predictor plus configurable modules: Aggregate (1-9 parallel agents / self-consistency), Reflect (0-4 self-reflection rounds), Debate (0-4 multi-agent-debate rounds), Summarize (0-4 summarization rounds), and Tool-use/Execute (binary insertion). Each agent is an LLM instance with an optimized prompt (instruction + bootstrapped exemplars); interactions are orchestrated in a fixed compositional order. Domains span math reasoning, reading comprehension, multi-hop QA, and code generation. Multi-agent (up to 9 parallel + debate/reflection loops) with offline-designed, static message passing.
agent_scenario.zh: 一套同質的 LLM MAS(每個系統採單一 backbone),由初始的 CoT predictor 加上可組態模組建構而成:Aggregate(1-9 個平行 agent / self-consistency)、Reflect(0-4 輪 self-reflection)、Debate(0-4 輪 multi-agent-debate)、Summarize(0-4 輪 summarization)與 Tool-use/Execute(二元插入)。每個 agent 均為一個帶有已最佳化 prompt(指令加上 bootstrapped 範例)的 LLM 實例;各項互動依固定的組合順序進行編排。應用領域涵蓋數學推理、閱讀理解、multi-hop QA 與程式碼生成。屬 multi-agent 情境(最多 9 個平行 agent 加上 debate/reflection 迴圈),採離線設計、靜態的 message passing。

title: MatKV: Trading Compute for Flash Storage in LLM Inference
authors: Kun-Woo Shin; Jay H. Park; Moonwook Oh; Yohan Jo; Jaeyoung Do; Sang-Won Lee
venue_full: IEEE International Conference on Data Engineering
research_focus: LLM serving, KV cache offloading, GPU memory tiering, Energy / Carbon, Performance modeling

problem_statement.en: In retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), the prefill phase must compute the key-value vectors of long retrieved documents, which is compute-intensive, energy-intensive, and time-consuming even on high-end GPUs, making prefill the dominant cost of RAG inference.
problem_statement.zh: 在 retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) 中，prefill 階段須計算長檢索文件的 key-value 向量；即使使用高階 GPU，此過程仍具高運算量、高能耗與高延遲，使 prefill 成為 RAG 推理的主要成本來源。

key_innovation.en: MatKV precomputes the KV vectors of RAG objects once, materializes them onto inexpensive, fast, power-efficient flash SSD storage, and reuses them at inference time instead of recomputing on the GPU. It derives a 'ten-day rule' (an extension of Gray's five-minute rule) giving the break-even access frequency above which SSD-backed KV reuse is cheaper than recomputation, and overlaps GPU decoding with KV loading to hide load latency.
key_innovation.zh: MatKV 將 RAG 物件的 KV 向量預先計算一次，materialize 至價格低廉、快速且省電的 flash SSD 儲存，並於推理時重用而非在 GPU 上重算。其推導出「ten-day rule」（Gray 五分鐘法則的延伸），給出當存取頻率高於此門檻時，SSD 上的 KV 重用即比重算更划算；並將 GPU decode 與 KV 載入重疊以隱藏載入延遲。

key_improvements.en: Reduces both inference time and system-wide power consumption by roughly half (up to 2x) versus full KV computation on GPUs, without severely impacting question-answering accuracy; loading a 250MB KV cache from SSD consumes over 1,200x less energy than recomputing it (0.14 J vs ~170 J).
key_improvements.zh: 相較 GPU 上的完整 KV 計算，將推理時間與全系統功耗約降低一半（最高 2x），且對問答準確度無顯著影響；自 SSD 載入 250MB KV cache 的能耗較重算低超過 1,200x（0.14 J 相對約 170 J）。

reported_accuracy: F1 comparable to full-compute vanilla on LongBench QA
validation_workloads: TurboRAG, LongBench (2WikiMultihopQA/HotpotQA/TriviaQA)

scope_assumptions.en: Adopts a simplified Eager-and-Materialize-All strategy (every ingested document's KV is materialized regardless of access frequency) as a controlled baseline, leaving selective materialization, eviction, and cold-start handling to future work. The 70B model is evaluated only in a 4-bit quantized form to fit a single H100, and it assumes RAG objects with short queries/answers and repeated document reuse.
scope_assumptions.zh: 採用簡化的 Eager-and-Materialize-All 策略（不論存取頻率，對每份文件的 KV 皆進行 materialize）作為受控 baseline，將 selective materialization、eviction 與 cold-start 處理留待後續研究；70B 模型僅以 4-bit 量化形式評估以放入單張 H100；並假設 RAG 物件的 query 與 answer 較短且文件會重複被重用。

compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA H100, NVIDIA RTX 4090, HBM, DRAM, Flash SSD
offload_trigger: Offline materialization rather than runtime offload: the KV of every ingested RAG object is precomputed once and written to flash SSD (Eager-and-Materialize-All), independent of runtime memory pressure.
prefetch_signal_timing: Reactive at inference time: stored KV of retrieved RAG objects is loaded from SSD, overlapping GPU decoding with KV loading to hide load latency.
costs_modeled: GPU FLOPs recompute, energy, transfer-vs-recompute crossover
agent_awareness: None: exploits repeated reuse of RAG objects across requests; no agent or session structure.

when_to_offload_rule.en: Materialize a RAG object's KV to SSD when its expected access frequency exceeds the break-even point of the 'ten-day rule' (an extension of Gray's five-minute rule trading flash storage cost against GPU recomputation cost); the evaluated prototype simplifies this to materializing every ingested object.
when_to_offload_rule.zh: 當 RAG 物件的預期存取頻率超過「ten-day rule」（Gray 五分鐘法則之延伸，以 flash 儲存成本對比 GPU 重算成本）的損益平衡點時，即將其 KV 物化至 SSD；所評估的原型簡化為對所有已匯入物件一律物化。

title: MCaM : Efficient LLM Inference with Multi-tier KV Cache Management
authors: Kexin Chu; Zixu Shen; Sheng-Ru Cheng; Dawei Xiang; Ziqin Liu; Wei Zhang
venue_full: IEEE International Conference on Distributed Computing Systems
research_focus: Multi-tenant scheduling, Datacenter networking, GPU memory tiering

problem_statement.en: Existing LLM serving systems discard the KV cache after each request, leading to redundant computation for repeated prefixes and high latency, while GPU HBM capacity limits the ability to cache historical tokens for reuse.
problem_statement.zh: 現有 LLM serving 系統在每次請求後丟棄 KV cache，導致重複前綴的冗餘計算與高延遲；同時 GPU HBM 容量限制了歷史 token 的快取重用能力。

key_innovation.en: A multi-tier KV cache management system (MCaM) that uses DRAM as a slow-tier memory for historical KV cache storage, combined with a co-designed scheduler, pipeline prefetcher, asynchronous offload engine, and quality-aware sparsification algorithm.
key_innovation.zh: MCaM 是一個多層 KV cache 管理系統，以 DRAM 作為慢速層儲存歷史 KV cache，並整合協同設計的 scheduler、pipeline 預取器、非同步卸載引擎與品質感知稀疏化演算法。

key_improvements.en: Up to 69% reduction in TTFT, 3.3X improvement in prompt prefilling throughput, and up to 58% reduction in end-to-end latency for 4096-token requests.
key_improvements.zh: TTFT 降低最高 69%，prompt prefilling 吞吐量提升 3.3x，4096 token 請求的端到端延遲降低最高 58%。

ai_task: LLM Serving, LLM Inference, KV Cache reuse

title: MDAgents: An Adaptive Collaboration of LLMs for Medical Decision-Making
authors: Yubin Kim; Chanwoo Park; Hyewon Jeong; Yik Siu Chan; Xuhai Xu; Daniel McDuff; Hyeonhoon Lee; Marzyeh Ghassemi; Cynthia Breazeal; Hae Won Park
venue_full: Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems 2024
affiliations: Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) is the primary institution;
research_focus: Agentic / Workflow serving, Reasoning / Test-time scaling

problem_statement.en: The best way to leverage LLMs for complex medical tasks is unresolved: solo prompting underperforms on hard cases while always using a heavy multi-agent group wastes compute (and can hurt) on easy cases. The paper asks how to automatically match the collaboration structure of a team of LLMs to the complexity of each medical query.
problem_statement.zh: 如何最佳運用 LLM 處理複雜醫療任務仍是未解問題:單一 agent 的 solo prompting 在困難案例上表現不足,而在簡單案例上恆定使用龐大的 multi-agent 群組則浪費運算資源(甚至可能損害效能)。本文探討如何自動使一組 LLM 團隊的協作結構與每則醫療查詢的複雜度相匹配。

key_innovation.en: A prompted "moderator" LLM acts as a zero-shot complexity classifier that labels each query low/moderate/high, and a fixed rule maps that label to one of three collaboration structures — solo Primary Care Clinician, Multi-Disciplinary Team (MDT), or Integrated Care Team (ICT) — so the entire team topology is selected per query at inference. Group settings add moderator review and external medical knowledge (MedRAG).
key_innovation.zh: 由一個經 prompt 的「moderator」LLM 充當 zero-shot 複雜度分類器,將每則查詢標記為低、中、高三級,並以固定規則將該標籤對應至三種協作結構之一:單一 Primary Care Clinician、Multi-Disciplinary Team(MDT)或 Integrated Care Team(ICT),使整個團隊拓撲得以於推論階段依查詢逐一選定。群組設定另加入 moderator 審查與外部醫學知識(MedRAG)。

baselines_compared: Zero-shot, Few-shot, Few-shot CoT, CoT-SC, Ensemble Refinement, Medprompt, Majority Voting, Weighted Voting, Borda Count, MedAgents

key_improvements.en: Best on 7/10 medical benchmarks (up to +4.8 pts); adaptive 81.2% vs best fixed 71.6%; 9.3 calls vs 20.3 for fixed teams.
key_improvements.zh: 10 個醫療評測中 7 個最佳(最高 +4.8 分);自適應 81.2% 對最佳固定結構 71.6%;呼叫數 9.3 對固定團隊的 20.3。

structure_space: Team composition (agent set), Workflow code, Roles / profiles
decision_mechanism: LLM on-the-fly orchestration, Heuristic scoring / ranking
benchmarks_used: MedQA, PubMedQA, DDXPlus, SymCat, MedBullets, JAMA, Path-VQA, PMC-VQA, MIMIC-CXR, MedVidQA

agent_scenario.en: Single medical-domain, LLM-only agents (no external tools beyond an optional MedRAG knowledge retrieval). A moderator agent classifies query complexity; a recruiter assembles specialist roles; depending on complexity the team is 1 agent (Solo), a small MDT (peak accuracy reported at N=3 specialist agents with iterative multi-round discussion and moderator feedback), or a multi-team hierarchical ICT. A final decision-maker aggregates the answer. Roles are prompted personas (Primary Care Clinician, specialists) rather than distinct fine-tuned models.
agent_scenario.zh: 單一醫療領域、僅使用 LLM 的 agent(除選用性的 MedRAG 知識檢索外無外部工具)。一個 moderator agent 分類查詢複雜度;一個 recruiter 組建專科角色;依複雜度不同,團隊為 1 個 agent(Solo)、小型 MDT(在 N=3 個專科 agent 進行多輪迭代討論與 moderator 回饋時報告達到峰值準確率),或多團隊階層式 ICT。最終由一個 decision-maker 彙整答案。各角色為經 prompt 的人物設定(Primary Care Clinician、專科醫師)而非各自獨立 fine-tune 的模型。

title: MegaScale-Infer: Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Model Serving with Disaggregated Expert Parallelism
authors: Ruidong Zhu; Ziheng Jiang; Chao Jin; Peng Wu; Cesar A. Stuardo; Dongyang Wang; Xinlei Zhang; Huaping Zhou; Haoran Wei; Yang Cheng; Jianzhe Xiao; Xinyi Zhang; Lingjun Liu; Haibin Lin; Li-Wen Chang; Jianxi Ye; Xiao Yu; Xuanzhe Liu; Xin Jin; Xin Liu
venue_full: Conference on Applications, Technologies, Architectures, and Protocols for Computer Communication
research_focus: MoE serving, Multi-tenant scheduling, PD disaggregation, Continuous batching, Capacity planning, Performance modeling, Datacenter networking

problem_statement.en: MoE models suffer from low GPU utilization and high operational costs during inference because their sparse activation architecture shifts FFN modules from being compute-intensive to memory-intensive.
problem_statement.zh: MoE 模型在推理期間因稀疏啟動架構將 FFN 模組由運算密集型轉為記憶體密集型，導致 GPU 利用率偏低且運營成本高昂。

key_innovation.en: Disaggregated Expert Parallelism, which separates attention and FFN modules for independent scaling and heterogeneous deployment, combined with ping-pong pipeline parallelism and a high-performance M2N communication library.
key_innovation.zh: 解耦合 Expert Parallelism：將 attention 與 FFN 模組分離，以支援獨立擴展與異構部署，並結合 ping-pong pipeline parallelism 與高效能 M2N 通訊庫。

key_improvements.en: Up to 1.90x higher per-GPU throughput, 1.7x higher throughput per unit cost in heterogeneous clusters, and 4.2x higher throughput with 68.2% lower latency for M2N communication compared to NCCL.
key_improvements.zh: 每 GPU 吞吐量最高提升 1.90x；異構叢集中單位成本吞吐量提升 1.7x；M2N 通訊吞吐量較 NCCL 提升 4.2x 且延遲降低 68.2%。

ai_task: LLM Serving, MoE Serving, Distributed Inference
compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA A800, H20, L40S, 80GB Ampere GPUs
reported_accuracy: Not Reported (system paper; performance gains reported as throughput speedup, not predictive error)
validation_workloads: Synthetic, Production trace (ByteDance)

scope_assumptions.en: Disaggregates attention from FFN so each component can scale independently; relies on a custom M2N (many-to-many across attention shards and expert shards) communication library to keep all-to-all traffic off NCCL; the cost/latency model is implicit in deployment choices rather than published as a closed-form predictor.
scope_assumptions.zh: 將 attention 與 FFN 解耦合，使兩者可獨立擴展；依賴自製 M2N（attention shard 與 expert shard 間多對多）通訊庫，避免 all-to-all 流量走 NCCL；其延遲與成本模型隱含於部署決策中，並未以 closed-form 預測器形式發表。

title: Understanding Bottlenecks for Efficiently Serving LLM Inference With KV Offloading
authors: William Meng; Benjamin Lee; Hong Wang
venue_full: Conference on Machine Learning and Systems
research_focus: Long-context / Prefix cache, MoE serving, Multi-tenant scheduling, Continuous batching, KV cache offloading, Capacity planning, Performance modeling, Hardware co-design

problem_statement.en: KV cache offloading enables long-context LLM inference by storing caches in CPU DRAM, but PCIe bandwidth limitations create severe bottlenecks. Existing schedulers and hardware co-design assume prefill is compute-bound, an assumption that breaks once cached tokens substantially outnumber new ones, transforming prefill into memory-bound execution and leaving GPU compute resources underutilized.
problem_statement.zh: KV cache offloading 透過將 cache 儲存於 CPU DRAM 來支援長 context LLM 推理，但 PCIe 頻寬限制造成嚴重瓶頸。現有 scheduler 與硬體協同設計假設 prefill 為 compute-bound，當 cached token 數遠大於新 token 時此假設不再成立，prefill 轉為 memory-bound，導致 GPU 計算資源閒置。

key_innovation.en: An analytical framework that derives kappa_crit, the critical cached-to-prefill token ratio at which prefill execution becomes memory-bound, decomposed into a model factor (kappa_M = F_pf / B_kv) and a hardware factor (kappa_HW = BW_PCIe / C_eff). Pairing kappa_crit with the workload-side kappa_ratio = K/T lets architects, model designers and schedulers reason separately about when offloaded prefill crosses into the bandwidth-limited regime.
key_innovation.zh: 提出分析式框架推導 kappa_crit，即 prefill 由 compute-bound 轉為 memory-bound 的臨界 cached-to-prefill token 比例，並分解為 model factor (kappa_M = F_pf / B_kv) 與 hardware factor (kappa_HW = BW_PCIe / C_eff)。配合工作負載側的 kappa_ratio = K/T，可讓硬體架構師、模型設計者與 scheduler 各自獨立分析 offloaded prefill 何時跨入 bandwidth-limited regime。

key_improvements.en: Empirically shows PCIe overhead reaches 86x prefill computation and accounts for 99% of execution time; GPUs consume only 28% of rated TDP under KV-offloaded serving. Median workload kappa_ratio is 100 for ShareGPT, 5000 for NarrativeQA, and 10000 for FinQA, exceeding hardware kappa_crit (1.06-14.3 across modern platforms) by orders of magnitude. NVLink C2C raises kappa_crit by 5.3x; MLA reduces B_kv by 2.7-4.7x.
key_improvements.zh: 實證顯示 PCIe overhead 達 prefill 計算量的 86 倍、佔執行時間 99%；KV offloaded 服務下 GPU 僅消耗額定 TDP 的 28%。ShareGPT 工作負載 kappa_ratio 中位數為 100、NarrativeQA 為 5000、FinQA 為 10000，遠超現代平台 kappa_crit (1.06-14.3) 數個數量級。NVLink C2C 提升 kappa_crit 5.3x；MLA 將 B_kv 縮減 2.7-4.7x。

compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA H100, NVIDIA B200, NVIDIA A100, HBM3, DDR4-3200 DRAM
node_count: 1 node (server with AMD EPYC 7R13 CPU, 2 TB DDR4-3200)
reported_accuracy: Empirical kappa_crit measured at 2 (Llama-3.1-70B) and 1 (Qwen3-235B-A22B) versus peak-bandwidth estimates of 14.3 and 7.8; recalibrated with measured 15 GB/s sustained PCIe bandwidth, predictions become 3.3 and 1.8 (close to empirical).
validation_workloads: ShareGPT, NarrativeQA, FinQA, Synthetic

scope_assumptions.en: Framework approximates F_pf as 2N FLOPs per token, omitting the context scaling term 2 n_layer n_ctx d_attn (negligible for typical contexts but introduces ~10% error at 65K tokens). Focuses on loading KV caches from CPU DRAM; ignores write-back overhead of storing new prefixes. Disables prefix caching during measurement to isolate PCIe transfer; limits output to one token to simulate a prefill-only server. MLA evaluation deferred to future work due to implementation challenges.
scope_assumptions.zh: 框架以 2N FLOPs/token 近似 F_pf，忽略 2 n_layer n_ctx d_attn 的 context scaling 項（典型 context 下可忽略，但 65K tokens 下會引入約 10% 誤差）。聚焦從 CPU DRAM 載入 KV cache，忽略新 prefix 寫回 DRAM 的 overhead；量測時關閉 prefix caching 以隔離 PCIe transfer，並將輸出限制為單一 token 以模擬 prefill-only server。受限於實作問題，MLA 評估留待後續工作。

title: MiniPIC: Flexible Position-Independent Caching in <100LOC
authors: Nathan Ordonez; Thomas Parnell
research_focus: LLM serving, Long-context / Prefix cache

problem_statement.en: Prefix caching in production engines such as vLLM and SGLang reuses KV entries only under exact prefix matches, so recurring 'spans' (documents, code files, tool descriptions) in RAG and agentic workloads miss the cache whenever they appear at different offsets. Existing Position-Independent Caching (PIC) implementations either require substantial engine changes (SPNL's CIDRA repositioning, MEPIC) or keep KV state outside the server (EPIC, CacheBlend), incurring host-to-device transfer overhead. The root conflict: shared KV blocks that store RoPE-rotated keys cannot serve the same span at two different offsets concurrently.
