problem_statement.zh: vLLM 與 SGLang 等生產級引擎的 prefix caching 僅在前綴完全相符時重用 KV entry，因此 RAG 與 agentic 工作負載中反覆出現的 'span'（文件、程式碼檔案、工具描述）一旦出現在不同 offset 便會 cache miss。既有 Position-Independent Caching (PIC) 實作或需大幅修改引擎（SPNL 的 CIDRA repositioning、MEPIC），或將 KV 狀態存放於伺服器之外（EPIC、CacheBlend）而引入 host-to-device 傳輸開銷。根本衝突在於：共享 KV block 儲存經 RoPE 旋轉的 key，同一 span 無法同時以兩個不同 offset 服務並行請求。

key_innovation.en: A minimal PIC substrate built from two ingredients: (1) a positional-encoding-free KV cache that stores unrotated K vectors and applies RoPE to K tiles inside the Triton attention kernel using per-request logical positions, so one physical block serves concurrent requests at different offsets without copy/reposition; (2) three user-facing token-level primitives — block-aligned Padding, SSep (detaches a block from its preceding hash chain), and PDep (forces the block hash to depend on the entire preceding prompt) — that modify only vLLM's block-hashing behavior. With 78 LOC of core changes (61 new functionality) plus a modular attention backend, the primitives express Block-Attention, EPIC, and Prompt Cache within one running vLLM instance and compose natively with vLLM's CPU offload; a PIC-aware interleaved scheduling policy (ISPS) removes span-prefill/final-prompt synchronization barriers.
key_innovation.zh: 由兩個要素構成的極簡 PIC 基底：(1) positional-encoding-free KV cache——儲存未旋轉的 K 向量，於 Triton attention kernel 內依 per-request 邏輯位置對 K tile 套用 RoPE，使同一物理 block 可服務不同 offset 的並行請求而無需 copy/reposition；(2) 三個 user-facing 的 token-level primitive——block-aligned Padding、SSep（將 block 與其前置 hash chain 分離）與 PDep（強制 block hash 相依於完整前置 prompt）——僅修改 vLLM 的 block-hashing 行為。核心改動僅 78 LOC（其中 61 LOC 為新功能）加上模組化 attention backend，即可在同一 vLLM instance 中表達 Block-Attention、EPIC 與 Prompt Cache，並與 vLLM 原生 CPU offload 自然相容；另提出 PIC-aware 交錯排程策略（ISPS），消除 span-prefill 與 final-prompt 間的同步 barrier。

key_improvements.en: On 12,576 2WikiMultihopQA samples, MiniPIC with ISPS reaches 48.01 samples/s prefill throughput — 49% over baseline vLLM (32.21) and 33% over SPNL/CIDRA (36.14); eliminating the barrier adds ~9% over batched PIC (44.07). Cached-span TTFT drops by up to two orders of magnitude vs vanilla vLLM; worst-case (PIC-disabled) overhead of RoPE-in-kernel is only 5.7%.
key_improvements.zh: 於 12,576 筆 2WikiMultihopQA 樣本上，MiniPIC 搭配 ISPS 達到 48.01 samples/s 的 prefill 吞吐量——較 baseline vLLM (32.21) 提升 49%，較 SPNL/CIDRA (36.14) 提升 33%；消除 barrier 較 batched PIC (44.07) 再提升約 9%。cached-span TTFT 相較 vanilla vLLM 最多降低兩個數量級；RoPE-in-kernel 的最壞情況（停用 PIC）開銷僅 5.7%。

reported_accuracy: Not Reported
validation_workloads: 2WikiMultihopQA (12,576 samples, 10x ~100-token docs each), Synthetic (1000-token documents)

scope_assumptions.en: Targets RoPE-based transformers only (ALiBi/NoPE require different handling). Marker-placement correctness is the user's responsibility — incorrect padding or markers can cause false cache hits (validation intentionally kept outside the engine). Span techniques approximate full causal attention and reduce accuracy; evaluation uses Tulu3-block-ft, a Llama-3-8B variant fine-tuned for span-style RAG attention. vLLM's eviction policy is unchanged, so a cached span is not guaranteed to remain in GPU memory until its dependent prompt is scheduled. Single H100, prefill-only throughput; SPNL baseline runs on vLLM 0.10.2 vs MiniPIC's 0.15.01 (version bias assessed as negligible).
scope_assumptions.zh: 僅針對 RoPE-based transformer（ALiBi/NoPE 需不同處理）。marker 放置的正確性由使用者負責——錯誤的 padding 或 marker 位置可能造成 false cache hit（驗證刻意留在引擎之外）。span 技術為完整 causal attention 的近似，會降低準確率；評估採用 Tulu3-block-ft，即針對 span 式 RAG attention 微調的 Llama-3-8B 變體。vLLM 的 eviction policy 未修改，cached span 不保證在其相依 prompt 被排程前仍留在 GPU 記憶體中。實驗為單張 H100、僅量測 prefill 吞吐量；SPNL baseline 建於 vLLM 0.10.2 而 MiniPIC 為 0.15.01（版本差異經評估影響甚微）。

title: MIST: A Co-Design Framework for Heterogeneous, Multi-Stage LLM Inference
authors: Abhimanyu Rajeshkumar Bambhaniya; Hanjiang Wu; Suvinay Subramanian; Sudarshan Srinivasan; Souvik Kundu; Amir Yazdanbakhsh; Midhilesh Elavazhagan; Madhu Kumar; Minlan Yu; Arijit Raychowdhury; Tushar Krishna
affiliations: Georgia Institute of Technology, Google, Intel, Intel Labs, Google DeepMind, Harvard University, Infravana
research_focus: Long-context / Prefix cache, MoE serving, Agentic / Workflow serving, PD disaggregation, KV cache offloading, Capacity planning, Performance modeling, Hardware co-design, GPU memory tiering

problem_statement.en: Modern LLM serving spans multi-stage pipelines (RAG retrieval, KV cache reuse, prefill, decode) with distinct compute, memory, and latency demands on increasingly heterogeneous hardware (GPUs, TPUs, ASICs), yet existing inference simulators model only single-stage serving on homogeneous clusters and cannot evaluate cross-vendor, prefill-decode disaggregated configurations end-to-end. Exhaustively benchmarking the resulting configuration space on real hardware (e.g. Llama-3-70B on 8xH100) can exceed 40,000 USD in cloud cost.
problem_statement.zh: 現代 LLM 服務跨越多階段 pipeline（RAG 檢索、KV cache 重用、prefill、decode），在 GPU、TPU、ASIC 等日益異質的硬體上各自具備不同的運算、記憶體與延遲需求；既有推理模擬器僅針對同質叢集上的單階段服務建模，無法端到端評估跨廠商、prefill-decode 解耦合的部署組態。直接在真實硬體上窮舉設定空間（例如 8xH100 上的 Llama-3-70B）可能耗費超過 40,000 美元的雲端成本。

key_innovation.en: An event-driven, end-to-end discrete-event simulation framework that models the full LLM serving stack across three layers (AI Workload, System & Software, Hardware) with pluggable accelerator models (real execution, empirical, analytical, or external simulator such as ASTRA-sim, AIConfigurator, and GenZ). MIST jointly captures multi-stage pipelines (RAG + KV retrieval + prefill + decode), heterogeneous multi-vendor PD-disaggregated configurations, batching policies (static / continuous / chunked / mixed / disaggregated), and tiered KV cache storage (HBM, DRAM, SSD, rack-shared) within one unified software stack.
key_innovation.zh: 一個事件驅動的端到端離散事件模擬框架，將完整 LLM 服務堆疊分為 AI Workload、System & Software、Hardware 三層，並支援可插拔的加速器模型（real execution、empirical、analytical、或 ASTRA-sim、AIConfigurator、GenZ 等外部模擬器）。MIST 在統一軟體堆疊內同時建模多階段 pipeline（RAG + KV retrieval + prefill + decode）、跨廠商異質 PD 解耦合組態、批次策略（static、continuous、chunked、mixed、disaggregated）與分層 KV cache 儲存（HBM、DRAM、SSD、rack-shared）。

key_improvements.en: End-to-end fidelity within 6% of real-hardware vLLM runs; less than 2% average error in aggregated validation against vLLM Llama-3-70B on H100x8, Qwen3-32B on L40Sx2, and Llama-3-8B on TPUv6e; 20-50x faster than real execution. MIST-optimized multi-vendor PD-disaggregated deployments yield up to 49.3% higher tokens-per-dollar than the best single-vendor homogeneous PD-disaggregated baseline.
key_improvements.zh: 端到端保真度在實機 vLLM 結果的 6% 之內；針對 H100x8 的 Llama-3-70B、L40Sx2 的 Qwen3-32B 與 TPUv6e 的 Llama-3-8B 進行聚合驗證時平均誤差小於 2%；模擬速度較實機快 20-50x。經 MIST 最佳化的跨廠商 PD 解耦合部署相較於最佳單廠商同質 PD 解耦合基線，每美元 token 吞吐可提升最高 49.3%。

compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA H100-SXM, NVIDIA H200-SXM, NVIDIA B200-SXM, NVIDIA GB300, AMD MI350X, AMD MI355X, Google TPUv6e, Google TPUv7, Etched Sohu, NVIDIA L40S, HBM, DDR4, NVMe SSD
gpu_count: Up to 256 GPUs (4 racks of 64xH100 in KV storage study); 8x H100 / 80x H100 / 4x L40S / 1-2x TPUv6e in validation
node_count: Up to 4 HGX racks (64 GPUs each)
reported_accuracy: <6% end-to-end error; <2% average aggregated error
models_validated: Llama-3-70B, Llama-3-8B, Llama-3.1-70B, Qwen3-32B, Bloom-176B, Llama-2-70B
validation_workloads: ShareGPT, Azure trace (Conv and Code), Narrative QA, Github-Code dataset, Synthetic Poisson arrivals

scope_assumptions.en: RAG retrieval modeled via empirical LangChain runtime on a 64-core x86 CPU; KV retrieval latency modeled via linear regression on profiled DDR4/NVMe data; KV Client and RAG Client clusters do not support analytical-model or external-simulator backends; output token counts are not predicted (taken as inputs); single-cluster pricing estimated from public cloud rates; the framework treats Splitwise-sim as a valid simulation-based baseline rather than real hardware at 80+ GPU scale.
scope_assumptions.zh: RAG 檢索採用 LangChain 在 64 核 x86 CPU 上的 empirical runtime 建模；KV retrieval 延遲以 profiled DDR4 與 NVMe 資料的線性回歸建模；KV Client 與 RAG Client 叢集不支援 analytical-model 或外部模擬器後端；輸出 token 數視為輸入而非預測量；單叢集價格採用公開雲端費率估算；在 80 GPU 以上規模時將 Splitwise-sim 視為合法的模擬基線而非實機驗證。

title: Models Take Notes at Prefill: KV Cache Can Be Editable and Composable
authors: Bojie Li
research_focus: LLM serving, Long-context / Prefix cache, Agentic / Workflow serving, Multimodal serving

problem_statement.en: Prefix caching reuses prefill only across an exactly shared prefix: one changed field (a timestamp, a user id, an order status) invalidates the entire downstream KV cache, yet surgically overwriting the field's own key/value vectors leaves the model acting on the old value. Agentic workloads with mutable fields and dynamically assembled contexts therefore pay repeated O(L^2) reprefill.
problem_statement.zh: Prefix caching 只能在完全相同的 prefix 上重用 prefill：只要其中一個欄位改變（如 timestamp、user id 或訂單狀態），整段下游 KV cache 即告失效；然而僅覆寫該欄位自身的 key/value 向量，模型仍會依舊值行動。因此帶有可變欄位與動態組裝 context 的 agentic 工作負載必須反覆支付 O(L^2) 的 reprefill 成本。

key_innovation.en: Causally establishes an attention-mediated memoized inference mechanism: at prefill the model already writes field-conditioned conclusions onto downstream aggregator tokens (the field's own KV drives under 1% of the decision), reframing the KV cache as a notebook of memoized conclusions. Two operations follow: an append-only erratum (or recompute of the affected downstream notes) that edits the cache, and RoPE-repositioned splicing of precompiled skill/memory/image KV chunks that composes caches in O(L) instead of O(L^2).
key_innovation.zh: 以因果實驗確立 attention-mediated memoized inference 機制：模型在 prefill 階段即把欄位條件化的結論寫入下游 aggregator token（欄位自身 KV 對決策的貢獻不到 1%），據此將 KV cache 重新定義為記錄既定結論的筆記本。由此衍生兩種操作：以 append-only erratum（或重算受影響的下游 notes）編輯 cache，以及透過 RoPE 重新定位拼接預編譯的 skill/memory/影像 KV 區塊，以 O(L) 而非 O(L^2) 完成組合。

baselines_compared: CacheBlend, ROME, LoRA fine-tuning, vLLM Automatic Prefix Caching

key_improvements.en: Unified edit+compose agent stays decision-identical to full recompute at up to 14.9x lower cumulative TTFT; skill transplant is O(L) vs O(L^2) (13.9x TTFT speedup at 32k tokens; logit cosine 0.90-0.999 across twelve models); in online vLLM serving the append-only erratum keeps a 98.5% vs 1.0% prefix-cache hit-rate, cutting p90 TTFT by 53-398x with throughput gains up to 14.5x at saturation.
key_improvements.zh: 統一的 edit+compose agent 與完整 recompute 決策一致，累計 TTFT 最多降低 14.9x；skill 移植為 O(L) 而非 O(L^2)（32k token 時 TTFT 加速 13.9x，十二個模型上 logit cosine 0.90–0.999）；線上 vLLM serving 中 append-only erratum 使 prefix cache 命中率維持 98.5%（基線僅 1.0%），p90 TTFT 降低 53–398x，飽和負載下吞吐量最高提升 14.5x。

ai_task: LLM Serving, AI Inference KV Cache transfer

title: ModServe: Modality- and Stage-Aware Resource Disaggregation for Scalable Multimodal Model Serving
authors: Haoran Qiu; Anish Biswas; Zihan Zhao; Jayashree Mohan; Alind Khare; Esha Choukse; Íñigo Goiri; Zeyu Zhang; Haiying Shen; Chetan Bansal; Ramachandran Ramjee; Rodrigo Fonseca
research_focus: Multimodal serving, Multi-tenant scheduling, PD disaggregation, Continuous batching, Capacity planning, Performance modeling, Datacenter networking, Routing / Load balancing

problem_statement.en: Existing monolithic LMM serving systems suffer from resource contention and inefficient scaling because they tightly couple heterogeneous inference stages (preprocessing, encoding, and LLM backend) that have different performance characteristics. This leads to head-of-line blocking and poor tail latency under bursty multimodal workloads.
problem_statement.zh: 現有單體式 LMM serving 系統將前處理、編碼與 LLM 後端等效能特性各異的異構推理階段緊耦合，導致資源爭用與擴展效率低落，在突發多模態工作負載下出現 head-of-line blocking 與尾延遲惡化。

key_innovation.en: ModServe, a modular LMM serving architecture that decouples image-specific (preprocessing/encoding) and text-specific (LLM prefill/decode) inference stages into independent instances, enabling stage-aware autoscaling, modality-aware request routing, and parallelized image encoding.
key_innovation.zh: ModServe 是一個模組化 LMM serving 架構，將影像專屬（前處理/編碼）與文字專屬（LLM prefill/decode）推理階段解耦為獨立實例，從而支援階段感知自動擴展、模態感知請求路由與並行化影像編碼。

key_improvements.en: 3.3–5.5x higher throughput, 25–41.3% cost reduction, and improved P99 TTFT SLO attainment.
key_improvements.zh: 吞吐量提升 3.3–5.5x，成本降低 25–41.3%，P99 TTFT SLO 達成率顯著改善。

ai_task: LLM Serving, Multimodal Model Serving, Image-Text-to-Text, Video-Text-to-Text
traffic_pattern: All-to-All, Pipeline Parallelism, Elephant flows, Concurrent flows
transport_and_interconnect: RDMA, GPU Direct RDMA, TCP/IP, Ethernet
reported_accuracy: Not Reported (system paper; reports throughput / cost / P99 TTFT SLO attainment rather than predictive error)
models_validated: LLaVA-1.5-7B, LLaVA-OneVision, InternVL, Qwen-VL (Azure production multimodal traces)
validation_workloads: Production trace (Azure multimodal traces), Synthetic
downstream_use: Capacity planning, Scheduling, Autoscaling, SLO admission

scope_assumptions.en: Modality- and stage-aware empirical characterization on Azure production multimodal traffic; decouples image-specific preprocessing/encoding and text-specific LLM prefill/decode stages into independent instances; performance model is *not* published as a closed-form TTFT/TPOT analytical formula — Cornserve / Cornfigurator subsequently fills that gap with a Monte-Carlo planner.
scope_assumptions.zh: 在 Azure 生產多模態流量上進行 modality 與 stage 感知的實證刻畫；將影像專屬的前處理與編碼，以及文字專屬的 LLM prefill/decode 階段，解耦為獨立實例；其效能模型並未以 closed-form 的 TTFT/TPOT 解析公式形式發表 — 此空缺隨後由 Cornserve / Cornfigurator 透過 Monte-Carlo planner 填補。

title: MoE-Lightning: High-Throughput MoE Inference on Memory-constrained GPUs
authors: Shiyi Cao; Shu Liu; Tyler Griggs; Peter Schafhalter; Xiaoxuan Liu; Ying Sheng; Joseph E. Gonzalez; Matei Zaharia; Ion Stoica
research_focus: MoE serving, Multi-tenant scheduling, KV cache offloading, Performance modeling, Roofline analysis, Hardware co-design, GPU memory tiering

problem_statement.en: Efficient batch inference of large MoE models on memory-constrained GPUs (e.g. Mixtral 8x7B on a single 16 GB T4) is bottlenecked by CPU-GPU I/O of expert weights and KV cache; existing offloading systems such as FlexGen and DeepSpeed Zero-Inference under-utilize CPU memory, CPU compute, and CPU-GPU bandwidth simultaneously, and rely on a flat roofline that cannot capture the hierarchical memory and bandwidth structure of CPU+GPU systems.
problem_statement.zh: 在記憶體受限的 GPU（例如單張 16 GB T4）上對 Mixtral 8x7B 等大型 MoE 模型進行批次推理時，效能瓶頸在於 expert 權重與 KV cache 的 CPU-GPU I/O；FlexGen 與 DeepSpeed Zero-Inference 等既有 offloading 系統無法同時充分利用 CPU 記憶體、CPU 運算與 CPU-GPU 頻寬，且其依賴的單層 roofline 模型無法刻畫 CPU 加 GPU 系統的階層式記憶體與頻寬結構。

key_innovation.en: Two co-designed components: (1) CGOPipe, a fine-grained CPU-GPU-I/O pipeline schedule with weights paging that interleaves QKV download, hidden upload, weights transfer, and KV cache transfer to overlap with CPU attention and GPU MoE FFN computation; and (2) the Hierarchical Roofline Model (HRM), an extension of the classical roofline to multi-level memory hierarchies (GPU HBM, CPU DRAM, CPU-GPU PCIe) that introduces per-level compute roofs, intra-level memory roofs, and cross-level memory roofs, exposing turning points and a balance point that guide the search for optimal batch size N, micro-batch size mu, device placement of attention and MoE FFN, and the fraction of weights stored on GPU.
key_innovation.zh: 兩個共同設計的元件：(1) CGOPipe，一種帶 weights paging 的細粒度 CPU-GPU-I/O pipeline schedule，將 QKV download、hidden upload、weights transfer 與 KV cache transfer 交錯安排，使其與 CPU attention 及 GPU MoE FFN 計算重疊；(2) Hierarchical Roofline Model（HRM），把傳統 roofline 擴展至多層記憶體階層（GPU HBM、CPU DRAM、CPU-GPU PCIe），引入各層 compute roof、層內 memory roof 與跨層 memory roof，揭露 turning point 與 balance point，藉以搜尋最佳批次大小 N、micro-batch 大小 mu、attention 與 MoE FFN 的放置裝置，以及 GPU 上靜態保留權重的比例。

key_improvements.en: Up to 10.3x higher generation throughput (without prompt padding) and 3.5x (with padding) over FlexGen on a single T4 GPU for Mixtral 8x7B (S1); up to 6.7x over FlexGen, FlexGen(c), and DeepSpeed (S2). Mixtral 8x22B and DBRX on 2-4 T4 GPUs reach 2.1-2.8x improvement, and super-linear scaling is observed from 2 to 4 T4 GPUs under tensor parallelism.
key_improvements.zh: 在單張 T4 GPU 上對 Mixtral 8x7B 的生成吞吐（S1）較 FlexGen 提升最多 10.3x（無 prompt padding）及 3.5x（含 padding）；在 S2 設定下相較 FlexGen、FlexGen(c) 與 DeepSpeed 提升最多 6.7x。Mixtral 8x22B 與 DBRX 於 2 至 4 張 T4 GPU 上達 2.1 至 2.8x 提升，且在 tensor parallelism 下從 2 GPU 擴展至 4 GPU 呈現超線性 scaling。

compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA T4 (16 GB), NVIDIA L4 (24 GB), Intel Xeon CPU, DDR4
reported_accuracy: Not Reported
validation_workloads: MTBench, Synthetic Reasoning (HELM), Summarization (HELM)

scope_assumptions.en: Decode-phase optimization only (prefill assumed compute-bound and offload-irrelevant); single-node, intra-node tensor parallelism only (no pipeline parallelism across nodes); no disk offloading considered; HRM assumes theoretically calculated FLOPs and bytes with profiled peak hardware bandwidth, acknowledged to deviate from real kernel performance; KV cache modeled at single-precision (float32 in figures, float16/int4 explored only for attention).
scope_assumptions.zh: 僅針對 decode 階段最佳化（prefill 視為 compute-bound 而不考慮 offload）；僅探討單節點內 tensor parallelism，不考慮跨節點 pipeline parallelism；不考慮 disk offload；HRM 採用理論 FLOPs 與 bytes 搭配實測峰值頻寬，作者明確指出與實際 kernel 表現可能存在差異；KV cache 主要以單精度建模（圖示使用 float32，僅在 attention 上探討 float16 與 int4）。

title: MoE-SpeQ: Speculative Quantized Decoding with Proactive Expert Prefetching and Offloading for Mixture-of-Experts
authors: Wenfeng Wang; Jiacheng Liu; Xiaofeng Hou; Xinfeng Xia; Peng Tang; Mingxuan Zhang; Chao Li; Minyi Guo
affiliations: Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Hong Kong University of Science and Technology
research_focus: Speculative decoding, MoE serving, Multi-tenant scheduling, Continuous batching, KV cache offloading, Quantization, Performance modeling, Roofline analysis, Routing / Load balancing

problem_statement.en: On memory-constrained accelerators, offloaded MoE inference is dominated by PCIe transfers of expert weights (e.g. 98.9% of step time on Mixtral-8x7B over an A100-40G), and token-level expert routing is highly entropic (close to theoretical maximum on Qwen-1.5MoE), so reactive caching policies such as LRU and one-layer-ahead predictors are inadequate to hide the I/O latency.
problem_statement.zh: 在記憶體受限的加速器上，offloaded MoE 推理的整體時間主要被 expert 權重的 PCIe 傳輸佔據（例如在 A100-40G 上執行 Mixtral-8x7B 時佔 98.9% 的 step time），且 token 層級的 expert routing 高度發散（Qwen-1.5MoE 接近理論最大熵），使得 LRU 與單層 lookahead 預測等被動式 caching 策略無法有效隱藏 I/O 延遲。

key_innovation.en: MoE-SpeQ co-designs speculative execution with proactive expert offloading: a 4-bit INT4 GPTQ-quantized draft model that achieves 90.9% top-4 expert prediction fidelity (44.1% hard matches + 46.8% soft matches) acts as a high-fidelity multi-step lookahead. Three components consume this lookahead: (1) an Expert Scheduler with an Expert Lookahead Buffer (ELB) for hierarchical, layer-aware proactive prefetching; (2) a Speculative Governor that solves an Amortization Roofline Model online for the optimal draft length k* under TTFT SLO constraints; (3) an Execution Engine with a fused INT4 MoE CUDA kernel, computation reordering, and shared non-expert parameter and KV cache between draft and target.
key_innovation.zh: MoE-SpeQ 將 speculative execution 與主動式 expert offloading 共同設計：以 GPTQ 4-bit INT4 量化的 draft model 作為高保真多步 lookahead（top-4 expert 預測正確率 90.9%，其中 hard match 44.1%、soft match 46.8%）。三個組件消費此 lookahead：(1) 配備 Expert Lookahead Buffer（ELB）的 Expert Scheduler，執行階層式、layer-aware 的主動 prefetching；(2) Speculative Governor，於線上求解 Amortization Roofline Model，在 TTFT SLO 限制下決定最適 draft length k*；(3) Execution Engine，採用 fused INT4 MoE CUDA kernel、computation reordering，並讓 draft 與 target 共享 non-expert 參數與 KV cache。

baselines_compared: HuggingFace Transformers (device_map offloading), Mixtral-Offloading-SC (same cache), Mixtral-Offloading-SM (same memory)

key_improvements.en: At most 2.34x end-to-end throughput speedup on Phi-MoE over state-of-the-art offloading frameworks across five datasets (GSM8K, WikiText-2, HumanEval, GPQA, C4) and varying GPU memory budgets; INT4 draft model achieves 90.9% top-4 expert prediction accuracy on Qwen-MoE, surpassing a specialized one-layer-ahead predictor at 84.7%; fused INT4 MoE kernel outperforms PyTorch FP16, ExLlamaV1, ExLlamaV2, and Marlin in both prefill and decode latency for the evaluated MoE models.
key_improvements.zh: 在 Phi-MoE 上跨 GSM8K、WikiText-2、HumanEval、GPQA、C4 五項資料集及不同 GPU 記憶體預算下，端到端吞吐相較 state-of-the-art offloading 框架提升最多 2.34x；INT4 draft model 在 Qwen-MoE 上達到 90.9% 的 top-4 expert 預測準確率，優於專門的單層 lookahead 預測器（84.7%）；fused INT4 MoE kernel 在所評估的 MoE 模型上於 prefill 與 decode 延遲皆優於 PyTorch FP16、ExLlamaV1、ExLlamaV2 與 Marlin。

compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA A100-40GB (PCIe 4.0 x16), Intel Xeon Silver 4310, DDR4 256 GB
reported_accuracy: Not Reported (system-level prediction accuracy: 90.9% top-4 expert match)
models_validated: Phi-3.5-MoE (41.9B total / 6.6B activated), Qwen1.5-MoE-A2.7B (14.3B / 2.7B), DeepSeek-V2-Lite (15.7B / 2.4B), Mixtral-8x7B, Qwen-1.5MoE (analysis)
validation_workloads: GSM8K, WikiText-2-v1, HumanEval, GPQA, C4

scope_assumptions.en: Single A100 (40 GB) workstation with PCIe 4.0 x16 (16 GB/s per direction); MLP linear layers quantized to symmetric INT4 with group size 128 while attention, norms, gating networks, and shared experts remain FP16; T_draft modeled as a linear function of k, T_pcie_init and T_verify as profiled constants/interpolations, only T_pcie_new(k) estimated online; Amortization Roofline Model assumes a single I/O roof slope set by PCIe bandwidth and ignores cross-request batching effects; comparison restricted to Transformers-based offloading frameworks (Mixtral-Offloading variants) for fairness, excluding vLLM/SGLang/llama.cpp.
scope_assumptions.zh: 單張 A100（40 GB）工作站，PCIe 4.0 x16（單向 16 GB/s）；MLP 線性層採對稱 INT4、group size 128 量化，attention、norm、gating network 與 shared expert 保留 FP16；T_draft 以 k 的線性函式建模，T_pcie_init 與 T_verify 為離線 profile 之常數或內插，僅 T_pcie_new(k) 於線上估算；Amortization Roofline Model 假設單一由 PCIe 頻寬決定的 I/O roof slope，並忽略跨 request 的 batching 效應；為公平比較，僅與基於 Transformers 的 offloading 框架（Mixtral-Offloading 變體）對比，未涵蓋 vLLM、SGLang、llama.cpp。

title: Mooncake: Trading More Storage for Less Computation — A KVCache-centric Architecture for Serving LLM Chatbot
authors: Ruoyu Qin; Moonshot Ai; Jialei Cui; Moonshot Ai; Feng Ren; Mingxing Zhang; Yongwei Wu; Weimin Zheng
venue_full: USENIX Conference on File and Storage Technologies
research_focus: Long-context / Prefix cache, PD disaggregation, Datacenter networking, RDMA / Transport

problem_statement.en: LLM serving faces bottlenecks in maximizing throughput while meeting stringent latency-related Service Level Objectives (SLOs) for long-context inputs, exacerbated by the high cost of recomputing KVCache.
problem_statement.zh: LLM serving 在長 context 輸入下難以同時兼顧吞吐量極大化與嚴格的延遲 SLO，而 KVCache 重計算的高昂代價進一步加劇此困境。

key_innovation.en: A KVCache-centric disaggregated architecture that pools CPU, DRAM, SSD, and RDMA resources across a GPU cluster to create a global, distributed KVCache store, enabling efficient prefix caching and inter-node transfer.
key_innovation.zh: 以 KVCache 為中心的解耦合架構：將 GPU 叢集中的 CPU、DRAM、SSD 與 RDMA 資源匯聚為全域分散式 KVCache 儲存池，實現高效的 prefix caching 與節點間傳輸。

baselines_compared: vLLM, vLLM Prefix Caching, vLLM Chunked Prefill

key_improvements.en: Up to 498% increase in effective request capacity, 115% and 107% more requests handled on A800 and H800 clusters respectively, and up to 48% savings in prefill computation time.
key_improvements.zh: 有效請求容量最高提升 498%；A800 與 H800 叢集分別多處理 115% 與 107% 的請求；prefill 計算時間節省最高 48%。

ai_task: LLM Serving, LLM Chatbot, Long-context Inference
compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA A800, H800, HBM, DRAM, SSD

title: Mooncake: A KVCache-centric Disaggregated Architecture for LLM Serving
authors: Ruoyu Qin; Zheming Li; Weiran He; Mingxing Zhang; Yongwei Wu; Weimin Zheng; Xinran Xu
research_focus: Long-context / Prefix cache, Multi-tenant scheduling, PD disaggregation, Continuous batching, KV cache offloading, Capacity planning, Performance modeling, Datacenter networking

problem_statement.en: LLM serving systems face challenges in maximizing throughput while meeting latency-related SLOs (TTFT and TBT) under overloaded scenarios and limited GPU resources. Traditional coupled architectures struggle with long-context requests and inefficient resource utilization.
problem_statement.zh: LLM 服務系統在過載情境與有限 GPU 資源下，難以同時兼顧吞吐量極大化與 TTFT/TBT 等延遲 SLO。傳統耦合架構在長 context 請求下表現不佳，資源利用率也偏低。

key_innovation.en: A KVCache-centric disaggregated architecture that separates prefill and decoding clusters, utilizes underutilized CPU/DRAM/SSD resources for a distributed KVCache pool, and employs a KVCache-centric scheduler with prediction-based early rejection.
key_innovation.zh: 以 KVCache 為中心的解耦合架構：將 prefill 與 decode 拆成獨立叢集，並把閒置的 CPU/DRAM/SSD 串成分散式 KVCache pool；scheduler 以 KVCache 為核心、結合預測式早期拒絕策略。

key_improvements.en: Up to 525% throughput increase in simulated scenarios; 75% more requests handled under real workloads while meeting SLOs.
key_improvements.zh: 模擬情境下吞吐量最高提升 525%；真實工作負載下在滿足 SLO 的前提下可多處理 75% 的請求。

ai_task: LLM Serving, Disaggregated Prefill/Decoding
reported_accuracy: Not Reported (system paper; scheduler uses prediction-based early rejection rather than reporting MAPE)
validation_workloads: Production trace (Mooncake/Kimi), Synthetic, ArXiv-Summarization, ShareGPT

scope_assumptions.en: TTFT and TBT SLOs are jointly optimized via early rejection of incoming requests when KVCache pool capacity is predicted to violate latency targets; assumes RDMA fabric between prefill, decode, and KVCache pool nodes; design and validation tied to Moonshot's production Kimi traffic, may not generalize to single-tenant settings.
scope_assumptions.zh: TTFT 與 TBT SLO 透過預測式早期拒絕策略共同優化：當 KVCache pool 容量預測無法滿足延遲目標時即拒收請求；假設 prefill、decode 與 KVCache pool 節點間使用 RDMA fabric；設計與驗證綁定於 Moonshot 的 Kimi 生產流量，難以直接外推至單租戶情境。

offload_trigger: Store-everything after prefill: KVCache blocks are saved into the distributed CPU/DRAM/SSD pool as part of normal serving; there is no gap- or lifetime-based offload decision.
destination_tiers: host DRAM, local SSD, disaggregated store
prefetch_signal_timing: Cache-aware request routing rather than prefetch: the scheduler routes requests to the node holding the longest reusable prefix and imports remote KV via layer-wise streaming when transfer beats recompute; restore is decided at request admission.
agent_awareness: None agent-specific: exploits cross-request prefix reuse in a disaggregated cluster; no tool-gap timing or per-session lifetime signal.

when_to_offload_rule.en: Store all KV into the distributed pool after prefill; the operative decision is on restore — import reusable remote KV when the estimated transfer/queueing/SLO cost beats local prefill recomputation, otherwise recompute.
when_to_offload_rule.zh: prefill 完成後即將所有 KV 存入分散式 pool；實際決策在於回填端——當估計的傳輸/排隊/SLO 成本優於本地 prefill 重算時即匯入遠端可重用 KV，否則重算。

title: More Tokens, Lower Precision: Towards the Optimal Token-Precision Trade-off in KV Cache Compression
authors: Jiebin Zhang; Dawei Zhu; Yifan Song; Wenhao Wu; Chuqiao Kuang; Xiaoguang Li; Lifeng Shang; Qun Liu; Sujian Li
venue_full: Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing
affiliations: MOE Key Laboratory of Computational Linguistics, Peking University
research_focus: Long-context / Prefix cache, KV cache compression, Quantization, Datacenter networking

problem_statement.en: The KV cache memory usage becomes a critical bottleneck for long-context LLM inference, and existing methods treat token pruning and precision quantization as orthogonal, under-explored dimensions.
problem_statement.zh: KV cache 記憶體佔用成為長 context LLM 推理的關鍵瓶頸，而現有方法將 token 剪枝與精度量化視為相互獨立、探索不足的兩個維度。

key_innovation.en: Quantized pruning, a strategy that integrates KV pruning and KV quantization to balance token count and precision, allowing for more tokens to be stored at lower bit-precision within a fixed memory budget.
key_innovation.zh: 量化剪枝（quantized pruning）策略：整合 KV 剪枝與 KV 量化，在固定記憶體預算內以較低 bit 精度儲存更多 token，從而在 token 數量與精度之間取得平衡。

baselines_compared: StreamingLLM, H2O, SnapKV, PyramidKV, Ada-KV, HeadKV, FlexGen, KIVI, KVQuant

key_improvements.en: Significant enhancement in long-context performance, particularly in retrieval tasks; 4x tokens in 4-bit precision outperforms 1x tokens in 16-bit precision.
key_improvements.zh: 長 context 效能顯著提升，尤其在檢索任務上表現突出；以 4-bit 精度存放 4x token 的效果優於以 16-bit 精度存放 1x token。

ai_task: LLM Serving, LLM Inference, Long-context Retrieval, Summarization, Code Completion

title: MPK: A Compiler and Runtime for Mega-Kernelizing Tensor Programs
authors: Xinhao Cheng; Zhihao Zhang; Yu Zhou; Jianan Ji; Jinchen Jiang; Zepeng Zhao; Ziruo Xiao; Zihao Ye; Yingyi Huang; Ruihang Lai; Hongyi Jin; Bohan Hou; Mengdi Wu; Yixin Dong; Anthony Yip; Songting Wang; Wenqin Yang; Xupeng Miao; Tianqi Chen; Zhihao Jia
venue_full: USENIX Symposium on Operating Systems Design and Implementation (OSDI '26)
research_focus: LLM serving, Roofline analysis, Performance modeling, Hardware co-design, Collective communication

problem_statement.en: The conventional kernel-per-operator execution model launches a separate GPU kernel for every operator in an LLM decoding step. Each launch incurs CPU dispatch/launch overhead and, more importantly, forces every intermediate tensor to be written out to and re-read from HBM between kernels. For low-latency single-request decoding the model is weight-roofline bound (e.g. loading ~16 GB of weights at 1.6 TB/s implies a ~10 ms floor), and these inter-kernel HBM round-trips plus launch/scheduling overhead keep real latency well above that hardware limit.
problem_statement.zh: 傳統的 kernel-per-operator 執行模型會為 LLM decode 每一步的每個 operator 各自啟動一個 GPU kernel。每次啟動都帶來 CPU dispatch/launch 額外負擔，更關鍵的是迫使所有中間張量在 kernel 之間被寫回並重新從 HBM 讀取。對於低延遲的單請求 decode，效能受 weight-roofline 限制（例如以 1.6 TB/s 載入約 16 GB 權重意味著約 10 ms 的下限），而這些 inter-kernel 的 HBM 往返加上 launch/排程開銷使實際延遲遠高於該硬體極限。

key_innovation.en: MPK is a compiler+runtime that compiles an entire multi-GPU LLM inference step into a single persistent mega-kernel. The compiler lowers the tensor program into an SM-level task graph that captures data dependencies at the granularity of individual streaming multiprocessors and generates fast CUDA code per task; an in-kernel parallel runtime then executes the whole graph inside one persistent kernel launch using decentralized scheduling across SMs (workers + local/remote schedulers). Because all operators run inside one kernel, intermediate results stay in on-chip SRAM/L2 / registers and are handed off worker-to-worker instead of round-tripping through HBM, which also enables cross-operator software pipelining and fine-grained overlap of computation with inter-GPU communication.
key_innovation.zh: MPK 是一套編譯器加執行期系統，能把整個多 GPU 的 LLM 推理步驟編譯成單一 persistent mega-kernel。編譯器將張量程式下降為 SM-level task graph，以個別串流多處理器（SM）的粒度捕捉資料相依性，並為每個 task 產生高效 CUDA 程式；in-kernel 平行 runtime 接著在單一 persistent kernel 啟動內，以跨 SM 的去中心化排程（workers 加 local/remote schedulers）執行整張圖。由於所有 operator 都在同一個 kernel 內運行，中間結果留在晶片上的 SRAM/L2／暫存器並以 worker 對 worker 的方式傳遞，而非往返 HBM；這同時實現了跨 operator 的 software pipelining 與計算/跨 GPU 通訊的細粒度重疊。

reported_accuracy: Not Reported (target is the weight-loading roofline bound: MPK reaches 12.5 ms single-GPU decode vs a ~10 ms theoretical floor for 16 GB weights at 1.6 TB/s)
validation_workloads: Synthetic (single-request low-latency decoding)

scope_assumptions.en: Targets low-latency, small-batch (single-request) autoregressive decoding where the step is weight-roofline (memory-bandwidth) bound; the megakernel is built per fixed model/shape configuration ahead of time. Multi-GPU gains assume NVLink/NVSHMEM intra-node communication. Reported analysis floors assume weights dominate HBM traffic and ignore KV-cache growth for long contexts.
scope_assumptions.zh: 針對低延遲、小批次（單請求）的自迴歸 decode，此時每步受 weight-roofline（記憶體頻寬）限制；mega-kernel 是針對固定模型/形狀組態事先編譯產生。多 GPU 的增益假設使用 NVLink/NVSHMEM 的節點內通訊。所報告的分析下限假設權重主導 HBM 流量，並忽略長上下文下 KV-cache 的成長。

baselines_compared: kernel-per-operator execution, vLLM, SGLang, Triton kernels, FlashInfer, CUDA Graphs

key_improvements.en: Eliminating inter-kernel HBM round-trips is the central contribution: by fusing the whole step into one persistent kernel, intermediates stay on-chip (SRAM/L2/registers) instead of being written to and re-read from HBM between operators, and per-operator launch/dispatch overhead is removed. The arXiv abstract reports up to 1.7x lower end-to-end inference latency vs kernel-per-operator serving systems, pushing single-request decode close to the hardware limit; the project's earlier MPK report quotes a 1.2x-6.7x latency reduction with gains growing with GPU count, e.g. single-GPU A100-40GB decode of 12.5 ms (MPK) vs 14.5 ms (kernel-per-operator) against a ~10 ms weight-roofline floor (16 GB weights / 1.6 TB/s).
key_improvements.zh: 消除 inter-kernel 的 HBM 往返是核心貢獻：藉由把整步融合進單一 persistent kernel，中間結果留在晶片上（SRAM/L2／暫存器）而非在 operator 之間寫回並重讀 HBM，同時移除每個 operator 的 launch/dispatch 開銷。arXiv 摘要回報相較 kernel-per-operator 服務系統最高降低 1.7x 的端到端推理延遲，使單請求 decode 逼近硬體極限；專案先前的 MPK 報告則引述 1.2x-6.7x 的延遲降低，且增益隨 GPU 數量上升，例如單 GPU A100-40GB 的 decode 為 12.5 ms（MPK）對 14.5 ms（kernel-per-operator），相對於約 10 ms 的 weight-roofline 下限（16 GB 權重／1.6 TB/s）。

compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA A100 40GB, NVIDIA H100, NVIDIA H200, NVIDIA B200, HBM, NVLink
gpu_count: 1-8x A100/H100 (single-node, gains grow with GPU count)

source.notes: L2/inter-kernel cache reuse is the load-bearing mechanism: fusing the whole decode step into one persistent megakernel keeps intermediates on-chip (SRAM/L2/registers) and removes inter-kernel HBM round-trips + launch overhead, leaving latency bounded by the weight-loading roofline.

title: MTP: Transport for In-Network Computing
authors: Tao Ji; UT Austin; Rohan Vardekar; Balajee Vamanan; Brent E Stephens
venue_full: Symposium on Networked Systems Design and Implementation
affiliations: UT Austin, University of Illinois Chicago, Google, University of Utah
research_focus: Datacenter networking, RDMA / Transport, Congestion control, In-network computing

problem_statement.en: Existing transport protocols like TCP, RDMA, and Homa fail to handle the unique attributes of In-Network Computing (INC) offloads, such as message mutation, interception, reordering, and unpredictable processing delays, leading to broken reliability and ineffective congestion control.
problem_statement.zh: 現有傳輸協定（如 TCP、RDMA、Homa）無法應對 In-Network Computing（INC）卸載所帶來的獨特屬性，包括訊息變異、攔截、重排序與不可預測的處理延遲，導致可靠性破壞與擁塞控制失效。

key_innovation.en: MTP (Message Transport Protocol), a message-oriented transport that decouples reliability from packet sequence numbers, uses per-message retransmission timeouts (RTOs) with pathlet-aware feedback (PRX/PTX ACKs), and implements a resource-specific congestion control framework with proactive pathlet switching.
key_innovation.zh: MTP（Message Transport Protocol）是一種以訊息為導向的傳輸協定，將可靠性與封包序號解耦，採用每訊息重傳超時（RTO）結合 pathlet 感知回饋（PRX/PTX ACK），並實作資源特定的擁塞控制框架與主動式 pathlet 切換。

key_improvements.en: 15% throughput increase for NetCache, 65% reduction in tail latency, and 10-20% higher load sustainability under heavy reordering.
key_improvements.zh: NetCache 吞吐量提升 15%，尾延遲降低 65%，在高度重排序場景下負載可持續性提高 10–20%。

ai_task: LLM Serving, AI Model Training, Key-Value Caching, Distributed Deep Learning (DDL)
compute_memory_hw: Intel Xeon 1.8GHz, AMD EPYC 3.0GHz, 64GB DRAM, 128GB DRAM
routing_and_congestion_control: ECMP, ECN, DCTCP, Proactive Pathlet Switching (PPS)

title: Multi-Bin Batching for Increasing LLM Inference Throughput
authors: Ozgur Guldogan; Jackson Kunde; Kangwook Lee; Ramtin Pedarsani
affiliations: University of California Santa Barbara, University of Wisconsin-Madison
research_focus: Multi-tenant scheduling, Length prediction, Capacity planning, Performance modeling, Queueing theory

problem_statement.en: Under standard batched LLM inference, requests with widely differing output lengths share a batch and the computing unit stays locked until the longest request completes, causing severe resource underutilization that offsets the throughput gains of parallel batching.
problem_statement.zh: 標準批次推理下，輸出長度差異大的請求被綁在同一批次，運算單元須等到批次中最長請求完成才能釋放，導致嚴重資源閒置，抵消批次平行化所帶來的吞吐量增益。

key_innovation.en: Multi-Bin Batching (k-Bin Batching): a queueing-theoretic control policy that classifies arriving requests into k bins by predicted output length with equal-probability-mass boundaries derived in closed form, then forms size-B batches within each bin and serves bins under FCFS. Proven to be asymptotically throughput-optimal as k grows.
key_innovation.zh: 提出 Multi-Bin Batching（k-Bin Batching）：以 queueing theory 為基礎的控制策略，依預測輸出長度將請求分入 k 個 bins，並以封閉解導出等機率質量的邊界；每個 bin 內形成 size-B 批次，再以 FCFS 服務。證明當 k 增大時為漸近吞吐量最佳。

key_improvements.en: Up to 70 percent throughput improvement over standard batching with oracle output-length information; with k=32 bins approaches theoretical maximum capacity; robust to symmetric output-length prediction errors, with throughput increasing in k even under noisy predictions.
key_improvements.zh: 在 oracle 輸出長度資訊下，吞吐量較標準批次最多提升 70%；k=32 時逼近理論最大容量；對 symmetric 輸出長度預測誤差亦具穩健性，吞吐量在含雜訊預測下仍隨 k 上升。

reported_accuracy: Linear inference-time fit at 0.0366 seconds per generated token on Phi-3.5-mini-instruct
validation_workloads: GSM8K, Synthetic (Poisson arrivals with uniform and exponential service-time distributions)

scope_assumptions.en: Single-server queueing model with infinite queue capacity, Poisson arrivals, i.i.d. uniform service times in [l_min, l_max] (main analysis; exponential in appendix). Batch service time equals the maximum among the B requests. Continuous batching is explicitly out of scope. Requires an output-length predictor (oracle in main experiments).
scope_assumptions.zh: 假設單伺服器 queue 模型、無窮佇列容量、Poisson 到達，主分析設定服務時間為 i.i.d. 均勻分佈 [l_min, l_max]（exponential 結果置於附錄）。批次服務時間取 B 個請求中的最大值。Continuous batching 明確排除於範圍外。需要輸出長度預測器（主要實驗使用 oracle）。

title: Network Load Balancing with In-network Reordering Support for RDMA
authors: Cha Hwan Song; Xin Zhe Khooi; Raj Joshi; Inho Choi; Jialin Li; Mun Choon Chan
venue_full: Conference on Applications, Technologies, Architectures, and Protocols for Computer Communication
research_focus: Datacenter networking, RDMA / Transport, Routing / Load balancing, In-network computing

problem_statement.en: RDMA traffic is highly sensitive to out-of-order packet arrivals, which trigger unnecessary loss recovery and rate reduction, while existing load balancing algorithms fail to effectively distribute RDMA traffic due to its continuous flow characteristics and lack of sufficient flowlet gaps.
problem_statement.zh: RDMA 流量對亂序封包到達高度敏感，容易觸發不必要的丟失恢復與速率降低；而現有負載均衡演算法因 RDMA 流量的連續流特性及 flowlet 間隔不足，難以有效分配 RDMA 流量。

key_innovation.en: ConWeave, a load balancing framework that performs fine-grained rerouting and masks out-of-order packet arrivals by using programmable switches to reorder packets in the network datapath.
key_innovation.zh: ConWeave 是一個負載均衡框架，透過可程式化交換機在網路資料路徑中對封包重排序，執行細粒度重路由並屏蔽亂序封包到達。

key_improvements.en: Up to 42.3% improvement in average FCT and 66.8% improvement in 99-percentile FCT compared to state-of-the-art algorithms.
key_improvements.zh: 相較於最先進演算法，平均 FCT 改善最高 42.3%，99 百分位 FCT 改善最高 66.8%。

ai_task: LLM Serving, AI Model Training, Distributed Deep Learning (DDL)
traffic_pattern: RDMA WRITE, Elephant flows, Concurrent flows

title: Forecasting GPU Performance for Deep Learning Training and Inference
authors: Seonho Lee; Amar Phanishayee; Divya Mahajan
venue_full: ACM International Conference on Architectural Support for Programming Languages and Operating Systems (ASPLOS 2025)
research_focus: Performance modeling, Roofline analysis, Capacity planning, Distributed training

problem_statement.en: Access to newer GPUs is limited by long lead times (up to 52 weeks for H100) and high cost, so practitioners need to predict the performance of new or existing DL models on unseen GPUs, for both training and inference, without executing them; prior regression- and MLP-based predictors show high percentage error on unseen models and GPUs.
problem_statement.zh: 新款 GPU 因交期長（H100 可達 52 週）且成本高而難以取得，因此使用者需要在不實際執行的情況下，預測新舊 DL 模型在未見過 GPU 上的訓練與推理效能；既有的迴歸式與 MLP 式預測器在未見過的模型與 GPU 上誤差偏高。

key_innovation.en: NeuSight decomposes each DNN kernel prediction into tile-granularity sub-problems, mirroring how GPU libraries dispatch tiles across SMs: an MLP predicts per-tile utilization (sigmoid-bounded and capped by roofline performance laws) from publicly available GPU specs (memory size/bandwidth, peak FLOPS, SM count, L2 cache size), then wave-based aggregation yields kernel, per-GPU, and single-server distributed latency with analytical network-operator estimates.
key_innovation.zh: NeuSight 仿照 GPU 函式庫將 kernel 切成 tile 並分派至各 SM 的執行方式，把每個 DNN kernel 的延遲預測分解為 tile 粒度的子問題：以 MLP 從公開的 GPU 規格（記憶體容量/頻寬、峰值 FLOPS、SM 數、L2 cache 大小）預測每個 tile 的利用率（經 sigmoid 限制並受 roofline 效能定律約束），再以 wave 為單位聚合出 kernel、單 GPU 以及單一伺服器內分散式執行的延遲（網路運算子以分析式方法估算）。

baselines_compared: Roofline analysis, Habitat, Li et al. (linear regression)

key_improvements.en: Reduces percentage error for GPT3 latency on unseen H100 from 121.4% (MLP-based) and 30.8% (linear regression) to 2.3%; overall 8.9% error on out-of-distribution GPUs (H100, L4, A100-80GB) vs 140% and 60.8% for prior work; 5.4% error for distributed training on 4-GPU servers.
key_improvements.zh: 在未見過的 H100 上預測 GPT3 延遲的誤差由 121.4%（MLP 式）與 30.8%（線性迴歸）降至 2.3%；在 out-of-distribution GPU（H100、L4、A100-80GB）上整體誤差為 8.9%，優於既有工作的 140% 與 60.8%；在 4-GPU 伺服器上的分散式訓練誤差為 5.4%。

compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA H100, NVIDIA A100-80GB, NVIDIA A100-40GB, NVIDIA L4, NVIDIA T4, NVIDIA V100, NVIDIA P100, NVIDIA P4, AMD MI100, AMD MI210, AMD MI250, HBM
gpu_count: 4x H100 (DGX Box), 4x A100-40GB (NVLink) for distributed; 11 GPU models single-device
reported_accuracy: MAPE 2.3% (GPT3 on unseen H100); avg 8.1% on out-of-distribution GPUs (max 28.2%); 7.7% distributed training
models_validated: BERT-Large, GPT2-Large, GPT3-XL, GPT3-2.7B, OPT-1.3B, Switch Transformer
validation_workloads: Synthetic (normal-distribution input tensors; batch sizes 1-16)

scope_assumptions.en: Assumes kernels execute sequentially on the device; distributed support covers data, tensor, and pipeline parallelism on a single multi-GPU server with the parallelism type, width, and schedule provided by the user; multi-node forecasts (up to 3840 nodes) rely on analytical network estimates and are not validated on a real cluster; training dataset collected in FP32 with PyTorch; inference latency for text generation is measured as time to generate the first token (decode/KV cache not modeled).
scope_assumptions.zh: 假設 kernel 在裝置上循序執行；分散式支援涵蓋單一多 GPU 伺服器內的 data、tensor 與 pipeline 平行化，且平行化類型、寬度與 schedule 由使用者提供；多節點預測（最多 3840 節點）依賴分析式網路估算，未在真實叢集上驗證；訓練資料以 PyTorch 在 FP32 精度下蒐集；文字生成的推理延遲以產生第一個 token 的時間衡量（未建模 decode/KV cache）。

title: Nezha: SmartNIC-based Virtual Switch Load Sharing
authors: Xing Li; Enge Song; Bowen Yang; Tian Pan; Ye Yang; Qiang Fu; Yang Song; Yilong Lv; Zikang Chen; Jianyuan Lu; Shize Zhang; Xiaoqing Sun; Rong Wen; Xionglie Wei; Biao Lyu; Zhigang Zong; Qinming He; Shunmin Zhu
venue_full: Conference on Applications, Technologies, Architectures, and Protocols for Computer Communication
affiliations: Zhejiang University, Alibaba Cloud, RMIT University, Hangzhou Feitian Cloud
research_focus: KV cache offloading, Datacenter networking

problem_statement.en: SmartNIC-based virtual switches (vSwitches) suffer from resource bottlenecks (CPU and memory) due to extreme load imbalances, where a few high-demand VMs overwhelm local SmartNICs while most remain underutilized. Existing solutions to offload these demands often require expensive new hardware or complex state synchronization.
problem_statement.zh: 基於 SmartNIC 的虛擬交換機（vSwitch）因負載嚴重不均而面臨 CPU 與記憶體資源瓶頸——少數高需求虛擬機使本地 SmartNIC 不堪負荷，而大多數 SmartNIC 卻閒置低用。現有卸載方案往往需要昂貴的新硬體或複雜的狀態同步機制。

key_innovation.en: Nezha, a distributed vSwitch load sharing system that decouples state from rule/flow tables, offloading stateless tables to a pool of idle remote SmartNICs while maintaining state locally in a single copy to eliminate synchronization overhead.
key_innovation.zh: Nezha 是一個分散式 vSwitch 負載共享系統，將狀態與規則/流表解耦：無狀態表卸載至閒置遠端 SmartNIC 池，而狀態以單一副本保留於本地，從而消除同步開銷。

key_improvements.en: Increased CPS by 3-4.4x, concurrent flows by 5.04-50.4x, and vNIC capacity by over 40x; resolved over 99.9% of vSwitch overloads.
key_improvements.zh: CPS 提升 3–4.4x，並發流數提升 5.04–50.4x，vNIC 容量提升超過 40x；vSwitch 過載問題解決率超過 99.9%。

ai_task: LLM Serving, Cloud Middleboxes (Load Balancer, NAT gateway, Transit Router)

title: Nitsum: Serving Tiered LLM Requests with Adaptive Tensor Parallelism
authors: Vikranth Srivatsa; Zijian He; Pu Guo; Dongming Li; Yiying Zhang
affiliations: University of California San Diego, GenseeAI Inc.
research_focus: LLM serving, Multi-tenant scheduling, PD disaggregation, Continuous batching, Capacity planning

problem_statement.en: Production LLM clusters increasingly multiplex latency-critical interactive traffic with relaxed background workloads under a single fixed GPU budget, creating a tiered-SLO setting in which each request class carries distinct TTFT and TPOT targets. Workload mix, prompt and decode lengths, and load intensity all drift over time, so the per-request service time that determines SLO compliance is itself non-stationary; yet existing SLO-aware serving systems control only when a request runs (queuing, migration, autoscaling) while leaving the execution configuration — tensor-parallel degree, prefill/decode GPU split — fixed at deployment time, which structurally limits how far goodput can be improved.
problem_statement.zh: 生產級 LLM 叢集愈來愈須在固定 GPU 預算之下同時承擔延遲敏感的互動式請求與寬鬆的後台工作負載，形成多 SLO 階層情境，每一階層各有獨立的 TTFT 與 TPOT 目標。工作負載組成、prompt 與 decode 長度、以及負載強度均隨時間漂移，決定 SLO 達成率的單請求服務時間因此本身就是非穩態的；然而既有的 SLO 感知 serving 系統僅控制請求「何時」執行（排隊、遷移、自動擴縮），執行配置（張量並行度、prefill/decode GPU 分配）則在部署時固定，這在結構上限制了 goodput 可改善的上限。

key_innovation.en: Nitsum elevates tensor parallelism (TP) from a static deployment knob to a first-class runtime control surface and jointly optimizes TP level, prefill/decode GPU partition, and SLO-aware request scheduling on a sub-second control window. To make sub-second TP reconfiguration practical, it introduces (i) TP-aware weight reuse — one full weight copy per GPU plus warm pre-launched processes for every candidate TP level, eliminating the ~30 s weight redistribution of conventional TP-switching; and (ii) aggregated and pipelined KV migration with double-buffered coalescing of PagedAttention fragments, reducing migration latency by 245-376x versus cudaMemcpyAsync (3.6-24.8 ms for 0.5-5 GB of KV instead of 0.88-9.25 s).
key_innovation.zh: Nitsum 將張量並行度（TP）由部署時的靜態設定提升為一等公民的執行期控制面，並在不到一秒的控制窗格內同時調整 TP 層級、prefill/decode GPU 切割與 SLO 感知排程。為使次秒級 TP 重配置可行，其引入兩項機制：(i) TP 感知權重重用 — 每張 GPU 持有完整權重一份，並為每個候選 TP 層級預先啟動「保溫」進程，消除傳統 TP 切換約 30 秒的權重重分佈成本；(ii) 聚合且管線化的 KV 遷移 — 以雙緩衝聚合 PagedAttention 分頁碎片，相對 cudaMemcpyAsync 將遷移延遲降低 245-376 倍（0.5-5 GB KV 由 0.88-9.25 秒縮短至 3.6-24.8 毫秒）。

baselines_compared: Llumnix, Chiron, SGLang, SGLang-PD, Split (per-tier static-TP partition)

key_improvements.en: Up to 5.3x higher SLO-compliant goodput than the strongest baseline across A100/H100, 4/8-GPU clusters, Llama-3.1-8B and Qwen-14B, on both Azure production traces and ServeGen (Alibaba-calibrated). Near-linear scaling from 4 to 64 GPUs; baselines need 1.5-4x more GPUs to match. Ablation shows efficient TP switching is necessary — naive dynamic TP with cudaMemcpyAsync collapses goodput to zero.
key_improvements.zh: 在 A100/H100、4/8 GPU 叢集、Llama-3.1-8B 與 Qwen-14B、以及 Azure 生產 trace 與 ServeGen（依 Alibaba 校準）兩種工作負載下，相較最強基準提升至多 5.3 倍的 SLO 合規 goodput；自 4 GPU 擴至 64 GPU 接近線性，基準需 1.5-4 倍 GPU 數方能追平。Ablation 顯示高效 TP 切換是必要前提：以原生 cudaMemcpyAsync 實作的 naive 動態 TP 會使 goodput 崩至零。

ai_task: LLM Serving, Disaggregated Prefill/Decoding
traffic_pattern: Tensor Parallelism, Pipeline Parallelism, Continuous Batching
compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA A100 80GB, NVIDIA H100 80GB, NVIDIA B200 (profiling only)
comm_libraries: NCCL, custom KV-migration kernel (double-buffered pipelined coalesce)
gpu_count: 4x A100, 8x A100, 4x H100, 8x H100; scalability up to 64 GPUs
node_count: Single-node up to 8 GPUs per node; multi-node not reported in detail

source.extraction_notes: End-to-end testbed paper; built atop SGLang. Schema fields drawn from abstract, §1 motivation, §3 architecture, §5 mechanisms, §6 evaluation.

title: Niyama: Breaking the Silos of LLM Inference Serving
authors: Kanishk Goel; Jayashree Mohan; Nipun Kwatra; Ravi Shreyas Anupindi; Ramachandran Ramjee
venue_full: ACM International Conference on Architectural Support for Programming Languages and Operating Systems (ASPLOS 2026); program title alias: QoServe: Breaking the Silos of LLM Inference Serving
research_focus: LLM serving, Multi-tenant scheduling, Continuous batching, Length prediction, Performance modeling

problem_statement.en: Existing LLM serving frameworks rely on siloed infrastructure with coarse interactive-vs-batch segregation, leading to GPU under-utilisation, no fine-grained QoS differentiation, and poor handling of overload — FCFS, SJF/SRPF, and EDF each fail under either low or high load.
problem_statement.zh: 現行 LLM 服務框架以 interactive 與 batch 兩個粗粒度類別做隔離部署，導致 GPU 資源利用率低、無法支援細粒度 QoS 差異化，且在過載時表現不佳：FCFS、SJF/SRPF 與 EDF 等策略在低載或高載下各有失效情境。

key_innovation.en: A QoS-driven serving system combining: (1) dynamic chunking that opportunistically enlarges prefill chunk size by exploiting decode-deadline slack of in-flight requests, with chunk size predicted by a Vidur-profiled random forest; (2) hybrid prioritisation that linearly interpolates EDF and SRPF priorities; (3) eager relegation that proactively moves a small fraction of soon-to-violate requests into a lower-priority relegated queue to prevent cascading deadline failures under overload.
key_innovation.zh: QoS 驅動的服務系統，結合三項機制：(1) dynamic chunking——利用 in-flight 請求 decode 端的 deadline slack 機會性地放大 prefill chunk size，chunk size 由以 Vidur profile 訓練的 random forest 預測；(2) hybrid prioritization——以線性內插結合 EDF 與 SRPF 優先級；(3) eager relegation——在過載前將少數即將違反 deadline 的請求主動轉入 relegated queue，避免 deadline 違反的連鎖效應。

baselines_compared: Sarathi-Silo (SOTA siloed deployment), Sarathi-FCFS, Sarathi-EDF, Sarathi-SRPF

key_improvements.en: Up to 32% higher effective serving capacity over the Sarathi-Silo SOTA siloed deployment while meeting QoS targets; 13-32% fewer A100 GPUs needed across Azure-Code, Azure-Conv, and ShareGPT workloads. Under extreme load, reduces SLO violations by an order of magnitude vs current schedulers. Sustains zero deadline violations up to 30% higher load than Sarathi-EDF.
key_improvements.zh: 在滿足 QoS 目標下，相較 SOTA siloed 部署（Sarathi-Silo）服務容量最高提升 32%；於 Azure-Code、Azure-Conv 與 ShareGPT 三組工作負載下，A100 GPU 需求降低 13-32%。極端過載情境下 SLO 違反率較現行 scheduler 降低一個數量級；可在較 Sarathi-EDF 高出 30% 的負載下維持零 deadline 違反。

gpu_count: 1x A100 (Llama-3-8B), 2x A100 TP2 (Qwen-7B); shared cluster up to 76 GPUs in capacity study
reported_accuracy: Not Reported (random-forest chunk-size predictor; paper reports serving-capacity/SLO-violation metrics rather than predictor MAPE)
validation_workloads: ShareGPT, Azure Conv, Azure Code (Poisson arrivals over the trace prompt/decode token distributions)

scope_assumptions.en: Implemented on top of Sarathi-Serve / vLLM and tied to its chunked-prefill execution model; chunk-size predictor is a random forest trained on Vidur simulator profiles and assumes its accuracy holds in deployment; non-interactive decode length is approximated from per-application history plus two standard deviations; eager relegation assumes a tolerable fraction (about 5%) of requests can be safely degraded; evaluation limited to A100 GPUs and Llama-3-8B / Qwen-7B class models.
scope_assumptions.zh: 實作建構於 Sarathi-Serve / vLLM 之上，緊耦合於其 chunked-prefill 執行模型；chunk size 預測器為以 Vidur 模擬器 profile 訓練的 random forest，假設其在部署時準確度仍成立；非互動式請求的 decode 長度以該應用歷史平均加兩個標準差估計；eager relegation 假設可容忍約 5% 的請求被降級；評估範圍限於 A100 GPU 與 Llama-3-8B / Qwen-7B 級別模型。

title: Not All Bits Are Equal: How Model Scale Changes Memory-Optimal Reasoning
authors: Not Specified
venue_full: The Fourteenth International Conference on Learning Representations
research_focus: Reasoning / Test-time scaling, Quantization, Datacenter networking

problem_statement.en: Reasoning models generate significantly more tokens than non-reasoning models, causing the KV cache to become a dominant memory bottleneck that renders scale-agnostic memory optimization strategies ineffective.
problem_statement.zh: 推理模型（reasoning model）生成的 token 數量遠多於非推理模型，使 KV cache 成為主導性記憶體瓶頸，令與規模無關的記憶體最佳化策略失效。

key_innovation.en: A scale-dependent memory allocation framework for reasoning models that determines the optimal trade-off between model weight precision, effective model size, and KV cache compression (eviction vs. quantization) based on the model's effective size.
key_innovation.zh: 一個針對推理模型的規模相關記憶體分配框架，根據模型的有效規模，在模型權重精度、有效模型大小與 KV cache 壓縮方式（eviction 對比 quantization）之間確定最優取捨。

baselines_compared: vLLM, GPTQ, AWQ, FP8, R-KV, StreamingLLM, HQQ

key_improvements.en: Identified a scale-dependent threshold (8-bit 4B effective size) for memory-optimal strategies; demonstrated that KV cache compression (eviction/quantization) consistently advances the Pareto frontier.
key_improvements.zh: 識別出記憶體最優策略的規模相關閾值（8-bit、4B 有效規模）；並驗證 KV cache 壓縮（eviction/quantization）能穩定推進 Pareto 前沿。

ai_task: LLM Serving, Reasoning, Mathematical Reasoning, Code Generation, Knowledge-intensive Reasoning
traffic_pattern: Serial Scaling, Parallel Scaling, Majority Voting

title: When Less Latent Leads to Better Relay: Information-Preserving Compression for Latent Multi-Agent LLM Collaboration
authors: Yiping Li; Zhiyu An; Wan Du
research_focus: Agentic / Workflow serving, KV cache compression

problem_statement.en: LatentMAS relays each agent's full KV cache to preserve richer inter-agent context, but the resulting memory and communication cost grows rapidly with the number of agents, rounds, and prompt tokens. Single-agent online KV eviction methods do not directly address one-shot compression at an inter-agent relay boundary.
problem_statement.zh: LatentMAS 透過 relay 每個 agent 的完整 KV cache 來保留更豐富的跨 agent context，但其記憶體與通訊成本會隨 agent 數量、round 與 prompt token 數快速成長。面向單一 agent 線上推論的 KV eviction 方法，無法直接處理 agent 間 relay boundary 的一次性壓縮。

key_innovation.en: Orthogonal BackFill (OBF) selects prompt KV positions by accumulated attention from the current latent reasoning states, isolates a low-rank PCA residual of discarded values that is orthogonal to the retained value span, scales it by deleted-versus-retained attention demand, and injects it into all retained values.
key_innovation.zh: Orthogonal BackFill (OBF) 先依 current latent reasoning state 的 accumulated attention 選取 prompt KV position，再抽取相對於 retained value span 正交的 discarded value 低秩 PCA residual，依 deleted-versus-retained attention demand 縮放後注入所有 retained value。

key_improvements.en: With only 9.9%–20.2% of prompt KV states retained, H-OBF achieves 97%–120% of full-KV relay accuracy across nine benchmarks. Using the accuracy-maximizing PCA rank selected per dataset from {2, 4, 8, 16, 32}, H-OBF and L-OBF exceed Full by 1.7 and 1.9 percentage points on average, respectively, with L-OBF reaching a 13.33-point gain on AIME 2024.
key_improvements.zh: 僅保留 9.9%–20.2% 的 prompt KV state 時，H-OBF 在九項 benchmark 上仍達到完整 KV relay accuracy 的 97%–120%。各 dataset 由 {2, 4, 8, 16, 32} 選取 accuracy 最高的 PCA rank 後，H-OBF 與 L-OBF 平均分別較 Full 高 1.7 與 1.9 個百分點；L-OBF 在 AIME 2024 上最高提升 13.33 個百分點。

compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA A100-PCIE-40GB, NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Max-Q Workstation Edition, NVIDIA RTX 6000 Ada Generation
gpu_count: 2x NVIDIA A100-PCIE-40GB per cluster node; 1x NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Max-Q Workstation Edition; 2x NVIDIA RTX 6000 Ada Generation

reuse_metric.en: H-OBF retains 9.9%–20.2% of prompt KV states while delivering 97%–120% of full-KV relay's per-benchmark accuracy across nine benchmarks, using the accuracy-maximizing PCA rank selected separately for each dataset from {2, 4, 8, 16, 32}.
reuse_metric.zh: H-OBF 僅保留 9.9%–20.2% 的 prompt KV state，仍在九項 benchmark 上達到完整 KV relay 每項 accuracy 的 97%–120%；其中各 dataset 分別由 {2, 4, 8, 16, 32} 選取 accuracy 最高的 PCA rank。

title: Observation, Not Prediction: Conversation-Level Disaggregated Scheduling for Agentic Serving
authors: Jianru Ding; Ryien Hosseini; Pouya Mahdi Gholami; Mingyuan Xiang; Henry Hoffmann
research_focus: LLM serving, Agentic / Workflow serving, PD disaggregation, Long-context / Prefix cache, Energy / Carbon, Performance modeling

problem_statement.en: Agentic tasks span many dependent turns whose total cost is unknown at arrival. Existing multi-turn systems keep the turn as the scheduling unit, so deciding whether to disaggregate each turn requires predicting unobservable decode-side quantities (decode length, tool behavior, KV growth), making per-turn placement structurally brittle and misaligned with the conversation-level latency users actually experience.
problem_statement.zh: Agentic 任務由多輪相依的推理與 tool call 組成，抵達時總成本未知。既有多輪系統以 turn 為排程單位，決定是否對每個 turn 解耦合時必須預測不可觀測的 decode 端數值（decode 長度、tool 行為、KV 成長），使逐 turn 放置在結構上脆弱，且與使用者實際感受的 conversation 層級延遲脫節。

key_innovation.en: Raises the scheduling unit from the turn to the conversation, collapsing turn-level irregularity into a stable two-phase structure: a compute-bound turn-1 prefill followed by a memory-bound tail. ConServe routes the first-turn prefill to a high-throughput prefiller, transfers the KV cache exactly once, and pins the conversation to a single decoder for its lifetime, driven only by observable signals (first-turn input length, per-decoder KV occupancy) with no learned decode-cost model; the phase split maps directly onto heterogeneous GPU tiers.
key_innovation.zh: 將排程單位由 turn 提升至 conversation，使逐 turn 的不規則性收斂為穩定的兩階段結構：compute-bound 的首輪 prefill 加上 memory-bound 的長尾。ConServe 將首輪 prefill 路由至高吞吐 prefiller、僅傳輸一次 KV cache，並將 conversation 固定於單一 decoder 直到結束；排程僅依賴可觀測訊號（首輪輸入長度、各 decoder 的 KV 佔用率），完全不需 decode 端成本的學習模型；此階段切分亦可直接映射至異質 GPU 層級。

key_improvements.en: Reduces p95 TTFET by 51.08% and improves energy efficiency by 7.51% vs the per-turn prediction baseline (AMPD) while preserving last-turn TBT and sustaining zero SLO violations at saturation; mapping the two phases onto heterogeneous GPU tiers adds a further 22.75% in tokens-per-joule.
key_improvements.zh: 相較逐 turn 預測式基線（AMPD），p95 TTFET 降低 51.08%、能源效率提升 7.51%，同時維持最後一輪 TBT，並在飽和點維持零 SLO 違規；將兩階段映射至異質 GPU 層級可再提升 22.75% 的 tokens-per-joule。

ai_task: LLM Serving, Disaggregated Prefill/Decoding
reported_accuracy: R² 1.000 (quadratic prefill-latency fit vs input tokens); R² 0.981 (linear KV-transfer latency fit)
validation_workloads: Agentic traces from SWE-bench_bm25_13K with swe-agent (Poisson arrivals 0.5-1.634 conv/s)

scope_assumptions.en: Single 4-GPU node with one prefiller and pinned decoder replicas; decoders are deliberately overprovisioned so the prefiller saturates first, and no decode-side cost is predicted by design. Heterogeneous GPUs are emulated by power-capping A40s to 2/3 TDP, and the AMPD baseline's bidirectional KV transfer is simulated rather than implemented.
scope_assumptions.zh: 單一 4-GPU 節點，一個 prefiller 搭配固定綁定的 decoder 副本；刻意超額配置 decoder 使 prefiller 先飽和，且設計上不預測 decode 端成本。異質 GPU 以將 A40 power cap 至 2/3 TDP 模擬，AMPD 基線的雙向 KV 傳輸以模擬延遲取代實作。

title: Octopus: Scalable Low-Cost CXL Memory Pooling
authors: Daniel S. Berger; Yuhong Zhong; Fiodar Kazhamiaka; Pantea Zardoshti; Shuwei Teng; Mark D. Hill; Rodrigo Fonseca
affiliations: Microsoft Azure, University of Washington, Columbia University, University of Wisconsin-Madison
research_focus: Datacenter networking, Network topology, GPU memory tiering

problem_statement.en: Existing CXL pod designs assume a fully-connected topology, which limits pod size due to the high cost and rarity of multi-port pooling devices. This creates a bottleneck for scaling memory pooling and communication efficiency.
problem_statement.zh: 現有 CXL pod 設計假設全連接拓撲，因多埠 pooling 裝置高昂的成本與稀缺性而限制了 pod 規模，成為記憶體池化擴展與通訊效率的瓶頸。

key_innovation.en: Octopus, a minimally-connected CXL pod topology that uses near-commodity pooling devices with bounded connections, ensuring all host pairs share at least one pooling device while enabling larger, more cost-effective pods.
key_innovation.zh: Octopus 是一種最小連接 CXL pod 拓撲，採用接近商用的有界連接 pooling 裝置，確保所有主機對至少共用一個 pooling 裝置，同時支援更大規模且更具成本效益的 pod。

key_improvements.en: 2.1x reduction in CXL overhead costs, 3.25x reduction in RPC latency compared to RDMA, and memory savings comparable to expensive fully-connected designs.
key_improvements.zh: CXL 額外成本降低 2.1x，RPC 延遲較 RDMA 降低 3.25x，記憶體節省效果與昂貴的全連接設計相當。

network_topology: Minimally-connected Octopus, Redundantly-connected Octopus, 3-rack pod design
ai_task: Dynamic Memory Allocation, Resource Pooling, Distributed Shuffle, RPCs, Distributed Consensus, Broadcast
network_hw: 100 Gbit Mellanox CZ5 NIC, Arista 7060X series switch

title: Parrot: Efficient Serving of LLM-based Applications with Semantic Variable
authors: Chaofan Lin; Zhenhua Han; Chengruidong Zhang; Yuqing Yang; Fan Yang; Chen Chen; Lili Qiu
venue_full: USENIX Symposium on Operating Systems Design and Implementation
research_focus: Long-context / Prefix cache, Agentic / Workflow serving, Multi-tenant scheduling, Continuous batching, Performance modeling, Datacenter networking

problem_statement.en: Existing LLM services are request-centric and lack application-level knowledge, leading to sub-optimal end-to-end performance due to excessive network overhead, misaligned scheduling objectives, and redundant computations. This causes high latency and reduced throughput for complex LLM-based applications.
problem_statement.zh: 現有 LLM 服務以請求為中心，缺乏應用層知識，因而產生過多網路開銷、不一致的 scheduling 目標與冗餘計算，導致複雜 LLM 應用的端到端效能欠佳，延遲偏高且吞吐量受限。

key_innovation.en: Semantic Variable, a unified abstraction that exposes application-level knowledge (prompt structure and request correlations) to the LLM service, enabling data flow analysis, inter-request optimization, and application-centric scheduling.
key_innovation.zh: Semantic Variable 是一種統一抽象，將應用層知識（prompt 結構與請求關聯性）暴露給 LLM 服務，從而實現資料流分析、跨請求最佳化與以應用為中心的 scheduling。

key_improvements.en: Up to 11.7x speedup and 12x higher throughput compared to state-of-the-art solutions.
key_improvements.zh: 相較於最先進方案，速度最高提升 11.7x，吞吐量最高提升 12x。

ai_task: LLM Serving, Data Analytics on Long Documents, Multi-agent Programming, Chat Service
traffic_pattern: Chain-style workflow, Map-Reduce style workflow, Multi-agent conversation
compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA A100 (80GB), NVIDIA A6000 (48GB), AMD EPYC-7V13, AMD EPYC CPU
comm_libraries: FastAPI, PyTorch, Transformers, CUDA, cuDNN, xFormers
reported_accuracy: Not Reported (no MAPE; reports end-to-end speedup against vLLM/FastChat)
models_validated: LLaMA-2-13B, LLaMA-2-7B, Vicuna-13B, CodeLlama, MetaGPT-style workflows
validation_workloads: Synthetic (Map-Reduce summarization, chain-of-thought, multi-agent programming, chat service)

scope_assumptions.en: Workflow DAG must be exposed to the serving layer through Semantic Variables; the scheduler optimizes across requests but does not produce per-request latency *predictions*. Performance model is application-aware but the paper does not publish a closed-form latency calculus for arbitrary workflow graphs.
scope_assumptions.zh: 工作流程 DAG 須透過 Semantic Variable 暴露給服務層；scheduler 跨請求進行最佳化，但並未產生 per-request 的延遲預測。效能模型具備應用感知能力，但論文並未針對任意工作流圖提出 closed-form 的延遲計算式。

title: Act While Thinking: Accelerating LLM Agents via Pattern-Aware Speculative Tool Execution
authors: Yifan Sui; Han Zhao; Rui Ma; Zhiyuan He; Hao Wang; Jianxun Li; Yuqing Yang
affiliations: Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Microsoft Research, Stevens Institute of Technology
research_focus: Agentic / Workflow serving, Speculative decoding, LLM serving, Length prediction

problem_statement.en: LLM agents operate in a strictly serial LLM-tool loop where the LLM waits for external tool execution at every step. Tool execution accounts for 35-61% of total request latency, yet existing agent serving optimizations focus on cold-start mitigation, environment reuse, or general LLM serving and fail to overlap tool execution with LLM generation under data-dependent dynamic workflows.
problem_statement.zh: LLM agent 以嚴格序列的 LLM-tool 迴圈執行，每一步 LLM 都需等待外部工具完成。工具執行佔 request 總延遲 35-61%，但現有 agent serving 優化集中於冷啟動緩解、環境重用或通用 LLM serving，無法在資料依賴的動態 workflow 下將工具執行與 LLM 生成重疊。

key_innovation.en: PASTE introduces Pattern-Aware Speculative Tool Execution built on two abstractions: (i) a Pattern Tuple (C, T, f, p) capturing control-flow context, tool target, late-binding value-mapping function, and confidence — mined via two-phase structural + symbolic dependency inference; (ii) an Opportunistic Speculative Scheduler that strictly partitions authoritative invocations from speculative ones, runs speculation only on transient idle compute/memory/IO slack under a dynamic budget, instantly preempts on contention, and promotes matching speculative jobs to authoritative status when the agent finally requests them.
key_innovation.zh: PASTE 提出 Pattern-Aware Speculative Tool Execution，建立在兩個抽象之上：(i) Pattern Tuple (C, T, f, p)，分別代表控制流上下文、工具目標、延遲綁定的值映射函式與信心度，透過兩階段結構性挖掘與符號式相依推論建構；(ii) Opportunistic Speculative Scheduler，嚴格區分 authoritative invocation 與 speculative invocation，speculative 僅在動態預算下使用瞬時閒置的運算、記憶體與 IO 資源，遇衝突即時搶占，並在 agent 實際請求時將相符的 speculative 任務晉升為 authoritative。

key_improvements.en: Up to 48.5% reduction in average task completion time and 1.8x increase in tool execution throughput. Average end-to-end speedup of 1.25x / 1.32x vs ORION / SpecFaaS; tool latency reduced by up to 55.2% (1.71x/1.83x mean speedup); p95/p99 tail latency reduced up to 46.8% / 61.9%.
key_improvements.zh: 平均任務完成時間最高降低 48.5%，工具執行吞吐量提升 1.8x；相較 ORION 與 SpecFaaS，平均端到端加速 1.25x 與 1.32x；工具延遲最高降低 55.2%（平均加速 1.71x 與 1.83x）；p95 與 p99 尾延遲最高分別降低 46.8% 與 61.9%。

ai_task: LLM Serving, Multi-agent Systems
reported_accuracy: Pattern confidence p mined empirically per pattern (e.g. P1=0.9, P2=0.8); patterns below configurable threshold tau discarded. Aggregate prediction quality reported only via downstream latency/throughput, not as MAPE/accuracy
validation_workloads: DeepResearchBench, SWE-bench, ScholarQA, Azure Functions invocation trace replay

scope_assumptions.en: Operates as middleware between LLM agents and tool execution backends; assumes a per-tool speculation eligibility policy declared by users/operators specifying max_speculation level and deduplication strategy. PASTE never speculates beyond policy bounds and never infers side-effect freedom automatically. Pattern mining requires a corpus of historical tasks; runtime evaluates on disjoint new tasks (no train/test overlap). Authoritative invocations never delayed by speculation through explicit preemption; speculation budget bounds the worst-case resource consumption of mispredictions.
scope_assumptions.zh: PASTE 以 middleware 形式介於 LLM agent 與工具後端之間；假設每個工具具備由使用者或營運者宣告的 speculation eligibility policy，內含 max_speculation 等級與去重策略。PASTE 不會逾越政策進行 speculation，也不會自動推斷副作用自由性。Pattern 挖掘需歷史任務語料庫，運行時則於不重疊的新任務評估。Authoritative invocation 永遠不會因 speculation 被延遲（透過明確搶占機制），speculation 預算則界定誤預測下的最壞資源耗用。

title: PAT: Accelerating LLM Decoding via Prefix-Aware Attention with Resource Efficient Multi-Tile Kernel
authors: Jinjun Yi; Zhixin Zhao; Yitao Hu; Ke Yan; Weiwei Sun; Hao Wang; Laiping Zhao; Yuhao Zhang; Wenxin Li; Keqiu Li
venue_full: ACM International Conference on Architectural Support for Programming Languages and Operating Systems (ASPLOS 2026)
affiliations: Tianjin University; Stevens Institute of Technology
research_focus: LLM serving, Long-context / Prefix cache, Continuous batching, Performance modeling, Hardware co-design

problem_statement.en: Decode attention becomes a dominant memory-bound component as requests reuse large hierarchical prefixes such as system prompts, tools, templates, and RAG context. Query-centric kernels reload shared prefix KV cache repeatedly, while fixed KV-centric tiling wastes on-chip resources when prefix groups and suffix lengths are uneven.
problem_statement.zh: 隨著請求大量重用 system prompts、tools/templates 與 RAG context 等階層式 prefix，decode attention 成為主要 memory-bound 元件。Query-centric kernel 會重複讀取共享 prefix KV cache，而固定 KV-centric tiling 在 prefix group 與 suffix 長度不均時會浪費 on-chip 資源。

key_innovation.en: PAT implements prefix-aware decode attention for vLLM with a pack-forward-merge execution pattern. It packs queries by shared prefix, runs a resource-efficient multi-tile kernel selected for each prefix group, forwards work through multiple CUDA streams and long-KV splitting, then merges partial results with online softmax.
key_innovation.zh: PAT 在 vLLM 中實作 prefix-aware decode attention，採用 pack-forward-merge 執行流程。它依共享 prefix 打包 query，對每個 prefix group 選擇 resource-efficient multi-tile kernel，透過多 CUDA stream 與 long-KV splitting 推進工作，最後用 online softmax 合併部分結果。

baselines_compared: FlashAttention, FlashInfer, FastTree, RelayAttention, RelayAttention++, DeFT, Cascade Inference

key_improvements.en: Reduces attention latency by 53.5% on average and TPOT by 17.0-93.1% under the same configurations against state-of-the-art attention kernels. Kernel-level comparisons report speedups up to 21.5x over FlashAttention and 11.7x over FlashInfer in shared-prefix settings; end-to-end P99 TPOT reductions are reported up to 93.4%.
key_improvements.zh: 在相同設定下，相較 SOTA attention kernels，平均 attention latency 降低 53.5%，TPOT 降低 17.0-93.1%。共享 prefix 設定中，kernel-level 相較 FlashAttention 最高 21.5x、相較 FlashInfer 最高 11.7x；端到端 P99 TPOT 降幅最高 93.4%。

reported_accuracy: Not Reported (kernel/system paper; reports attention latency, TPOT, TTFT, and P99 reductions rather than predictor error)
models_validated: Llama-3-8B, Qwen3-8B, Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct, Qwen3-30B-A3B, Gemma-family head configurations
validation_workloads: Toolagent trace, BurstGPT-derived conversation trace, Synthetic shared-prefix workloads

scope_assumptions.en: PAT targets decode attention when substantial shared prefix structure exists. Benefits depend on the prefix cache hit rate, prefix-group packing quality, and kernel integration with the serving runtime; it does not model prefill scheduling, request admission, or multi-node routing.
scope_assumptions.zh: PAT 主要針對具有大量共享 prefix 結構的 decode attention。收益取決於 prefix cache hit rate、prefix group packing 品質、以及 kernel 與 serving runtime 的整合；它不處理 prefill scheduling、request admission 或 multi-node routing。

title: Patterns behind Chaos: Forecasting Data Movement for Efficient Large-Scale MoE LLM Inference
authors: Zhongkai Yu; Yue Guan; Zihao Yu; Chenyang Zhou; Zhengding Hu; Shuyi Pei; Yangwook Kang; Yufei Ding; Po-An Tsai
affiliations: UCSD, Indiana University Bloomington, Columbia University, Samsung Semiconductor, NVIDIA
research_focus: MoE serving, Multi-tenant scheduling, Continuous batching, Performance modeling, Collective communication, Hardware co-design

problem_statement.en: Random expert selection in 200B-1000B MoE LLMs (DeepSeek-V3, Llama-4-Maverick, Qwen3-235B, Kimi-K2) makes data movement (MoE all-to-all and expert weight transfer) the dominant 60%-90% latency component on multi-GPU and emerging wafer-scale systems. Without a system-agnostic characterization of how expert selections correlate across layers, tokens, prefill/decode and tasks, prefetching/caching/replication strategies remain ad hoc and tied to specific platforms.
problem_statement.zh: 在 200B-1000B 規模的 MoE LLM（DeepSeek-V3、Llama-4-Maverick、Qwen3-235B、Kimi-K2）中，隨機 expert 選擇使資料搬移（MoE all-to-all 與 expert weight 傳輸）成為多 GPU 與新興 wafer-scale 系統上佔據 60%-90% 延遲的主導因素。在缺乏跨層、跨 token、跨 prefill/decode 與跨任務之 expert 選擇關聯的系統無關（system-agnostic）特徵化研究下，prefetching、caching、replication 策略仍各自綁定特定平台。

key_innovation.en: A model-centric, data-movement profiling study of four 2025 SOTA MoE models over 24,000 requests producing 150 GB of expert-selection traces. It distills six insights (layer-level correlation, token-level correlation, prefill-decode correlation, single-expert imbalance, expert-pair affinity, task/language influence) and applies them in two case studies: (i) a wafer-scale GPU two-level data-placement-aware command processor + ATU/PDU hardware extension, and (ii) a prefill-aware expert-placement algorithm for existing 8xH100 GPUs. The forecasting itself is a lightweight ML predictor in the PDU prediction table.
key_innovation.zh: 以 model-centric、資料搬移為核心的剖析研究：對 2025 年四個 SOTA MoE 模型、24,000 筆請求進行系統無關之 profiling，產出 150 GB 的 expert-selection trace，萃取六項洞察（layer 關聯、token 關聯、prefill-decode 關聯、單一 expert 不均衡、expert-pair 共啟動親和、任務與語言影響），並以兩個案例研究應用：(i) 在 wafer-scale GPU 上新增 data-placement-aware command processor 與 ATU/PDU 硬體擴充的二級記憶體管理；(ii) 在既有 8xH100 上採 prefill-aware 的 expert placement 演算法；資料搬移預測本身則以輕量 ML predictor 於 PDU prediction table 實作。

baselines_compared: EP baseline (SGLang), MoE-Lightning, CoServe, Comet, MegaScale-Infer, MoEntwine (placement), Dojo and TSMC SoW (hardware references)

key_improvements.en: 6.6x average MoE throughput speedup on wafer-scale GPUs across four 200B-1000B models with minor hardware modifications; up to 1.25x MoE-layer speedup on existing 8xH100 systems; hop-number reduction up to 277x relative to baseline on wafer-scale; multi-chiplet GPU simulator validated within 5% error against measurements.
key_improvements.zh: 於四個 200B-1000B 模型於 wafer-scale GPU 平均提升 MoE 吞吐量 6.6x（僅需少量硬體修改）；既有 8xH100 系統上 MoE 層加速最高 1.25x；wafer-scale 上 hop 數最高降至基線的 1/277；多 chiplet GPU 模擬器與實機量測誤差控制於 5% 以內。

compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA H100, NVIDIA H200, simulated TSMC SoW wafer (24 dies, 96 HBM dies, 3 TB HBM, H100-like 1000 TFLOPS FP16 per die), simulated Dojo 5x5 2D mesh, Dojo-Enhanced B300-like 4500 TFLOPS variant
gpu_count: 8x H100 DGX (real measurement); 8x H200 AWS instance (real measurement); 5x5 and 8x3 wafer chiplet meshes in simulation
node_count: 1-2 nodes for real measurement; wafer-scale single-package simulated
reported_accuracy: Custom event-driven multi-chiplet simulator validated within 5% error vs. 8xH100 measurements for single-GPU execution and P2P; Spearman ratio >= 0.7 between prefill and decode expert frequencies confirms predictability; quantitative accuracy of the PDU predictor itself is not reported as a single MAPE figure.
validation_workloads: MMLU, MMLU-Pro (Chinese), ChineseSimpleQA, LiveCodeBench (>24,000 requests per model, >2000 GPU-hours of profiling, 150 GB of traces)

scope_assumptions.en: Profiling is system-agnostic and model-centric (insights independent of platform); two case-study evaluations are platform-specific: (a) wafer-scale assumes single-GPU-like programming model with command processor extensions, mesh D2D bandwidth 1.7 TB/s and HBM 3.35 TB/s, LLC 64 MB, 10% DRAM reserved for system overhead; (b) existing-GPU case study covers only the decode stage MoE layer throughput. Custom Python event-driven simulator does not model microarchitecture in detail; calibrated against 8xH100. Predictor implementation details (size, training cost) are not reported in the main text.
scope_assumptions.zh: Profiling 為系統無關且 model-centric（洞察獨立於平台）；兩個案例評估則屬平台特定：(a) wafer-scale 假設採用 single-GPU-like 程式模型加上 command processor 擴充，mesh D2D 頻寬 1.7 TB/s、HBM 3.35 TB/s，LLC 64 MB，DRAM 保留 10% 給系統開銷；(b) 既有 GPU 案例僅涵蓋 decode 階段 MoE 層吞吐量。自製 Python event-driven simulator 不細緻建模 microarchitecture，已以 8xH100 校正。predictor 的實作細節（規模、訓練成本）主文未具體說明。

title: Efficient Serving for Dynamic Agent Workflows with Prediction-based KV-Cache Management
authors: Haoyu Zheng; Fangcheng Fu; Jia Wu; Binhang Yuan; Yongqiang Zhang; Hao Wang; Yuanyuan Zhu; Xiao Yan; Jiawei Jiang
affiliations: Wuhan University, Dameng Database, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Macquarie University, HKUST
research_focus: Agentic / Workflow serving, Long-context / Prefix cache, KV cache offloading, Multi-tenant scheduling, Length prediction

problem_statement.en: LLM-based agent workflows share substantial context that enables KV-cache reuse, but existing managers either work at agent-level (ignoring workflow reuse) or assume static workflow call graphs. Real workflows are dynamic and runtime-dependent, so KV-cache management must shift from assuming the future to predicting it under inherent prediction error.
problem_statement.zh: 基於 LLM 的 agent workflow 之間共享大量 context，提供 KV cache 重用契機；然而現有管理機制要麼在 agent 層級運作而忽略 workflow 層次的重用，要麼假設 workflow 呼叫圖為靜態。實際 workflow 呈現動態且依賴 runtime 結果，因此 KV cache 管理必須由「假設未來」轉為「在不可避免的預測誤差下預測未來」。

key_innovation.en: PBKV introduces a prediction-based KV-cache management framework with three components: (i) a multi-signal GraphSAGE predictor that fuses graph-level transition patterns with per-request prefill embeddings and forecasts the next K agent invocations; (ii) hierarchical eviction that reclaims retired cache first and then ranks active cache via a K-step lookahead Value(c) score aggregated across workflows; (iii) conservative prefetching restricted to idle GPU space and idle PCIe bandwidth so prefetching never displaces valuable cache. PBKV is proven Lipschitz-continuous in prediction error.
key_innovation.zh: PBKV 提出基於預測的 KV cache 管理框架，包含三個組件：(i) 多訊號 GraphSAGE 預測器，融合全域呼叫圖的轉移模式與請求層級 prefill embedding，輸出未來 K 步 agent invocation 機率；(ii) 階層式 eviction，先回收已終止 workflow 的 retired cache，再以跨 workflow 聚合之 K 步 lookahead Value(c) 分數排序 active cache；(iii) 保守式 prefetching，僅在閒置 GPU 空間與閒置 PCIe 頻寬上執行，確保 prefetch 不會排擠高價值 cache。論文證明 PBKV 對預測誤差具備 Lipschitz 連續的退化保證。

key_improvements.en: On dynamic workflows: up to 1.85x lower workflow latency and up to 2.55x higher KV-Cache hit rate over LRU; on static workflows up to 1.26x latency and 1.39x hit rate over KVFlow. Lifecycle-aware eviction alone gives up to 1.66x hit-rate gain over LRU.
key_improvements.zh: 在動態 workflow 上：相較 LRU，workflow 延遲最高降低 1.85x、KV cache 命中率最高提升 2.55x；在靜態 workflow 上，相較 KVFlow 延遲與命中率分別提升 1.26x 與 1.39x。單獨啟用 lifecycle-aware eviction 即可較 LRU 提升 1.66x 命中率。

ai_task: LLM Serving, Multi-agent Systems, AI Inference KV Cache transfer
reported_accuracy: 1-step accuracy 0.94, 3-step accuracy 0.77 on HoVer dataset (GraphSAGE backbone, 1K training traces)
validation_workloads: HoVer + LangChain (fact verification), SWE-bench + AutoGen (code generation), FinanceBench + CrewAI (document analysis)

scope_assumptions.en: Predictor must be trained on a workload-specific trace set (~1K traces); cache-reuse indicator A_w(c) assumes a basic per-agent access model that may need customization when frameworks specify cache inheritance between agents; conservative prefetching only activates on pure-decode batches (>90% of measurements); per-invocation predictor latency overhead ~1.56 ms is treated as negligible relative to LLM inference.
scope_assumptions.zh: 預測器需針對特定 workload 訓練（約 1K 條 trace）；cache 重用指標 A_w(c) 採用基本的 per-agent 存取假設，若 framework 規定 agent 間 cache 繼承關係則需客製化；保守式 prefetching 僅在純 decode batch（量測中 >90%）下啟用；每次 invocation 的預測器額外耗時約 1.56 ms，相較 LLM 推論被視為可忽略。

title: Stateful Large Language Model Serving with Pensieve
authors: Lingfan Yu; Jinkun Lin; Jinyang Li
venue_full: Twentieth European Conference on Computer Systems (EuroSys '25)
research_focus: LLM serving, KV cache offloading, GPU memory tiering, Continuous batching

problem_statement.en: Existing LLM serving systems are stateless across requests: in multi-turn conversations the growing dialogue history is re-prefetched and recomputed with every request, so prefill cost of redundant history processing soon outgrows generation cost.
problem_statement.zh: 既有 LLM 服務系統在請求之間為 stateless：多輪對話中不斷成長的歷史必須隨每個請求重新作為 prompt 處理，重複的 prefill 計算成本很快超過 generation 本身。
