key_innovation.en: Stateful serving with a two-tier GPU-CPU KV cache for conversation state: chunk-granularity (32-token) eviction ranked by retention value V = recompute-cost / inactive-time (preferring to evict leading tokens, which are cheaper to recompute), ahead-of-time swap-out with pipelined layer-by-layer swap-in, recomputation for dropped tokens, and a new multi-token attention kernel (generalized PagedAttention) that runs prefill over non-contiguous KV cache and unifies prefill and generation batching.
key_innovation.zh: 以雙層 GPU-CPU KV cache 保存對話狀態的 stateful serving：以 32-token chunk 為粒度、依 retention value V =（重算成本 / 閒置時間）排序逐出（偏好逐出重算較便宜的開頭 token），ahead-of-time 換出搭配逐層 pipeline 換入，被丟棄的 token 以重算補回；並提出新的 multi-token attention kernel（廣義化 PagedAttention），使 prefill 可直接在非連續 KV cache 上執行，進而統一 prefill 與 generation 的批次排程。

key_improvements.en: 1.14-3.0x throughput of vLLM and TensorRT-LLM: 1.36x/1.14x (OPT-13B, ShareGPT) and 1.70x/1.58x (Llama 2-13B) on one GPU; 2.04x/1.64x (OPT-66B) and 3.0x/2.47x (Llama 2-70B) on four GPUs; recompute-aware eviction beats LRU by up to 4.4 pp CPU-cache hit rate, cutting recomputed KV-tokens by up to 14.6%.
key_improvements.zh: 吞吐量為 vLLM 與 TensorRT-LLM 的 1.14-3.0x：單 GPU 上 OPT-13B（ShareGPT）為 1.36x/1.14x、Llama 2-13B 為 1.70x/1.58x；四 GPU 上 OPT-66B 為 2.04x/1.64x、Llama 2-70B 為 3.0x/2.47x；重算成本感知的逐出策略較 LRU 提升最多 4.4 個百分點的 CPU cache 命中率，重算 KV-token 數最多減少 14.6%。

ai_task: LLM Serving, AI Inference KV Cache transfer
offload_trigger: GPU memory pressure: when free GPU slots fall below a threshold, chunks are evicted to CPU DRAM (with ahead-of-time swap-out preparing candidates); a second drop trigger applies the same ranking when the CPU tier fills.
prefetch_signal_timing: Reactive layer-wise restore: pipelined layer-by-layer swap-in when the conversation resumes, with host-to-GPU transfers prioritized over swap-out (simultaneous duplex PCIe transfers measured to cut each direction's throughput by 18-20%).
costs_modeled: PCIe bandwidth, host DRAM capacity, GPU FLOPs recompute, transfer-vs-recompute crossover
agent_awareness: Multi-turn conversation (session recency): eviction value combines recompute cost with inactive time; no tool semantics or workflow graph.

when_to_offload_rule.en: When free GPU slots fall below a threshold, evict the 32-token chunks with the lowest retention value V = recompute-cost / inactive-time (preferring leading tokens, which are cheaper to recompute); apply the same rule to drop when CPU DRAM fills.
when_to_offload_rule.zh: 當 GPU 可用槽位低於門檻時，逐出保留價值 V =（重算成本/閒置時間）最低的 32-token chunks（優先逐出重算成本較低的前導 token）；CPU DRAM 滿載時依同一規則丟棄。

title: PERKS: a Locality-Optimized Execution Model for Iterative Memory-bound GPU Applications
authors: Lingqi Zhang; Mohamed Wahib; Peng Chen; Jintao Meng; Xiao Wang; Toshio Endo; Satoshi Matsuoka
affiliations: Tokyo Institute of Technology, RIKEN Center for Computational Science, AIST, Shenzhen Institutes of Advanced Technology (CAS), Oak Ridge National Laboratory
research_focus: Roofline analysis, Performance modeling, Hardware co-design, GPU memory tiering

problem_statement.en: Iterative memory-bound GPU solvers (stencils, Krylov/CG) are bottlenecked by repeated round-trips to device memory: the standard pattern launches one kernel per time step, so every iteration writes the full output back to global memory and reads it again next step, wasting the kernel-launch/barrier overhead and saturating HBM bandwidth even though much of the working set could stay on-chip across iterations.
problem_statement.zh: 迭代式且受記憶體頻寬限制的 GPU 解算器（stencil、Krylov/CG）的瓶頸在於對 device memory 的反覆往返：標準作法是每個時間步啟動一個 kernel，因此每次迭代都把完整輸出寫回 global memory、下一步再讀回，浪費了 kernel 啟動與 barrier 開銷，並把 HBM 頻寬打滿——即使大部分工作集其實可以跨迭代留在晶片上。

key_innovation.en: PERKS (PERsistent KernelS): move the time loop *inside* a single persistent kernel that spans the whole device and uses grid-wide (cooperative-groups) barriers for inter-iteration synchronization instead of relaunching. The freed-up on-chip capacity — leftover registers and shared memory not needed for peak occupancy — is then used to cache a subset of each step's output across iterations, cutting device-memory traffic. The scheme is solver-agnostic and orthogonal to the solver's own kernel math.
key_innovation.zh: PERKS（PERsistent KernelS）：把時間迴圈搬進單一、橫跨整個 device 的 persistent kernel，以 grid 層級（cooperative-groups）barrier 做跨迭代同步，取代反覆重啟 kernel。接著把省下來的晶片內容量——達到尖峰 occupancy 後仍有餘裕的 register 與 shared memory——用來跨迭代快取每一步輸出的子集，藉此削減 device memory 流量。此機制與解算器無關，且與解算器本身的 kernel 數學正交。

reported_accuracy: Not Reported (this is an execution model + roofline analysis, not a latency-prediction model; speedups are measured, not predicted)
validation_workloads: 2D/3D iterative stencils (Jacobi etc.), Krylov-subspace Conjugate Gradient over SuiteSparse SpMV matrices

scope_assumptions.en: Targets iterative memory-bound (bandwidth-bound, not compute-bound) kernels whose working set does not need all registers/shared memory for peak performance; reuse capacity is bounded by leftover on-chip SRAM, so problems must fit (or be tiled to fit) the cacheable subset. Relies on grid-wide cooperative-group barriers (persistent grid must fit on one device). Single-GPU; no multi-GPU/TP. Crucially, the authors evaluated using the A100 hardware L2-residency control (cudaAccessPolicyWindow / persisting L2) as the reuse mechanism instead of registers+shared memory and measured roughly an 8% slowdown — i.e. explicit L2 residency was WORSE than their on-chip register/shared-memory caching, so L2 reuse is deliberately NOT the mechanism PERKS relies on.
scope_assumptions.zh: 鎖定迭代且受記憶體頻寬限制（bandwidth-bound 而非 compute-bound）的 kernel，其工作集不需要用盡所有 register/shared memory 即可達到尖峰效能；可重用容量受限於剩餘的晶片內 SRAM，因此問題必須能放進（或經 tiling 放進）可快取的子集。依賴 grid 層級 cooperative-group barrier（persistent grid 必須容納於單一 device）。為單 GPU，無多 GPU/TP。關鍵在於：作者曾改用 A100 硬體 L2 residency 控制（cudaAccessPolicyWindow / persisting L2）作為重用機制以取代 register+shared memory，量測到約 8% 的「變慢」——亦即顯式 L2 residency 比他們的晶片內 register/shared-memory 快取更差，因此 L2 reuse 刻意地並非 PERKS 所依賴的機制。

baselines_compared: AN5D / state-of-the-art stencil libraries, NVIDIA cuSPARSE-based CG (state-of-the-art Krylov/SpMV library), standard host-side iterative kernel-relaunch baseline

key_improvements.en: Geomean speedup 2.12x for 2D stencils and 1.24x for 3D stencils over state-of-the-art stencil libraries; for Conjugate Gradient, 4.86x geomean on smaller SuiteSparse SpMV datasets and 1.43x on larger datasets over a state-of-the-art library. Gains come from caching per-iteration output in leftover registers + shared memory to cut HBM traffic. Reuse/cache placement is central to the contribution, but the reuse tier is on-chip SRAM (registers + shared memory), NOT the L2 cache: the authors explicitly tried A100 L2 residency control as the caching mechanism and observed ~8% slowdown, confirming inter-kernel L2 reuse is not the effective lever here.
key_improvements.zh: 相較最先進的 stencil 函式庫，2D stencil 取得幾何平均 2.12x、3D stencil 1.24x 的加速；在 Conjugate Gradient 上，較最先進函式庫於較小的 SuiteSparse SpMV 資料集達 4.86x 幾何平均、較大資料集達 1.43x。加速來自把每次迭代的輸出快取在剩餘的 register 與 shared memory，以削減 HBM 流量。重用／快取放置是貢獻的核心，但重用層級是晶片內 SRAM（register + shared memory），而非 L2 cache：作者明確嘗試以 A100 L2 residency 控制作為快取機制，卻量到約 8% 的變慢，證實跨 kernel 的 L2 reuse 在此並非有效槓桿。

source.notes: L2-reuse relevance: reuse/caching across iterations is the entire mechanism, but the authors deliberately use on-chip registers+shared memory, NOT L2 residency; an explicit A100 L2-residency experiment gave ~8% slowdown.

title: PipeWeave: Synergizing Analytical and Learning Models for Unified GPU Performance Prediction
authors: Kaixuan Zhang; Yunfan Cui; Shuhao Zhang; Chutong Ding; Shiyou Qian; Luping Wang; Jian Cao; Guangtao Xue; Cheng Huang; Guodong Yang; Liping Zhang
venue_full: International Symposium on Computer Architecture (accepted, ISCA 2026)
affiliations: Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Alibaba Group
research_focus: LLM serving, MoE serving, Performance modeling, Roofline analysis, Hardware co-design

problem_statement.en: Existing GPU performance models cannot be simultaneously fast, accurate, and generalizable: cycle-accurate simulators are too slow, analytical models are labor-intensive with limited accuracy, and data-driven methods generalize poorly across hardware and inadequately model complex production fused kernels (e.g., FlashAttention, Fused MoE), hindering next-generation hardware selection and system-level exploration.
problem_statement.zh: 現有 GPU 效能模型難以同時兼顧速度、精度與泛化能力：cycle-accurate 模擬器過慢，解析式模型費工且精度有限，資料驅動方法跨硬體泛化不佳，也無法妥善建模生產環境常見的複雜 fused kernel（如 FlashAttention、Fused MoE），阻礙次世代硬體選型與系統層級探索。

key_innovation.en: A grey-box framework that weaves pipeline-level analysis into ML prediction: a Kernel Decomposer breaks each kernel into schedulable tasks, a Scheduling Simulator maps tasks onto SMs (covering both hardware round-robin and software persistent-kernel schedulers), a Feature Analyzer extends the Roofline model into multi-dimensional per-pipeline (Tensor/FMA/XU/MIO) demand and theoretical-cycle features, and a lightweight per-kernel MLP predicts execution efficiency; a P80 quantile-loss variant estimates a Potential Performance Ceiling for optimization guidance.
key_innovation.zh: 將 pipeline 層級分析織入 ML 預測的 grey-box 框架：Kernel Decomposer 將 kernel 拆解為可排程的 task，Scheduling Simulator 模擬 task 到 SM 的映射（涵蓋硬體 round-robin 與軟體 persistent-kernel 兩種排程機制），Feature Analyzer 將 Roofline 模型擴展為多維度、逐 pipeline（Tensor/FMA/XU/MIO）的 demand 與理論 cycle 特徵，最後由輕量級的 per-kernel MLP 預測執行效率；並以 P80 quantile loss 變體估計「潛在效能上限」，提供優化指引。

baselines_compared: Roofline, Linear regression, Habitat, Neusight, AMALI, LLMCompass

key_improvements.en: 6.1% average kernel-level error (11.4% on unseen GPUs) and 8.5% end-to-end inference error, reducing SOTA (Neusight) error by 6.7x and 4.4x respectively; versus detailed simulators AMALI and LLMCompass, lower GEMM error (MAPE 6.4% vs 28.3%/29.7%) with 3-7 orders of magnitude less prediction time; P80-ceiling-guided tuning of SGLang's production Fused MoE Triton kernel achieves up to 1.7x speedup.
key_improvements.zh: kernel 層級平均誤差 6.1%（未見過的 GPU 上為 11.4%），端到端推理誤差 8.5%，分別將 SOTA（Neusight）誤差降低 6.7x 與 4.4x；相較 AMALI 與 LLMCompass 等精細模擬器，GEMM 誤差更低（MAPE 6.4% vs 28.3%/29.7%）且預測時間減少 3–7 個數量級；以 P80 效能上限指引調校 SGLang 生產環境的 Fused MoE Triton kernel，最高獲得 1.7x 加速。

compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA A40, NVIDIA A100, NVIDIA RTX 6000 Ada, NVIDIA L20, NVIDIA H20, NVIDIA H800, NVIDIA RTX A6000, NVIDIA L40, NVIDIA H100, NVIDIA H200, NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000
gpu_count: 11 GPU types (6 seen for training, 5 unseen for testing)
reported_accuracy: Kernel MAPE 6.1% seen / 11.4% unseen; E2E MAPE 8.5% seen / 10.7% unseen
validation_workloads: Synthetic (~1M profiled kernel samples), ArXiv-Summarization, Splitwise trace

scope_assumptions.en: E2E prediction assumes sequential kernel execution without overlap (following prior work); communication kernels (All-Reduce, Send/Recv) are modeled by a simplified data-driven regression (Random Forest) over a profiled baseline database rather than the analytical pipeline; contextualized within NVIDIA GPU architectures (Ampere through Blackwell); multi-node clusters and Expert Parallelism (EP) are left to future work; a separate MLP is trained per kernel category, requiring cross-GPU profiling data.
scope_assumptions.zh: 端到端預測假設 kernel 依序執行、無重疊（沿用先前研究的假設）；通訊 kernel（All-Reduce、Send/Recv）以 profiled 基準資料庫上的簡化資料驅動迴歸（Random Forest）建模，而非解析式 pipeline 分析；討論範疇限定於 NVIDIA GPU 架構（Ampere 至 Blackwell）；多節點叢集與 Expert Parallelism (EP) 留待未來工作；每類 kernel 需各自訓練一個 MLP，仰賴跨 GPU 的 profiling 資料。

title: PLB: congestion signals are simple and effective for network load balancing
authors: Mubashir Adnan Qureshi; Yuchung Cheng; Qianwen Yin; Qiaobin Fu; Gautam Kumar; Masoud Moshref; Junhua Yan; Van Jacobson; David Wetherall; Abdul Kabbani
venue_full: Conference on Applications, Technologies, Architectures, and Protocols for Computer Communication
research_focus: Datacenter networking, RDMA / Transport, Routing / Load balancing

problem_statement.en: Datacenter networks suffer from congestion hotspots caused by ECMP/WCMP hashing, which ignores flow sizes and leads to uneven link utilization and increased tail latency.
problem_statement.zh: 資料中心網路因 ECMP/WCMP 雜湊忽略流量大小而產生壅塞熱點，導致鏈路利用率不均與尾延遲上升。

key_innovation.en: PLB (Protective Load Balancing) is a host-based design that uses the IPv6 Flow Label to dynamically repath congested connections, leveraging existing transport-layer congestion signals to minimize reordering.
key_innovation.zh: PLB（Protective Load Balancing）是一種基於主機的設計，利用 IPv6 Flow Label 對壅塞連線動態重新路由，並借助現有傳輸層壅塞訊號以最小化重排序。

key_improvements.en: 60% reduction in median utilization imbalance, 33% reduction in packet drops, 20% reduction in tail latency (99p) for small RPCs.
key_improvements.zh: 中位數利用率不均降低 60%，封包丟失減少 33%，小型 RPC 尾延遲（99p）降低 20%。

ai_task: LLM Serving, Distributed Deep Learning (DDL), RAG, AI Inference KV Cache transfer
traffic_pattern: All-to-All, Incast, Elephant flows, Concurrent flows

title: Predicting LLM Output Length via Entropy-Guided Representations
authors: Huanyi Xie; Yubin Chen; Liangyu Wang; Lijie Hu; Di Wang
affiliations: King Abdullah University of Science and Technology, Provable Responsible AI and Data Analytics Lab, Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence
research_focus: Long-context / Prefix cache, Reasoning / Test-time scaling, Multi-tenant scheduling, Continuous batching, Length prediction, Performance modeling

problem_statement.en: Auxiliary length predictors (DistilBERT, OPT, etc.) attached to LLM serving stacks suffer three flaws: stochastic one-to-many generation makes any static estimate unreliable, especially in RL sampling; predictors trained on LMSYS-style data generalise poorly to long-sequence, CoT, and RL workloads; and running a separate predictor per request adds non-negligible computational and deployment cost on top of the served LLM.
problem_statement.zh: 外掛在 LLM serving stack 上的輔助長度預測器（DistilBERT、OPT 等）存在三個問題：generation 本身的隨機 one-to-many 特性使任何靜態估計都不可靠，在 RL sampling 中尤其明顯；以 LMSYS 風格資料訓練的預測器難以推廣至 long-sequence、CoT 與 RL 等任務；以及對每個請求另外執行一個預測器，在 serving LLM 之外帶來不可忽視的運算與部署成本。

key_innovation.en: Two reuse-the-LLM components: (1) EGTP (Entropy-Guided Token Pooling) aggregates the served LLM's hidden states {h_1,...,h_n} into one feature vector by softmax-weighting them by per-token entropy H_i = -sum_v P(v|x_<i) log P(v|x_<i), then trains a length head with a joint cross-entropy + MSE loss over K = 20 soft-label bins; (2) PLP (Progressive Length Prediction) reapplies the same head at each decode step with input z_t = Aggregate(h, {h'_1,...,h'_t}) to update the predicted remaining length online for RL-style stochastic sampling.
key_innovation.zh: 提出兩個重用 serving LLM 自身的元件：(1) EGTP（Entropy-Guided Token Pooling）將 serving LLM 的 hidden states {h_1,...,h_n} 以 per-token 熵 H_i = -sum_v P(v|x_<i) log P(v|x_<i) 經 softmax 加權聚合為單一特徵向量，並以 K = 20 個 soft-label bin 上的 cross-entropy 加 MSE 聯合損失訓練長度 head；(2) PLP（Progressive Length Prediction）於每個 decoding step 重用同一 head，輸入 z_t = Aggregate(h, {h'_1,...,h'_t}) 線上更新剩餘長度預測，特別適用於 RL 風格的隨機 sampling。

baselines_compared: SSJF-Reg, SSJF-MC, S^3, PiA, TPV, TRAIL, LTR-C

key_improvements.en: EGTP reduces average MAE by 29.16% over the strongest baseline (TRAIL) and 55.09% over SSJF-Reg on ForeLen. On Qwen2.5-3B average MAE drops from 132.20 (TRAIL) to 110.75; on Llama3.2-3B from 143.62 (TRAIL) to 101.53. End-to-end with EGTP + length-aware SJF on vLLM: padding ratio reduced to 0.18 on Long Sequence (vs 0.51 for TRAIL) and 0.09 on Reasoning, with Avg JCT cut from 9.45s to 4.20s on Long Sequence.
key_improvements.zh: EGTP 在 ForeLen 上將平均 MAE 較最強 baseline（TRAIL）降低 29.16%、較 SSJF-Reg 降低 55.09%。Qwen2.5-3B 平均 MAE 從 TRAIL 的 132.20 降到 110.75；Llama3.2-3B 從 143.62 降到 101.53。整合 EGTP 與 length-aware SJF 於 vLLM 之端到端結果：Long Sequence 的 padding ratio 從 TRAIL 的 0.51 降到 0.18、Reasoning 降到 0.09；Long Sequence 的 Avg JCT 從 9.45s 縮短至 4.20s。

reported_accuracy: Average MAE 110.75 (Qwen2.5-3B), 103.47 (Qwen2.5-7B), 105.08 (Llama3.2-1B), 101.53 (Llama3.2-3B) on ForeLen; 87.32 (GPT-4) and 68.33 (Claude-2) on LMSYS
models_validated: Qwen2.5-0.5B, Qwen2.5-1.5B, Qwen2.5-3B, Qwen2.5-7B, Llama3.2-1B, Llama3.2-3B, DeepSeek-R1-Distill Qwen series, GPT-4, Claude-2
validation_workloads: ForeLen (constructed: LongBench, Zero-SCROLLS, IFEval for long-seq; CRUXEval, GSM8K, LiveCodeBench, MATH, MBPP, MMLU-STEM for reasoning; GRPO training data for RL), LMSYS

scope_assumptions.en: Predictor must run inside the served LLM's pipeline to reuse hidden states, so it presumes co-location with the serving stack (validated on vLLM). PLP is designed for stochastic one-to-many sampling such as GRPO; for purely static prompts the static EGTP path is sufficient. Length target discretised into K = 20 bins; lambda = 0.95 in the joint loss; training caps at 10 epochs with AdamW (learning rate 2e-5). Hyperparameters for baselines follow their original papers.
scope_assumptions.zh: 預測器必須在 serving LLM 的 pipeline 內執行以重用 hidden states，因此預設與 serving stack 同部署（論文以 vLLM 驗證）。PLP 主要針對 GRPO 等隨機 one-to-many 採樣設計；單純靜態 prompt 場景只需 EGTP 路徑即可。長度目標離散為 K = 20 個 bin、聯合損失 lambda = 0.95，訓練最多 10 個 epoch、AdamW（learning rate 2e-5）。Baseline 之超參數遵循各自原始論文。

title: PolyKV: A Shared Asymmetrically-Compressed KV Cache Pool for Multi-Agent LLM Inference
authors: Ishan Patel; Ishan Joshi
research_focus: LLM serving, Long-context / Prefix cache, Agentic / Workflow serving, KV cache compression, Quantization

problem_statement.en: Multi-agent LLM inference conventionally allocates a separate full-precision KV cache for every agent, causing memory use to scale linearly even when all agents process the same document context. Existing KV compression and multi-agent cache sharing approaches address these costs separately.
problem_statement.zh: 多 agent LLM inference 通常為每個 agent 配置獨立的全精度 KV cache；即使所有 agent 處理相同文件 context，記憶體用量仍隨 agent 數量線性增長。既有 KV compression 與多 agent cache sharing 方法僅分別處理這兩類成本。

key_innovation.en: PolyKV introduces a write-once, read-many SharedKVPool that stores one asymmetrically compressed cache and injects it into independent HuggingFace DynamicCache instances. Keys use q8_0 int8 quantization, while Values use FWHT rotation followed by 3-bit Lloyd-Max quantization.
key_innovation.zh: PolyKV 提出 write-once、read-many 的 SharedKVPool，僅儲存一份非對稱壓縮 cache，並將其注入各 agent 的獨立 HuggingFace DynamicCache。Key 採用 q8_0 int8 quantization，Value 則採用 FWHT rotation 與後續的 3-bit Lloyd-Max quantization。

key_improvements.en: PolyKV maintains a 2.91x compression ratio across all configurations. With 15 agents and a 7,194-token Llama-3-8B context, it reduces KV cache memory from 19.798 GB to 0.454 GB (97.7%) while limiting perplexity degradation to +0.57% and retaining a mean BERTScore F1 of 0.928.
key_improvements.zh: PolyKV 在所有實驗設定中皆維持 2.91x compression ratio。於 15 個 agent 共享 7,194-token Llama-3-8B context 時，KV cache 記憶體由 19.798 GB 降至 0.454 GB（減少 97.7%），perplexity 僅劣化 +0.57%，mean BERTScore F1 仍達 0.928。

reuse_metric.en: A single 2.91x-compressed pool is shared by up to 15 concurrent agents; at 15 agents it saves 97.7% of KV cache memory with +0.57% perplexity degradation and 0.928 mean BERTScore F1.
reuse_metric.zh: 單一 2.91x 壓縮 pool 可由最多 15 個並行 agent 共享；於 15 個 agent 設定下可節省 97.7% 的 KV cache 記憶體，perplexity 劣化為 +0.57%，mean BERTScore F1 為 0.928。

title: PREBLE: EFFICIENT DISTRIBUTED PROMPT SCHEDULING FOR LLM SERVING
authors: Vikranth Srivatsa; Zijian He; Reyna Abhyankar; Dongming Li; Yiying Zhang
affiliations: University of California, San Diego, GenseeAI Inc.
research_focus: Multi-tenant scheduling, LoRA / Multi-adapter, Datacenter networking

problem_statement.en: Existing LLM serving systems are not prompt-cache-aware in distributed environments, leading to inefficient KV computation and load imbalance when requests with shared prefixes are distributed across different GPUs.
problem_statement.zh: 現有的 LLM 服務系統在分散式環境中缺乏對 prompt cache 的感知，導致具有共享前綴的 request 被分散到不同 GPU 時，KV 計算效率低落且負載失衡。

key_innovation.en: Preble, a distributed LLM serving platform featuring the E2 (Exploitation + Exploration) scheduling algorithm that co-optimizes KV state reuse and computation load-balancing through a hierarchical scheduling mechanism.
key_innovation.zh: Preble 是一個分散式 LLM 服務平台，其核心為 E2（Exploitation + Exploration）scheduling 演算法，藉由階層式排程機制同步最佳化 KV 狀態重用與計算負載均衡。

key_improvements.en: 1.5x to 14.5x improvement in average latency and 2x to 10x improvement in p99 latency compared to SGLang.
key_improvements.zh: 相較於 SGLang，平均 latency 提升 1.5x 至 14.5x，p99 latency 提升 2x 至 10x。

ai_task: LLM Serving, Tool Calling, Embodied Agents, Code Generation, Video QA, Long Document QA

title: Predictive Scheduling for Efficient Inference-Time Reasoning in Large Language Models
authors: Katrina Brown; Aneesh Muppidi; Rana Shahout
research_focus: Reasoning / Test-time scaling, Multi-tenant scheduling, Continuous batching, LoRA / Multi-adapter, Performance modeling

problem_statement.en: Chain-of-thought reasoning under a fixed per-query token budget over-spends on easy queries and starves hard ones, inflating latency and cost. Prior schedulers rely on surface-level signals (queue length, past runtimes) or single-checkpoint early-termination, missing a pre-run estimate of the reasoning length each query actually needs.
problem_statement.zh: chain-of-thought 推理在固定每筆查詢 token budget 下會在簡單問題上過度計算、在困難問題上計算不足，造成延遲與成本上升。先前的 scheduler 仰賴表層訊號（佇列長度、過往執行時間）或單一檢查點 early-termination，缺少在生成前估計各查詢所需推理長度的能力。

key_innovation.en: Predictive Scheduling: lightweight pre-run predictors built on intermediate transformer hidden states (an MLP per layer) or a LoRA-fine-tuned classifier on raw question text, which estimate each query's optimal reasoning length or difficulty class before generation. A layer-wise analysis identifies middle layers (12-17, best layer 16) as carrying the strongest predictive signal. A greedy batch allocator then distributes a fixed total token budget by iteratively assigning 16-token windows to the query with highest predicted marginal accuracy gain.
key_innovation.zh: Predictive Scheduling：在生成前以輕量預測器估計各查詢所需的推理長度或難度類別，採用兩種方案——以中間 transformer hidden states 為輸入的 per-layer MLP，以及對原始題目文字進行 LoRA fine-tune 的分類器。Layer-wise 分析指出中段 layer（第 12-17 層、最佳為第 16 層）攜帶最強預測訊號。後續再以 greedy batch allocator 將固定總 token budget 以每次 16 個 token 為步長，配置給預測邊際準確率增益最高的查詢。

key_improvements.en: On GSM8K with DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B, predictive scheduling yields up to 7.9 percentage points absolute accuracy gain over uniform budgeting at identical token cost, closing over 50% of the gap to the oracle. Best MLP-per-layer test correlation reaches Pearson r = 0.742 at layer 16.
key_improvements.zh: 在 GSM8K 上以 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B 為基底，predictive scheduling 在相同 token 成本下相較 uniform budgeting 取得最高 7.9 個百分點的絕對準確率提升，並補上與 oracle 之間超過 50% 的差距。Per-layer MLP 的最佳 test 相關係數於第 16 層達 Pearson r = 0.742。

reported_accuracy: Best layer Pearson r = 0.742 (layer 16); +7.9 pp accuracy vs uniform at equal token cost
validation_workloads: GSM8K

scope_assumptions.en: Evaluated on a single dataset (GSM8K) with a single base model (DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B); predictors are trained per (model, task) and may not transfer; uses a fixed probe-string injection (every 16 tokens up to 256) to derive ground-truth early-stopping labels, capping the modelled reasoning length at 256 tokens; greedy allocator assumes marginal gains are monotonically decreasing per query.
scope_assumptions.zh: 僅在單一資料集（GSM8K）與單一基底模型（DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B）上評估；預測器需針對 (模型, 任務) 分別訓練，跨設定移植性未驗證；以固定 probe-string 插入（每 16 token、最多 256 token）取得 early-stopping 標籤，因此所建模的推理長度上限為 256 token；greedy allocator 假設每筆查詢的邊際增益單調遞減。

title: PrefillShare: A Shared Prefill Module for KV Reuse in Multi-LLM Disaggregated Serving
authors: Sunghyeon Woo; Hoseung Kim; Sunghwan Shim; Minjung Jo; Hyunjoon Jeong; Jeongtae Lee; Joonghoon Kim; Sungjae Lee; Baeseong Park; Se Jung Kwon; Dongsoo Lee
research_focus: LLM serving, Long-context / Prefix cache, Agentic / Workflow serving, PD disaggregation

problem_statement.en: Multi-model agent workflows repeatedly run prefill and store separate KV caches when specialized models process the same shared context. Even prefill/decode disaggregation leaves this inter-model redundancy intact, increasing TTFT, tail latency, aggregate prefill load, and cache-memory pressure.
problem_statement.zh: 當 specialized model 處理相同的共享 context 時，多 model agent workflow 會重複執行 prefill 並分別儲存 KV cache。即使採用 prefill/decode disaggregation，這項 inter-model redundancy 仍然存在，因而提高 TTFT、tail latency、aggregate prefill load 與 cache memory 壓力。

key_innovation.en: PrefillShare freezes one base prefill module and cache-conditionally fine-tunes task-specific decode modules to consume its shared prompt KV cache. A prefix-locality-aware router and cache-handoff pipeline then reuse and incrementally extend that cache across heterogeneous model switches in vLLM-based disaggregated serving.
key_innovation.zh: PrefillShare 凍結單一 base prefill module，並以 cache-conditioned fine-tuning 訓練 task-specific decode module，使其可直接使用共享的 prompt KV cache。prefix-locality-aware router 與 cache-handoff pipeline 進一步在基於 vLLM 的 disaggregated serving 中，跨 heterogeneous model switch 重用並增量延伸該 cache。

key_improvements.en: In four-agent ReAct and Reflexion workloads, PrefillShare provides up to 4.5x lower p95 latency and 3.9x higher throughput than the disaggregated baseline while maintaining accuracy comparable to full fine-tuning across math, coding, and tool-calling tasks.
key_improvements.zh: 在四 agent 的 ReAct 與 Reflexion workload 中，PrefillShare 相較 disaggregated baseline 可將 p95 latency 最高降低 4.5x、throughput 最高提升 3.9x，並在數學、coding 與 tool-calling task 上維持與 full fine-tuning 相當的 accuracy。

reuse_metric.en: PrefillShare sustains a prefix-cache hit ratio of nearly 89% across concurrency levels, whereas the disaggregated baseline peaks at 60% before dropping; cache-conditioned fine-tuning preserves near-Full-FT accuracy even at 100% KV-cache sharing.
reuse_metric.zh: PrefillShare 在不同 concurrency level 下均維持近 89% 的 prefix-cache hit ratio，而 disaggregated baseline 僅在 60% 達到峰值後即下降；cache-conditioned fine-tuning 即使在 100% KV cache sharing 下，仍維持接近 Full-FT 的 accuracy。

title: LLM Query Scheduling with Prefix Reuse and Latency Constraints
authors: Gregory Dexter; Shao Tang; Ata Fatahibaarzi; Qingquan Song; Tejas Dharamsi; Aman Gupta
venue_full: 39th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2025)
research_focus: Long-context / Prefix cache, Agentic / Workflow serving, Multi-tenant scheduling, Continuous batching, Performance modeling

problem_statement.en: Under RadixAttention prefix caching, common online schedulers (FCFS, Longest-Prefix-Match) can produce large TTFT spikes under bursty traffic, but their behaviour with respect to TTFT latency constraints has not been characterised. FCFS misses prefix-reuse opportunities; LPM greedily maximizes cache reuse but can starve queries that lack high prefix overlap, hurting tail TTFT.
problem_statement.zh: 於 RadixAttention prefix caching 之下，常見的線上 scheduler (FCFS、Longest-Prefix-Match) 在突發流量下會產生大幅 TTFT 突波，但對 TTFT 延遲約束的行為尚未被刻畫。FCFS 錯失 prefix-reuse 機會；LPM 雖貪婪追求 cache reuse，卻可能餓死缺乏高 prefix overlap 的查詢，惡化 tail TTFT。

key_innovation.en: A formal computational model of RadixAttention-based LLM inference and proof that deciding feasibility of a TTFT constraint under prefix reuse is NP-Hard (via reduction from 3-PARTITION). Proposes k-LPM, a scheduling algorithm that interleaves k-1 greedy LPM steps with one FCFS step (processing the oldest query), generalizing FCFS (k=1) and LPM (k=infty). Under a tree-structured data generative model with regular arrivals, k-LPM provably achieves max TTFT <= T + n(u/k + d - s/k), strictly better than both LPM and FCFS for intermediate s.
key_innovation.zh: 建立 RadixAttention 式 LLM 推理的形式化計算模型，並證明在 prefix reuse 下判定能否滿足 TTFT 約束為 NP-Hard (由 3-PARTITION 約化)。提出 k-LPM 排程演算法：以 k-1 步貪婪 LPM 加 1 步 FCFS (處理最舊查詢) 交錯，當 k=1 退化為 FCFS、k=infty 退化為 LPM。在 tree-structured data generative model 與固定到達間隔下可證明 k-LPM 滿足 max TTFT <= T + n(u/k + d - s/k)，在中等 s 下嚴格優於 LPM 與 FCFS。

baselines_compared: FCFS, LPM (Longest Prefix Match, SGLang default)

key_improvements.en: k-LPM with k=2 achieves reduced P99 TTFT across a wide range of request rates compared to FCFS and LPM (Figure 2). FCFS P99 TTFT grows ~linearly past 30 RPS while k-LPM stays within ~50 s; under burst-traffic theoretical analysis k-LPM retains a 1/k factor of the sn reduction in TTFT over FCFS. Also gives an approximation algorithm certifying (1-p)-percentile TTFT <= T in O(n * exp(1/p log(1/p))) time.
key_improvements.zh: k=2 的 k-LPM 在廣泛 request rate 區間相較 FCFS 與 LPM 均達成更低的 P99 TTFT (Figure 2)。FCFS P99 TTFT 超過 30 RPS 後近線性成長，k-LPM 仍維持約 50 s 上下；於 burst-traffic 之理論分析下，k-LPM 相較 FCFS 保有 sn reduction 的 1/k 因子。並提供保證 (1-p)-percentile TTFT <= T 的近似演算法，複雜度為 O(n * exp(1/p log(1/p)))。

reported_accuracy: Not Reported (theorems give worst/expected-case bounds rather than empirical MAPE; experiments validate that k-LPM beats FCFS and LPM on P99 TTFT)
validation_workloads: 360Brew prompt set (Team 2025) - 2100 prompts, 8K context, structure (Instruction)(MemberProfile)(PastInteractions)(Question); SGLang serving benchmark with Poisson arrivals

scope_assumptions.en: Computational model assumes batch size of one and that only the most recently processed prompt's KV cache is reused (single-prompt cache rather than full RadixAttention memory pool); focuses on prefill-dominated regime where self-attention or FFN dominates. Theoretical guarantees rely on a height-2 tree-structured prompt generative model with regular arrivals and uniform user-doc edge lengths; relaxations (overlap among user/doc substrings, non-uniform repetitions) are acknowledged as gaps. Decoding length and TPOT constraints are not modelled.
scope_assumptions.zh: 計算模型假設 batch size 為 1 且僅重用最近處理過的 prompt 之 KV cache (單 prompt cache 而非完整 RadixAttention memory pool)；聚焦 prefill 主導 regime，self-attention 或 FFN 為主要成本。理論保證基於高度為 2 的 tree-structured prompt 生成模型、固定到達間隔與均勻 user-doc edge 長度；overlap 與不均勻重複等放寬條件被列為留待未來工作的差距。Decoding length 與 TPOT 約束未納入模型。

title: PROBE: Co-Balancing Computation and Communication in MoE Inference via Real-Time Predictive Prefetching
authors: Qianchao Zhu; Xucheng Ye; Yuliang Liu; Haodong Ouyang; Chengru Song
research_focus: MoE serving, Multi-tenant scheduling, Continuous batching, Performance modeling, Collective communication

problem_statement.en: Latency-critical MoE inference under expert parallelism (EP) suffers a 'double penalty': expert hotspots create both computational stragglers and bandwidth-bound network congestion in all-to-all collectives. Continuous batching makes the workload temporally volatile (imbalance ratio fluctuates between 1.43 and 2.28 within hundreds of decode steps), so reactive statistic-based rebalancers like DeepSeek-EPLB lag behind abrupt semantic shifts and force ~50% of global compute to idle at synchronization barriers.
problem_statement.zh: 在 expert parallelism（EP）下的延遲敏感型 MoE 推論面臨 double penalty：expert hotspot 同時造成計算 straggler 與 all-to-all 集合通訊的頻寬擁塞。continuous batching 又使工作負載在時序上劇烈波動（imbalance ratio 於數百個 decode step 內介於 1.43 與 2.28），DeepSeek-EPLB 等被動式統計型 rebalancer 因此跟不上突發的語意轉換，使 ~50% 的全域算力於同步屏障閒置。

key_innovation.en: PROBE introduces Continuous Lookahead Pipelining: (1) a Gate-Initialized Lookahead Predictor that clones the next layer's frozen router and adds a trainable residual MLP, distilled online from live traffic to forecast next-layer expert activations at ~90% top-k accuracy; (2) a Hardware-Aware Balance Planner formulated as bounded ILP that respects a per-device 'hiding window'; (3) Phase-Locked Co-Scheduling with split-phase P2P transfers that overlap expert prefetching with compute-bound GEMM while never contending with all-to-all collectives.
key_innovation.zh: PROBE 提出 Continuous Lookahead Pipelining：(1) Gate-Initialized Lookahead Predictor，凍結下一層 router 並接上可訓練 residual MLP，於線上流量持續蒸餾，可在 top-k 達 ~90% 準確率預測下一層的 expert 啟動；(2) Hardware-Aware Balance Planner 以受 device hiding window 約束的 ILP 形式建構；(3) Phase-Locked Co-Scheduling 採 split-phase P2P 傳輸，將 expert prefetch 與 compute-bound GEMM overlap，並避免與 all-to-all 競爭頻寬。

key_improvements.en: Up to 1.32x prefill latency reduction (TTFT) and 1.26x decoding throughput improvement over state-of-the-art baselines; reduces average imbalance ratio across 35 layers from 2.13 to 1.09; predictor reaches 87%-94% top-k accuracy and approaches 100% top-half-k recall.
key_improvements.zh: 相較最先進基線，PROBE 將 prefill 延遲（TTFT）最多降低 1.32x、decode 吞吐量提升 1.26x；35 層平均 imbalance ratio 由 2.13 降至 1.09；predictor 達到 87%-94% top-k 準確率，top-half-k recall 近乎 100%。

reported_accuracy: Lookahead predictor: 87%-94% top-K accuracy after online distillation; ~100% top-half-K recall and 2x-top-K recall; 70%-80% accuracy for the untrained baseline (frozen router only)
models_validated: Qwen3-MoE-235B (128 experts, top-8, 93 layers, BF16), GPT-OSS-120B (128 experts, top-4, 36 layers, BF16)
validation_workloads: Chinese (Alpaca-zh), Code (CodeAlpaca-20k, OpenAI-humaneval), Repeat (synthetic high-skew stress test)

scope_assumptions.en: Built on SGLang with DeepEP as communication backend; assumes hybrid parallelism (DP for attention, EP for MoE) and 8x Hopper-141GB single-node deployment with 900 GB/s NVSwitch; the analytical performance model is the bottleneck-rank-latency formulation and is used to motivate the design rather than fitted with reported MAPE; up to three redundant experts per rank are buffered; planner is implemented as a single-SM CUDA kernel with iteration cap k_max=16 to keep the solver under the device hiding window; relies on CUDA Graph compatibility.
scope_assumptions.zh: 建構於 SGLang 之上，以 DeepEP 為通訊後端；假設 hybrid parallelism（attention 採 DP、MoE 採 EP）並部署於 8x Hopper-141GB 單節點、900 GB/s NVSwitch 之硬體；分析式效能模型採用 bottleneck-rank-latency 公式，用於設計動機而非以 MAPE 擬合；每個 rank 至多緩衝三個 redundant expert；planner 實作為單 SM 之 CUDA kernel 並以 k_max=16 迭代上限約束於 hiding window 內；依賴 CUDA Graph 相容性。

title: Prompt Cache: Modular Attention Reuse for Low-Latency Inference
authors: In Gim; Guojun Chen; Seung-seob Lee; Nikhil Sarda; Anurag Khandelwal; Lin Zhong
venue_full: Conference on Machine Learning and Systems (MLSys 2024, Santa Clara, CA)
research_focus: Long-context / Prefix cache, LLM serving

problem_statement.en: Many LLM prompts share overlapping text segments (system messages, documents, prompt templates), but KV Cache only reuses attention states within a single prompt, and prefix sharing only covers identical prefixes. Because attention states are position-dependent, shared segments appearing at different positions in different prompts are recomputed on every request, inflating TTFT quadratically with prompt length.
problem_statement.zh: 許多 LLM prompt 之間存在重疊的文字片段（system message、文件、prompt template），但 KV Cache 僅在單一 prompt 內重用 attention state，prefix sharing 也只涵蓋完全相同的前綴。由於 attention state 具位置相依性，共享片段若出現在不同 prompt 的不同位置，每次請求都必須重新計算，使 TTFT 隨 prompt 長度呈二次方增長。

key_innovation.en: Modular inter-request attention reuse via a Prompt Markup Language (PML): users declare reusable segments as 'prompt modules' in a schema, whose (k,v) attention states are precomputed once with schema-assigned position IDs and concatenated at serving time. Builds on the empirical finding that LLMs can operate on attention states with discontinuous position IDs; supports parameterized modules (<param>), union modules, scaffolding to offset attention-masking effects, and ~20-line RoPE/ALiBi lookup-table adaptations per transformer architecture.
key_innovation.zh: 藉由 Prompt Markup Language (PML) 實現跨請求的模組化 attention 重用：使用者在 schema 中將可重用片段宣告為 prompt module，其 (k,v) attention state 以 schema 指派的 position ID 預先計算一次，服務時直接串接。核心依據是 LLM 可在不連續 position ID 的 attention state 上運作的實證發現；並支援參數化模組（<param>）、union 模組、用以抵銷 attention masking 效應的 scaffolding，以及每個 transformer 架構約 20 行的 RoPE/ALiBi lookup table 改動。

key_improvements.en: TTFT latency reduced up to 8x for GPU-based inference and 60x for CPU-based inference (headline); evaluation shows 1.5x-3x (modules in CPU memory) to 5x-10x (GPU memory) on RTX 4090/A40/A100 and 20x-70x on CPUs across LongBench, while output accuracy remains comparable to the baseline and no model parameters are modified. Latency advantage grows quadratically with sequence length (attention is O(n^2) vs linear memcpy).
key_improvements.zh: TTFT 延遲最高降低 8x（GPU 推理）與 60x（CPU 推理，headline 數字）；評估顯示在 RTX 4090/A40/A100 上為 1.5x-3x（module 存於 CPU memory）至 5x-10x（GPU memory），CPU 上為 20x-70x（LongBench），同時輸出精度與 baseline 相當，且無需修改模型參數。延遲優勢隨序列長度呈二次方擴大（attention 為 O(n^2)，memcpy 為線性）。

compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA RTX 4090, NVIDIA A40, NVIDIA A100, Intel i9-13900K, AMD Ryzen 9 7950X, DDR5, DDR4
reported_accuracy: Not Reported (measurement study; LongBench output accuracy comparable to KV Cache baseline)
validation_workloads: LongBench, Synthetic

scope_assumptions.en: Reduces only TTFT; time-to-subsequent-token is identical to KV Cache. Requires prompts to be authored in (or compiled to) PML against a schema, and reuse quality assumes semantically independent modules (attention masking effect; scaffolding costs extra memory). Memory overhead is proportional to cached tokens (e.g. ~2.5 GB per 1K-token module for Llama 70B at 16-bit precision); cache replacement and prefetching strategies are explicitly left to future work. Evaluated single-GPU (models fitting in 40 GB) with deterministic sampling for accuracy comparison.
scope_assumptions.zh: 僅降低 TTFT；time-to-subsequent-token 與 KV Cache 相同。要求 prompt 以 PML 撰寫（或由 prompt program 編譯而來）並依附於 schema，重用品質假設模組間語意獨立（attention masking 效應；scaffolding 需額外記憶體）。記憶體開銷與快取 token 數成正比（如 Llama 70B 在 16-bit 精度下每個 1K-token module 約 2.5 GB）；cache replacement 與 prefetching 策略明確留待後續研究。評估限於單 GPU（模型需容納於 40 GB 內），精度比較採用 deterministic sampling。

title: ProphetKV: User-Query-Driven Selective Recomputation for Efficient KV Cache Reuse in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
authors: Shihao Wang; Jiahao Chen; Yanqi Pan; Hao Huang; Yichen Hao; Xiangyu Zou; Wen Xia; Wentao Zhang; Chongyang Qiu; Pengfei Wang
affiliations: Harbin Institute of Technology, Shenzhen, Beijing Yanrong Technology Co., Ltd.
research_focus: LLM serving, Long-context / Prefix cache

problem_statement.en: Position-independent KV cache reuse can avoid repeated long-context RAG prefill, but isolated document caches lose cross-document attention. Existing partial-recomputation criteria favor globally salient yet query-irrelevant tokens, crowding task-critical tokens out of a limited recomputation budget and degrading answer accuracy.
problem_statement.zh: Position-independent KV cache reuse 可避免重複執行 long-context RAG prefill，但獨立預先計算的文件 cache 會缺失跨文件 attention。既有 partial recomputation 準則偏向全域顯著但與 query 無關的 token，使任務關鍵 token 無法納入有限的 recomputation budget，進而降低回答準確度。

key_innovation.en: ProphetKV uses user-query-to-context attention to prioritize task-relevant tokens, then applies a dual-stage recomputation pipeline with layer-wise metric fusion to form one GPU-friendly, high-utility token set for selective recomputation across all layers.
key_innovation.zh: ProphetKV 利用 user-query-to-context attention 優先選取與任務相關的 token，再透過具備 layer-wise metric fusion 的 dual-stage recomputation pipeline，建立可供所有 layer 執行 selective recomputation 的單一 GPU-friendly high-utility token set。

baselines_compared: Full Recompute, Naive Reuse, CacheBlend, KVShare, EPIC

key_improvements.en: With a 20% recomputation ratio, ProphetKV retains 96%–101% of full-prefill accuracy, improves accuracy by 8.8%–24.9% on RULER and 18.6%–50.9% on LongBench over prior methods, and achieves up to 5× speedup over full recomputation for 8K and 16K contexts.
key_improvements.zh: 在 20% recomputation ratio 下，ProphetKV 保留 Full Recompute 96%–101% 的準確度；相較既有方法，在 RULER 與 LongBench 上分別提升 8.8%–24.9% 與 18.6%–50.9% 的準確度，並在 8K 與 16K context 上達成相較 Full Recompute 最高 5× 的 speedup。

compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA A100, NVIDIA H100, NVIDIA L20

reuse_metric.en: At a 20% recomputation ratio, ProphetKV retains 96%–101% of full-prefill accuracy across RULER and LongBench.
reuse_metric.zh: 在 20% recomputation ratio 下，ProphetKV 於 RULER 與 LongBench 保留 Full Recompute 96%–101% 的準確度。

title: Multi-Agent Collaboration via Evolving Orchestration
authors: Yufan Dang; Chen Qian; Xueheng Luo; Jingru Fan; Zihao Xie; Ruijie Shi; Weize Chen; Cheng Yang; Xiaoyin Che; Ye Tian; Xuantang Xiong; Lei Han; et al.
venue_full: Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems 2025
research_focus: Agentic / Workflow serving, Reasoning / Test-time scaling

problem_statement.en: Existing multi-agent LLM systems rely on static, hand-designed collaboration topologies that neither adapt to evolving per-task conditions nor control computational cost. The paper asks how to dynamically orchestrate a pool of heterogeneous agents on the fly so that collective reasoning is both effective and resource-efficient.
problem_statement.zh: 現有的 multi-agent LLM 系統依賴靜態、人工設計的協作拓撲,既無法因應各任務隨情境演變的條件進行調適,亦無法控制計算成本。本文探討如何即時動態地編排一組異質 agent,使集體推理同時兼顧有效性與資源效率。

key_innovation.en: A centralized orchestrator ("puppeteer") LLM that, at each reasoning step, selects which agent ("puppet") to activate; its selection policy is trained by REINFORCE on a cost-penalized task-outcome reward, so the executed sequence "unfolds" into a per-instance directed graph (trees/cycles) instead of searching a fixed topology space.
key_innovation.zh: 一個中央化的編排器(orchestrator,即「puppeteer」)LLM,於每一推理步驟選擇要啟用哪一個 agent(即「puppet」);其選擇 policy 以 REINFORCE 在具成本懲罰的任務結果 reward 上訓練,使得所執行的序列「展開」為各實例的有向圖(樹狀或含環結構),而非在固定的拓撲空間中搜尋。

baselines_compared: Self-Refine, AFlow, MacNet, EvoAgent, Pure single models, Puppeteer-Mono

key_improvements.en: Titan avg 0.7731 evolved vs 0.6893 init (best baseline AFlow 0.6899); cost falls as accuracy rises during RL.
key_improvements.zh: Titan 子空間演化後平均 0.7731 對初始 0.6893(最佳基線 AFlow 0.6899);RL 過程中成本隨準確率上升而下降。

structure_space: Operator / node graph, Edge topology (spatial), Temporal / cross-round edges, Termination / depth
decision_mechanism: Policy gradient / REINFORCE, LLM on-the-fly orchestration
benchmarks_used: GSM-Hard, MMLU-Pro, SRDD, CommonGen-Hard

agent_scenario.en: A single centralized orchestrator (puppeteer) governs a pool of 13 candidate agents (5 tool-use: read_file, search_arxiv, search_bing, access_website, run_python; 8 reasoning-pattern: reasoning, critique, reflect, question, summarize, conclude, modify, planning), each instantiable on multiple LLM backbones. At each step the orchestrator activates exactly one agent conditioned on the global system state and the task; the sequence of activations forms a directed reasoning graph (trees/graphs/cycles). Two backbone regimes are tested: a "Mimas" subspace of smaller models and a "Titan" subspace of large models, plus a homogeneous single-model variant (Puppeteer-Mono) versus the heterogeneous multi-model Puppeteer. It is a general-purpose reasoning setting spanning math, multiple-choice, software, and generation. Default protocol: episode length 4, up to 3 parallel explorations.
agent_scenario.zh: 單一中央化編排器(puppeteer)統理由 13 個候選 agent 構成的資源池(5 個工具使用型:read_file、search_arxiv、search_bing、access_website、run_python;8 個推理模式型:reasoning、critique、reflect、question、summarize、conclude、modify、planning),每個 agent 皆可於多種 LLM backbone 上實例化。於每一步驟,編排器依全域系統狀態與任務,恰啟用一個 agent;啟用序列構成一有向推理圖(樹狀、圖狀或含環結構)。測試兩種 backbone 情境:由較小模型組成的「Mimas」子空間與由大型模型組成的「Titan」子空間,並另設同質的單一模型變體(Puppeteer-Mono)以對比異質的多模型 Puppeteer。此為橫跨數學、多選題、軟體與生成的通用推理設定。預設協定:episode 長度為 4,最多 3 條平行探索。

title: Pythia: Exploiting Workflow Predictability for Efficient Agent-Native LLM Serving
authors: Shan Yu; Junyi Shu; Yuanjiang Ni; Kun Qian; Xue Li; Yang Wang; Jinyuan Zhang; Ziyi Xu; Shuo Yang; Lingjun Zhu; Ennan Zhai; Qingda Lu; Jiarong Xing; Youyou Lu; Xin Jin; Xuanzhe Liu; Harry Xu
affiliations: UCLA, Alibaba Cloud Computing, Alibaba Group, Intel, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, UC Berkeley, Rice University, Tsinghua University, Peking University
research_focus: Agentic / Workflow serving, Long-context / Prefix cache, Length prediction, Multi-tenant scheduling, Capacity planning, KV cache offloading

problem_statement.en: Production agent-serving traces show that agentic LLM workloads suffer three structural inefficiencies hidden from workflow-agnostic serving stacks: low prefix cache hit rates (over 40% requests with zero hits), severe load imbalance and preemption from long-context requests, and substantial queueing from burst-induced fan-outs that reactive autoscaling cannot anticipate.
problem_statement.zh: 生產環境 agent serving trace 顯示，agentic LLM workload 在 workflow-agnostic 的 serving stack 下存在三類結構性低效：prefix cache 命中率偏低（超過 40% 請求 zero hit）、long-context 請求引發的負載不均與頻繁 preemption，以及 burst-driven fan-out 造成的大量排隊，這些都是被動式 autoscaling 無法事前因應的。

key_innovation.en: Pythia exploits workflow predictability via three coordinated mechanisms built atop SGLang: (1) a speculative cache manager that prunes dead KV blocks and forward-stages prompts for the next agent in a Belady-like manner using a Probabilistic Finite Automaton modeled from historical traces; (2) a lookahead request scheduler that combines a distribution-free statistical capacity router with a graph-driven global priority assignment; (3) a phase-adaptive autoscaler that uses regex-projected execution graphs to proactively scale models up before fan-outs and tear them down once obsolete.
key_innovation.zh: Pythia 在 SGLang 之上建構三項協同機制以利用 workflow 可預測性：(1) speculative cache manager，根據由歷史 trace 學得的 Probabilistic Finite Automaton 對未來 agent 進行 Belady 風格的 KV block 提早釋放與 prompt forward-staging；(2) lookahead request scheduler，結合 distribution-free 的統計式容量 router 與 graph-driven 的全域優先權指派；(3) phase-adaptive autoscaler，以 regex 投射的執行圖預先擴容即將出現的 fan-out 模型，並及時縮減已過期模型。

key_improvements.en: Up to 2.9x average job completion time reduction and 1.96x throughput improvement on multi-agent workloads compared to the SGLang baseline.
key_improvements.zh: 於多 agent workload 上相較 SGLang baseline，平均 job completion time 最多降低 2.9x，throughput 提升 1.96x。

ai_task: LLM Serving, Multi-agent Systems, AI Inference KV Cache transfer
reported_accuracy: Not Reported (per-agent output length CV reported as 0.15-0.45; system reports downstream JCT and throughput rather than prediction MAPE)
validation_workloads: Internal multi-agent coding assistant production trace, deep research agent

scope_assumptions.en: Predictions optimize for the dominant percentile, deliberately bounding rare execution paths via probabilistic regex projection rather than modeling all edge cases; relies on agentic frameworks injecting app_metadata (workflow_type_id, workflow_id, agent_id) via OpenAI extra_body; KV cache assumes a three-tier hierarchy (GPU HBM L1 / CPU DRAM L2 / shared L3); cold starts and workflow drift are handled via shadow-profiling fallback during onboarding.
scope_assumptions.zh: 預測以主流百分位數為目標，透過機率式 regex 投射界定罕見執行路徑，而非建模所有 edge case；依賴 agentic framework 經 OpenAI extra_body 注入 app_metadata（workflow_type_id、workflow_id、agent_id）；KV cache 假設三層階層（GPU HBM L1 / CPU DRAM L2 / 共享 L3）；新 workflow 上線與 workflow drift 透過 shadow-profiling 回退機制處理。

title: QKVShare: Quantized KV-Cache Handoff for Multi-Agent On-Device LLMs
authors: Pratik Honavar; Tejpratap GVSL
research_focus: LLM serving, Long-context / Prefix cache, Agentic / Workflow serving, KV cache compression, Quantization

problem_statement.en: In on-device multi-agent LLM systems, a receiving agent typically either recomputes an upstream agent's latent context through costly re-prefill or transfers a memory-intensive full-precision KV cache. Because KV-cache size grows linearly with context length, these choices impose substantial latency and memory costs on small edge GPUs.
problem_statement.zh: 在 on-device 多 agent LLM 系統中，接收端 agent 通常必須透過高成本的 re-prefill 重建上游 agent 的 latent context，或傳輸占用大量記憶體的全精度 KV cache。由於 KV cache 容量隨 context 長度線性成長，這兩種方式都會對小型 edge GPU 造成顯著的延遲與記憶體負擔。

key_innovation.en: QKVShare uses a learned token-level controller that combines local-importance features with downstream-demand and segment signals to assign mixed precisions from {2, 4, 8, 16} bits. It packages quantized KV groups and receiver metadata into a CacheCard; the current HuggingFace-compatible receiver path dequantizes the card into FP16 past_key_values before injection.
key_innovation.zh: QKVShare 使用 learned token-level controller，結合 local-importance 特徵、downstream-demand 與 segment signal，從 {2, 4, 8, 16} bit 中配置 mixed precision。系統將量化 KV group 與接收端所需 metadata 封裝為 CacheCard；目前的 HuggingFace-compatible 接收路徑會先將 CacheCard dequantize 為 FP16 past_key_values，再執行注入。

baselines_compared: FP16 re-prefill, FP16 cache copy, Q4 cache reload, Uniform Q4/Q8 sharing, Adaptive local quantization

key_improvements.en: The uniform-Q4 QKVShare handoff path reduces TTFT relative to full re-prefill at every tested context: 130.7 ms versus 150.2 ms at nominal 1K and 397.1 ms versus 1029.7 ms at nominal 8K. At five hops and an approximately 8-bit budget, topology-aware allocation reaches 82.67% GSM8K accuracy versus 71.33% for uniform Q8, although the local-only adaptive controller reaches 83.33%.
key_improvements.zh: uniform-Q4 QKVShare handoff path 在所有測試 context 長度下均較 full re-prefill 降低 TTFT：nominal 1K 時為 130.7 ms vs. 150.2 ms，nominal 8K 時為 397.1 ms vs. 1029.7 ms。在五次 handoff、約 8-bit budget 下，topology-aware allocation 的 GSM8K 準確率為 82.67%，uniform Q8 為 71.33%；不過 local-only adaptive controller 達到 83.33%。

ai_task: Multi-agent Systems, AI Inference KV Cache transfer, KV Cache Compression
compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA RTX 5070 Ti Laptop GPU (12 GB)

reuse_metric.en: No reuse-rate percentage is reported. At five hops and an approximately 8-bit budget, topology-aware QKVShare attains 82.67% GSM8K accuracy versus 71.33% for uniform Q8 and 83.33% for the local-only adaptive controller.
reuse_metric.zh: 論文未報告重用率百分比。在五次 handoff、約 8-bit budget 下，topology-aware QKVShare 的 GSM8K 準確率為 82.67%，uniform Q8 為 71.33%，local-only adaptive controller 為 83.33%。

title: RANDOMIZATION BOOSTS KV CACHING, LEARNING BALANCES QUERY LOAD: A JOINT PERSPECTIVE
authors: Fangzhou Wu; Sandeep Silwal
research_focus: Datacenter networking, Routing / Load balancing

problem_statement.en: Existing KV cache eviction policies like LRU are fragile under dynamic query arrivals, and current load balancing heuristics fail to capture the coupling between cache state and system congestion. This leads to suboptimal cache hit rates and increased end-to-end latency in multi-LLM serving environments.
problem_statement.zh: 現有 KV cache 淘汰策略（如 LRU）在動態 query 到達下表現脆弱，而現有的負載均衡啟發式方法無法捕捉 cache 狀態與系統壅塞之間的耦合關係，導致多 LLM 服務環境中 cache hit rate 欠佳、端到端 latency 上升。

key_innovation.en: A unified mathematical model for KV cache-aware load balancing, combined with a Randomized Leaf Token (RLT) eviction algorithm and a Learning-Based Greedy Routing (LBGR) strategy that uses online regression to predict end-to-end latency.
key_innovation.zh: 針對 KV cache 感知負載均衡建立統一數學模型，並結合隨機葉節點 token（RLT）淘汰演算法與 Learning-Based Greedy Routing（LBGR）策略，藉由線上迴歸預測端到端 latency。

key_improvements.en: Up to 6.92x higher cache hit rate, 11.96x reduction in median latency, 14.06x reduction in TTFT, and 77.4% increase in throughput.
key_improvements.zh: cache hit rate 最高提升 6.92x，中位數 latency 降低 11.96x，TTFT 降低 14.06x，throughput 提升 77.4%。

ai_task: LLM Serving, Multi-LLM Serving, KV Cache-aware Load Balancing
traffic_pattern: Poisson arrival process, Dynamic query arrivals, Batch processing

title: RAPID-LLM: Resilience-Aware Performance analysis of Infrastructure for Distributed LLM Training and Inference
authors: George Karfakis; Faraz Tahmasebi; Binglu Chen; Lime Yao; Saptarshi Mitra; Tianyue Pan; Hyoukjun Kwon; Puneet Gupta
research_focus: Long-context / Prefix cache, Capacity planning, Performance modeling, Roofline analysis, Routing / Load balancing, Hardware co-design, GPU memory tiering

problem_statement.en: Existing modeling tools for distributed LLM training and inference either lose hardware fidelity (coarse layer-level analytical roofline) or fail to scale (cycle-level simulators), and none jointly capture operator-level tile-aware compute behavior, multi-dimensional congestion-aware network modeling, and link faults/degradation at cluster scale.
problem_statement.zh: 既有針對分散式 LLM 訓練與推理的建模工具，或者犧牲硬體擬真度（粗粒度的 layer-level roofline 分析模型），或者難以擴展（cycle-level 模擬器），且皆無法在叢集規模下同時刻畫 operator 層級的 tile-aware 運算行為、多維度且擁塞感知的網路建模，以及鏈路故障或退化的影響。

key_innovation.en: A unified framework that couples a DeepFlow-based frontend (hardware-aware Chakra execution traces with tile-level SRAM/L2/HBM modeling and ZeRO/FSDP-aware activation-liveness pruning) with an extended Astra-Sim backend that adds multi-dimensional congestion-aware routing and soft/hard link-fault models.
key_innovation.zh: 提出統一框架：前端以 DeepFlow 為基礎，生成具硬體感知的 Chakra execution trace，並進行 tile 層級的 SRAM/L2/HBM 建模，以及考量 ZeRO/FSDP 切分策略的 activation-liveness 修剪；後端則延伸 Astra-Sim，新增多維度且擁塞感知的路由建模與 soft/hard 鏈路故障模型。

baselines_compared: Astra-Sim (stock), ns-3, published reference runtimes for GPT/Llama training

key_improvements.en: Inference step latency error at most 10.4% vs published Llama measurements; training time error within 14% vs published GPT-scale references; matches ns-3 within 8% on representative communication workloads; DDP training error within 5.5% on 4xA100 PCIe measurements.
key_improvements.zh: 推理 step latency 與已發表 Llama 量測之誤差最高為 10.4%；GPT 規模訓練時間相對已發表參考之誤差落在 14% 以內；於代表性通訊工作負載下與 ns-3 結果相差不超過 8%；於 4x A100 PCIe 上之 DDP 訓練誤差控制在 5.5% 以內。

compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA A100 SXM (80GB), NVIDIA A100 PCIe (80GB), modeled HBM2.5/3D-HBM variants
gpu_count: Up to 2048 GPUs (modeled); 64x A100 80GB SXM (case study); 4x A100 80GB PCIe (measurement validation)
node_count: Up to thousands of GPU nodes (modeled)
reported_accuracy: 10.4% step-latency MAPE (Llama inference); within 14% on GPT training; within 8% of ns-3; within 5.5% on DDP measurements
models_validated: Llama-2-7B, Llama-2-13B, Llama-2-70B, Llama3.1-70B, GPT-175B, GPT-530B, GPT-1T
validation_workloads: Published Llama inference and GPT-scale training runtimes; in-house DDP measurements on 4xA100 PCIe; ns-3 packet-level reference simulations across Torus2D / Mesh2D / KingMesh2D / HyperCube topologies

scope_assumptions.en: Hierarchical execution mode introduces mild parallelism mapping constraints (TP/SP/CP in first network dimension, PP and DP in outer dimensions) and slight loss of multi-dimensional congestion fidelity; soft-fault sensitivity study uses single-fault injection only; reported runtimes consider aggregated collectives, not full per-node compute traces.
scope_assumptions.zh: Hierarchical 執行模式引入溫和的平行映射限制（TP/SP/CP 須置於第一網路維度，PP 與 DP 置於外層維度），並對多維擁塞建模產生輕微擬真度損失；soft-fault 敏感度研究僅注入單一故障；所回報的執行時間係根據聚合後的 collective 計算，未涵蓋每個節點的完整運算 trace。

title: RDMA over Ethernet for Distributed Training at Meta Scale
authors: Adithya Gangidi; Rui Miao; Shengbao Zheng; Sai Jayesh Bondu; Guilherme Goes; Hany Morsy; Rohit Puri; Mohammad Riftadi; Ashmitha Jeevaraj Shetty; Jingyi Yang; Shuqiang Zhang; Mikel Jimenez Fernandez; Shashidhar Gandham; Hongyi Zeng
venue_full: Conference on Applications, Technologies, Architectures, and Protocols for Computer Communication
research_focus: Multi-tenant scheduling, Datacenter networking, RDMA / Transport, Congestion control, Routing / Load balancing, Network topology, Collective communication, Distributed training

problem_statement.en: Distributed AI training at scale suffers from network congestion, load imbalance, and performance degradation due to the bursty, low-entropy traffic patterns of collective communication. Existing congestion control mechanisms like DCQCN are difficult to tune for these workloads, and standard routing schemes like ECMP fail to distribute traffic effectively.
problem_statement.zh: 大規模分散式 AI 訓練因 collective communication 的突發性低熵流量模式，而面臨嚴重的網路壅塞、負載失衡與效能下降。DCQCN 等現有壅塞控制機制難以針對此類 workload 進行調校，而 ECMP 等標準路由方案亦無法有效分散流量。

key_innovation.en: A co-designed approach for RoCE networks that replaces transport-level congestion control (DCQCN) with receiver-driven traffic admission via the collective library, combined with enhanced routing schemes (E-ECMP, Centralized Traffic Engineering) and topology-aware scheduling.
key_innovation.zh: 針對 RoCE 網路的協同設計方案：以 collective library 層的接收端驅動流量准入取代傳輸層壅塞控制（DCQCN），並搭配強化路由方案（E-ECMP、集中式 Traffic Engineering）與拓撲感知排程。

baselines_compared: ECMP, DCQCN, standard RoCEv2, path pinning

key_improvements.en: Up to 2x performance improvement in collective communication, 40% improvement in AllReduce performance with E-ECMP, and stable performance without persistent congestion.
key_improvements.zh: collective communication 效能最高提升 2x；E-ECMP 使 AllReduce 效能提升 40%；系統在無持續壅塞的狀態下維持穩定效能。

ai_task: LLM Serving, AI Model Training, Distributed Deep Learning (DDL), Ranking, Content Recommendation, Content Understanding, Natural Language Processing
traffic_pattern: All-to-All, AllReduce, AllGather, ReduceScatter, Incast, Elephant flows, Pipeline Parallelism, Tensor Parallelism, FSDP
compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA H100, NVIDIA A100, Intel Xeon
transport_and_interconnect: RoCEv2, RDMA, Ethernet, NVLink, PCIe Gen5
routing_and_congestion_control: ECMP, Enhanced ECMP (E-ECMP), Centralized Traffic Engineering (TE), PFC, DSCP, Flowlet switching

title: RDMA Point-to-Point Communication for LLM Systems
authors: Nandor Licker; Kevin Hu; Vladimir Zaytsev; Lequn Chen
research_focus: Datacenter networking, RDMA / Transport, Collective communication

problem_statement.en: Existing LLM communication libraries are locked to specific NICs and rely on collective communication, which hinders dynamic scaling and portability across heterogeneous RDMA hardware like NVIDIA ConnectX and AWS EFA.
problem_statement.zh: 現有 LLM 通訊函式庫與特定 NIC 深度綁定，並依賴 collective communication，導致在 NVIDIA ConnectX 與 AWS EFA 等異質 RDMA 硬體間難以動態擴展與移植。

key_innovation.en: TransferEngine, a portable RDMA communication library that abstracts heterogeneous hardware by providing a uniform interface for two-sided SEND/RECV and one-sided WRITEIMM operations, utilizing a novel IMMCOUNTER primitive for completion notification that avoids ordering assumptions.
key_innovation.zh: TransferEngine 是一個可移植的 RDMA 通訊函式庫，藉由統一介面抽象異質硬體，支援雙向 SEND/RECV 及單向 WRITEIMM 操作，並引入新穎的 IMMCOUNTER 原語進行完成通知，從而避免對排序的假設。

key_improvements.en: Achieved 400 Gbps peak throughput on both ConnectX-7 and AWS EFA, 1.3-second RL weight updates for trillion-parameter models, and state-of-the-art MoE decode latency on ConnectX-7 with the first viable implementation on EFA.
key_improvements.zh: 在 ConnectX-7 及 AWS EFA 上均達到 400 Gbps 峰值 throughput；兆參數模型的 RL 權重更新僅需 1.3 秒；並首次在 EFA 上實現可行的 MoE decode，ConnectX-7 上的 decode latency 達到業界最佳水準。

ai_task: LLM Serving, Disaggregated Inference, Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) Serving, Reinforcement Learning (RL) Fine-tuning
network_hw: NVIDIA ConnectX-7, AWS Elastic Fabric Adapter (EFA)
transport_and_interconnect: RDMA, RoCEv2, InfiniBand, EFA SRD, NVLink, PCIe

title: RelayCaching: Accelerating LLM Collaboration via Decoding KV Cache Reuse
authors: Yingsheng Geng; Yuchong Gao; Weihong Wu; Guyue Liu; Jiang Liu
affiliations: Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications, Tsinghua University, University of Electronic Science and Technology of China, Peking University
research_focus: LLM serving, Long-context / Prefix cache, Agentic / Workflow serving

problem_statement.en: Multi-agent LLM pipelines repeatedly prefill upstream agents' outputs when they are embedded in downstream prompts. Because the same tokens occur under different prefixes and at non-prefix positions, existing prefix and pre-computed caching methods cannot eliminate this cascading redundancy without sacrificing accuracy or reuse rate.
problem_statement.zh: 多 agent LLM pipeline 將上游 agent 的輸出嵌入下游 prompt 時，必須反覆執行 prefill。由於相同 token 會出現在不同 prefix 與非前綴位置，既有 prefix caching 與 pre-computed caching 方法無法在維持準確率與重用率的同時消除此類串聯式冗餘。

key_innovation.en: RelayCaching directly reuses upstream decoding-phase KV caches during downstream prefill, re-applies RoPE for positional alignment, and selectively recomputes only deviation-prone tokens in a profiled middle-layer range. Its token selector combines value-cosine deviation with accumulated-attention influence and a suffix-position heuristic.
key_innovation.zh: RelayCaching 將上游 decoding 階段的 KV cache 直接重用於下游 prefill，重新套用 RoPE 以對齊位置，並僅在 profiler 所界定的中間層區間內選擇性重算偏差較大的 token。其 token selector 結合 value-cosine 偏差、累積 attention 影響力與 suffix 位置啟發式。

baselines_compared: Full Prefill, Direct Reuse, CacheBlend, EPIC, KVCOMM

key_improvements.en: RelayCaching achieves over 80% KV cache reuse with accuracy comparable to full prefill and up to 4.7× TTFT speedup. At 12k cumulative output tokens, it is 9.2× faster than full prefill and 2.5× faster than CacheBlend.
key_improvements.zh: RelayCaching 在準確率與 full prefill 相當的情況下達成逾 80% 的 KV cache 重用率，TTFT 最高加速 4.7×。在累積輸出 12k token 時，其速度較 full prefill 提升 9.2×，較 CacheBlend 提升 2.5×。

ai_task: Multi-agent Systems, LLM Serving, AI Inference KV Cache transfer
agent_role: Judge / aggregator, Planner, Coder, RAG reader, Generic pipeline

reuse_metric.en: Over 80% KV cache reuse with accuracy comparable to full prefill; the complete method reaches 85.35% reuse and 84.84% accuracy on GSM8K in the two-agent ablation.
reuse_metric.zh: KV cache 重用率逾 80%，且準確率與 full prefill 相當；完整方法在 GSM8K 的雙 agent ablation 中達到 85.35% 重用率與 84.84% 準確率。

title: Revealing the Challenges of Attention-FFN Disaggregation for Modern MoE Models and Hardware Systems
authors: Guowei Liu; Hongming Li; Yaning Guo; Yongxi Lyu; Mo Zhou; Yi Liu; Zhaogeng Li; Yanpeng Wang
research_focus: MoE serving, PD disaggregation, Roofline analysis, Datacenter networking

problem_statement.en: Attention-FFN Disaggregation (AFD) often fails to improve Hardware FLOPS Utilization (HFU) on standard clusters due to communication bottlenecks and load imbalance, creating a 'dead zone' where scaling FFN instances does not yield performance gains.
problem_statement.zh: Attention-FFN Disaggregation（AFD）在標準叢集上因通訊瓶頸與負載失衡，往往無法提升 Hardware FLOPS Utilization（HFU），形成一個「死區」——在此區間內，擴展 FFN 實例數量並不帶來效能增益。

key_innovation.en: A budget-based HFU upper-bound analysis method that extends the roofline model to the communication level, identifying the specific conditions (Superpod-class hardware, coarse-grained experts) where AFD is advantageous.
key_innovation.zh: 一種基於資源預算的 HFU 上界分析方法，將 roofline model 延伸至通訊層級，從而識別出 AFD 具有優勢的特定條件（Superpod 級硬體、粗粒度 expert 劃分）。

baselines_compared: Expert Parallelism (EP), standard large-scale EP deployment

key_improvements.en: Identified that Superpod-class hardware can achieve up to 65.5% theoretical HFU for specific models; demonstrated that AFD is less robust to load imbalance than EP.
key_improvements.zh: 研究指出 Superpod 級硬體在特定模型上可達到高達 65.5% 的理論 HFU；並證明 AFD 相較於 Expert Parallelism（EP），對負載失衡的容忍度更低。

ai_task: LLM Serving, MoE Serving, Disaggregated Prefill/Decoding
traffic_pattern: All-to-All, M2N communication, Unidirectional collective communication

title: Revisiting Congestion Control for Lossless Ethernet
authors: Yiran Zhang; Qingkai Meng; Chaolei Hu; Fengyuan Ren
venue_full: Symposium on Networked Systems Design and Implementation
affiliations: Tsinghua University, Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications, Beihang University
research_focus: Datacenter networking, Congestion control

problem_statement.en: Lossless Ethernet networks suffer from congestion spreading, Head-of-Line (HoL) blocking, and deadlock due to the limitations of Priority-based Flow Control (PFC) and sub-optimal congestion control schemes.
problem_statement.zh: 無損 Ethernet 網路因 Priority-based Flow Control（PFC）的局限性與次優壅塞控制機制，而面臨壅塞擴散、Head-of-Line（HoL）阻塞及死鎖等問題。

key_innovation.en: ACK-driven congestion control (ACC) that leverages the packet conservation property of lossless networks to infer network pipe capacity and excessive packets, using a two-step strategy of temporary source halting followed by rate matching.
key_innovation.zh: ACK 驅動的壅塞控制（ACC）：利用無損網路的封包守恆特性推斷網路管道容量及多餘封包數，採用「暫停發送端」後接「速率匹配」的兩階段策略。

key_improvements.en: 1.3~3.3x improvement in average FCT and 1.4~11.5x improvement in 99th percentile FCT for small flows compared to existing schemes.
key_improvements.zh: 相較於現有方案，小流的平均 FCT 提升 1.3~3.3x，第 99 百分位 FCT 提升 1.4~11.5x。

ai_task: AI applications, Data processing, Storage workloads (NVMe-over-Fabrics)

title: Revisiting Disaggregated Large Language Model Serving for Performance and Energy Implications
authors: Jiaxi Li; Yue Zhu; Eun Kyung Lee; Klara Nahrstedt
research_focus: PD disaggregation, KV cache offloading, Datacenter networking, Energy / Carbon

problem_statement.en: Existing LLM serving frameworks often colocate prefill and decode stages, leading to resource interference, while disaggregated serving lacks systematic benchmarking of performance and energy efficiency across different KV cache transfer paths and optimization strategies.
problem_statement.zh: 現有 LLM 服務框架多將 prefill 與 decode 階段共置於同一節點，造成資源相互干擾；而解耦合服務方式則缺乏針對不同 KV cache 傳輸路徑及優化策略的系統性效能與能耗評測。

key_innovation.en: A comprehensive benchmarking study of prefill-decode disaggregation that evaluates multiple KV cache transfer paths (GPU P2P, CPU offloading, disk offloading) and assesses the energy implications of independent stage-wise frequency scaling using DVFS.
key_innovation.zh: 針對 prefill-decode 解耦合的全面評測研究：評估多種 KV cache 傳輸路徑（GPU P2P、CPU offloading、磁碟 offloading），並分析利用 DVFS 對各階段獨立進行頻率調節的能耗影響。

key_improvements.en: Disaggregated serving outperforms colocated serving in TPOT at high batch sizes due to reduced memory pressure, though it generally consumes more energy and exhibits higher TTFT when high-speed interconnects are unavailable.
key_improvements.zh: 在大 batch size 下，解耦合服務因記憶體壓力降低而在 TPOT 上優於共置方案；然而在缺乏高速互連的情況下，其能耗通常更高，且 TTFT 亦較長。

ai_task: LLM Serving, Disaggregated Prefill/Decoding
compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA A100 40GB, Intel Xeon E5-2697 v4, Samsung 1 TB DDR4 Memory, Samsung 3.2 TB NVMe SSD

title: Robust Length Prediction: A Perspective from Heavy-Tailed Prompt-Conditioned Distributions
authors: Jing Wang; Yu-Yang Qian; Ke Xue; Chao Qian; Peng Zhao; Zhi-Hua Zhou
research_focus: Long-context / Prefix cache, Reasoning / Test-time scaling, Multi-tenant scheduling, Continuous batching, Length prediction, Performance modeling

problem_statement.en: Existing output-length predictors for LLM serving train on a single sampled length per prompt as if it were the prompt's true length. Under a fixed model and decoding setup, however, repeated generations of the same prompt induce a prompt-conditioned distribution with median noise radius of 21.7-42.9 tokens and max-to-median ratios up to 4.03x, so single-sample supervision is misaligned with the heavy-tailed nature of LLM outputs and corrupts the training signal.
problem_statement.zh: 現有 LLM serving 的 output length 預測器在訓練時，將每個 prompt 採樣到的單一輸出長度當作該 prompt 的真實標籤。然而在固定模型與 decoding 設定下，同一 prompt 多次重新生成所得的 prompt-conditioned 分佈呈現 21.7-42.9 tokens 的 median noise radius，max-to-median 比率最高達 4.03x。單一樣本監督與 LLM 輸出本身的重尾特性錯位，污染了訓練信號。

key_innovation.en: Formulates prompt-only length prediction as robust estimation from prompt-conditioned length distributions (ProD). Two variants: (i) ProD-M draws r independent generations per prompt and uses their sample median as the training label, aligning supervision with the Bayes-optimal conditional median under MAE; (ii) ProD-D projects the same repeated samples onto a K-bin histogram and trains the predictor with soft cross-entropy against the full empirical distribution. Both reuse the served LLM's last-layer hidden state and need no auxiliary model at inference time.
key_innovation.zh: 將 prompt-only length prediction 重新定義為從 prompt-conditioned 長度分佈進行的 robust estimation (ProD)。兩個變體：(i) ProD-M 對每個 prompt 採樣 r 次獨立生成，取樣本中位數作為訓練標籤，使監督訊號對齊 MAE 下的 Bayes-optimal conditional median；(ii) ProD-D 將同樣的多次採樣投影至 K 個 bin 的 histogram，並以 soft cross-entropy 訓練預測器擬合完整經驗分佈。兩者皆重用 serving LLM 最後一層的 hidden state，inference 時不需額外輔助模型。

key_improvements.en: ProD-D achieves the lowest average MAE: 56.78 on Qwen-2.5-7B and 44.31 on Llama-3-8B across Math, Coding, LongSequence, and Chat scenarios, beating the strongest baseline TRAIL-Last (64.23 / 49.08) by 11.6% and 9.7% respectively. Reduces average prediction error by up to 25% over previous SOTA. Advantage persists under fixed total inference budgets, confirming gain comes from supervision-target design rather than predictor complexity.
key_improvements.zh: ProD-D 在 Math、Coding、LongSequence、Chat 四個情境上取得最低平均 MAE：Qwen-2.5-7B 為 56.78、Llama-3-8B 為 44.31，分別較最強 baseline TRAIL-Last（64.23、49.08）改善 11.6% 與 9.7%。整體平均預測誤差較先前 SOTA 降低達 25%。在固定總 inference budget 條件下優勢依舊維持，顯示提升來自監督目標設計而非預測器複雜度。

compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA Tesla A100 80GB, Intel Xeon Platinum 8358
reported_accuracy: MAE 30.35 / 31.76 / 51.41 / 113.60 (Qwen Math/Coding/LongSeq/Chat); MAE 19.57 / 26.61 / 37.68 / 93.39 (Llama Math/Coding/LongSeq/Chat) for ProD-D
validation_workloads: GSM8K (Math), MBPP (Coding), LongBench (LongSequence), LMSys-Chat-1M (Chat)

scope_assumptions.en: Focuses on the prompt-only static prediction setting (predict before decoding begins); the iterative refinement during decoding is acknowledged as a future extension. Theoretical guarantee derived via a simplified linear surrogate with bounded representations and symmetric, weakly concentrated noise. Predictors are single-shot at inference time, even though training uses repeated sampling (16 generations per prompt; temperature 0.8).
scope_assumptions.zh: 聚焦於 prompt-only 的靜態預測情境（在 decoding 開始前做預測）；decoding 過程中的迭代式 refinement 被列為未來工作。理論保證係透過簡化的線性 surrogate 推導，假設表徵有界、雜訊對稱且弱集中。Inference 時為 single-shot，雖然訓練使用 repeated sampling（每個 prompt 16 次生成、temperature 0.8）。

title: SAGA: Workflow-Atomic Scheduling for AI Agent Inference on GPU Clusters
authors: Dongxin Guo; Jikun Wu; Siu-Ming Yiu
venue_full: ACM International Symposium on High-Performance Parallel and Distributed Computing
affiliations: The University of Hong Kong, Brain Investing Limited, Stellaris AI Limited
research_focus: Agentic / Workflow serving, Long-context / Prefix cache, Multi-tenant scheduling, KV cache offloading, LLM serving

problem_statement.en: AI agents execute tens to hundreds of chained LLM calls per task, yet GPU schedulers treat each call as independent and discard gigabytes of intermediate KV state between steps, inflating end-to-end latency by 3-8x. The request-level scheduling abstraction is fundamentally mismatched to compound AI workloads, which exhibit sequential dependency with variable gaps, KV-cache continuity across steps, and bursty correlated request patterns.
problem_statement.zh: AI agent 每項任務串接數十至數百次 LLM 呼叫，但 GPU 排程器仍將每次呼叫視為獨立 request，在步驟間丟棄 GB 級的中間 KV 狀態，使端到端延遲膨脹 3-8x。Request-level 排程抽象與 compound AI workload 本質上不匹配：後者具備帶可變間隔的順序相依、跨步驟的 KV cache 連續性，以及群聚而關聯的 request 突發模式。

key_innovation.en: SAGA proposes program-level scheduling that treats the entire agent workflow as the first-class schedulable unit via three mechanisms: (i) Agent Execution Graphs (AEGs) capture workflow structure for predictive cache retention with workflow-aware LRU (WA-LRU) eviction proven within 1.31x of Belady optimal; (ii) session-affinity batching with work stealing co-locates correlated requests while preserving load balance; (iii) Agent Fair Share (AFS) provides a task-completion-time fairness metric with Lyapunov-drift bounded deviation guarantees.
key_innovation.zh: SAGA 提出 program-level 排程，將整個 agent workflow 視為一等公民的可排程單位，包含三個機制：(i) Agent Execution Graph（AEG）捕捉 workflow 結構，並以 workflow-aware LRU（WA-LRU）做預測式 cache 保留，經證明在 Belady optimal 1.31x 之內；(ii) 結合 work stealing 的 session-affinity batching，在維持負載平衡的同時將關聯 request 共置；(iii) Agent Fair Share（AFS）提供以任務完成時間為基礎的公平性指標，並透過 Lyapunov drift 給出偏差界限保證。

baselines_compared: vLLM v0.6.0, vLLM v0.15.1 + APC, SGLang, Llumnix, TRT-LLM+Scaffolding, vLLM+KVFlow

key_improvements.en: 1.64x geometric-mean reduction in task completion time over vLLM v0.15.1 with prefix caching (p<0.001), 1.22x GPU memory utilization improvement, and 99.2% SLO attainment under multi-tenant interference. 3.01x speedup over vLLM v0.6.0 on SWE-bench; 1.47x over vLLM+KVFlow.
key_improvements.zh: 相較啟用 prefix caching 的 vLLM v0.15.1，任務完成時間幾何平均降低 1.64x（p<0.001），GPU 記憶體利用率提升 1.22x，多租戶干擾下達成 99.2% SLO；相較 vLLM v0.6.0 在 SWE-bench 上加速 3.01x，相較 vLLM+KVFlow 加速 1.47x。

ai_task: LLM Serving, Multi-agent Systems, AI Inference KV Cache transfer
reported_accuracy: WA-LRU achieves empirical competitive ratio 1.31 vs Belady on SWE-bench (1.28 on WebArena); AEG pattern inference reaches 87% next-step transition accuracy without framework hints
validation_workloads: SWE-bench (500 verified), WebArena (812 browser tasks), BurstGPT-derived synthetic multi-tenant

scope_assumptions.en: Performance is best with framework-level execution-graph hints (LangChain callbacks, AutoGen logs); without hints SAGA falls back to pattern inference (15.6% TCT degradation), and degrades further on dynamic multi-agent frameworks (AutoGen, CrewAI) where AEG structure is generated on the fly. TTL prediction assumes empirical tool-call latency distributions (black-swan events >5x P99 still cause eviction). AFS requires task-duration estimates that may be inaccurate for unprofiled agent types. Single-datacenter scope; empirical evaluation uses Llama-3-70B only; evaluation reaches 71-75% peak utilization, so behavior under over-subscription (>95%) is analyzed but not empirically validated.
scope_assumptions.zh: 在具備框架層級執行圖提示（LangChain callback、AutoGen log）時表現最佳；無提示時 SAGA 退回模式推論（TCT 退化 15.6%），在 AEG 結構於 runtime 才生成的動態多 agent 框架（AutoGen、CrewAI）上退化更明顯。TTL 預測假設工具呼叫延遲為經驗分佈（>5x P99 的黑天鵝事件仍會觸發 eviction）。AFS 需要任務耗時估計，對未經 profile 的 agent 類型可能不準。範圍限於單一資料中心；實證僅使用 Llama-3-70B；評估只達 71-75% 峰值利用率，>95% 過載情境僅做理論分析未實證。

title: Taming Throughput-Latency Tradeoff in LLM Inference with Sarathi-Serve
authors: Amey Agrawal; Nitin Kedia; Ashish Panwar; Jayashree Mohan; Nipun Kwatra; Bhargav S. Gulavani; Alexey Tumanov; Ramachandran Ramjee
venue_full: USENIX Symposium on Operating Systems Design and Implementation
affiliations: Microsoft Research India, Georgia Institute of Technology
research_focus: Continuous batching, LLM serving, Multi-tenant scheduling, Performance modeling, Roofline analysis

problem_statement.en: LLM inference scheduling faces a fundamental throughput-latency tradeoff: prefill-prioritizing schedulers (vLLM, Orca) boost throughput but cause multi-second generation stalls that violate TBT SLOs, while decode-prioritizing schedulers (FasterTransformer) keep TBT low but under-utilize compute. Pipeline-parallel deployments further suffer from pipeline bubbles caused by heterogeneous prefill and decode batch execution times.
problem_statement.zh: LLM 推理排程面臨吞吐量與延遲的根本權衡：prefill-prioritizing scheduler（如 vLLM、Orca）提升吞吐量但會造成數秒級的 generation stall，違反 TBT SLO；decode-prioritizing scheduler（如 FasterTransformer）雖維持低 TBT 但 GPU 計算利用率偏低；pipeline parallel 部署更受 prefill 與 decode batch 執行時間差異所致的 pipeline bubble 困擾。

key_innovation.en: Sarathi-Serve introduces chunked-prefills — splitting a prefill into near-equal-sized token chunks — combined with stall-free batching that adds new requests to a running batch without pausing on-going decodes. By forming near-uniform hybrid batches under a tunable per-iteration token budget (selected via Vidur-based profiling), it simultaneously achieves high throughput, low TBT tail latency, and reduced pipeline bubbles.
key_innovation.zh: Sarathi-Serve 提出 chunked-prefills，將 prefill 切分成大小近似的 token chunk，並結合 stall-free batching：在不暫停進行中 decode 的前提下將新請求加入正在執行的 batch；透過可調的每 iteration token budget（以 Vidur profile 決定），形成近乎均勻的 hybrid batch，同時達到高吞吐量、低 TBT tail latency 與更少的 pipeline bubble。

key_improvements.en: Up to 2.6x higher serving capacity for Mistral-7B on a single A100; up to 3.7x higher capacity for Yi-34B on two A100s; up to 5.6x end-to-end gain for Falcon-180B with pipeline parallelism on commodity Ethernet.
key_improvements.zh: Mistral-7B 於單顆 A100 上服務容量提升最多 2.6x；Yi-34B 於兩顆 A100 提升最多 3.7x；Falcon-180B 在以一般 Ethernet 連線的 pipeline parallel 部署下端到端容量提升最多 5.6x。

ai_task: LLM Serving
traffic_pattern: Continuous Batching, Pipeline Parallelism, Tensor Parallelism
reported_accuracy: Not Reported (token budget chosen via Vidur profiling; paper reports serving capacity and P99 TBT rather than per-iteration latency MAPE)
validation_workloads: openchat_sharegpt4, arxiv_summarization

scope_assumptions.en: Built atop vLLM v0.x with FlashAttention v2 / FlashInfer kernels for paged chunked-prefill; token budget assumes a one-time offline profile of (model, hardware, SLO) and is fixed at deployment; tile-quantization effects forced careful chunk-size selection (chunk 257 increased prefill time 32% versus 256); long-context evaluation filters requests above 8192 (sharegpt4) or 16384 (arxiv_summarization) tokens; pipeline-parallel deployments evaluated only on Falcon-180B over commodity Ethernet at 100 Gbps; KV cache treatment inherits vLLM PagedAttention assumptions (HBM only).
scope_assumptions.zh: 建構於 vLLM v0.x 並使用 FlashAttention v2 / FlashInfer kernel 支援 paged chunked-prefill；token budget 假設一次性離線 profile（model、hardware、SLO）並於部署時固定；tile-quantization 效應使 chunk size 選擇必須謹慎（chunk size 257 較 256 增加 32% prefill 時間）；長 context 評估過濾掉 8192（sharegpt4）或 16384（arxiv_summarization）以上的請求；pipeline parallel 部署僅於 Falcon-180B 以 100 Gbps Ethernet 評估；KV cache 處理沿用 vLLM PagedAttention 的 HBM-only 假設。

title: Scalable Processing-Near-Memory for 1M-Token LLM Inference: CXL-Enabled KV-Cache Management Beyond GPU Limits
authors: Dowon Kim; MinJae Lee; Janghyeon Kim; HyuckSung Kwon; Hyeonggyu Jeong; Sang-Soo Park; Minyong Yoon; Si-Dong Roh; Yongsuk Kwon; Jinin So; Jungwook Choi
venue_full: International Conference on Parallel Architectures and Compilation Techniques
research_focus: Long-context / Prefix cache, Datacenter networking

problem_statement.en: Long-context LLM inference suffers from severe memory and compute bottlenecks due to the linear scaling of the KV-cache, which leads to costly data recall overheads and GPU memory pressure that limits batch sizes.
problem_statement.zh: 長 context LLM inference 因 KV cache 線性擴展而面臨嚴重的記憶體與計算瓶頸，導致高昂的資料召回開銷以及 GPU 記憶體壓力，進而限制 batch size。

key_innovation.en: A CXL-enabled Processing-Near-Memory (PNM) architecture that offloads KV-cache management and attention computation to PNM accelerators, combined with a hybrid GPU-PNM execution model using steady-token selection to maintain large batch sizes.
key_innovation.zh: 以 CXL 為基礎的 Processing-Near-Memory（PNM）架構：將 KV cache 管理與 attention 計算卸載至 PNM 加速器，並結合 GPU-PNM 混合執行模型與穩態 token 選擇策略，以維持大 batch size。

baselines_compared: NVIDIA DGX appliance with A100-80GB GPUs, ArkVale

key_improvements.en: Up to 21.9x throughput improvement, up to 60x lower energy per token, and up to 7.3x better total cost efficiency.
key_improvements.zh: throughput 最高提升 21.9x，每 token 能耗最高降低 60x，總體成本效率最高改善 7.3x。

software_simulator: Cycle-level simulator parameterized by synthesized timing and power models
network_topology: CXL switch-based shared memory pool, Rack-scale
ai_task: LLM Serving, Long-context LLM Inference
traffic_pattern: Tensor Parallelism, Data Parallelism, GPU-CXL DMA
compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA A100-80GB, Intel 4th-generation Xeon CPU, LPDDR5X

title: Scepsy: Serving Agentic Workflows Using Aggregate LLM Pipelines
authors: Marcel Wagenländer; Otto White; Britannio Jarrett; Pedro Silvestre; Yanda Tao; Guo Li; Huanzhou Zhu; Lluís Vilanova; Peter Pietzuch
research_focus: Agentic / Workflow serving, LLM serving, Multi-tenant scheduling, Capacity planning, Performance modeling

problem_statement.en: Agentic workflows compose multiple heterogeneous LLMs and tools whose end-to-end latency is highly variable, yet small-to-medium clusters oversubscribe scarce GPUs and lack workflow-aware GPU allocation. Existing systems either run LLMs in isolation (no workflow awareness) or rely on temporal request scheduling rather than allocating fractional GPU resources jointly across LLMs.
