problem_statement.zh: Agentic workflow 結合多種異質 LLM 與工具，端到端延遲高度變異；中小型叢集面對稀缺 GPU 易發生超賣，且缺乏 workflow-aware 的 GPU 配置。現有系統要麼將 LLM 視為獨立服務（無 workflow 視野），要麼僅以時間維度排程 request，未跨 LLM 聯合分配分數 GPU 資源。

key_innovation.en: Scepsy introduces the Aggregate LLM Pipeline abstraction: from execution traces it extracts per-LLM relative statistics (mean invocations n_m, request-level parallelism p_m) that remain stable across runs, then synthesizes a pipeline-level throughput/latency predictor. A joint scheduler searches over fractional GPU shares, tensor-parallel degrees, and replica counts using the predictor, followed by topology-aware fractional GPU placement on a Kubernetes cluster via NVIDIA MPS.
key_innovation.zh: Scepsy 提出 Aggregate LLM Pipeline 抽象：由執行 trace 萃取每個 LLM 的相對統計量（平均 invocation 數 n_m 與 request-level parallelism p_m），這些量在不同 run 間穩定；再合成 pipeline 層級的 throughput 與 latency 預測器。聯合排程器以該預測器搜尋分數 GPU share、tensor parallel degree 與 replica 數量，並在 Kubernetes 叢集上透過 NVIDIA MPS 進行 topology-aware 的分數 GPU 配置。

key_improvements.en: Up to 2.4x higher throughput and 27x lower latency vs systems that optimize LLMs independently or rely on user-specified allocations; on beam search Scepsy attains 2.5x throughput on 4 GPUs and 2.9x on 8 GPUs over Aegaeon, with 3.4x/4.5x latency improvements.
key_improvements.zh: 相較將 LLM 獨立優化或依靠使用者指定資源的系統，throughput 最高提升 2.4x、延遲最高降低 27x；在 beam search 上相較 Aegaeon，4 GPU 與 8 GPU 分別達到 2.5x 與 2.9x throughput，延遲分別改進 3.4x 與 4.5x。

ai_task: LLM Serving, Multi-agent Systems, RAG
compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA RTX A6000, AMD EPYC 7402P, HBM
gpu_count: 16x NVIDIA RTX A6000 (4 machines x 4 GPUs)
reported_accuracy: Not Reported (paper validates predictor implicitly by scheduler-driven throughput/latency gains rather than reporting MAPE)
models_validated: Llama-3.2-1B, Llama-3.2-8B, Llama-3.1-8B-PRM, Llama-2-7B, math-shepherd, e5-base-v2
validation_workloads: RAG+reranker, Beam search, combined RAG+beam workload

scope_assumptions.en: Aggregate LLM Pipeline relies on the empirical observation that per-LLM relative execution-time shares are stable across runs even when absolute end-to-end latency varies up to 4x; assumes Kubernetes deployment with NVIDIA MPS enforcing GPU-fraction isolation; topology-aware placement assumes intra-node NVLink and inter-node interconnect, with one vLLM/SGLang replica per LLM and an SGLang router per workflow; non-LLM components (tools, databases) are discarded from the model as their GPU cost is assumed negligible.
scope_assumptions.zh: Aggregate LLM Pipeline 依賴一項經驗觀察：每個 LLM 的相對執行時間佔比在不同 run 之間穩定，即便絕對端到端延遲變異可達 4x；假設 Kubernetes 部署且以 NVIDIA MPS 強制分數 GPU 隔離；topology-aware 配置假設 intra-node NVLink 與 inter-node 互聯，每個 LLM 配一個 vLLM 或 SGLang replica，每條 workflow 配一個 SGLang router；模型刻意忽略非 LLM 組件（工具、資料庫），因為其 GPU 成本被視為可忽略。

title: Scheduling the Unschedulable: Taming Black-Box LLM Inference at Scale
authors: Renzhong Yuan; Yijun Zeng; Xiaosong Gao; Linxi Yu; Haochun Liao; Han Wang
research_focus: LLM serving, Multi-tenant scheduling, Length prediction, SLO admission, Performance modeling

problem_statement.en: When LLM inference is consumed through hosted black-box APIs, the client cannot reorder or preempt in-flight requests and the provider's internal scheduling is opaque; without per-request output-length priors, classical size-aware or weighted fair queueing cannot transfer to the API boundary. The question is what becomes possible at the client side once coarse output-length predictors (e.g. SageSched) make scheduling semi-clairvoyant.
problem_statement.zh: 當 LLM 推論透過託管的黑盒 API 消費時，客戶端無法重排或搶占 in-flight request，提供方內部排程亦不可觀察；缺乏 per-request 輸出長度先驗時，傳統 size-aware 或加權公平排隊無法跨越此 API 邊界。本研究探討：在 SageSched 等粗粒度輸出長度預測器讓排程具備 semi-clairvoyant 特性後，客戶端能做到什麼。

key_innovation.en: A three-layer client-side scheduling decomposition for token-predictable black-box LLM APIs: (i) Allocation via congestion-aware adaptive Deficit Round Robin (DRR) over size classes; (ii) Ordering via slowdown-aware feasible-set scoring score=w*(wait/cost) - w*(size/ref) + w*urgency; (iii) Overload control via an explicit admit/defer/reject cost ladder gated by a severity score combining provider load, queue pressure, and tail-latency ratio. The design treats coarse token priors as a first-class scheduling input.
key_innovation.zh: 針對 token 可預測的黑盒 LLM API，提出三層客戶端排程分解：(i) Allocation 採壅塞感知的自適應 Deficit Round Robin（DRR）跨類別配額；(ii) Ordering 採 slowdown-aware feasible-set 評分 score=w*(wait/cost) - w*(size/ref) + w*urgency；(iii) Overload control 以 admit/defer/reject 的成本梯度判定，閾值由 provider_load、queue_pressure 與 tail_latency_ratio 合成的 severity score 觸發。此設計將粗粒度 token 先驗視為一等公民的排程輸入。

baselines_compared: FIFO (direct dispatch), quota-tiered, naive class-only routing

key_improvements.en: Under balanced/high congestion the full stack achieves 100% completion, 100% deadline satisfaction, and 4.2+/-1.6 SLO-meeting goodput req/s with short-request P95 within tens of milliseconds. On ShareGPT replay: 4.4x short-P95 improvement over naive dispatch (330 vs 1449 ms) and 1.9x global-P95 reduction (17470 vs 33337 ms). Removing magnitude information inflates short-request P95 by up to 5.8x.
key_improvements.zh: 在 balanced/high 壅塞情境下，完整堆疊達成 100% 完成率、100% 截止期滿足率，以及 4.2+/-1.6 req/s 的 SLO 達標 goodput，且短 request P95 控制在數十 ms。在 ShareGPT replay 中：短 request P95 相較 naive dispatch 改善 4.4x（330 vs 1449 ms）、全域 P95 降低 1.9x（17470 vs 33337 ms）。移除幅度資訊會使短 request P95 膨脹最高 5.8x。

ai_task: LLM Serving
reported_accuracy: Latency calibration on Volcengine Doubao yields latency_ms = 3294 + 18.7 x output_tokens with R^2 = 0.97; predictor-noise sweep confirms graceful degradation up to 60% multiplicative error on coarse priors
models_validated: Volcengine Doubao (used only for latency calibration of the mock provider)
validation_workloads: Synthetic balanced/heavy-dominated mixes x medium/high congestion (5 seeds each), ShareGPT-English real-trace validation

scope_assumptions.en: Client-side scheduler only; assumes the provider is an opaque black-box API whose internal state is hidden and in-flight requests cannot be preempted. Output-length priors are coarse (token magnitudes from SageSched-style predictor), not oracle; the formulation rests on output-length predictability. Mock provider is an abstraction calibrated to a single LLM API (Volcengine Doubao) under low load, not a faithful model of any specific vendor. Authors explicitly cite this as a boundary condition: the same code reduces to blind budgeting if magnitude priors are unavailable.
scope_assumptions.zh: 純客戶端排程器；假設 provider 為黑盒 API，內部狀態不可見、in-flight request 無法被搶占。輸出長度先驗為粗粒度（SageSched 風格的 token magnitude），非 oracle；整個論點立基於輸出長度可預測性。Mock provider 為抽象化模型，僅以單一 LLM API（Volcengine Doubao）低負載校準，並非任何 vendor 的忠實模型。作者明白指出此為邊界條件：若無 magnitude 先驗，同一份程式碼將退化為盲目預算分配。

title: ScoreFlow: Mastering LLM Agent Workflows via Score-based Preference Optimization
authors: Yinjie Wang; Ling Yang; Guohao Li; Mengdi Wang; Bryon Aragam
affiliations: University of Chicago (Yinjie Wang, Bryon Aragam);
research_focus: Agentic / Workflow serving

problem_statement.en: Existing automated agentic-workflow optimization methods are inflexible: they rely on rigid workflow representations, produce a single static workflow for an entire task set (poor adaptability/scalability), and use discrete optimization (e.g. MCTS in AFlow, iterative failed-case refinement in ADAS) that converges prematurely and incurs high API costs. The goal is to automatically generate, for each input query, an adaptive multi-agent workflow that maximizes task performance at low cost.
problem_statement.zh: 現有的自動化 agentic-workflow 最佳化方法缺乏彈性:其依賴僵化的 workflow 表徵,對整個任務集僅產生單一靜態 workflow(適應性與可擴充性不佳),並採用離散最佳化(例如 AFlow 的 MCTS、ADAS 的迭代式失敗案例修正),導致過早收斂且產生高昂的 API 成本。本研究目標為針對每一筆輸入 query,自動生成能在低成本下最大化任務表現的自適應 multi-agent workflow。

key_innovation.en: An open-source LLM workflow generator that emits per-query Python-code workflows is fine-tuned by gradient-based optimization in continuous parameter space using Score-DPO, a DPO variant that (1) up-weights preference pairs by their measured task-score difference and (2) scales the implicit DPO rewards by monotone functions of the raw evaluation scores, so more-confident/higher-scoring workflows exert proportionally larger influence on the loss.
key_innovation.zh: 本研究提出一個開源的 LLM workflow 生成器,可針對每一筆 query 輸出以 Python 程式碼表示的 workflow,並透過 Score-DPO 在連續參數空間中以梯度式最佳化進行 fine-tune。Score-DPO 為 DPO 之變體,其(1)依據所量測的任務分數差異,對偏好對(preference pair)加權;(2)以原始評估分數的單調函數縮放隱式 DPO reward,使置信度較高、分數較高的 workflow 對損失施加成比例的更大影響。

baselines_compared: IO, Chain-of-Thought, Self-Consistency CoT, MedPrompt, MultiPersona Debate, Self-Refine, ADAS, AFlow, SFT, PPO

key_improvements.en: Avg 85.3% vs AFlow 80.6%; 8B generator exceeds API-model generators; Score-DPO > SFT/PPO/DPO on every dataset.
key_improvements.zh: 六評測平均 85.3% 對 AFlow 80.6%;8B 生成器優於 API 模型生成器;Score-DPO 在所有資料集勝過 SFT/PPO/DPO。

structure_space: Workflow code, Operator / node graph, Prompts (joint), Team composition (agent set)
decision_mechanism: Preference optimization (DPO-style), Trained generator (SFT)
optimization_signal: Task utility (accuracy), Preference pairs, Validation-set score
benchmarks_used: HumanEval, MBPP, GSM8K, MATH, DROP, HotpotQA

agent_scenario.en: Task-solving multi-agent workflows within a single domain per benchmark (QA / coding / math). A trained generator LLM emits a Python-coded workflow composed of predefined reusable operators (agents): Custom, CustomCodeGenerate, AnswerGenerate, Programmer (writes+executes Python), ScEnsemble (selects best of multiple solutions), Review, Test (runs public test cases), and a final Answer-Extractor Agent appended after the final response. A separate executor LLM runs the generated workflow to produce the answer. Agent-set size is adaptive per task (workflows range from 1 agent to 5+), and operator system prompts are customizable by the generator. Operator design follows the AFlow framework.
agent_scenario.zh: 每個 benchmark 在單一領域(QA/coding/math)內的任務求解 multi-agent workflow。一個經訓練的生成器 LLM 輸出以 Python 程式碼表示的 workflow,其由預先定義且可重複使用的 operator(agent)組成:Custom、CustomCodeGenerate、AnswerGenerate、Programmer(撰寫並執行 Python)、ScEnsemble(從多個解中選取最佳者)、Review、Test(執行公開測試案例),以及附加於最終回應之後的 Answer-Extractor Agent。另有一個獨立的執行器 LLM 執行所生成的 workflow 以產出答案。Agent 集合的規模依任務自適應調整(workflow 由 1 個 agent 至 5 個以上不等),且 operator 的 system prompt 可由生成器自訂。Operator 設計沿用 AFlow 框架。

title: Serving Long-Context LLMs at the Mobile Edge: Test-Time Reinforcement Learning-based Model Caching and Inference Offloading
authors: Minrui Xu; Dusit Niyato; Christopher G. Brinton
research_focus: LLM serving, Long-context / Prefix cache, Multi-tenant scheduling, Reasoning / Test-time scaling, Agentic / Workflow serving

problem_statement.en: Resource-limited mobile edge networks struggle to support long-context LLM serving for LLM agents during multi-round interactions, because LLMs continuously learn from context (raising accuracy, latency, and resource-consumption dynamics) and can overflow context windows. Existing stateless computation offloading and static service offloading cannot accommodate these dynamics.
problem_statement.zh: 資源受限的 mobile edge 網路難以支援 LLM agent 在多輪互動中的長 context LLM serving：LLM 會持續從 context 中學習（使準確度、延遲與資源消耗具動態性），且可能造成 context window 溢位。現有的無狀態 computation offloading 與靜態 service offloading 無法因應此類動態。

key_innovation.en: A joint model-caching and inference-offloading framework formulated as a mixed-integer/MDP problem, solved by a test-time deep reinforcement learning (T2DRL) algorithm whose actor-critic uses test-time-training models to adapt caching and offloading decisions during execution. It further introduces a Double Dutch Auction (DDA) that dynamically matches edge-server supply with user-device demand, maximizing social welfare while remaining individually rational, incentive-compatible, and budget-balanced.
key_innovation.zh: 提出聯合 model caching 與 inference offloading 的框架，並將其建模為 mixed-integer/MDP 問題；以 test-time deep reinforcement learning (T2DRL) 求解，其 actor-critic 採用 test-time-training 模型，於執行期動態調整 caching 與 offloading 決策。此外導入 Double Dutch Auction (DDA)，動態匹配 edge server 供給與 user device 需求，在維持 individual rationality、incentive compatibility 與 budget balance 的前提下最大化 social welfare。

key_improvements.en: The T2DRL algorithm reduces total system cost by at least 30% versus baselines (and outperforms PPO by about 20% in cost efficiency) while guaranteeing the perception and reasoning performance of LLM agents; the DDA reaches market clearing with strong budget balance and incentive compatibility.
key_improvements.zh: T2DRL 相較 baselines 將總系統成本降低至少 30%（成本效率較 PPO 高約 20%），同時保證 LLM agent 的感知與推理表現；DDA 則在強 budget balance 與 incentive compatibility 下達成市場結清。

ai_task: LLM Serving, Multi-agent Systems
node_count: N edge servers + 1 cloud data center (simulated)

title: SGLang: Efficient Execution of Structured Language Model Programs
authors: Lianmin Zheng; Liangsheng Yin; Zhiqiang Xie; Chuyue Sun; Jeff Huang; Cody Hao Yu; Shiyi Cao; Christos Kozyrakis; Ion Stoica; Joseph E. Gonzalez; Clark Barrett; Ying Sheng
venue_full: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 37 (NeurIPS 2024)
affiliations: Stanford University, UC Berkeley, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Texas A&M University, Independent Researcher
research_focus: LLM serving, Long-context / Prefix cache, Agentic / Workflow serving, Multimodal serving

problem_statement.en: LM programs (agents, tree-of-thought, few-shot pipelines, multi-turn chat) issue many dependent LLM calls that share prompt prefixes, but state-of-the-art inference engines (vLLM, TGI, TensorRT-LLM) discard the KV cache once a request finishes, recomputing shared prefixes across calls; constrained decoding for structured outputs (e.g. JSON) also proceeds one token at a time. Programming such multi-call workflows is additionally tedious and brittle.
problem_statement.zh: Agent、tree-of-thought、few-shot pipeline 與多輪對話等 LM program 會發出大量共享 prompt 前綴的相依 LLM 呼叫，然而 vLLM、TGI、TensorRT-LLM 等最先進推理引擎在請求結束後即丟棄 KV cache，使共享前綴在多次呼叫間被重複計算；針對結構化輸出（如 JSON）的 constrained decoding 也只能逐 token 解碼。此外，撰寫此類 multi-call 工作流程繁瑣且易出錯。

key_innovation.en: RadixAttention: keeps the KV cache of all finished requests in a radix tree mapping token sequences to paged KV tensors (one token per page). Running requests pin nodes via reference counters; eviction is a leaf-first LRU policy (evicting leaves exposes ancestors for later eviction). No fixed cache pool is preallocated — cached and running requests share one memory pool, and cached tokens are evicted in favor of larger batches when needed. A cache-aware longest-shared-prefix-first scheduler approximates the DFS order proven hit-rate-optimal for offline batches (Theorem 3.1). Complemented by a compressed finite state machine for multi-token constrained decoding and API speculative execution.
key_innovation.zh: RadixAttention：以 radix tree 將 token 序列映射至 paged KV cache tensor（每頁一個 token），保留所有已完成請求的 KV cache。執行中請求以 reference counter 釘住節點；淘汰採 leaf-first LRU 策略（先淘汰葉節點，使其祖先成為葉節點後亦可淘汰）。系統不預先保留固定 cache pool——cache 與執行中請求共用同一記憶體池，必要時淘汰 cached token 以換取更大 batch。cache-aware scheduling 以 longest-shared-prefix-first 排序逼近離線批次下證明 hit rate 最優的 DFS 順序（Theorem 3.1）。另以 compressed finite state machine 實現多 token constrained decoding，並提供 API speculative execution。

baselines_compared: vLLM v0.2.5, Guidance v0.1.8 (llama.cpp), LMQL v0.7.3 (HF Transformers), LLaVA original HF Transformers implementation

key_improvements.en: Up to 6.4x higher throughput and up to 3.7x lower latency than vLLM/Guidance/LMQL on Llama-2 7B/70B and Mixtral-8x7B; up to 6x throughput on LLaVA image/video models; compressed FSM adds 1.6x throughput on JSON decoding. Cache-aware scheduling reaches ~96% of the optimal cache hit rate on average (hit rates 50%-99%). In Chatbot Arena production serving, RadixAttention hit rates of 52.4% (LLaVA-Next-34B) and 74.1% (Vicuna-33B) cut first-token latency by an average of 1.7x.
key_improvements.zh: 在 Llama-2 7B/70B 與 Mixtral-8x7B 上，相較 vLLM、Guidance、LMQL 吞吐量最高提升 6.4x、延遲最高降低 3.7x；LLaVA 影像/影片模型吞吐量最高提升 6x；compressed FSM 使 JSON decoding 吞吐量再提升 1.6x。cache-aware scheduling 平均達到最優 cache hit rate 的約 96%（hit rate 介於 50%-99%）。於 Chatbot Arena 生產部署中，RadixAttention hit rate 分別為 52.4%（LLaVA-Next-34B）與 74.1%（Vicuna-33B），使 first-token latency 平均降低 1.7x。

gpu_count: 1x A10G (7B models); multiple A10G via TP for larger models (count not specified)
reported_accuracy: Not a prediction model; cache-aware scheduling achieves ~96% of the offline-optimal cache hit rate on average, and RadixAttention overhead is <0.3% when no reuse exists.
models_validated: Llama-2-7B, Llama-2-70B, Mixtral-8x7B, LLaVA-v1.5-7B, LLaVA-NeXT-34B, GPT-3.5, Vicuna-33B
validation_workloads: MMLU (5-shot), HellaSwag (20-shot), ReAct agents, Generative agents, Tree-of-thought (GSM-8K), Skeleton-of-thought, LLM judge, JSON decoding, Multi-turn chat (synthetic), DSPy RAG pipeline, ShareGPT, llava-bench-in-the-wild, ActivityNet, Chatbot Arena (production)

scope_assumptions.en: Eviction is purely LRU on the radix tree (leaf-first, reference-count-pinned for in-flight requests) with no client lifecycle signal, TTL, or pricing/cost model; the authors note greedy cache-aware scheduling can cause starvation and leave fairness integration as future work. KV cache stays in single-level GPU memory — multi-level hierarchy (DRAM/disk) and fuzzy semantic matching are listed as future directions. Theorem 3.1's optimal-hit-rate DFS schedule assumes an offline batch and cache size >= maximum request length; online it is only approximated because output lengths are unpredictable. Evaluated at FP16 on single-node A10G/A100.
scope_assumptions.zh: 淘汰策略為 radix tree 上的純 LRU（leaf-first，執行中請求以 reference count 釘住），不含任何 client 生命週期訊號、TTL 或計價/成本模型；作者指出貪婪式 cache-aware scheduling 可能導致 starvation，公平性整合留作未來工作。KV cache 僅存於單層 GPU 記憶體——多層記憶體階層（DRAM/disk）與 fuzzy semantic matching 列為未來方向。Theorem 3.1 的最優 hit rate DFS 排程假設離線批次且 cache 容量 >= 最長請求長度，線上情形因輸出長度不可預測僅能近似。實驗以 FP16 於單節點 A10G/A100 進行。

title: Shadow in the Cache: Unveiling and Mitigating Privacy Risks of KV-cache in LLM Inference
authors: Zhifan Luo; Shuo Shao; Su Zhang; Lijing Zhou; Yuke Hu; Chenxu Zhao; Zhihao Liu; Zhan Qin
venue_full: Network and Distributed System Security Symposium
affiliations: Zhejiang University, Huawei Technology, Hangzhou High-Tech Zone (Binjiang) Institute of Blockchain and Data Security
research_focus: LLM serving, PD disaggregation

problem_statement.en: Production LLM systems often transfer and persist large KV caches in plaintext, exposing token-correlated internal representations even when user–server traffic is encrypted. An adversary with direct cache access can reconstruct sensitive user inputs through algebraic inversion, cache collision matching, or instruction-based injection.
problem_statement.zh: 生產環境中的 LLM 系統經常以明文傳輸與持久化大型 KV cache；即使 user–server traffic 已加密，與 token 高度相關的內部 representation 仍會暴露。可直接存取 cache 的 adversary 能透過 algebraic inversion、cache collision matching 或 instruction-based injection 重建敏感使用者輸入。

key_innovation.en: KV-Cloak protects each KV-cache block with secret reversible matrix transformations and a one-time random permutation, then algebraically fuses part of the obfuscation into attention-layer weights. Legitimate inference reverses the transformation losslessly, while exposed caches lose stable algebraic and semantic structure usable by reconstruction attacks.
key_innovation.zh: KV-Cloak 以秘密可逆 matrix transformation 與 one-time random permutation 保護每個 KV-cache block，並將部分 obfuscation 以代數方式融合至 attention-layer weight。合法 inference 可無損逆轉該 transformation，而外洩 cache 不再保有可供 reconstruction attack 利用的穩定代數與語意結構。

key_improvements.en: KV-Cloak reduces reconstruction under all three proposed attacks to near-zero, random-noise-level quality while preserving plaintext-level MMLU and SQuAD accuracy. With operator fusion, it adds 15.41 ms/GB, or 0.45% of prefill latency, in the reported micro-benchmark.
key_improvements.zh: KV-Cloak 將三種所提 attack 的 reconstruction quality 降至接近零、等同 random noise 的水準，同時維持與 plaintext 相當的 MMLU 與 SQuAD accuracy。採用 operator fusion 後，其 micro-benchmark 額外成本為 15.41 ms/GB，亦即 prefill latency 的 0.45%。

reuse_metric.en: KV-Cloak preserves plaintext-level MMLU and SQuAD accuracy while reducing reconstructed text under Inversion, Collision, and Injection attacks to near-zero, random-noise-level quality.
reuse_metric.zh: KV-Cloak 維持與 plaintext 相當的 MMLU 與 SQuAD accuracy，並將 Inversion、Collision 與 Injection attack 所重建之 text 降至接近零、等同 random noise 的品質水準。

title: ShadowServe: Interference-Free KV Cache Fetching for Distributed Prefix Caching
authors: Xingyu Xiang; Raj Joshi; Yuhan Liu; Jiayi Yao; Chenxingyu Zhao; Junchen Jiang; Yang Zhou; Eddie Kohler; Minlan Yu
affiliations: Harvard University, University of Chicago, University of Washington, UC Davis
research_focus: Datacenter networking

problem_statement.en: KV cache fetching in distributed prefix caching is bottlenecked by limited network bandwidth, and existing compression solutions cause significant interference with model computation when decompressed on the GPU.
problem_statement.zh: 分散式 prefix caching 中的 KV cache 抓取受限於有限的網路頻寬，而現有的壓縮方案在 GPU 上解壓縮時，會對模型計算造成顯著干擾。

key_innovation.en: ShadowServe, a SmartNIC-accelerated system that offloads KV cache fetching and decompression to the SmartNIC, using a chunked pipeline and minimal-copy memory management to eliminate host-side interference.
key_innovation.zh: ShadowServe 是一個以 SmartNIC 加速的系統，將 KV cache 的抓取與解壓縮卸載至 SmartNIC，藉由分塊流水線與最小化拷貝記憶體管理，徹底消除主機端的計算干擾。

key_improvements.en: Up to 2.2x lower loaded TPOT, up to 1.38x lower TTFT in low-bandwidth scenarios, and up to 1.35x higher throughput.
key_improvements.zh: 負載下 TPOT 最低降至原來的 1/2.2；低頻寬情境中 TTFT 最低降至原來的 1/1.38；throughput 最高提升 1.35x。

ai_task: LLM Serving, Distributed Prefix Caching
compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA L40S, Intel Xeon Gold 6526Y, 32GB DDR5 (on SmartNIC)
network_hw: NVIDIA BlueField-3 DPU, Mellanox ConnectX-7 400 Gbps NIC

title: Shift Parallelism: Low-Latency, High-Throughput LLM Inference for Dynamic Workloads
authors: Mert Hidayetoglu; Aurick Qiao; Michael Wyatt; Jeff Rasley; Yuxiong He; Samyam Rajbhandari
venue_full: ACM International Conference on Architectural Support for Programming Languages and Operating Systems (ASPLOS 2026)
research_focus: LLM serving, Multi-tenant scheduling, Continuous batching, Performance modeling, Hardware co-design, Agentic / Workflow serving

problem_statement.en: Tensor parallelism lowers per-request latency but sacrifices combined token throughput because of GPU communication, while data parallelism maximises throughput but has poor response latency. Existing serving systems cannot freely switch between the two because KV cache layout differs across parallelism modes.
problem_statement.zh: Tensor parallelism 可降低單請求延遲，但 GPU communication 會犧牲整體 token throughput；data parallelism 則提升 throughput，卻有較差的 response latency。既有服務系統無法自由切換兩者，因為不同 parallelism mode 的 KV cache layout 不一致。

key_innovation.en: Shift Parallelism adapts Ulysses-style sequence parallelism to inference and exploits KV-cache invariance between TP and SP. The runtime dynamically switches to TP for low-traffic latency and SP for high-traffic throughput, with load balancing and combined SP+TP support for grouped-query attention models.
key_innovation.zh: Shift Parallelism 將 Ulysses-style sequence parallelism 改造到 inference，並利用 TP 與 SP 之間 KV-cache invariance。Runtime 在低流量時切到 TP 追求 latency，在高流量時切到 SP 追求 throughput，並支援 GQA 模型的 load balancing 與 SP+TP 組合。

baselines_compared: vLLM data parallelism, vLLM tensor parallelism, sequence parallelism

key_improvements.en: Reports up to 1.51x faster response in interactive workloads and 50% higher throughput in batch workloads than TP-only serving. In bursty production-trace replay, Shift reduces median TTFT from 1355 ms for DP and 3930 ms for TP to 148 ms, while reaching 69k tokens/s peak throughput, close to DP and substantially above TP.
key_improvements.zh: 相較 TP-only serving，在 interactive workload 中 response 最高加速 1.51x，在 batch workload 中 throughput 最高提升 50%。於 bursty production-trace replay 中，Shift 將 median TTFT 從 DP 的 1355 ms、TP 的 3930 ms 降到 148 ms，同時達到約 69k tokens/s peak throughput，接近 DP 且明顯高於 TP。

reported_accuracy: Not Reported (parallel runtime/system paper; reports latency-throughput tradeoff rather than prediction error)
validation_workloads: Azure LLM Code trace, Mooncake Conversation trace, Synthetic bursty arrivals, HumanEval, CodeAct/SWE-bench

scope_assumptions.en: The design assumes models and runtimes can preserve KV-cache compatibility when shifting between TP and SP. It is strongest for multi-GPU H200-class deployments and leaves single-GPU kernel efficiency, host overhead, and arbitrary network-topology effects outside the main model.
scope_assumptions.zh: 此設計假設模型與 runtime 在 TP 與 SP 切換時能維持 KV-cache compatibility。它最適合多 GPU H200 級部署；single-GPU kernel efficiency、host overhead、以及任意 network topology 效應不是主要模型範圍。

title: Optimal Scheduling Algorithms for LLM Inference: Theory and Practice
authors: Agrim Bari; Parikshit Hegde; Gustavo de Veciana
venue_full: Proceedings of the ACM on Measurement and Analysis of Computing Systems (SIGMETRICS)
affiliations: The University of Texas at Austin
research_focus: Multi-tenant scheduling, PD disaggregation, Continuous batching, Queueing theory, Performance modeling, Roofline analysis

problem_statement.en: LLM inference scheduling combines a compute-bound prefill phase and a memory-bandwidth-bound decode phase whose batch composition jointly determines throughput, TTFT, and TBT. Existing schedulers either prioritize prefill or decode, leaving the optimal tiling and dynamic resource-allocation strategy across heterogeneous SLOs uncharacterized in theory and unmet in practice.
problem_statement.zh: LLM 推理排程同時涉及 compute-bound 的 prefill phase 與 memory-bandwidth-bound 的 decode phase，其 batch 組成決定 throughput、TTFT 與 TBT；既有 scheduler 不是偏好 prefill 就是偏好 decode，理論上未刻畫最佳 tiling 與 dynamic resource allocation 策略，實務上也無法滿足異質 SLO。

key_innovation.en: A theoretical LLM-inference scheduling framework that models GeMM/GeMV tile-level batch processing time and proves a Resource-Aware Dynamic (RAD) scheduler is throughput-optimal under mild assumptions. The practical SLO-Aware LLM Inference (SLAI) scheduler instantiates these principles, using online TBT measurements to prioritize near-deadline decode-iterations and reordering prefill-phase requests by known prompt length to reduce median TTFT.
key_innovation.zh: 建立 LLM 推理排程的理論框架，將 GeMM/GeMV tile 層級的 batch 處理時間明確建模，並在溫和假設下證明 Resource-Aware Dynamic（RAD）scheduler 為 throughput-optimal；其實務版本 SLO-Aware LLM Inference（SLAI）scheduler 透過線上 TBT 量測優先處理接近 deadline 的 decode iteration，並以已知 prompt 長度重排 prefill 請求以降低 median TTFT。

key_improvements.en: Compared to Sarathi-Serve on Mistral-7B with the openchat_shareGPT4 trace: median TTFT reduced by 53%; maximum serving capacity increased by 26% while keeping median TTFT under 0.5 s and meeting tail TBT constraints.
key_improvements.zh: 於 Mistral-7B + openchat_shareGPT4 trace 下與 Sarathi-Serve 比較：median TTFT 降低 53%；在 median TTFT 低於 0.5 秒並滿足 tail TBT 限制的條件下，最大服務容量提升 26%。

ai_task: LLM Serving
reported_accuracy: Not Reported (theoretical throughput-optimality proof; empirical claims expressed as TTFT/TBT and capacity rather than model MAPE)
validation_workloads: openchat_shareGPT4

scope_assumptions.en: Decoder-only Transformer with single-head attention generalized to GQA/MQA; GeMM/GeMV tile model assumes (a) sufficiently large matrices and (b) perfectly tiled, no-padding execution so the GPU hits peak FLOP/s; resource-planner does not turn nodes on/off (stationary arrivals); empirical evaluation on a single GPU and single model only; throughput-optimality proven under FCFS prefill ordering, with heterogeneous SLOs handled by the SLAI heuristic rather than re-proven optimal.
scope_assumptions.zh: decoder-only Transformer 並擴展支援 GQA/MQA；GeMM/GeMV tile 模型假設 (a) 矩陣足夠大且 (b) 完美對齊無 padding，使 GPU 達到 peak FLOP/s；resource planner 不做動態開關節點（穩態到達假設）；實驗僅於單 GPU 單模型上驗證；throughput-optimality 證明僅針對 FCFS prefill 排序，異質 SLO 由 SLAI 啟發式處理，未重新證明最佳性。

title: Slim Fly: A Cost Effective Low-Diameter Network Topology
authors: Maciej Besta; Torsten Hoefler
venue: Int Conf High Perform Comput Netw Storage Anal
venue_full: International Conference for High Performance Computing, Networking, Storage and Analysis
research_focus: Datacenter networking, Network topology, Energy / Carbon

problem_statement.en: High-performance computing and datacenter networks face challenges with high latency, high costs, and energy consumption due to sub-optimal network diameters in existing topologies.
problem_statement.zh: 高效能運算與資料中心網路因現有拓撲的次優網路直徑，而面臨高 latency、高成本與高能耗等挑戰。

key_innovation.en: Slim Fly, a high-performance, cost-effective network topology based on graphs that approximate the solution to the degree-diameter problem, achieving near-optimal network diameter.
key_innovation.zh: Slim Fly 是一種高效能且具成本效益的網路拓撲，以近似求解 degree-diameter 問題的圖論結構為基礎，實現接近最優的網路直徑。

baselines_compared: Torus 3D, Torus 5D, Hypercube, Fat Tree, Flattened Butterfly, Dragonfly, Random topologies (DLN), Long Hop

key_improvements.en: 25% cost and power benefit over Dragonfly, lower latency, high resiliency, and scalability to over 100K endpoints with diameter two.
key_improvements.zh: 相較於 Dragonfly，成本與功耗降低 25%；latency 更低、韌性更高；在直徑為 2 的前提下可擴展至超過 10 萬個端點。

network_topology: Slim Fly, Fat-Tree, Dragonfly, Flattened Butterfly, Torus, Hypercube, Long Hop, Random topologies
ai_task: HPC workloads, Stencil computations, Graph computations, Deep learning, Irregular matrix computations
traffic_pattern: Uniform random traffic, Bit complement, Bit reversal, Shuffle, Shift traffic, Worst-case adversarial traffic
compute_memory_hw: Black Widow 64-port routers, Mellanox 108-port Director, Mellanox IB FDR10 routers
network_hw: Mellanox IB FDR10 40Gb/s QSFP, Mellanox IB QDR 56Gb/s QSFP, Mellanox Ethernet 40Gb/s QSFP, Elpeus Ethernet 10Gb/s SFP+
routing_and_congestion_control: Minimal static routing (MIN), Valiant Random Routing (VAL), UGAL-L, UGAL-G, DFSSSP

title: SparseX: Efficient Segment-Level KV Cache Sharing for Interleaved LLM Serving
authors: Quqing Zhang; Kai Chen; Ning Liao; Zehao Lin; Bo Tang; Feiyu Xiong; Zhiyu Li; Xiaoxing Wang
research_focus: LLM serving, Long-context / Prefix cache, Agentic / Workflow serving

problem_statement.en: Repeated content in multi-round chat, RAG, and agent workflows often appears as interleaved non-prefix segments, beyond the hit condition of conventional Prefix Cache. Direct arbitrary-position KV cache reuse is inaccurate because a segment's hidden states and KV tensors depend on both its prefix context and position.
problem_statement.zh: 多輪對話、RAG 與 agent workflow 中的重複內容，經常以交錯的非 prefix segment 出現，超出傳統 Prefix Cache 的命中條件。由於 segment 的 hidden state 與 KV tensor 同時依賴其 prefix context 與位置，直接進行任意位置的 KV cache 重用會造成精度損失。

key_innovation.en: SparseX uses receiver-side non-reuse queries as Sparse-Q probes to rank reused tokens by accumulated attention, selectively recomputes the top-k tokens, and RoPE-aligns the rest. A layer-specific full+sparse hybrid performs full attention in early layers before switching to Sparse-KV Recomputation, all integrated into vLLM's paged-cache and attention execution path.
key_innovation.zh: SparseX 將接收端的非重用 query 作為 Sparse-Q probe，依 accumulated attention 排序重用 token，僅重算 top-k token，並對其餘 token 執行 RoPE alignment。其 layer-specific full+sparse hybrid 在早期 layer 使用 full attention，之後切換至 Sparse-KV Recomputation，且完整整合於 vLLM 的 paged-cache 與 attention execution path。

baselines_compared: Full recompute, Naive reuse, CacheBlend, EPIC, Vanilla

key_improvements.en: On Qwen3-32B LOCOMO, SparseX with hybrid attention preserves a 0.67 score versus 0.68 for full recompute while reducing TTFT from 9.23 s to 0.87 s. On RULER, its average scores reach 0.94–0.98 across the evaluated Qwen3 models, close to or above full recompute at 0.94–0.97.
key_improvements.zh: 在 Qwen3-32B LOCOMO 上，啟用 hybrid attention 的 SparseX 將 score 維持於 0.67，相較 full recompute 為 0.68，同時把 TTFT 由 9.23 s 降至 0.87 s。在 RULER 上，其於各 Qwen3 模型的平均 score 達 0.94–0.98，接近或高於 full recompute 的 0.94–0.97。

reuse_scope: Cross-agent (same backbone), Cross-context RAG, Cross-request / multi-tenant, Cross-position

reuse_metric.en: On Qwen3-32B LOCOMO, SparseX with full+sparse hybrid attention retains a 0.67 quality score versus 0.68 for full recompute while lowering TTFT from 9.23 s to 0.87 s.
reuse_metric.zh: 在 Qwen3-32B LOCOMO 上，採用 full+sparse hybrid attention 的 SparseX 將品質 score 維持於 0.67，相較 full recompute 為 0.68，並將 TTFT 由 9.23 s 降至 0.87 s。

title: Draft-based Approximate Inference for LLMs
authors: Kevin Galim; Ethan Ewer; Wonjun Kang; Minjae Lee; Hyung Il Koo; Kangwook Lee
affiliations: FuriosaAI, University of Wisconsin–Madison, Seoul National University, Ajou University, KRAFTON
research_focus: LLM serving, Long-context / Prefix cache, KV cache compression

problem_statement.en: Long-context transformer inference has quadratic attention cost and linearly growing KV cache memory. Existing KV-dropping and other approximate-inference methods estimate future token importance from prompt-side activations, which can poorly predict which cached KV pairs future generated tokens will need.
problem_statement.zh: Long-context transformer inference 面臨平方成長的 attention 運算成本，以及隨 context 線性成長的 KV cache 記憶體需求。既有 KV dropping 與其他 approximate inference 方法依賴 prompt-side activation 估計未來 token 的重要性，因而可能無法準確預測後續生成 token 所需的 cached KV pair。

key_innovation.en: SpecKV uses a lightweight draft model to generate lookahead tokens, then scores target-model input KV pairs with cross-attention from recent input queries and draft-output queries. The scores jointly drive sparse prefill and retention of the highest-importance KV pairs under a fixed cache capacity.
key_innovation.zh: SpecKV 以輕量 draft model 生成 lookahead token，再利用近期 input query 與 draft-output query 對 target model 的 input KV pair 計算 cross-attention score。該 score 同時用於 sparse prefill，並在固定 cache 容量下保留重要性最高的 KV pair。

key_improvements.en: At fixed KV-cache capacity, SpecKV consistently outperforms the compared KV-dropping baselines on RULER and LongBench and is faster than SnapKV and LAQ++. The cascaded SpecKV-PC variant reduces latency by 75% versus LAQ++ at 64K context and saves about 25GB of peak memory.
key_improvements.zh: 在固定 KV cache 容量下，SpecKV 於 RULER 與 LongBench 持續優於所比較的 KV-dropping baseline，速度亦快於 SnapKV 與 LAQ++。其 cascaded SpecKV-PC variant 在 64K context 下相較 LAQ++ 降低 75% latency，並節省約 25GB peak memory。

gpu_count: 1x NVIDIA H200 (141GB) for latency and memory evaluation

reuse_metric.en: With a fixed Cmax=256 KV-cache capacity, SpecKV consistently outperforms all compared KV-dropping baselines across sequence lengths on RULER and LongBench.
reuse_metric.zh: 在固定 Cmax=256 KV cache 容量下，SpecKV 於 RULER 與 LongBench 的各種 sequence length 設定中，持續優於所有比較的 KV-dropping baseline。

title: Splitwise: Efficient generative LLM inference using phase splitting
authors: Pratyush Patel; Esha Choukse; Chaojie Zhang; Aashaka Shah; Íñigo Goiri; Saeed Maleki; Ricardo Bianchini
research_focus: Long-context / Prefix cache, Multi-tenant scheduling, PD disaggregation, Continuous batching, Capacity planning, Performance modeling, Datacenter networking, Hardware co-design

problem_statement.en: Generative LLM inference consists of a compute-intensive prompt computation phase and a memory-intensive token generation phase, leading to resource underutilization when both phases are run on the same machine. This results in inefficient GPU usage and high costs for cloud service providers.
problem_statement.zh: 生成式 LLM inference 由計算密集的 prompt 計算階段與記憶體密集的 token 生成階段組成，在同一機器上共同運行時資源利用率低落，導致 GPU 使用效率不佳並推高雲端服務商的成本。

key_innovation.en: Splitwise, a deployment and scheduling technique that decouples the prompt computation and token generation phases onto separate machines, enabling phase-specific hardware optimization and efficient KV-cache transfer.
key_innovation.zh: Splitwise 是一種部署與排程技術，將 prompt 計算與 token 生成階段解耦合至獨立機器，從而實現各階段的針對性硬體優化與高效的 KV cache 傳輸。

key_improvements.en: Up to 1.4x higher throughput at 20% lower cost, or 2.35x more throughput under the same power and cost budgets.
key_improvements.zh: 在成本降低 20% 的前提下 throughput 最高提升 1.4x；或在相同功耗與成本預算下 throughput 可達 2.35x。

ai_task: LLM Serving, Generative LLM Inference
traffic_pattern: Pipeline Parallelism, Tensor Parallelism, Continuous Batching
reported_accuracy: Not Reported (system paper; KV-transfer sized empirically — 1.13 GB OPT-66B prompt at 90 Gbps for 10 req/s)
validation_workloads: Production trace (Azure inference traces), Synthetic

scope_assumptions.en: Phase characterization assumes prompt-token-count and generation-token-count distributions taken from Azure production traces; KV-cache transfer modeled as layer-wise async overlap with prefill compute over InfiniBand; heterogeneous-cluster recipes (H100 prefill + A100 decode) require manual provisioning, not auto-derived from the model.
scope_assumptions.zh: Phase characterization 假設 prompt token 數與生成 token 數分布取自 Azure 生產流量；KV cache 傳輸建模為以 InfiniBand 進行的 layer-wise 非同步傳輸，與 prefill compute 重疊；異質叢集配方（H100 prefill + A100 decode）需手動 provisioning，無法由模型自動推導。

title: Spritz: Path-Aware Load Balancing in Low-Diameter Networks
authors: Tommaso Bonato; Ales Kubicek; Abdul Kabbani; Ahmad Ghalayini; Maciej Besta; Torsten Hoefler
research_focus: Datacenter networking, Congestion control, Routing / Load balancing, Network topology, In-network computing

problem_statement.en: Existing load balancing techniques for low-diameter topologies like Dragonfly and Slim Fly either rely on proprietary in-network mechanisms or fail to utilize full path diversity, leading to congestion and poor performance under link failures.
problem_statement.zh: 針對 Dragonfly 與 Slim Fly 等低直徑拓撲的現有負載均衡技術，或依賴專有的網內機制，或無法充分利用路徑多樣性，導致鏈路故障時出現壅塞與效能下降。

key_innovation.en: Spritz, a sender-based load balancing framework that shifts adaptive topology-aware routing to endpoints using standard Ethernet features (ECN, packet trimming, and timeout feedback) to explore and cache efficient paths.
key_innovation.zh: Spritz 是一個以發送端為核心的負載均衡框架，利用標準 Ethernet 特性（ECN、封包修剪及逾時反饋），將自適應拓撲感知路由移至端點執行，進而探索並快取高效路徑。

baselines_compared: ECMP, UGAL-L, Minimal, Valiant, Flicr, OPS

key_improvements.en: Up to 1.8x throughput increase in flow completion time and up to 25.4x performance improvement under link failures.
key_improvements.zh: 流完成時間 throughput 最高提升 1.8x；鏈路故障情境下效能最高改善 25.4x。

ai_task: AI Model Training, Allreduce, Alltoall, Datacenter workloads
node_count: 1056 endpoints for Dragonfly, 1134 endpoints for Slim Fly

title: STrack: A Reliable Multipath Transport for AI/ML Clusters
authors: Yanfang Le; Rong Pan; Peter Newman; Jeremias Blendin; Abdul Kabbani; Vipin Jain; Raghava Sivaramu; Francis Matus
research_focus: Datacenter networking, RDMA / Transport, Congestion control, Routing / Load balancing

problem_statement.en: Standard RoCEv2 suffers from ECMP hash collisions, poor load balancing, and inefficient loss recovery in large-scale AI/ML clusters, leading to network hotspots and performance degradation.
problem_statement.zh: 標準 RoCEv2 在大規模 AI/ML 叢集中面臨 ECMP 雜湊碰撞、負載均衡效果差及遺失恢復效率低等問題，導致網路熱點與效能下降。

key_innovation.en: STrack, a hardware-offloaded reliable multipath transport protocol that uses egress-marked ECN for adaptive packet spraying and a window-based congestion control algorithm that jointly optimizes path selection and rate adjustment.
key_innovation.zh: STrack 是一種硬體卸載的可靠多路徑傳輸協定，利用出口標記的 ECN 實現自適應封包噴射，並採用基於視窗的壅塞控制演算法，聯合優化路徑選擇與速率調節。

key_improvements.en: Up to 6X throughput increase with synthetic workloads and 27.4% improvement with collective workloads compared to optimized RoCEv2.
key_improvements.zh: 相較於優化後的 RoCEv2，合成 workload 下 throughput 最高提升 6x，collective workload 下提升 27.4%。

ai_task: LLM Serving, AI Model Training, Distributed Deep Learning (DDL), AllReduce, AlltoAll

title: Efficient AllReduce with Stragglers
authors: Arjun Devraj; Eric Ding; Abhishek Vijaya Kumar; Robert Kleinberg; Rachee Singh
research_focus: Performance modeling, Collective communication

problem_statement.en: Distributed ML AllReduce collectives are delayed by the slowest GPU to reach the synchronization barrier (the straggler), and bandwidth-optimal algorithms such as Ring assume bulk-synchronous start. Existing mitigation either drops or approximates straggler data, which hurts convergence and does not generalize to tensor-parallel inference where exact reductions are required.
problem_statement.zh: 分散式 ML 中的 AllReduce 集合通訊受限於最慢的 GPU 才能進入同步屏障（即 straggler），而 Ring 等頻寬最佳化演算法假設所有 GPU 同時啟動。既有的緩解策略以丟棄或近似 straggler 資料為主，將影響訓練收斂，亦無法套用於需要精確規約的 tensor parallelism 推論。

key_innovation.en: StragglAR is a straggler-aware AllReduce algorithm built on an analytical alpha-beta cost model: it eagerly runs a ReduceScatter among non-straggler GPUs during the straggler delay, then executes a novel schedule that completes the AllReduce in n + log n - 2 rounds. The schedule is provably 2x more bandwidth-efficient than Ring's lower bound when overlap is possible, while matching bandwidth-optimal cost in the worst case.
key_innovation.zh: StragglAR 為 straggler-aware 的 AllReduce 演算法，建立於 alpha-beta 成本模型之上：在 straggler 延遲期間於非 straggler GPU 之間先執行 ReduceScatter，隨後以新穎排程於 n + log n - 2 個 round 內完成整個 AllReduce。理論上，當 overlap 可行時，其頻寬效率較 Ring 已知下界提升 2x，且在最差情境下仍能匹配頻寬最佳化的成本。

key_improvements.en: 25% AllReduce speedup over bandwidth-optimal baselines on 8-GPU DGX H100; up to 2x speedup at 256 GPUs in simulation; end-to-end fine-tuning speedups of 4.75%, 4.43%, 2.39% on Llama-3.2-3B, Phi-3-mini-3.8B, Qwen-2.5-3B respectively, saving up to 9.12 GPU-hours per day on an 8-GPU server.
key_improvements.zh: 在 8-GPU DGX H100 上 AllReduce 較頻寬最佳化基線加速 25%；模擬 256 GPUs 時最高達 2x 加速；Llama-3.2-3B、Phi-3-mini-3.8B、Qwen-2.5-3B fine-tuning 端到端分別加速 4.75%、4.43%、2.39%，於 8-GPU server 每日最多節省 9.12 GPU-hours。

gpu_count: 8x H100 (DGX H100), 8x A100 (DGX A100), 4x A100 40GB (Perlmutter); up to 256 GPUs in simulation
node_count: Single-node multi-GPU server (8 GPUs); 1-32 simulated nodes
reported_accuracy: Not Reported (algorithm derives a provable n + log n - 2 round bound; analytical simulator validated on H100 P2P bandwidth)
validation_workloads: Synthetic (varying buffer sizes 1 MiB to 4 GiB and straggler delays 0-20 ms), data-parallel fine-tuning workloads

scope_assumptions.en: Targets the homogeneous scale-up domain (DGX-class servers, racks of 10-100 GPUs); assumes single P2P link per GPU and power-of-two world size in the main algorithm (extensions in appendix); assumes the straggler rank can be detected ahead of time via profiling; algorithm is bandwidth-efficient only when buffer is large enough for beta cost to dominate alpha; not designed for many simultaneous stragglers.
scope_assumptions.zh: 鎖定同質 scale-up domain（如 DGX 級伺服器、10-100 GPUs 的機架）；假設每個 GPU 對外僅單一 P2P 連線、且主要演算法限定 world size 為 2 的次方（非次方情境見附錄）；假設可預先透過 profiling 偵測到 straggler rank；演算法的頻寬效率僅在 buffer 足夠大、由 beta cost 主導時成立；不針對多個 straggler 同時發生的情境設計。

title: StreamRL: Scalable, Heterogeneous, and Elastic RL for LLMs with Disaggregated Stream Generation
authors: Yinmin Zhong; Zili Zhang; Xiaoniu Song; Hanpeng Hu; Chao Jin; Bingyang Wu; Nuo Chen; Yukun Chen; Yu Zhou; Changyi Wan; Hongyu Zhou; Yimin Jiang; Yibo Zhu; Daxin Jiang
research_focus: Multi-tenant scheduling, PD disaggregation, Length prediction, Datacenter networking

problem_statement.en: Colocated RL architectures suffer from resource coupling, where the memory-bandwidth-bound generation stage and compute-bound training stage are forced to share identical hardware, leading to poor scalability and inefficient resource utilization. Additionally, existing disaggregated frameworks face performance bottlenecks due to pipeline bubbles from stage dependencies and skewness bubbles from long-tail output length distributions.
problem_statement.zh: 共置式 RL 架構因資源耦合而受限：記憶體頻寬瓶頸的生成階段與計算瓶頸的訓練階段被迫共用相同硬體，導致擴展性差且資源利用率低。此外，現有解耦合框架因階段依賴產生的 pipeline bubble，以及輸出長度長尾分布引起的偏斜 bubble，而面臨效能瓶頸。

key_innovation.en: StreamRL, a disaggregated RL framework that abstracts generation and training into a Stream Generation Service (SGS) and Trainer, utilizing stream-based communication, skewness-aware scheduling with an output-length ranker, and dynamic resource adjustment to enable elastic, heterogeneous, and cross-datacenter training.
key_innovation.zh: StreamRL 是一個解耦合 RL 框架，將生成與訓練抽象為 Stream Generation Service（SGS）與 Trainer 兩個元件，藉由流式通訊、帶有輸出長度排序器的偏斜感知排程及動態資源調配，實現彈性、異質且跨資料中心的訓練。

key_improvements.en: Up to 2.66x throughput increase compared to state-of-the-art systems and up to 1.33x improvement in cost-effectiveness in heterogeneous, cross-datacenter settings.
key_improvements.zh: 相較於最先進系統，throughput 最高提升 2.66x；在異質跨資料中心設定下，成本效益最高改善 1.33x。

ai_task: LLM Serving, AI Model Training, RLHF, Disaggregated Prefill/Decoding
traffic_pattern: All-to-All, Pipeline Parallelism, Tensor Parallelism, Point-to-point data transfer

title: SwarmAgentic: Towards Fully Automated Agentic System Generation via Swarm Intelligence
authors: Yao Zhang; Chenyang Lin; Shijie Tang; Haokun Chen; Shijie Zhou; Yunpu Ma; Volker Tresp
venue_full: Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing 2025
research_focus: Agentic / Workflow serving

problem_statement.en: Existing frameworks that automate agentic-system design lack full autonomy: they depend on predefined agents, fixed templates or hand-crafted seed agents, and typically optimize agent functionality and inter-agent collaboration separately. The paper targets fully autonomous generation of a complete multi-agent system from scratch — jointly optimizing agent roles/policies and their coordination — given only a task description and an objective function.
problem_statement.zh: 現有自動化 agentic system 設計的框架缺乏完整的自主性:其依賴於預先定義的 agent、固定的模板或人工設計的種子 agent,且通常將 agent 功能與 agent 之間的協作分開最佳化。本論文的目標為在僅給定任務描述與目標函數的條件下,從零開始完整地自主生成一套完整的 multi-agent system,並聯合最佳化 agent 的角色/策略及其協調機制。

key_innovation.en: Reformulates Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) as a symbolic, language-based process over a population of complete agentic systems encoded as structured text/code, and introduces a "Failure-Aware Velocity Update" in which an LLM diagnoses execution flaws and computes textual edits that move each particle toward its personal-best and the swarm's global-best system, jointly optimizing agent functionality and collaboration offline.
key_innovation.zh: 本方法將 Particle Swarm Optimization(PSO)重新表述為一個以語言為基礎的符號化流程,作用於一群以結構化文字/程式碼編碼的完整 agentic system 個體之上,並引入「Failure-Aware Velocity Update」機制:由 LLM 診斷執行過程中的缺陷,並計算文字層級的編輯,使每個 particle 朝其個體最佳(personal-best)與群體全域最佳(global-best)的系統移動,從而在離線階段聯合最佳化 agent 功能與協作。

baselines_compared: Direct, CoT, Self-Refine, SPP, EvoAgent, ADAS

key_improvements.en: TravelPlanner 32.2 vs ADAS 8.9 (GPT-4o executor; +261.8% relative); systems transfer across 5 executors.
key_improvements.zh: TravelPlanner 32.2 對 ADAS 8.9(GPT-4o 執行器;相對 +261.8%);發現的系統可遷移至五種執行器。

structure_space: Team composition (agent set), Roles / profiles, Prompts (joint), Workflow code, Operator / node graph
decision_mechanism: Evolutionary / swarm search, Textual gradient (LLM feedback)
optimization_signal: Task utility (accuracy), Textual feedback, Validation-set score
benchmarks_used: TravelPlanner, Natural Plan, Creative Writing, MGSM

agent_scenario.en: Fully automated, from-scratch generation of role-based multi-agent systems. A candidate system contains a variable-size set of LLM agents — each defined by a role identifier, a responsibility description, and an execution policy — orchestrated by a collaborative structure that sequences execution steps, assigns agents to steps, and routes information between them. A single optimizer LLM (GPT-4o-mini-0718) drives the swarm search offline; the discovered system's agents then run on separate executor LLMs. The framework is general-purpose across six domains (long-horizon travel planning, trip/meeting/calendar scheduling, creative writing, multilingual math). Agents operate purely in a text environment — no external tools, retrieval, or real-world perception/action are used (explicitly noted as a limitation). A case study on TravelPlanner shows the swarm introducing a "Quality Assurance Specialist" and verification steps that raise success rate from ~11% to 22% to 33% across iterations.
agent_scenario.zh: 完整自動化、從零開始生成以角色為基礎的 multi-agent system。一個候選系統包含一組大小可變的 LLM agent,每個 agent 由角色識別碼、職責描述與執行策略所定義,並由一個協作結構加以編排,該結構負責排定執行步驟的順序、將 agent 指派至各步驟,並在各 agent 之間傳遞資訊。單一的最佳化 LLM(GPT-4o-mini-0718)於離線階段驅動 swarm 搜尋;所發現系統中的 agent 隨後於不同的 executor LLM 上運行。該框架具通用性,涵蓋六個領域(長程旅行規劃、行程/會議/行事曆排程、創意寫作、多語言數學)。各 agent 純粹於文字環境中運作,不使用任何外部工具、檢索或真實世界的感知/行動(論文明確指出此為一項限制)。針對 TravelPlanner 的案例研究顯示,swarm 引入了「Quality Assurance Specialist」與驗證步驟,使成功率於各次迭代中由約 11% 提升至 22% 再至 33%。

title: SwarmX: Agentic Scheduling for Low-Latency Agentic Systems
authors: Yeqi Huang; Yanwei Ye; Guomin Chen; Wenhao Su; Bin Gong; Jialian Li; Zhan Lu; Yangshen Deng; Xuan Sun; Le Xu; Luo Mai
research_focus: Agentic / Workflow serving, Multi-tenant scheduling, Routing / Load balancing, Length prediction, Performance modeling, Capacity planning

problem_statement.en: Agentic AI applications compose multiple model calls and tool executions on GPU-CPU clusters, where both inference time and model-call structure depend on prompt semantics. Conventional routers and scalers (round-robin, power-of-two choices, average-based estimates) make poor decisions that persist under low-QPS, long-running agentic requests, amplifying tail latency and hurting utilization.
problem_statement.zh: Agentic AI 應用在 GPU-CPU 叢集上串接多次 model call 與 tool 執行，其 inference 時間與 model-call 結構皆取決於 prompt 語意。傳統 router 與 scaler（round-robin、power-of-two choices、平均值估計）的錯誤決策在低 QPS、長時間執行的 agentic 請求下會持續存在並放大尾延遲，資源利用率也隨之下降。

key_innovation.en: Agentic scheduling via scheduling-specific neural predictors: a small isomorphic semantic model (e.g. 35M parameters for a Qwen3-8B target) extracts prompt semantics, and a lightweight MLP combines them with device, runtime, and target-model features to predict inference-time and model-call distributions. Predictions stay distributional (quantile sketches) all the way to routers and scalers for tail-aware decisions, with OOD-triggered online MLP retraining and a scheduler-agent framework that plugs into existing infrastructure such as Ray and Kubernetes.
key_innovation.zh: 以 scheduling 專用神經預測器實現 agentic scheduling：小型 isomorphic semantic model（例如對 Qwen3-8B target 使用 35M 參數變體）擷取 prompt 語意，再由輕量 MLP 結合 device、runtime 與 target-model 特徵，預測 inference 時間與 model-call 分佈。預測以 quantile sketch 保留完整分佈並直接傳遞給 router 與 scaler 進行尾延遲感知決策，並配合 OOD 觸發的線上 MLP 重訓練，以及可掛載於 Ray 與 Kubernetes 等既有基礎設施的 scheduler-agent 框架。

baselines_compared: Murakkab, Ray Core, Power-of-Two Choices, Random, Production scheduler

key_improvements.en: Reduces tail latency by up to 61.5% versus state-of-the-art schedulers and sustains up to 2x the throughput of production schedulers under the same SLO; in production deployments P99 latency drops by 44-52%, and OOD-triggered retraining recovers from a severe workload shift within 100 s.
key_improvements.zh: 相較 state-of-the-art scheduler，尾延遲最多降低 61.5%；在相同 SLO 下可維持生產 scheduler 最高 2x 的吞吐量；生產部署中 P99 延遲降低 44-52%，且 OOD 觸發的重訓練可在 100 s 內從嚴重的 workload 漂移中恢復。

ai_task: LLM Serving, Multi-agent Systems
reported_accuracy: Output-length MAE 27.89 tokens (35M Qwen3 semantic model); latency-prediction MAPE Not Reported
models_validated: Qwen3-8B, Qwen3-32B, Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B, Qwen3-8B-VL, Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B, Qwen3VL-8B, Qwen3-omni-30B
validation_workloads: DR Bench, OpenVid-1M, MCP-Atlas, SWE-bench Pro trace (DataClaw-PeterOMallet), Production traffic (11M records)

scope_assumptions.en: Predictors are trained from service traces and production logs, so accuracy depends on historical data per workload; most online drift is assumed correctable by retraining only the lightweight MLP (the semantic model is retrained only after target-model changes); prediction runs in ~30 ms on CPU or ~4 ms on GPU, small relative to seconds-to-minutes model execution; on predictor failure SwarmX falls back to the underlying scheduler policy.
scope_assumptions.zh: 預測器由 service trace 與生產 log 訓練，精度依賴各 workload 的歷史資料；假設多數線上漂移僅需重訓練輕量 MLP 即可修正（semantic model 僅在 target model 變更後重訓練）；預測在 CPU 上約 30 ms、GPU 上約 4 ms，相較秒級至分鐘級的模型執行時間佔比極小；預測器失效時回退至底層 scheduler 策略。

title: SweetSpot: An Analytical Model for Predicting Energy Efficiency of LLM Inference
authors: Hiari Pizzini Cavagna; Andrea Proia; Giacomo Madella; Giovanni B. Esposito; Francesco Antici; Daniele Cesarini; Zeynep Kiziltan; Andrea Bartolini
research_focus: Continuous batching, Capacity planning, Performance modeling, Energy / Carbon

problem_statement.en: LLM inference energy consumption has become a critical sustainability and cost concern, yet existing models estimate it as a simple linear function of input and output sequence lengths, failing to capture the autoregressive structure of Transformers that implies a non-linear relationship between sequence lengths and energy.
problem_statement.zh: LLM 推理的能耗已成為關鍵的永續性與成本議題；然而既有方法以輸入與輸出序列長度的簡單線性函式估計能耗，未能反映 Transformer 自回歸結構所隱含的非線性關係。

key_innovation.en: SweetSpot, an analytical closed-form model of per-token energy derived from the computational FLOPs and memory-access complexity of the prefill and decode phases. It expresses energy as a polynomial in input tokens n_in and output tokens n_out, exposing a quadratic input term and a 1/n_out amortization term, and yields a closed-form expression for the n_out value that minimizes per-token energy (the energy efficiency sweet spot).
key_innovation.zh: SweetSpot 是一個解析式的閉式 per-token 能耗模型，從 prefill 與 decode 階段的 FLOPs 與 memory access 複雜度推導而得。模型將能耗表示為 n_in（輸入 token 數）與 n_out（輸出 token 數）的多項式，揭示輸入端的二次項與 1/n_out 的攤銷項，並給出使每 token 能耗最小化的 n_out 解析解（即能效 sweet spot）。

baselines_compared: Baseline 1 (constant E_tok), Baseline 2 (E_tok = theta_0 + theta_1/n_out), Baseline 3 (Argerich linear model), Baseline 4 (Husom workload-based model)

key_improvements.en: Mean MAPE of 1.79% (+/- 0.61) on energy prediction across 13 LLMs from 1B to 9B parameters and input/output lengths from 64 to 4096 tokens, versus 130.45%, 130.49%, 106.25%, and 31.40% for the four baselines. Aligning generation with the predicted sweet spot reduces per-token energy by up to 33.41x relative to the worst-case configuration.
key_improvements.zh: 在 13 個從 1B 至 9B 參數的 LLM、輸入與輸出長度涵蓋 64 至 4096 token 的條件下，能耗預測的平均 MAPE 為 1.79%（+/- 0.61），相較四個 baseline 的 130.45%、130.49%、106.25%、31.40% 大幅領先。將生成對齊到所預測的 sweet spot 可使每 token 能耗較最差設定降低最多 33.41x。

compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA H100, HBM, Intel Xeon Platinum 8480+, DDR5
reported_accuracy: 1.79% MAPE (energy)
models_validated: Llama-3.2-1B, OPT-1.3B, Qwen2-1.5B, Gemma-2-2B, OPT-2.7B, Llama-3.2-3B, Granite-3B, OPT-6.7B, Qwen2-7B, Falcon-RW-7B, Granite-8B, Llama-3.1-8B, Gemma-2-9B
validation_workloads: Synthetic (TensorRT-LLM trtllm-bench utility, fixed n_in and n_out in powers of two from 64 to 4096)

scope_assumptions.en: Single inference framework (TensorRT-LLM); single hardware platform (NVIDIA H100 + Intel Sapphire Rapids); models limited to 1B-9B parameters with a fixed max_batch_size of 1024; ignores network and inter-node effects; saturation regime with 1000 requests per workload; FP16/BF16 precision only.
scope_assumptions.zh: 僅使用單一推理框架（TensorRT-LLM）與單一硬體平台（NVIDIA H100 與 Intel Sapphire Rapids）；模型參數量限定於 1B 至 9B，max_batch_size 固定為 1024；忽略網路與跨節點效應；採用每個 workload 1000 個 request 的飽和情境；僅涵蓋 FP16/BF16 精度。

title: Prefill-Decode Aggregation or Disaggregation? Unifying Both for Goodput-Optimized LLM Serving
authors: Chao Wang; Pengfei Zuo; Zhangyu Chen; Yunkai Liang; Zhou Yu; Ming-Chang Yang
affiliations: The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Huawei Cloud, Sun Yat-sen University
research_focus: Multi-tenant scheduling, PD disaggregation, Datacenter networking

problem_statement.en: Existing LLM serving systems face a fundamental trade-off between PD aggregation (optimal for tight TTFT) and PD disaggregation (optimal for tight TPOT), leading to sub-optimal goodput under balanced SLO constraints.
problem_statement.zh: 現有 LLM 服務系統在 PD aggregation（最適嚴格 TTFT）與 PD disaggregation（最適嚴格 TPOT）之間存在根本性的取捨，導致在均衡 SLO 約束下 goodput 欠佳。

key_innovation.en: TaiChi, a unified serving system that leverages a hybrid aggregation-disaggregation architecture with differentiated-capability GPU instances and request-level latency shifting via flowing decode and length-aware prefill scheduling.
key_innovation.zh: TaiChi 是一個統一服務系統，採用混合 aggregation-disaggregation 架構，搭配差異化能力的 GPU 實例，並透過流動式 decode 與長度感知 prefill 排程實現 request 層級的 latency 調移。

baselines_compared: vLLM, PD aggregation (Chunked Prefill), PD disaggregation

key_improvements.en: Up to 77% goodput improvement, 13.2x TTFT reduction, and 1.69x TPOT reduction compared to state-of-the-art systems.
key_improvements.zh: 相較於最先進系統，goodput 最高提升 77%，TTFT 降低 13.2x，TPOT 降低 1.69x。

ai_task: LLM Serving, Chatbot, Summarization
traffic_pattern: Continuous batching, Prefill-Decode interference, KV Cache transfer

title: Taming Throughput-Latency Tradeoff in LLM Inference with Sarathi-Serve
authors: Amey Agrawal; Jayashree Mohan; Nipun Kwatra; Bhargav Gulavani; Alexey Tumanov
venue_full: USENIX Symposium on Operating Systems Design and Implementation
research_focus: Multi-tenant scheduling, Continuous batching, Datacenter networking

problem_statement.en: Existing LLM serving systems face a throughput-latency tradeoff where prefill-prioritizing schedulers improve throughput but cause generation stalls, while decode-prioritizing schedulers optimize latency but suffer from low throughput.
problem_statement.zh: 現有 LLM 服務系統面臨 throughput-latency 的取捨困境：優先 prefill 的 scheduler 可提升 throughput，但會造成生成停滯；而優先 decode 的 scheduler 雖能優化 latency，卻導致 throughput 偏低。

key_innovation.en: Sarathi-Serve introduces chunked-prefills to split prompt processing into smaller compute units and stall-free scheduling to coalesce these chunks with ongoing decodes, minimizing latency impact while maximizing GPU utilization.
key_innovation.zh: Sarathi-Serve 引入 chunked-prefill，將 prompt 處理拆分為更小的計算單元，並以無停滯排程將這些 chunk 與進行中的 decode 合批，在最大化 GPU 利用率的同時將 latency 影響降至最低。

key_improvements.en: Up to 3.7x higher serving capacity for Yi-34B, 2.6x for Mistral-7B, and 5.6x gain in end-to-end serving capacity for Falcon-180B.
key_improvements.zh: Yi-34B 的服務容量最高提升 3.7x，Mistral-7B 提升 2.6x，Falcon-180B 的端到端服務容量提升 5.6x。

ai_task: LLM Serving, Disaggregated Prefill/Decoding

title: TaxBreak: Unmasking the Hidden Costs of LLM Inference Through Overhead Decomposition
authors: Prabhu Vellaisamy; Shreesh Tripathi; Vignesh Natarajan; Surya Santhan Thenarasu; Shawn Blanton; John P. Shen
research_focus: LLM serving, MoE serving, Performance modeling, Hardware co-design

problem_statement.en: In latency-sensitive LLM deployments, inference time can become dominated by host-side orchestration overhead, but existing approaches expose this cost only as an aggregate residual (framework tax) or a launch/queue metric (TKLQT), which is insufficient to identify which execution layer (Python dispatch, CUDA library front-end, or kernel launch path) should be optimized.
problem_statement.zh: 在延遲敏感的 LLM 部署中，inference time 可能被 host 端 orchestration overhead 主導，但既有做法僅以聚合殘差（framework tax）或 launch/queue metric（TKLQT）呈現此成本，難以辨識應該優化哪一層執行路徑（Python dispatch、CUDA library front-end 或 kernel launch path）。

key_innovation.en: TaxBreak is a trace-driven methodology that decomposes host-visible orchestration overhead into three mutually exclusive components per kernel invocation: framework translation (ΔFT), CUDA library translation (ΔCT), and kernel launch path (ΔKT), with a per-kernel launch floor T_sys^floor characterized via null-kernel nsys profiling. It further defines the Host-Device Balance Index HDBI = T_DeviceActive / (T_DeviceActive + T_Orchestration) as a diagnostic for whether optimization effort should target the software stack or the device side.
key_innovation.zh: TaxBreak 是一套 trace-driven 方法，將 host 端可見的 orchestration overhead 在每個 kernel invocation 中拆解為三個互斥成分：framework translation (ΔFT)、CUDA library translation (ΔCT) 與 kernel launch path (ΔKT)，並以 null-kernel nsys profiling 量測 per-kernel launch floor T_sys^floor。此外提出 Host-Device Balance Index HDBI = T_DeviceActive / (T_DeviceActive + T_Orchestration) 作為診斷指標，判斷優化應針對 software stack 或 device 端。

baselines_compared: Framework tax, TKLQT, GPU Inference Characterization

key_improvements.en: TaxBreak shows MoE models dispatch 8-11x more GPU kernels per output token than dense models of comparable active parameter count (OLMoE-1B/7B issues 9,305 kernels per token vs. 848 for Llama-3.2-1B). A faster host CPU (Sapphire Rapids vs. Emerald Rapids) reduces T_Orchestration by 10-29% and improves end-to-end latency by 11-14% even when paired with a slower-clocked GPU. FlashAttention-2 on Llama-3.2-1B at BS=8/SL=2048 lowers end-to-end latency by 68.6% and T_Orchestration by 24%.
key_improvements.zh: TaxBreak 顯示 MoE 模型在每個 output token 上 dispatch 的 GPU kernel 數比相當 active parameter 規模的 dense 模型高 8-11 倍（OLMoE-1B/7B 每 token 啟動 9,305 個 kernel，Llama-3.2-1B 僅 848 個）。較快的 host CPU（Sapphire Rapids 對比 Emerald Rapids）可將 T_Orchestration 降低 10-29%，並使 end-to-end latency 改善 11-14%，即使搭配時脈較低的 GPU 亦然。在 Llama-3.2-1B、BS=8/SL=2048 設定下，FlashAttention-2 可將 end-to-end latency 降低 68.6%，T_Orchestration 降低 24%。

compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA H100, NVIDIA H200 NVL, Intel Xeon 8480C, Intel Xeon Gold 6538Y+, HBM
reported_accuracy: 95% confidence interval of T_Orchestration below 0.34 ms across all configurations
validation_workloads: Synthetic (controlled BS x SL sweep)

scope_assumptions.en: Single-GPU SLURM allocations only; methodology is evaluated on NVIDIA GPUs and depends on CUDA tracing interfaces (nsys, NVTX, CUPTI); replay-based attribution can be imperfect for highly dynamic, autotuned, or synchronization-heavy kernels; evaluation focuses on eager mode (no torch.compile or CUDA Graphs); HDBI is a diagnostic work ratio rather than an optimization objective and must be interpreted alongside absolute latency.
scope_assumptions.zh: 僅評估單 GPU SLURM 配置；方法在 NVIDIA GPU 上驗證，依賴 CUDA tracing 介面（nsys、NVTX、CUPTI）；對高度動態、autotuned 或 synchronization-heavy 的 kernel，replay-based attribution 可能不精確；評估聚焦於 eager mode（未涵蓋 torch.compile 或 CUDA Graphs）；HDBI 為 diagnostic work ratio 而非優化目標，須與絕對 latency 一併解讀。

title: The development of carbon-neutral data centres in space
authors: Ablimit Aili; Jihwan Choi; Yew Soon Ong; Yonggang Wen
affiliations: Nanyang Technological University, Zhejiang University, Korea Advanced Institute of Science & Technology, Agency for Science, Technology and Research
research_focus: Datacenter networking, Energy / Carbon

problem_statement.en: Terrestrial data centres suffer from high energy consumption and large carbon footprints, while space-based data generation faces high latency and energy costs when processed on Earth.
problem_statement.zh: 地面資料中心面臨高能耗與龐大碳足跡的挑戰，而太空產生的資料若在地球上處理，則需承受高 latency 與高能源成本。

key_innovation.en: A framework for carbon-neutral orbital data centres (edge and cloud) that leverages abundant solar energy in space and deep space as a natural cold heat sink for radiative cooling.
key_innovation.zh: 針對碳中性軌道資料中心（邊緣與雲端）所提出的框架：利用太空中豐沛的太陽能，並以深太空作為天然冷熱沉以實現輻射散熱。

baselines_compared: Google data centres, terrestrial data centres powered by mixed and all-renewable electric grids

key_improvements.en: Orbital cloud data centres achieve a lifecycle CUE comparable to or better than terrestrial data centres powered by all-renewable energy grids, with zero scope 2 emissions.
key_improvements.zh: 軌道雲端資料中心的全生命週期 CUE 可達到或優於全再生能源電網供電的地面資料中心，且範疇二排放為零。

ai_task: AI Inference, AI Model Training, Large-scale scientific simulations, Space-native big data processing
compute_memory_hw: Dell R740 servers, NPUs, GPUs, FPGAs, ASICs

title: Theoretically Optimal Attention/FFN Ratios in Disaggregated LLM Serving
authors: Chendong Song; Meixuan Wang; Hang Zhou; Hong Liang; Yuan Lyu; Zixi Chen; Yuwei Fan; Zijie Zhou
affiliations: HKUST, Tsinghua University, Huawei Hong Kong Research Center, Peking University
research_focus: PD disaggregation, Continuous batching, Datacenter networking

problem_statement.en: The Attention/FFN provisioning ratio in Attention-FFN Disaggregation (AFD) architectures is highly sensitive, where mis-sizing leads to step-level blocking and device idle time. Existing systems rely on empirical search rather than a theoretical foundation to determine the optimal ratio.
problem_statement.zh: Attention-FFN Disaggregation（AFD）架構中的 Attention/FFN 資源配置比例高度敏感，比例設定不當將導致步驟級阻塞與裝置閒置。現有系統依賴經驗性搜索而非理論基礎來確定最優比例。

key_innovation.en: A tractable analytical framework and closed-form rules for the optimal Attention-to-FFN (A/F) ratio, derived from a probabilistic workload model that accounts for non-stationary KV cache growth and continuous batching.
key_innovation.zh: 一個可解析的分析框架與求解最優 Attention-to-FFN（A/F）比例的閉合公式，源自考量 KV cache 非平穩增長與 continuous batching 的機率性 workload 模型。

key_improvements.en: Theoretical optimal A/F ratio matches simulation-optimal within 10% relative error, and the framework consistently reduces idle time.
key_improvements.zh: 理論最優 A/F 比例與模擬最優結果的相對誤差在 10% 以內，且該框架在各情境下均能持續降低裝置閒置時間。

ai_task: LLM Serving, Disaggregated Attention/FFN

title: Scheduling LLM Inference with Uncertainty-Aware Output Length Predictions
authors: Haoyu Zheng; Yongqiang Zhang; Fangcheng Fu; Xiaokai Zhou; Hao Luo; Hongchao Zhu; Yuanyuan Zhu; Hao Wang; Xiao Yan; Jiawei Jiang
affiliations: Wuhan University, Dameng Database Co. Ltd., Shanghai Jiao Tong University
research_focus: MoE serving, Multi-tenant scheduling, Continuous batching, Length prediction, Performance modeling

problem_statement.en: Existing SJF-style LLM schedulers predict a single point output length per prompt, but LLM decoding is stochastic: the same prompt induces an entire output-length distribution determined by when the EOS token is sampled. A point estimate misses this uncertainty, and empirical distributions on LMSYS-Chat-1M exhibit clear heavy tails, so mispredicted long requests block subsequent ones and degrade per-token latency and throughput.
problem_statement.zh: 現有 SJF 類 LLM scheduler 對每個 prompt 只預測單一 output length 點估計，然而 LLM decoding 本身具隨機性：同一 prompt 的輸出長度取決於 EOS token 何時被採樣，實際上呈現整個分佈。在 LMSYS-Chat-1M 上的實證觀察顯示輸出長度分佈具明顯重尾，點估計無法捕捉此不確定性；被低估的長請求會阻塞後續請求，造成 per-token latency 與 throughput 劣化。

key_innovation.en: Fits per-prompt output length with a log-t distribution (fixed nu = 3.5) using a DeBERTa-v3-base encoder with multi-pooling and two MLP heads predicting (mu, sigma). A scheduling score combines the censored expectation with CVaR at alpha = 0.9 to penalise heavy tails: Score = E[X] + beta x CVaR[X], with beta adaptively tied to queue pressure. An asynchronous prediction thread and dynamic batching avoid blocking the main scheduler loop in vLLM.
key_innovation.zh: 以 log-t 分佈（固定 nu = 3.5）擬合 per-prompt 輸出長度，使用 DeBERTa-v3-base encoder 搭配 multi-pooling，由兩個 MLP head 分別預測 (mu, sigma)。Scheduling score 結合截尾期望與 alpha = 0.9 的 CVaR 以懲罰重尾：Score = E[X] + beta x CVaR[X]，其中 beta 隨 queue 壓力動態調整。Prediction thread 採非同步設計並使用 dynamic batching，避免阻塞 vLLM 主 scheduler loop。

key_improvements.en: Reduces average per-token latency by 2.31x for online chatbot serving and improves throughput by 1.42x for offline SDG over the best-performing baseline. At 100 RPS on the 8B model with LMSYS-Chat-1M, TIE achieves a 4.73x average per-token-latency reduction vs FCFS, outperforming SSJF by 2.91x and LTR by 2.31x; per-token latency degradation as RPS rises from 30 to 100 is only 3.68x for TIE vs 7.42x/8.55x/6.17x for FCFS/SSJF/LTR.
key_improvements.zh: 相較於最強 baseline，TIE 在 online chatbot 上將 average per-token latency 降低 2.31x，offline SDG throughput 提升 1.42x。8B 模型於 LMSYS-Chat-1M、100 RPS 時，TIE 相對 FCFS 取得 4.73x 的平均 per-token latency 減幅，且分別超越 SSJF 與 LTR 達 2.91x 與 2.31x；當 RPS 從 30 升至 100 時，TIE 的 per-token latency 僅劣化 3.68x，FCFS、SSJF、LTR 分別為 7.42x、8.55x、6.17x。

reported_accuracy: Log-t (nu = 3.5) achieves 90.6% KS-test pass rate on 1,000 prompts x 100 generations vs 60.3% for log-normal; R^2 of 0.82 (mu) and 0.76 (sigma) for the predictor
models_validated: Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct, Meta-Llama-3-70B-Instruct (additional MoE models in Appendix D.1)
validation_workloads: LMSys-Chat-1M, ShareGPT, Alpaca

scope_assumptions.en: Output length is treated as drawn from a log-t distribution with fixed nu = 3.5 (selected after fitting common heavy-tailed families); training data is restricted to LMSYS-Chat-1M with 8B-generated outputs, then transferred to ShareGPT/Alpaca and the 70B model for testing. Scheduler is non-preemptive; starvation prevented via exponential waiting-time decay (gamma = 0.9, tau = 30s).
scope_assumptions.zh: 輸出長度被假設來自固定 nu = 3.5 的 log-t 分佈（在比較多種常見重尾分佈後選定）；訓練資料僅來自 LMSYS-Chat-1M 並以 8B 模型生成輸出，再遷移到 ShareGPT、Alpaca 與 70B 模型測試。Scheduler 為非搶佔式，starvation 透過 gamma = 0.9、tau = 30s 的等待時間指數衰減機制處理。

title: Token Economics for LLM Agents: A Dual-View Study from Computing and Economics
authors: Yuxi Chen; Junming Chen; Chenyu He; Yiwei Li; Yicheng Ji; Yifan Wu; Dingyu Yang; Lansong Diao; Lidan Shou; Hongliang Zhang; Huan Li; Gang Chen
research_focus: Agentic / Workflow serving, LLM serving, Long-context / Prefix cache, Multi-tenant scheduling, Reasoning / Test-time scaling, Performance modeling

problem_statement.en: Token consumption by LLM agents is exploding (OpenRouter weekly volume grew ~68x, from 0.4T tokens in Dec 2024 to 27.0T by Mar 2026), turning tokens into a systemic supply-demand pressure point. Yet prior surveys are compartmentalized into isolated silos (agent architecture, system optimization, trust/security) with no unified language for the trade-off between output quality and economic cost, leaving the Product-Cost Pareto frontier of agent systems uncharacterized.
problem_statement.zh: LLM agent 的 token 消耗正呈爆炸式成長（OpenRouter 每週處理量從 2024 年 12 月的 0.4T tokens 增至 2026 年 3 月的 27.0T，約 68 倍），使 token 成為系統性的供需壓力點。然而既有綜述割裂於孤立的技術領域（agent 架構、系統最佳化、信任與安全），缺乏衡量輸出品質與經濟成本權衡的統一語言，agent 系統的 Product-Cost Pareto frontier 因此難以刻畫。

key_innovation.en: First comprehensive survey of 'Token Economics' via a dual-view (computer science + economics) framework: tokens are formalized with a triple economic attribute (factor of production, medium of exchange, unit of account); agent inference is cast as a constrained resource-allocation problem min TC s.t. Y >= Z, with a nested-CES production function Y = A[dK^p+(1-d)M^p]^(t/p) L^b e^e and cost function TC = Pk K + Pm M + wL. Literature is organized in a four-level taxonomy: micro/single-agent (neoclassical firm theory, factor substitution), meso/multi-agent (transaction cost + principal-agent theory), macro/agent-ecosystem (mechanism design, congestion externalities), plus security internalized as an endogenous economic constraint.
key_innovation.zh: 首篇以雙視角（computer science + economics）框架系統化「Token Economics」的綜述：將 token 形式化為三重經濟屬性（生產要素、交換媒介、記帳單位），把 agent 推理定式為受限資源配置問題 min TC s.t. Y >= Z，並給出 nested-CES 生產函數 Y = A[dK^p+(1-d)M^p]^(t/p) L^b e^e 與成本函數 TC = Pk K + Pm M + wL。文獻依四層 taxonomy 組織：micro／single-agent（新古典廠商理論、要素替代）、meso／multi-agent（transaction cost 與 principal-agent 理論）、macro／agent ecosystem（mechanism design、congestion externalities），並將 security 內生化為經濟約束。

key_improvements.en: Not Specified (survey; contributes a unifying analytical framework and taxonomy rather than quantitative improvements).
key_improvements.zh: Not Specified（綜述論文；貢獻為統一的分析框架與 taxonomy，而非量化改進）。

reported_accuracy: Not Reported (survey; the CES production/cost model is conceptual and never validated against measurements)
validation_workloads: Not Specified

scope_assumptions.en: Survey plus analytical framework only: the nested-CES production/cost model is illustrative -- its parameters (substitution elasticity, distribution, returns-to-scale) are never estimated from data, and no prediction is validated. Provider-pricing facts (Anthropic cached-input reads at 10% of base input price with a 25% write surcharge; OpenAI automatic 50% prefix-cache discount; OpenAI Batch API 50% discount; provisioned-throughput tiers) are quoted as point-in-time list prices, not measured; the survey collects no production billing data. Cache economics is treated at the market level (cost pass-through, switching friction, retention asset) without modeling cache TTL, keepalive, or state-residency mechanics.
scope_assumptions.zh: 僅為綜述加分析框架：nested-CES 生產／成本模型屬概念性示意——其參數（替代彈性、分配、規模報酬）從未由資料估計，任何預測皆未經驗證。Provider 定價事實（Anthropic cached-input 讀取為基礎 input 價格的 10%、首次寫入加收 25% surcharge；OpenAI 自動 50% prefix-cache 折扣；OpenAI Batch API 50% 折扣；provisioned-throughput 等級）為特定時點的牌價引用而非實測；本綜述未收集任何 production billing 資料。Cache 經濟學僅在市場層面處理（cost pass-through、switching friction、retention asset），未建模 cache TTL、keepalive 或 state-residency 機制。

title: TokenCake: A KV-Cache-centric Serving Framework for LLM-based Multi-Agent Applications
authors: Zhuohang Bian; Feiyang Wu; Zhuoran Li; Teng Ma; Youwei Zhuo
research_focus: LLM serving, Agentic / Workflow serving, KV cache offloading, GPU memory tiering, Multi-tenant scheduling

problem_statement.en: Multi-agent LLM applications with frequent, long-running external function calls create two KV cache problems that existing serving systems handle poorly: temporal underutilization, where stalled agents' KV caches sit idle in GPU memory (up to 18.5% of KV cache blocks at peak), and spatial contention, where non-critical agents evict critical-path agents' caches (critical inversion), forcing costly recomputation that stalls the whole workflow.
problem_statement.zh: 依賴頻繁且長時間外部 function call 的多 agent LLM 應用，帶來現有服務系統難以處理的兩個 KV cache 問題：temporal underutilization——停滯 agent 的 KV cache 閒置於 GPU 記憶體（尖峰時最高佔 18.5% 的 KV cache blocks）；以及 spatial contention——非關鍵 agent 逐出關鍵路徑 agent 的 cache（critical inversion），迫使昂貴的重計算並使整個 workflow 停滯。

key_innovation.en: An agent-aware co-design of scheduling and memory management: a frontend API describing the application as a DAG with function-call stages; a Temporal Scheduler that opportunistically offloads idle KV caches to CPU memory on function-call events and predictively uploads them before agents resume (EWMA forecasting of tool duration); and a Spatial Scheduler that dynamically partitions GPU memory into shared and reserved pools via a hybrid priority metric combining graph structure and runtime state. Both schedulers coordinate through a shared pressure snapshot.
key_innovation.zh: agent 感知的排程與記憶體管理協同設計：frontend API 以帶 function call 階段的 DAG 描述應用；Temporal Scheduler 以 function call 事件驅動、機會式地將閒置 KV cache offload 至 CPU 記憶體，並藉由 EWMA 預測工具執行時間、在 agent 恢復前預測式 upload 回 GPU；Spatial Scheduler 依結合圖結構與執行期狀態的混合優先度指標，動態將 GPU 記憶體劃分為共享池與保留池。兩個 scheduler 透過共享的 pressure snapshot 協調。

key_improvements.en: Reduces end-to-end latency by over 47.06% vs vLLM under high load and improves effective GPU memory utilization by up to 16.9% (85.8–87.0% vs 69.9–74.1% for vLLM); 28.0% latency reduction over Mooncake at 0.5 QPS; measured KV cache recomputation is 26.8–37.5x slower than round-trip CPU migration.
key_improvements.zh: 高負載下相較 vLLM 端到端延遲降低超過 47.06%、有效 GPU 記憶體利用率最高提升 16.9%（85.8–87.0% vs vLLM 的 69.9–74.1%）；0.5 QPS 時相較 Mooncake 延遲降低 28.0%；量測顯示 KV cache 重計算比 CPU 往返遷移慢 26.8–37.5x。

ai_task: LLM Serving, Multi-agent Systems, AI Inference KV Cache transfer
offload_trigger: Function-call start event (call_start): when an agent emits a function call, the Temporal Scheduler proactively offloads the stalled agent's KV cache subject to a cost-benefit gate — not memory pressure or session inactivity.
prefetch_signal_timing: Predictive upload against the forecast function-call completion time (per-function-type EWMA blending user estimate with observed history); gradual budgeted upload as the deadline approaches, ranked by importance + urgency, with immediate upload on early call_finish.
costs_modeled: PCIe bandwidth, host DRAM capacity, GPU FLOPs recompute, transfer-vs-recompute crossover
agent_awareness: Exploits function-call (tool-call) idle gaps and the application's workflow DAG supplied via the frontend API: graph structure (depth, degree, critical path), function-call stages, and time estimates drive offload/upload timing and critical-path memory reservation.

when_to_offload_rule.en: Offload a stalled agent's KV cache at function-call start only when the predicted stall is long enough to cover the round-trip GPU-CPU transfer, a waiting request can use the freed GPU blocks, and the later upload can be prepared without displacing critical-path work.
when_to_offload_rule.zh: 僅當三項條件同時成立時，才於 function call 開始時卸載停滯 agent 的 KV cache：預測的停滯時間足以涵蓋 GPU 與 CPU 之間的往返傳輸、存在可利用所釋放 GPU blocks 的等待請求、且後續 upload 可在不排擠 critical-path 工作的前提下完成。

title: TokenDance: Scaling Multi-Agent LLM Serving via Collective KV Cache Sharing
authors: Zhuohang Bian; Feiyang Wu; Chengrui Zhang; Hangcheng Dong; Yun Liang; Youwei Zhuo
affiliations: Peking University, Shanghai Jiao Tong University
research_focus: LLM serving, Long-context / Prefix cache, Agentic / Workflow serving, KV cache compression

problem_statement.en: Synchronized All-Gather rounds in multi-agent LLM applications redistribute every agent's outputs into subsequent prompts, creating near-duplicate KV caches at different positions. Request-local prefix and position-independent caching repeat reuse analysis for every agent and retain a dense cache per request, limiting concurrent-agent capacity under a fixed GPU-memory budget.
problem_statement.zh: 多 agent LLM 應用的同步 All-Gather round 會將每個 agent 的輸出重新分發至後續 prompt，使不同位置產生近乎重複的 KV cache。request-local prefix caching 與 position-independent caching 會對每個 agent 重複執行重用分析，並為每個 request 保留一份 dense cache，因而在固定 GPU memory 預算下限制可並行的 agent 數量。

key_innovation.en: TokenDance raises the reuse unit from one request to an entire All-Gather round. Its KV Collector performs one batched RoPE and key-difference analysis for compatible agents, while Diff-Aware Storage represents sibling caches as sparse Mirrors of one Master and fuses diff restoration into the layerwise GPU-transfer path.
key_innovation.zh: TokenDance 將重用單位由單一 request 提升至整個 All-Gather round。其 KV Collector 對相容的 agent 統一執行一次 batched RoPE 與 key-difference analysis；Diff-Aware Storage 則以一份 Master 及其 sparse Mirror 表示同輪的 sibling cache，並將 diff restore 融合至逐層 GPU transfer path。

key_improvements.en: On GenerativeAgents and AgentSociety, TokenDance supports up to 2.7x more concurrent agents than vLLM with prefix caching under the latency SLO, compresses per-agent KV-cache storage by up to 17.5x, and accelerates prefill by up to 1.9x over per-request position-independent caching.
key_improvements.zh: 在 GenerativeAgents 與 AgentSociety 上，TokenDance 於 latency SLO 下可支援的並行 agent 數量最高為使用 prefix caching 之 vLLM 的 2.7x，per-agent KV cache storage 最高壓縮 17.5x，且相較 per-request position-independent caching 的 prefill 最高加速 1.9x。

reuse_metric.en: Master-Mirror storage compresses a recovered Mirror KV cache by 11.2x for Qwen2.5-7B and 17.5x for Qwen2.5-14B. The collective path produces the same recovered KV caches as per-request CacheBlend and introduces no additional accuracy degradation beyond that backend.
reuse_metric.zh: Master-Mirror storage 對 Qwen2.5-7B 與 Qwen2.5-14B 的 recovered Mirror KV cache 分別達到 11.2x 與 17.5x 壓縮。collective path 產生的 recovered KV cache 與 per-request CacheBlend 相同，未在該 backend 之外引入額外 accuracy degradation。

title: Towards a future space-based, highly scalable AI infrastructure system design
authors: Blaise Agüera y Arcas; Travis Beals; Maria Biggs; Jessica V. Bloom; Thomas Fischbacher; Konstantin Gromov; Urs Köster; Rishiraj Pravahan; James Manyika
research_focus: Datacenter networking, Energy / Carbon

problem_statement.en: The rapid growth of AI compute demand and energy consumption necessitates a more efficient, scalable infrastructure, which is currently limited by terrestrial constraints like land and power availability.
problem_statement.zh: AI 計算需求與能源消耗的快速增長迫切需要更高效、可擴展的基礎設施，而地面環境的土地與電力供應限制正制約著這一發展。
