key_innovation.en: A space-based AI infrastructure using a constellation of solar-powered satellites in LEO, utilizing free-space optical inter-satellite links (FSO ISLs) and radiation-tested TPU accelerators.
key_innovation.zh: 以 LEO 軌道太陽能衛星星座為基礎的太空 AI 基礎設施，利用自由空間光學衛星間鏈路（FSO ISL）與經輻射測試的 TPU 加速器。

baselines_compared: Starlink, Mynaric Condor, terrestrial data centers

key_improvements.en: Achieved 1.6 Tbps bidirectional transmission in a bench-scale demonstrator; projected launch costs to LEO of ≲$200/kg by mid-2030s; TPU radiation tolerance confirmed for 5-year mission life.
key_improvements.zh: 實驗室規模驗證器達到 1.6 Tbps 雙向傳輸；預計 2030 年代中期 LEO 發射成本降至 ≲$200/kg；TPU 輻射容忍度已確認可支援 5 年任務壽命。

ai_task: AI Model Training, AI Inference
compute_memory_hw: Google V6e Trillium Cloud TPU, AMD host server, HBM
transport_and_interconnect: Free-space optical inter-satellite links (FSO ISLs), DWDM

title: TraceLab: Characterizing Coding Agent Workloads for LLM Serving
authors: Kan Zhu; Mathew Jacob; Chenxi Ma; Yi Pan; Stephanie Wang; Arvind Krishnamurthy; Baris Kasikci
affiliations: University of Washington, Wuhan University of Technology, Shanghai Jiao Tong University
research_focus: LLM serving, Agentic / Workflow serving, Long-context / Prefix cache

problem_statement.en: Serving coding agents efficiently requires understanding real workload patterns, but existing public traces and benchmarks do not capture real, day-to-day coding-agent usage — long sessions, repeated tool calls, accumulated context, and human-paced gaps — across multiple agents and model families for serving-system analysis.
problem_statement.zh: 要高效 serving coding agent 必須先理解真實 workload 模式，然而既有公開 trace 與 benchmark 無法捕捉真實日常 coding agent 的使用行為——長 session、反覆 tool call、持續累積的 context、以及以人為節奏出現的間隔——也缺乏跨多個 agent 與模型家族、可供 serving 系統分析的資料。

key_innovation.en: First large-scale cross-provider trace of real coding-agent usage: ~4,300 sessions with ~350,000 LLM steps and ~430,000 tool calls, collected from 43 developers' day-to-day use of Claude Code and Codex over roughly eight months, normalized into a unified step-level schema (prefix/append/output tokens) with an anonymization pipeline; the analysis covers the agentic loop, context growth and compaction, cost, tool-call latency, and prefix cache behavior.
key_innovation.zh: 首個大規模、跨供應商的真實 coding agent 使用 trace：收集 43 位開發者約八個月日常使用 Claude Code 與 Codex 的約 4,300 個 session、約 350,000 個 LLM step 與約 430,000 次 tool call，正規化為統一的 step 級 schema（prefix/append/output token）並附匿名化 pipeline；分析涵蓋 agentic loop、context 成長與 compaction、成本、tool call 延遲與 prefix cache 行為。

key_improvements.en: Characterization findings rather than system improvements: global prefix cache hit rate is 95.7%, yet cache misses cause 3.8x more tokens to be prefilled than truly fresh tokens; a median step reads ~119K prefix tokens but outputs only 214 tokens; prefix tokens dominate cost (59.5% of spend); tool calls longer than 1 min are only 4% of calls but 85% of total tool-call time.
key_improvements.zh: 屬工作負載特徵化結果而非系統改進：全域 prefix cache 命中率為 95.7%，但 cache miss 使實際 prefill 的 token 量達到真正新輸入 token 的 3.8x；中位數 step 讀取約 119K 個 prefix token 卻僅輸出 214 個 token；prefix token 佔成本主導地位（59.5%）；超過 1 分鐘的 tool call 僅佔 4% 的呼叫次數，卻佔總 tool call 時間的 85%。

reported_accuracy: Not Reported (trace characterization study; no predictive model)
models_validated: Claude Opus 4.7, Claude Opus 4.6, Claude Opus 4.8, Claude Sonnet 4.6, Claude Haiku 4.5, GPT-5.5, GPT-5.4, GPT-5.3-codex, GPT-5.2-codex
validation_workloads: Real developer usage trace (Claude Code, Codex)

scope_assumptions.en: Trace is drawn from the authors' own day-to-day use (43 developers, largely one research community) and may not generalize to other organizations, workflows, or agent domains; analysis is limited to externally visible client-side logs, so provider-internal mechanisms (scheduling policies, cache behavior, backend routing) can only be inferred; scope is coding agents, while agent workloads are expanding to broader computer-use and automation tasks.
scope_assumptions.zh: trace 來自作者自身的日常使用（43 位開發者，多屬同一研究社群），未必能推廣至其他組織、開發流程或 agent 領域；分析僅限於外部可見的 client 端 log，供應商內部機制（scheduling 策略、cache 行為、後端路由）只能間接推測；範圍聚焦於 coding agent，而 agent workload 正擴展至更廣泛的 computer-use 與自動化任務。

title: TraCT: Disaggregated LLM Serving with CXL Shared Memory KV Cache at Rack-Scale
authors: Dongha Yoon; Younghoon Min; Hoshik Kim; Sam H. Noh; Jongryool Kim
research_focus: PD disaggregation, Datacenter networking, RDMA / Transport, GPU memory tiering

problem_statement.en: Disaggregated LLM serving architectures suffer from high latency and throughput bottlenecks caused by network-based (RDMA) transfer of KV tensors between prefill and decode workers.
problem_statement.zh: 解耦合 LLM 服務架構因 prefill 與 decode worker 之間透過網路（RDMA）傳輸 KV tensor，而面臨高 latency 與 throughput 瓶頸。

key_innovation.en: TraCT, a rack-scale system that uses CXL shared memory as a network-free KV-transfer substrate and prefix-aware KV cache, enabling direct GPU-to-CXL DMA.
key_innovation.zh: TraCT 是一個機架規模系統，以 CXL 共享記憶體作為無需網路的 KV 傳輸基底，並結合前綴感知 KV cache，實現 GPU 至 CXL 的直接 DMA。

key_improvements.en: 9.8x average TTFT reduction, 6.2x P99 latency reduction, 1.6x peak throughput increase
key_improvements.zh: 平均 TTFT 降低 9.8x，P99 latency 降低 6.2x，峰值 throughput 提升 1.6x。

ai_task: LLM Serving, Disaggregated Prefill/Decoding, KV Cache
compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA A6000, Niagara 2.0 CXL Type-3 memory expander

title: Scaling over Scaling: Exploring Test-Time Scaling Plateau in Large Reasoning Models
authors: Jian Wang; Boyan Zhu; Chak Tou Leong; Yongqi Li; Wenjie Li
research_focus: Reasoning / Test-time scaling, Capacity planning, Performance modeling

problem_statement.en: As large reasoning models adopt test-time scaling (either parallel sampling or sequential rethinking) to boost accuracy, additional compute eventually yields diminishing returns. Practitioners lack a principled way to identify the scaling plateau, leading to wasted token budget on unproductive generations.
problem_statement.zh: 大型推理模型透過 test-time scaling（平行採樣或序列式 rethinking）提升準確率，但額外運算最終會出現邊際遞減。實務上缺乏原則性的方式辨識此 scaling plateau，導致 token budget 浪費在無效的生成上。

key_innovation.en: TTSPM (Test-Time Scaling Performance Model): a probabilistic closed-form model with a unified saturation point N* = ceil(ln(eps/(F_max * p_x)) / ln(1 - p_x)). Both parallel scaling and sequential rethinking converge to the same F(N) = F_max * (1 - (1 - p_x)^N) upper bound, enabling principled budget allocation by computing the smallest N at which marginal accuracy gain drops below a chosen threshold epsilon.
key_innovation.zh: TTSPM（Test-Time Scaling Performance Model）：以機率建模給出封閉解的飽和點 N* = ceil(ln(eps/(F_max * p_x)) / ln(1 - p_x))。平行 scaling 與序列式 rethinking 雖機制不同，皆收斂至同一上界 F(N) = F_max * (1 - (1 - p_x)^N)，藉此可在邊際準確率增益低於門檻 epsilon 時定出最小 N，做為原則性的 budget 配置依據。

key_improvements.en: Empirical validation on MATH-500 shows strong correlation between TTSPM-predicted and observed plateau points (Pearson r = 0.803 for R1-7B parallel scaling, r = 0.768 for R1-1.5B parallel, r = 0.744 / 0.575 for sequential). Parallel scaling with N=32 lifts R1-1.5B AIME 2024 accuracy from 30.0% to 53.3% (23.3 percentage points), illustrating the gap that TTSPM's bound predicts saturating.
key_improvements.zh: 在 MATH-500 上 TTSPM 預測的 plateau 點與實測點呈現強相關（R1-7B parallel scaling 之 Pearson r = 0.803、R1-1.5B parallel r = 0.768、sequential 為 0.744 / 0.575）。Parallel scaling 在 N=32 將 R1-1.5B 於 AIME 2024 的準確率自 30.0% 提升至 53.3%（提升 23.3 個百分點），對應 TTSPM 所預測的飽和區間。

reported_accuracy: Pearson r = 0.575-0.803 across (model, scaling-strategy) pairs on MATH-500
validation_workloads: AIME 2024, AIME 2025, MATH-500, GPQA

scope_assumptions.en: Assumes conditional independence of scaling units (the (1 - p_x)^N derivation); assumes p_x is constant across problem instances within a (model, task) pair; verifier-free setting only — a strong external verifier may change p_x or the form of the curve; F_max, p_x, and epsilon must be estimated per task and per scaling strategy.
scope_assumptions.zh: 假設各 scaling unit 條件獨立（(1 - p_x)^N 推導之前提）；假設同一 (model, task) 組合內 p_x 為常數；僅適用無外部 verifier 的情境，若引入強 verifier 可能改變 p_x 或曲線形狀；F_max、p_x、epsilon 需針對任務與 scaling 策略個別估計。

title: Vidur: A Large-Scale Simulation Framework for LLM Inference
authors: Amey Agrawal; Nitin Kedia; Jayashree Mohan; Ashish Panwar; Nipun Kwatra; Bhargav S Gulavani; Ramachandran Ramjee; Alexey Tumanov
venue_full: Conference on Machine Learning and Systems
research_focus: Multi-tenant scheduling, Continuous batching, LoRA / Multi-adapter, Capacity planning, Performance modeling, Datacenter networking

problem_statement.en: Optimizing LLM inference deployment is prohibitively expensive due to the massive configuration space and the high cost of experimental exploration on actual hardware. Misconfiguration can lead to significant performance degradation and cost inefficiencies.
problem_statement.zh: LLM inference 部署的優化因龐大的配置空間與在真實硬體上進行實驗探索的高昂成本而代價極高；配置不當將導致顯著的效能下降與成本浪費。

key_innovation.en: Vidur, a high-fidelity, extensible simulation framework for LLM inference that uses operator-level profiling and predictive modeling to estimate performance metrics, coupled with Vidur-Search for automated, cost-effective configuration optimization.
key_innovation.zh: Vidur 是一個高保真、可擴展的 LLM inference 模擬框架，透過算子級 profiling 與預測建模來估算效能指標，並結合 Vidur-Search 實現自動化的低成本配置優化。

key_improvements.en: Estimates inference latency with less than 9% error; reduces configuration search cost by several orders of magnitude (e.g., $125 in simulation vs $218K on hardware for LLaMA2-70B).
key_improvements.zh: inference latency 估算誤差低於 9%；配置搜索成本降低數個數量級（例如 LLaMA2-70B 的搜索成本：模擬僅需 $125，而在硬體上需 $218K）。

ai_task: LLM Inference, LLM Serving
traffic_pattern: Pipeline Parallelism, Tensor Parallelism, Prefill, Decode
reported_accuracy: <5% latency and throughput error (paper headline); validation reports <9% across LLaMA-2 7B/70B, InternLM-20B, Qwen-72B
validation_workloads: LMSys-Chat-1M, ArXiv-Summarization, Bilingual-Web-Book, Synthetic

scope_assumptions.en: Per-operator runtime obtained from sparse profiling and interpolated by a random forest regressor; replica-centric scheduler abstraction (recently critiqued by Frontier as misaligned with disaggregated PD); attention surrogate uses a single proxy sequence length; primarily targets dense Transformer architectures on NVIDIA hardware.
scope_assumptions.zh: 每個 operator 的執行時間以稀疏 profiling 採樣後，再由 random forest regressor 內插得到；scheduler 採 replica-centric 抽象（近期 Frontier 批評此設計與 disaggregated PD 架構不一致）；attention surrogate 僅使用單一 proxy sequence length；主要針對 NVIDIA 硬體上的稠密 Transformer 架構。

title: The Vision Wormhole: Latent-Space Communication in Heterogeneous Multi-Agent Systems
authors: Xiaoze Liu; Ruowang Zhang; Weichen Yu; Siheng Xiong; Liu He; Feijie Wu; Hoin Jung; Matt Fredrikson; Xiaoqian Wang; Jing Gao
affiliations: Purdue University, Contextual AI, Carnegie Mellon University, Georgia Institute of Technology
research_focus: Multimodal serving, Agentic / Workflow serving

problem_statement.en: Text-mediated multi-agent systems incur substantial runtime overhead and information quantization loss, while existing latent-state transfer either assumes homogeneous agents or requires pair-specific translators that scale quadratically across heterogeneous model families.
problem_statement.zh: 以離散文字為媒介的多 agent 系統會產生顯著 runtime 開銷與資訊量化損失；既有 latent-state transfer 方法則假設 agent 同質，或依賴隨異質模型家族數量呈二次成長的 pair-specific translator。

key_innovation.en: Vision Wormhole uses a per-family Universal Visual Codec to compress a sender's latent reasoning trace into a shared reference space, then decodes it as a residual perturbation in the receiver's native vision-token span. Its hub-and-spoke affine alignment reduces multi-family integration complexity from O(N²) pairwise translators to O(N) per-model mappings.
key_innovation.zh: Vision Wormhole 以 per-family Universal Visual Codec 將 sender 的 latent reasoning trace 壓縮至共享 reference space，再解碼為 receiver 原生 vision-token span 中的 residual perturbation。其 hub-and-spoke affine alignment 將多模型家族的整合複雜度由 O(N²) 個 pairwise translator 降至 O(N) 個 per-model mapping。

baselines_compared: TextMAS, LatentMAS-Hybrid, OCR image relay, Single-agent VLM

key_improvements.en: In the main heterogeneous MAS results, Vision Wormhole improves accuracy by up to 26.2 percentage points and provides up to 5.47x wall-clock speedup over TextMAS; it reduces end-to-end runtime in most evaluated settings and yields positive macro-average Δ-accuracy.
key_improvements.zh: 在主要異質 MAS 結果中，Vision Wormhole 相較 TextMAS 的 accuracy 最高提升 26.2 個百分點，wall-clock speedup 最高達 5.47x；多數評測設定的 end-to-end runtime 均縮短，且 macro-average Δ-accuracy 為正。

gpu_count: 1x NVIDIA RTX A6000 (two-backbone runs); 2x NVIDIA RTX A6000 (four-backbone pool)

reuse_metric.en: No explicit reuse rate is reported; across nine reasoning benchmarks, the latent channel yields positive macro-average Δ-accuracy and reduces wall-clock time in most heterogeneous settings.
reuse_metric.zh: 論文未報告明確的 reuse rate；在九項 reasoning benchmark 上，latent channel 的 macro-average Δ-accuracy 為正，且在多數異質設定中縮短 wall-clock time。

title: Efficient Memory Management for Large Language Model Serving with PagedAttention
authors: Woosuk Kwon; Zhuohan Li; Siyuan Zhuang; Ying Sheng; Lianmin Zheng; Cody Hao Yu; Joseph E. Gonzalez; Hao Zhang; Ion Stoica
research_focus: Datacenter networking

problem_statement.en: Existing LLM serving systems suffer from significant memory waste due to internal and external fragmentation of the KV cache, which is stored in contiguous memory and pre-allocated based on maximum sequence lengths. This limits the batch size and overall throughput of LLM serving.
problem_statement.zh: 現有 LLM 服務系統因 KV cache 的內部與外部碎片化而造成嚴重記憶體浪費——KV cache 以連續記憶體儲存並依最大序列長度預先分配，進而限制了 batch size 與整體 throughput。

key_innovation.en: PagedAttention, an attention algorithm that partitions the KV cache into fixed-size blocks and manages them using virtual memory and paging techniques, enabling non-contiguous memory storage and flexible memory sharing.
key_innovation.zh: PagedAttention 是一種 attention 演算法，將 KV cache 切分為固定大小的 block，並以虛擬記憶體與分頁技術加以管理，實現非連續記憶體儲存與靈活的記憶體共享。

key_improvements.en: 2-4x throughput increase, near-zero KV cache memory waste, and significant memory savings through sharing (up to 55% in beam search).
key_improvements.zh: throughput 提升 2-4x，KV cache 記憶體浪費趨近於零，並透過共享實現顯著的記憶體節省（beam search 場景下最高節省 55%）。

ai_task: LLM Serving, Parallel Sampling, Beam Search, Shared Prefix, Chatbot

title: When KV Cache Reuse Fails in Multi-Agent Systems: Cross-Candidate Interaction is Crucial for LLM Judges
authors: Sichu Liang; Zhenglin Wang; Jiajia Chu; Pengfei Xia; Hui Zang; Deyu Zhou
research_focus: LLM serving, Long-context / Prefix cache, Agentic / Workflow serving

problem_statement.en: Multi-agent LLM pipelines increasingly reuse KV caches across partially shared contexts to cut prefill cost, but these strategies are validated only for execution agents. Whether judge-side reuse preserves the behavior of LLM judges that must jointly compare multiple candidates within a single context remains unexamined.
problem_statement.zh: 多 agent LLM 管線普遍藉由跨部分共享 context 的 KV cache 重用來降低 prefill 成本，但既有策略僅在 execution agent 上驗證。對必須在單一 context 內聯合比較多個候選答案的 LLM judge 而言，judge 端重用是否保持決策行為不變仍未被檢驗。

key_innovation.en: A judge-centric diagnostic of KV cache reuse: introduces the Judge Consistency Rate (JCR) metric to quantify decision non-invariance relative to dense prefill, uses attention analysis and a cross-candidate attention-masking ablation to attribute failures to disrupted cross-candidate interaction, and develops PAL-KV (pooled-anchor lookup reuse) as a probe ruling out agent identity as the dominant bottleneck.
key_innovation.zh: 以 judge 為中心的 KV cache 重用診斷：提出 Judge Consistency Rate (JCR) 指標，量化相對於 dense prefill 的決策非不變性；透過 attention 分析與跨候選 attention 遮蔽消融，將失效歸因於跨候選互動被破壞；並設計 PAL-KV（pooled-anchor lookup 重用）作為探針，排除 agent 身分是主要瓶頸的假設。

baselines_compared: Dense Prefill, Naïve Reuse (position-only), KVCOMM, PAL-KV

key_improvements.en: Diagnostic findings rather than speedups: reuse methods keep task accuracy roughly stable while JCR falls far below 100% (dropping up to ~38 more points under shuffled candidate order); masking cross-candidate attention collapses JCR to ~22-32% with little accuracy change; a classifier detecting universally reuse-safe instances reaches AUC 0.82.
key_improvements.zh: 診斷性結果而非加速：各重用方法大致維持任務準確率，但 JCR 遠低於 100%（候選順序 shuffle 下最多再降約 38 點）；遮蔽跨候選 attention 使 JCR 驟降至約 22-32% 而準確率變化甚微；偵測普遍可安全重用實例的分類器達 AUC 0.82。

title: When Latent Agents Lie: KV-Cache Integrity in Multi-Agent LLM Collaboration
authors: Luís Brito; Carlos Baquero
affiliations: Politécnico de Viana do Castelo, Universidade do Porto
research_focus: Agentic / Workflow serving

problem_statement.en: Full-KV latent collaboration lets specialists pass useful hidden evidence to a coordinator, but the opaque transported KV state can be maliciously substituted or manipulated while its visible commitment remains plausible. Text-only verification therefore cannot establish KV-transport integrity.
problem_statement.zh: full-KV latent collaboration 使 specialist 能將有用的 hidden evidence 傳至 coordinator；然而，即使 visible commitment 仍看似合理，不透明的 transported KV state 也可能遭惡意替換或操控。因此，僅依賴 text 的 verifier 無法確立 KV-transport integrity。

key_innovation.en: A role-sequenced planner–specialist–verifier–coordinator protocol audits full-KV handoffs under malicious specialists and adds an HMAC-SHA256 transport manifest binding specialist/session/model identity, the visible-commitment hash, tensor metadata, and the payload digest. After an integrity-check failure, the coordinator fail-closes by dropping the KV or downgrading that specialist to visible text.
key_innovation.zh: 提出依序串接 planner–specialist–verifier–coordinator 的 protocol，用以在 malicious specialist 情境下稽核 full-KV handoff，並以 HMAC-SHA256 transport manifest 綁定 specialist/session/model identity、visible-commitment hash、tensor metadata 與 payload digest。integrity check 失敗後，coordinator 採 fail-closed policy，捨棄該 KV 或將該 specialist 降級為 visible text。

baselines_compared: Local-only agents, Independent majority, Full-evidence oracle, Text role collaboration, Verifier-filtered full-KV latent collaboration

key_improvements.en: On Qwen3-4B HiddenBench, full-KV collaboration raises observed EM/F1 from 0.231/0.369 to 0.338/0.486 and reduces estimated parallel critical-path latency from 3.009 s to 2.379 s, at a mean KV-transfer cost of 279.03 MB per example. The HMAC gate accepts 774/774 honest replayed payloads and rejects 295/295 tampered payloads; fail-closed drop reaches EM/F1 0.338/0.476 after detected failure.
key_improvements.zh: 在 Qwen3-4B HiddenBench 上，full-KV collaboration 的觀測 EM/F1 由 0.231/0.369 提升至 0.338/0.486，估計的 parallel critical-path latency 由 3.009 s 降至 2.379 s；每筆樣本平均需傳輸 279.03 MB KV。HMAC gate 接受 774/774 個 honest replay payload，並拒絕 295/295 個 tampered payload；偵測到 failure 後，fail-closed drop 的 EM/F1 達 0.338/0.476。

gpu_count: 1x NVIDIA L40S (remote HotPotQA); local GPU count Not Specified
safety_integrity: Tamper integrity, Poisoning / injection, Access control / provenance

reuse_metric.en: Full-KV latent collaboration achieves EM/F1 0.338/0.486 on 65 Qwen3-4B HiddenBench records, versus 0.231/0.369 for matched text collaboration; it requires 279.03 MB mean KV transfer per example.
reuse_metric.zh: 在 65 筆 Qwen3-4B HiddenBench 樣本上，full-KV latent collaboration 的 EM/F1 達 0.338/0.486，相較 matched text collaboration 為 0.231/0.369；每筆樣本平均需傳輸 279.03 MB KV。

title: Why we should train AI in space
authors: Adi Oltean; Philip Johnston
research_focus: Datacenter networking, Energy / Carbon

problem_statement.en: Terrestrial data centers face severe energy supply constraints, permitting bottlenecks, and cooling limitations that hinder the scaling of gigawatt-sized AI training clusters.
problem_statement.zh: 地面資料中心面臨嚴峻的能源供應限制、許可審批瓶頸與散熱限制，阻礙了 GW 級 AI 訓練叢集的規模擴展。

key_innovation.en: Orbital data centers utilizing high-intensity 24/7 solar power, passive radiative cooling in deep space, and modular, scalable compute containers deployed via heavy-lift launch vehicles.
key_innovation.zh: 軌道資料中心方案：利用高強度全天候太陽能、深太空被動輻射散熱，以及透過重型運載火箭部署的模組化可擴展計算容器。

key_improvements.en: Energy costs reduced to ~$0.002/kWh, 95%+ solar capacity factor, elimination of fresh water usage for cooling, and removal of terrestrial permitting constraints.
key_improvements.zh: 能源成本降至約 $0.002/kWh，太陽能容量係數超過 95%，散熱完全無需淡水，且徹底免除地面許可審批限制。

title: A Queueing Theoretic Perspective on Low-Latency LLM Inference with Variable Token Length
authors: Yuqing Yang; Lei Jiao; Yuedong Xu
research_focus: Multi-tenant scheduling, Continuous batching, Capacity planning, Performance modeling, Queueing theory

problem_statement.en: LLM inference platforms suffer high queueing delay because output token length is heavy-tailed and the max-token-clipping limit plus batching configuration jointly determine the end-to-end service delay, yet there is no closed-form queueing analysis for these knobs.
problem_statement.zh: LLM 推理平台因輸出 token 長度具重尾分佈，且 max-token-clipping 與批次設定共同決定端到端服務延遲，卻缺乏針對這些參數的封閉解 queueing 分析，導致排隊延遲偏高。

key_innovation.en: Closed-form M/G/1 queueing model for single-request inference under max-token clipping, and bulk-service queueing models for dynamic, fixed, and elastic batching that derive tight upper bounds on mean queueing delay and yield the optimal max-token limit and batch size as functions of arrival rate and output-length distribution.
key_innovation.zh: 對 max-token-clipping 下的單一請求推理，給出 M/G/1 的封閉解；對 dynamic、fixed 與 elastic 批次推理，建立 bulk-service queue 模型，推導平均排隊延遲的緊上界，並以到達率與輸出長度分佈導出最佳 max-token 上限與批次大小。

baselines_compared: Dynamic batching, Fixed batching, Elastic batching

key_improvements.en: Optimal max-token limit of 1300 (with user impatience) reduces mean queueing delay by 58.93 percent and lost-user fraction by 56.36 percent versus n_max=3000 on LLaMA-2-7b-chat. Elastic batching attains the minimum mean queueing delay across batching strategies for both light-tailed and heavy-tailed output distributions.
key_improvements.zh: 在 LLaMA-2-7b-chat 上，考慮使用者不耐心的最佳 max-token 上限為 1300，相較 n_max=3000 可降低平均排隊延遲 58.93%、降低流失使用者比例 56.36%。Elastic batching 在 light-tailed 與 heavy-tailed 輸出分佈下皆能取得最低平均排隊延遲。

reported_accuracy: Mathematical bounds match MATLAB event-driven simulations across all reported configurations
validation_workloads: Instruction-in-Wild dataset, Synthetic (uniform/Gaussian/log-normal output lengths)

scope_assumptions.en: Assumes Poisson arrivals and FCFS scheduling. Single-server M/G/1 setting; bulk-service models assume known output-length distribution (uniform, truncated Gaussian, or log-normal) and that single-request latency is approximately linear in output token count. Heavy-tailed analysis requires light- vs heavy-tail distinction known in advance.
scope_assumptions.zh: 假設 Poisson 到達與 FCFS scheduling，採單伺服器 M/G/1 設定；bulk-service 模型假設輸出長度分佈已知（uniform、truncated Gaussian 或 log-normal），且單一請求延遲對輸出 token 數近似線性。重尾分析需事先區分 light-tail 與 heavy-tail。

title: ZipServ: Fast and Memory-Efficient LLM Inference with Hardware-Aware Lossless Compression
authors: Ruibo Fan; Xiangrui Yu; Xinglin Pan; Zeyu Li; Weile Luo; Qiang Wang; Wei Wang; Xiaowen Chu
venue_full: ACM International Conference on Architectural Support for Programming Languages and Operating Systems (ASPLOS 2026)
affiliations: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou); Harbin Institute of Technology, Shenzhen; Hong Kong University of Science and Technology
research_focus: LLM serving, Performance modeling, Roofline analysis, Hardware co-design, GPU memory tiering

problem_statement.en: Lossless compression can reduce model memory footprint and bandwidth demand, but conventional entropy codecs are poorly matched to GPU inference: variable-length bitstreams break SIMT parallelism and decoupled decompression creates extra memory traffic.
problem_statement.zh: Lossless compression 可降低模型記憶體占用與 bandwidth demand，但傳統 entropy codec 不適合 GPU inference：variable-length bitstream 破壞 SIMT parallelism，而分離式 decompression 會產生額外 memory traffic。

key_innovation.en: ZipServ co-designs a fixed-length Tensor-Core-Aware Triple Bitmap Encoding format with ZipGEMM, a fused decompression-GEMM kernel. The kernel loads compressed weights, reconstructs them directly into Tensor Core registers, and computes without intermediate buffers; the system uses stage-aware integration to avoid slowing compute-bound prefill.
key_innovation.zh: ZipServ 將固定長度的 Tensor-Core-Aware Triple Bitmap Encoding 與 fused decompression-GEMM kernel ZipGEMM 協同設計。Kernel 載入壓縮權重後直接在 Tensor Core register 中重建並計算，不產生中間 buffer；系統端用 stage-aware integration 避免拖慢 compute-bound prefill。

baselines_compared: cuBLAS Tensor Core GEMM, DietGPU, nvCOMP, DFloat11, vLLM, Transformers

key_improvements.en: Reduces model size by up to 30%, achieves up to 2.21x kernel-level speedup over cuBLAS, and improves end-to-end inference by 1.22x on average over vLLM. Reported memory savings reduce LLaMA3.1-8B weights from 14.96 GB to 10.83 GB and LLaMA3.1-70B from 131.56 GB to 93.52 GB.
key_improvements.zh: 模型大小最高降低 30%，kernel-level 相較 cuBLAS 最高加速 2.21x，端到端相較 vLLM 平均加速 1.22x。記憶體節省方面，LLaMA3.1-8B 權重由 14.96 GB 降至 10.83 GB，LLaMA3.1-70B 由 131.56 GB 降至 93.52 GB。

compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA RTX4090, NVIDIA L40S, NVIDIA RTX5090, NVIDIA A100, NVIDIA H800
gpu_count: 1x RTX4090; 2x L40S; 4x L40S; RTX5090 single-GPU kernel experiments
reported_accuracy: Not Reported (compression/kernel system; reports memory savings, kernel speedup, and end-to-end latency/throughput rather than predictor error)
models_validated: LLaMA3.1-8B, LLaMA3.1-70B, LLaMA3.1-405B, Qwen2.5-7B, Qwen2.5-14B, Qwen2.5-32B, Qwen2.5-72B, Gemma3-12B, Gemma3-27B, Mistral-24B, Mistral-123B
validation_workloads: Synthetic GEMM/model-layer workloads; end-to-end LLaMA and Mistral decoding workloads

scope_assumptions.en: ZipServ assumes weight values can be compressed losslessly into the proposed fixed-length bitmap format with sufficient density gains. It changes GEMM memory-traffic and compute-intensity assumptions, but does not address KV-cache compression, request scheduling, or framework overhead.
scope_assumptions.zh: ZipServ 假設權重值能以所提出的固定長度 bitmap format 進行 lossless compression 並取得足夠 density gains。它改變 GEMM memory traffic 與 compute intensity 假設，但不處理 KV-cache compression、request scheduling 或 framework overhead。
